day_to_day.name: Aga no Sato Agarina Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_en: Aga no Sato Agarina Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 阿賀の里 あがりーな
day_to_day.description: Indoor all-weather play facility at Aga no Sato roadside station, with wooden slides, net play equipment, and a digital sandbox.

day_to_day.name: Michi-no-Eki Mikawa (Village of Giant Trees)
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 「みかわ（巨木の里）」（国道49号）
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Aga Town selling local vegetables and serving tofu dishes made with Yakushi spring water at its attached factory.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Aga no Sato
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 阿賀の里
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Aga Town with a shop selling local specialties and seasonal vegetables, plus meals such as onigiri, ramen, and sweets.

day_to_day.name: Kamikawa Produce Direct Sales Shop
day_to_day.name_ja: かみかわ物産直売所
day_to_day.description: Shop in Kamikawa, Aga Town, selling locally harvested vegetables, wild plants, and mushrooms.

activities.name: Kanose Akayu Hot Spring
activities.name_ja: かのせ温泉 赤湯
activities.description: Town-run day-trip hot spring in Kanose, Aga, with iron-rich reddish-brown water from a 59°C source and a forest-surrounded semi-outdoor bath.

activities.name: Kiyokawa Highland Recreation Center (Tsugawa Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 津川温泉 清川高原保養センター
activities.description: Day-use alkaline simple hot spring heated with local wood pellets, opposite a complex with a coworking space and book cafe.

activities.name: Mikagura-so (Mikagura Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 御神楽温泉 みかぐら荘
activities.description: A day-use hot spring at the foot of Mount Mikagura, with a large bath of big windows and an open feel.

activities.name: Shichifuku-so Hot Spring
activities.name_ja: 七福温泉 七福荘
activities.description: Cedar hot-spring inn in Nana, Aga, enshrining the Seven Lucky Gods, with soba-making and a cold sulfur spring.

activities.name: Kirinzan Sake Brewery (Kirinzan Traditional Dry)
activities.name_ja: 麒麟山酒造（株）
activities.description: A sake brewery in Aga Town making dry sake since 1843 with rice it grows and clear water.

activities.name: Mikawa Onsen Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 三川温泉スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort in Aga with 10 courses from beginner to advanced, snowboarding throughout, and a 38-degree mogul run.

activities.name: Mikagura Onsen
activities.name_ja: 御神楽温泉
activities.description: Hot-spring area at the foot of Mt. Mikagura with two facilities, including day-trip Mikagura-so, and a weak sodium sulfate spring.

food.name: Ashi Sawa Kogen Habaru Park
food.name_ja: 芦沢高原ハーバルパーク

food.name: Aizu-ya Agano Kawa SA Outbound
food.name_ja: 会津屋 阿賀野川SA下り線

food.name: Tokutoku Agano Kawa Service Area
food.name_ja: とくとく 阿賀野川サービスエリア店

food.name: Michi no Eki Aga no Sato
food.name_en: Michi no Eki Aga no Sato

food.name: Kirindo
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Aga, Niigata.

food.name: Rinzando
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Aga, Niigata.

sights.name: Kushima Orchard (Chestnut Picking)
sights.description: A flat chestnut orchard of about four hectares at the entrance to Aga’s Kamikawa area, where visitors pick reputedly sweet chestnuts and can make chestnut rice or sweets.

sights.name: Tsunogami Lakeside Youth Travel Village
sights.name_ja: 角神湖畔青少年旅行村
sights.description: A youth travel village in a wide, quiet forest by Tsunogami Lake, with cottages, bungalows, tent sites, a hot spring, hiking, and birdwatching.

sights.name: Tsugawa Fox Wedding Procession
sights.name_ja: つがわ狐の嫁入り行列
sights.description: An Edo-period wedding reenactment in Tsugawa, Aga, in which a fox-makeup bride in white walks from evening into night by torch and lantern light.

sights.name: Mikawa Tourist Mushroom Garden
sights.description: A mushroom garden in Aga where visitors pick cultivated mushrooms and can barbecue or dine.

sights.name: Agano River Line Sightseeing Boat
sights.name_ja: 阿賀野川ライン遊覧船
sights.description: A roughly 40-minute sightseeing cruise on the Agano River views the varied Oku-Aga gorge, one of Japan's 100 scenic views, with a boatman guide.

sights.name: Shogun Cedar
sights.description: A giant cedar at Byodo-ji Temple, 40 m tall with a 19.31 m trunk, said to mark the burial of Taira no Koreshige.

sights.name: Mikawa Tourist Fish Weir
sights.description: A summer fish weir on the Shintani River, a tributary of the Agano River, where visitors can eat sweetfish caught there.

sights.name: Ashizawa Highland Herbal Park
sights.name_ja: 芦沢高原ハーバルパーク
sights.description: A three-hectare garden amid rich nature, planted mainly with lavender and other herbs, where seasonal flowers are fragrant and a workshop offers herb-soap making.

sights.name: Nakanosawa Valley Forest Park
sights.description: Traditional riverside forest campsite with 60 tent sites, trails among 100 tree species, and activities such as fishing, hiking, and firefly viewing.

sights.name: Kirinzan Park
sights.description: An 11-hectare park in Aga with about 100 cherry trees, Kirinzan Castle ruins, and a riverbed swimming area by the Tokonami River.

sights.name: Takigashira Wetland
sights.description: An artificial wetland in Aga where visitors can see seasonal wetland plants, birds, dozens of dragonfly species, early-summer fireflies, and autumn leaves on the Kamoshika Trail.

sights.name: Fox Wedding House
sights.description: A free hands-on facility in Aga themed on the Tsugawa fox-wedding procession, with mask painting, crafts, and Agano River views.

sights.name: Agano River Line Autumn Foliage
sights.name_ja: 阿賀野川ラインの紅葉
sights.description: Autumn foliage along the Agano River, seen from the riverside national road and also from boat rides or the steam locomotive.

sights.name: Oku-Aga Hometown Hall
sights.name_ja: 奥阿賀ふるさと館（休館中）
sights.description: A facility of three boxes in Aga offering electricity experiments, 3D washi TAMAGO making, and washi lighting displays.

sights.name: Mount Kirin (Kanose Trailhead)
sights.description: Beginner trail to 195 m Mount Kirin passes earthworks and stone walls of Tsugawa Castle and overlooks the Agano River.

sights.name: Kirinzan Park
sights.description: A quiet park overlooking the Jōnai River and Mount Kirin, with spring cherry blossoms, summer camping, and autumn foliage.

sights.name: Mount Iide (Jitsukawa Trailhead)
sights.description: Advanced trail to 2,105 m Mount Iide, known for alpine flower fields and main-ridge views, taking about 10 hours 30 minutes to the summit.

sights.name: Tsunogami Snow Camellia Garden
sights.description: A garden near Kanose Dam on the Agano River’s left bank protects and grows native snow camellias, peaking in mid-April.

sights.name: Gokuraku-ji Nonaka Cherry Tree
sights.description: A deep-crimson, large-flowered cherry at Gokuraku-ji, a wild beni-yamazakura variant designated a national natural monument.

sights.name: Aga Town Guided Town Walk
sights.name_ja: 阿賀町観光ガイドと町歩き
sights.description: Guides lead about 90-minute walks through former river-port Tsugawa on historic river-port, food-and-alleys, and Kirinzan courses.

sights.name: Yakushi Spring
sights.name_ja: 薬師清水（やくししみず）
sights.description: A spring at the center of Agano River Line Prefectural Natural Park, flowing about 11 tons a minute at 12°C near Yakushi Hall and Shogun Cedar.

sights.name: Hoshun-en (Snow Camellia Garden)
sights.description: Snow-camellia garden at Kirinzan Onsen in Aga, where about 2,000 cultivated camellias and cherry trees bloom.

sights.name: Mt. Mikagura (Muroya Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 御神楽岳・室谷登山口
sights.description: A 1,386 m mountain where kagura offered to the gods can be heard, with an intermediate four-hour hike and no hut.

sights.name: Meotozakura (Couple Cherry Trees)
sights.description: Two cherry trees that can look like one from some angles, a photo spot against mountains with lingering snow.

sights.name: Konpira Spring
sights.name_ja: 琴平清水（こんぴらしみず）
sights.description: A spring in Tsugawa, Aga, with abundant water, a tank bottom curved by long use, and cleaning by local volunteers.

sights.name: Obi Fudo Falls
sights.description: A waterfall of about 15 meters on the forest road to Takigashira Marsh, set among seasonal natural scenery.

sights.name: Aga Hina Doll Tour
sights.description: Hina-doll tour in Aga Town, with seven doll sets at Roadside Station Aga no Sato and other sites, including the Fox’s Wedding House.

sights.name: Ura-Gozu Nakanosawa Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 裏五頭・中ノ沢登山口
sights.description: Nakanosawa trailhead for Ura-Gozu, the Aga Town side of Mount Gozu; an intermediate climb of about four hours to the 912 m summit, with no mountain hut.

sights.name: Marubuchi Bracken Garden (Warabi Picking)
sights.description: Visitors harvest fresh bracken in season at this 10-hectare garden in Aga, for salting, tempura, or miso soup.

sights.name: Hojusan (Ishima Trailhead)
sights.description: Beginner trail from Ishima to the 559 m summit, about 2 hours 30 minutes, season late May to November, with no mountain hut.

sights.name: Hishigatake (Ishido Trailhead)
sights.description: Intermediate trail from Ishido to the 974 m summit, about 3 hours 40 minutes, season late May to November, with no mountain hut.

sights.name: Katsura Spring
sights.description: A bedrock spring beside the Agano River among centuries-old zelkova and beech, yielding 100 tons of 11°C water daily; the access road is currently collapsed.

sights.name: Mount Nihondaira (Yazawa Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 日本平山・谷沢登山口
sights.description: A 1,081-meter mountain with a gentle summit ridge marking the boundary between two districts; about 4 hours 30 minutes from Yazawa, with no hut.

sights.name: Kosegasawa Cave
sights.description: A cave formed by a rhyolite fissure, dating to the Incipient Jomon about 9,000 years ago, where pottery and over a thousand stone tools were found.

sights.name: Mt. Higura (Igashima Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 日倉山・五十島登山口
sights.description: An 843 m peak for intermediate hikers, about four hours from the Igashima trailhead to the summit, with no mountain hut.

sights.name: Muroya Cave
sights.description: A cave formed by lateral erosion beside the Tokonami River, a tributary of the Agano, yielding Jomon tools, pottery, and a flexed female burial.

sights.name: Jomon Spring
sights.description: A spring along National Route 459 beside the Agano River, used by locals for rest and drinking, with stable year-round water.

sights.name: Mount Umanokami (Tsunagi Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 馬ノ髪山・綱木登山口
sights.description: A 757-meter peak at the end of a long ridge, with many natural cedars along the trail; about 2 hours 30 minutes to the summit and no hut.

sights.name: Wooden Standing Kongorikishi Statues at Nishiyama Nikko-ji
sights.name_en: Wooden Standing Kongorikishi Statues at Nishiyama Nikko-ji
sights.name_ja: 西山日光寺「木造金剛力士立像」
sights.description: A pair of Agyo and Ungyo Nio statues in the gate of Nishiyama Nikko-ji, with restrained movement and gentle robe carving from the Kamakura period.

sights.name: Nonaka Cherry at Gokurakuji Temple
sights.description: A wild Beniyamazakura cherry variant in the grounds of Gokurakuji Temple, a national natural monument flowering deep crimson since the early Showa era.

sights.name: Kaneyoshi Doburoku
sights.description: Doburoku brewed with water and rice from Kamikawa, with a mild sweetness, slight acidity, and a fragrant rustic flavor.

stays.name: Kirinzan Onsen Painter's Inn Fukusen
stays.name_ja: 麒麟山温泉 絵かきの宿 福泉
stays.description: Inn at Kirinyama Onsen in Kase, Aga.

stays.name: Ura Gozu Sanso
stays.name_ja: 裏五頭山荘
stays.description: Mountain lodge in Aga, Niigata.

stays.name: Ekaki no Yado Fukusen
stays.name_ja: 絵かきの宿 福泉
stays.description: Inn in Kanose, Aga.

stays.name: Yukitsubaki no Yado Furusawaya
stays.name_ja: 雪つばきの宿 古澤屋
stays.description: Inn with 12 guest rooms and a private open-air bath in Kanose, Aga.

stays.name: Tsunogami Onsen Hotel Tsunogami
stays.name_ja: 角神温泉 和みのリゾート ホテル角神
stays.description: Hotel in Kanose, Aga.

stays.name: Buna no Yado Koase
stays.name_ja: ブナの宿 小会瀬-koase-
stays.description: Five-room inn with a hot spring open-air bath in a beech forest in Hirotani, Aga.

stays.name: Mikawa Onsen Shinkaiso
stays.name_ja: 三川温泉 新かい荘
stays.description: Inn with a natural hot spring bath in Higashikanbara, Aga.

stays.name: Tsugawa Onsen Kiyokawa Kogen Hoyo Senta
stays.name_en: Tsugawa Onsen Kiyokawa Kogen Hoyo Senta
stays.name_ja: 津川温泉 清川高原保養センター
stays.description: Inn without meals, with a pH 9.3 hot spring bath in Higashikanbara, Aga.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Agano
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 「あがの」
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Agano City selling seasonal produce, prepared foods, and local-milk sweets, with a lawn playground and indoor playroom.

activities.name: Kahoji no Yu Hot Spring Bath
activities.name_en: Kahoji no Yu Hot Spring Bath
activities.name_ja: 華報寺の湯
activities.description: Hot spring bath in Deyu Onsen, Agano, with lukewarm water linked to the Kobo Daishi legend.

activities.name: Deyu Onsen (Gozu Hot Springs)
activities.name_ja: 出湯温泉（五頭温泉郷）
activities.description: Hot-spring area in Agano opened 1,200 years ago, legendarily made to flow when Kobo Daishi struck the ground with his staff.

activities.name: Yakushi-no-Yu Communal Bath
activities.name_ja: 共同浴場薬師の湯
activities.description: Source spring of Murasugi Onsen, known as a child-blessing bath, with jet, bubble, and sole-massage baths behind the communal bath.

activities.name: Murasugi Onsen (Gozu Hot Springs)
activities.name_ja: 村杉温泉（五頭温泉郷）
activities.description: Radium-rich hot spring in Agano, traditionally found after an oracle from Yakushi Nyorai and long known as Kodakara no Yu.

activities.name: Yasuda Onsen Yasuragi
activities.name_ja: 安田温泉 保養センターやすらぎ
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring in Agano at the foot of the Gozu mountains, with a sodium chloride spring said to be about 27 times standard concentration.

activities.name: Acorn Forest Campground
activities.name_ja: どんぐりの森 キャンプ場
activities.description: Campground surrounded by acorn trees at the Mount Gozu Sannomine course trailhead, with 20 tent sites but no drinking water.

activities.name: Akamatsuyama Forest Park Campground
activities.name_ja: 赤松山森林公園キャンプ場
activities.description: A forest-park campground beside Hoju Onsen Akamatsu-so, set in preserved Yasuda greenery, with hiking, camping, outdoor cooking and a hilltop gazebo that looks toward Sado in clear weather.

activities.name: Koshitsukano Sake Brewery (Yoyoizumi)
activities.name_ja: 越つかの酒造（株）
activities.description: Sake brewery in Agano still using the original Tsukano Shuzo building, with reserved tours and tastings.

activities.name: Oku-Murasugi Campground
activities.name_ja: 奥村杉キャンプ場
activities.description: A campground on the Yasuno River’s left bank, inland from Murasugi Onsen town, with a cooking area and toilets, drive-in access and spots to play in the river.

activities.name: Hyoko Lakeside Wind Chime Festival
activities.name_ja: 瓢湖畔風鈴まつり
activities.description: Summer wind-chime festival at Suibara Hachimangu Shrine beside Lake Hyoko, with ceramic chimes made from Agano clay and a photo bench.

activities.name: Echigo Zakura Sake Brewery (Daiginjo Echigo Zakura)
activities.name_en: Echigo Zakura Sake Brewery (Daiginjo Echigo Zakura)
activities.name_ja: 越後桜酒造（株）
activities.description: Sake brewery offering fresh-pressed sake tastings, brewery-exclusive shopping, and 360-degree VR tours of areas not usually open to visitors.

activities.name: Hakuryu Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: 白龍酒造（株）
activities.description: Sake brewery in Agano City that has made sake for 160 years near Lake Hyoko, known for swans.

activities.name: Kawaraza Theater (Yasuda Onsen Yasuragi)
activities.name_ja: 劇場「かわら座」（安田温泉やすらぎ） ※営業日等は公式サイトhttp://yasudaonsen.com/でご確認ください。
activities.description: Theater at the Yasuda Onsen Yasuragi facility in Agano.

activities.name: Yasuda Roof Tile Breaking Experience
activities.name_ja: 安田瓦を割る体験
activities.description: Experience throwing or karate-splitting sturdy Yasuda roof tiles, with gloves and helmets provided.

food.name_ja: ブック&カフェ コティ

food.name: Aichaku Coffee Deyu Onsen Kissashitsu
food.name_ja: 愛着珈琲出湯温泉喫茶室

food.name: Aga no Shokudo Nigirimanma
food.name_ja: あがの食堂にぎりまんま

food.name: Chuka Kobo Shohei
food.description: Chinese or Asian restaurant in Agano.

food.name: Taiwanese Hyakufuku En
food.description: Chinese or Asian restaurant in Agano.

food.name: Hyoko Yashiki no Mori Brewery The Restaurant Swan Lake
food.name_en: Hyoko Yashiki no Mori Brewery The Restaurant Swan Lake
food.name_ja: 瓢湖屋敷の杜ブルワリー ザ レストランスワンレイク

food.name: Ramen To Hisago
food.name_ja: ラーメン党 ひさご

food.name: Yurari Yura Mizutori no Yado Sakihana
food.name_en: Yurari Yura Mizutori no Yado Sakihana
food.name_ja: ゆらりゆら 水鳥の宿 さきはな

food.name: Ikarashi Tei Garden
food.name_ja: 五十嵐邸 ガーデン

food.name: Mirupasu
food.description: Gelato and ice-cream shop in Agano, Niigata.

sights.name: Hyoko Waterfowl Park
sights.description: A Ramsar wetland park in Agano where swans winter from early October to late March, with about 5,000 birds at the late-November peak.

sights.name: Asaiino Shrine
sights.description: A 1,700-year-old shrine in Sasakami, Agano, dedicated to Hondawake-no-Mikoto, with a round sacred stone visitors touch for happiness.

sights.name: Suntopia World
sights.description: Amusement park in Agano with about 30 attractions, including a dinosaur roller coaster and a large Ferris wheel, plus an indoor play area.

sights.name: Deyu Communal Bath
sights.description: A communal bath in Deyu, locally called Shin-yu, offering a retro atmosphere and 100 percent free-flowing spring water.

sights.name: Hojusan and Akamatsuyama Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 宝珠山・赤松山登山口
sights.description: Beginner trailhead for 559 m Hojusan in Agano; the summit takes about two hours, and Hoju Onsen Akamatsuso is at the foot.

sights.name: Urara no Mori Information Center (Mount Gozu Foothills)
sights.name_en: Urara no Mori Information Center (Mount Gozu Foothills)
sights.name_ja: 五頭山麓うららの森 情報発信館
sights.description: A food and greenery zone with produce sales, tourism and hot-spring information, bamboo, pottery and tofu-making experiences, coffee, souvenirs, and a lawn.

sights.name: Kojunji Temple (Former Saito Residence)
sights.description: A Shinshu Otani-sect temple in the former Saito mansion, linked to Shinran's three-crop chestnut wonder and set in a pond-stroll garden.

sights.name: Yasuda Roof Tile Road
sights.name_ja: やすだ瓦ロード（安田瓦協同組合）
sights.description: Street among Yasuda tile factories in Agano, lined with some 10,000 tile decorations, onigawara art, and brick chimneys.

sights.name: Fromage Cellar (Yasuda Yogurt)
sights.name_ja: ヤスダヨーグルト チーズ専門店「フロマージュセラー」
sights.description: Cheese shop by Yasuda Yogurt inside Y&Y Garden in Agano, offering cheese chips, cream-cheese omelettes, natural cheeses and cheesecakes.

sights.name: Hyoko Yashiki-no-Mori Brewery (Swan Lake Beer)
sights.name_ja: 瓢湖屋敷の杜ブルワリー
sights.description: Beer brewery opened in 1997 in the former Igarashi residence near Lake Hyoko, where visitors can see the garden and brewing.

sights.name: Mount Gozu Foothills Recreation Forest
sights.description: Campground in more than 50 hectares of red pine and mixed forest along the Oarakawa stream, with a terraced river easy for small children.

sights.name: Hachibei Sunflower Field
sights.description: Sunflower field managed by the Hachibei apiary, with about two hectares of sunflowers and rapeseed planted as bee forage.

sights.name: Yasuda Yogurt
sights.description: Drinkable yogurt maker in Agano offering advance-booked factory tours through glass windows, with a direct shop and cafe opposite.

sights.name: Yasuda Castle Ruins
sights.description: Castle ruins, now a traffic park, retain part of the Hori-period main and second baileys and a castle town facing the southwest highway.

sights.name: Yoshida Togo Memorial Museum
sights.description: Museum in the birthplace of Yoshida Togo, pioneer of Japanese historical geography, who compiled the Dai Nihon Chimei Jisho in 13 years.

sights.name: Yasuda Kowa Noji Strawberry Orchard
sights.name_ja: 安田興和農事イチゴ園
sights.description: Strawberry orchard.

sights.name: Hyoko Iris Garden
sights.description: Iris garden in Agano that reaches peak bloom around mid-June, with an iris festival and lanterns in the grounds.

sights.name: Uodome Falls
sights.description: An 8-metre waterfall in Gozu Renpo Prefectural Natural Park, with trailheads to Mount Wasabi and Mount Matsudaira and a viewpoint near the plunge pool.

sights.name: Juzukake Cherry Tree at Baigo-ji Temple
sights.name_en: Juzukake Cherry Tree at Baigo-ji Temple
sights.name_ja: 梅護寺の珠数掛ザクラ
sights.description: A cherry tree at Baigo-ji Temple, one of the Seven Wonders of Echigo, whose flowers are said to hang in chains like prayer beads.

sights.name: Suibara Magistrate's Office
sights.description: Magistrate's office restored in August 1995 from the former floor plan, including a tax and civil office and a court for questioning criminals.

sights.name: Hyoko Waterfowl Park
sights.description: A waterfowl park designated a national natural monument, where visitors can feed swans and ducks that come close in winter.

sights.name: Iwase Clear Spring
sights.name_ja: 岩瀬の清水（いわせのしみず）
sights.description: Spring of constant temperature beside Sasaoka Elementary School, with a nearby pavilion, used by children since 1903 and designated a city cultural property.

sights.name: 5yukuri
sights.description: Private Finnish barrel sauna in a villa, where guests pour aroma or plain water on the stones, with a pool lit by LEDs after sunset and optional BBQ.

sights.name: Mirupasu Soft-Serve and Gelato Shop
sights.name_ja: ソフトクリーム＆ジェラートショップ みるぱす
sights.description: Gelato shop in Agano with six daily flavors made from Kanda Dairy raw milk and local vegetables and fruit.

sights.name: Shin-e Cherry Blossom Avenue
sights.description: A 4.6-kilometre avenue of 550 Somei-Yoshino cherry trees along the Shin-e irrigation canal, planted by town residents in 1980.

sights.name: Yatsufusa Plum Tree at Baigo-ji Temple
sights.name_en: Yatsufusa Plum Tree at Baigo-ji Temple
sights.description: A plum tree at Baigo-ji Temple, one of the Seven Wonders of Echigo, said to bear pale-pink double blossoms and fruit in groups of eight.

sights.name: Kahoji Temple
sights.description: A temple housing a statue Gyoki carved from sacred Mount Gozu wood, a place of Uba-son worship with monuments to Sasaki Shodo and Soma Gyofu.

sights.name: Sasakami Gozu Golf Club
sights.name_ja: 笹神五頭ゴルフ倶楽部
sights.description: A 27-hole golf course on gentle hills at the foot of Mount Gozu, with views of the Agano River, Echigo Plain, and Sado.

sights.name: Yamaguchi Kanzan Memorial Monument
sights.description: A monument honoring Yamaguchi Kanzan, a late-Edo wasan mathematician from former Suibara who traveled across Japan several times.

sights.name: Yasuda Ware
sights.description: Pottery ranging from everyday utensils to craft works; hands-on experiences require advance contact.

sights.name: Yamabiko Road
sights.description: A forest road of about 5 km lined with more than 250 poetry monuments, with views of the Kanbara Plain.

sights.name: Marusan Yasuda Tile Factory
sights.name_ja: 丸三安田瓦工業株式会社
sights.description: Tile factory in Agano making durable Yasuda roof tiles since the Tenpo era, with tours, clay play, and painting experiences.

sights.name: Kuboyama Suikin Park
sights.description: Formerly an irrigation pond for rice paddies, it is now a citizens' park with spring cherry blossoms reflected on the water.

sights.name: East Hill Golf Club
sights.name_ja: イーストヒルゴルフクラブ
sights.description: An 18-hole golf course in Agano covering 117 hectares, with a practice range among the greens.

sights.name: Swan Lake OFFICE
sights.description: A telework and study space inside Rhythm House Hyoko, with private rooms, open space, Wi-Fi, and baths.

sights.name: Tenchozan Park
sights.description: A park remembered as the birthplace of Niigata’s prefectural government after the Boshin War, also known for cherry blossoms and playground equipment.

sights.name: Gozu Foothills Urara no Mori Experience Learning Center
sights.name_en: Gozu Foothills Urara no Mori Experience Learning Center
sights.name_ja: 五頭山麓うららの森体験学習館
sights.description: Experience learning center at Murasugi Onsen entrance in Agano, with advance-booked workshops in bamboo crafts, soba, pottery, miso, gyoza, and tofu.

sights.name: Yasuda Tile-Clay Motifs (1–10 Pieces)
sights.name_ja: オリジナルの焼き物を作ろう！瓦粘土モチーフ1～10個
sights.description: Make one to ten motifs from Yasuda roof-tile clay by mold or hand-building, then have tea while watching a Yasuda tile DVD.

sights.name: Lake Hyoko Specialty Products Sales Center
sights.name_en: Lake Hyoko Specialty Products Sales Center
sights.name_ja: 瓢湖特産品販売センター
sights.description: A shop and rest area selling local vegetables, pickles, miso, sweets, and other regional specialties.

sights.name: Suibara Hachiman Shrine
sights.description: Shrine near Lake Hyoko in Agano enshrining Emperor Ojin, with swan-themed fortune slips and arithmetic amulets.

sights.name: Agano City Suibara Hometown Agricultural History Museum
sights.name_en: Agano City Suibara Hometown Agricultural History Museum
sights.name_ja: 阿賀野市水原ふるさと農業歴史資料館
sights.description: Museum beside Suibara Magistrate's Office that introduces Agano in culture, tourism, and industry zones, with weekend vegetable sales and soba-making.

sights.name: Electric Potter's Wheel Experience
sights.name_ja: 電動ろくろ 集中して土と向き合う時間。初めての方も楽しめます
sights.description: In Agano, shape a tea bowl or cup on an electric wheel; it is glazed, fired, and delivered one to two months later.

sights.name: Echigo-fu Site (Tenchozan)
sights.description: Site on Tenchozan where Niigata-fu was established in 1868, renamed Echigo-fu, before the prefectural office moved to Niigata City.

sights.name: Yaezakura at Hyoko Suikin Park
sights.name_ja: 瓢湖水きん公園の八重桜
sights.description: Double cherry blossoms at Hyoko Suikin Park in Agano bloom in late April, after Somei-yoshino and Yui-zakura have leafed out.

sights.name: Agano City Gozu Medicinal Plant Garden
sights.name_en: Agano City Gozu Medicinal Plant Garden
sights.name_ja: 阿賀野市五頭薬用植物園
sights.description: Garden at the foot of Mount Gozu for learning about roughly 300 wild medicinal plants and links between people, herbs, and health.

sights.name: Furusato Park (Park with a Library)
sights.name_ja: ふるさと公園（図書館のある公園）
sights.description: Park in Agano with a children’s library of 19,000 books and an indoor sports arena with sand-filled artificial turf.

sights.name: Handmade Cat Figurine (1 Piece)
sights.name_ja: あなただけの可愛い作品をつくろう！猫の置物（1個）
sights.description: Hand-build one cat figurine from 2 kg of clay with staff guidance; the finished piece is ready in one to two months.

sights.name: Muishinji Temple Treasures
sights.description: Temple treasures of Muishinji, a Jodo Shinshu Otani-ha temple, including nationally and prefecturally designated cultural properties such as the Kongochokyo.

sights.name: Mount Gozu Beech Forest Hike
sights.name_ja: 五頭・ブナの森ハイク
sights.description: A two-to-three-hour hike to a beech forest on the mid-slope of Mount Gozu, offered as a morning or afternoon half-day activity.

sights.name: Soybean Processing Experience Facility
sights.description: A facility for experiencing, researching, producing, and selling tofu, where families can try making it by hand.

stays.name: Shizukana Mori to Bunkazai Hanare no Yado Kansuiro
stays.name_en: Shizukana Mori to Bunkazai Hanare no Yado Kansuiro
stays.name_ja: 静かな森と文化財離れの宿 環翠楼

stays.name_ja: 五十嵐邸ガーデン新潟阿賀野リゾート(スノーピークグランピング)
stays.description: Resort in Agano, Niigata.

stays.name: Yasuda Onsen Yasuragi
stays.name_ja: 安田温泉やすらぎ
stays.description: Inn at Yasuda Onsen in Yasuda, Agano with private baths and a sauna.

stays.name: Hotel Gurin Yasuda

stays.description: Hotel in Yasuda, Agano with business travelers; 3-minute drive from Yasuda IC.

stays.description: Inn at Murasugi Onsen in Murasugi, Agano with room-only plans.

stays.name: Hanadokei
stays.name_ja: 花時計
stays.description: Inn at Murasugi Onsen in Murasugi, Agano with room-only plans.

stays.name_ja: 村杉温泉 石原館
stays.description: Inn at Murasugi Onsen in Murasugi, Agano with private baths and in-room dining.

stays.name_ja: 割烹旅館 室町
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Rajiumu Onsen in Murasugi, Agano with open-air baths and private baths.

stays.name: Ima Ita Onsen Yumoto Kan
stays.name_ja: 今板温泉 湯本舘
stays.description: Inn at Imaita Onsen in Imaita, Agano.

stays.name: Goto Onsen Sato Murasugi Onsen Yamafutokoro Nokutsurogi no Yado Kawakami-ya Ryokan
stays.name_en: Goto Onsen Sato Murasugi Onsen Yamafutokoro Nokutsurogi no Yado Kawakami-ya Ryokan
stays.name_ja: 五頭温泉郷 村杉温泉 山懐のくつろぎの宿 川上屋旅館
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Goto Onsen in Murasugi, Agano with in-room dining.

stays.name_ja: ふるさとがしのばれる宿 角屋旅館
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Murasugi Onsen in Murasugi, Agano with private baths.

stays.name: Gozu Onsenkyo Deyu Onsen Oishiya Ryokan
stays.name_en: Gozu Onsenkyo Deyu Onsen Oishiya Ryokan
stays.name_ja: 五頭温泉郷 出湯温泉 大石屋旅館
stays.description: Ryokan in Deyu, Agano, with two large hot-spring baths alternating by gender. Dogs may stay. The spring opened in 809.

stays.name: Yurari Yura Mizutori no Yado Sakihana
stays.name_en: Yurari Yura Mizutori no Yado Sakihana
stays.name_ja: ゆらりゆら 水鳥の宿 さきはな
stays.description: Inn in Komatsu, Agano.

day_to_day.name_ja: 漁火温浴 おと姫の湯
day_to_day.description: Day-use bath currently using heated water due to equipment failure, with Sea of Japan views from the windows.

activities.description: Campsite near Uchiura Beach on Awashima, with bungalows, showers and tent rentals, open from April through October.

sights.description: Sandy swimming beach in central Awashima, with clear shallow water near the ferry terminal for Iwafune Port.

sights.name: Awashima Coast
sights.description: Rocky reefs along the Awashima coast, shaped by the Japan Sea, support many fish species for shore and boat fishing.

sights.name: Wappa-ni
sights.description: On Awashima, a fisherman’s dish of grilled seasonal fish and green onions is boiled with a red-hot stone, then finished with miso; from 1,000 yen.

sights.name: Hachimanbana Observatory
sights.description: Observatory on Awashima listed in the Shima-yama 100 Views, with scenery from the stairway path.

day_to_day.name: Gosen City Shopping Plaza (Gosen City Regular Open-Air Market)
day_to_day.name_en: Gosen City Shopping Plaza (Gosen City Regular Open-Air Market)
day_to_day.name_ja: 五泉市買物広場（五泉市定期露店市場）
day_to_day.description: Founded in 1645 by village headman Wakui Genzaemon and held on the 2nd and 7th days, this market still keeps that tradition.

day_to_day.name: Yorineya Direct Sales Shop (Sakurando)
day_to_day.name_ja: さくらんど物産直売所「よりね家」
day_to_day.description: Direct-sales shop in Gosen selling local vegetables, fruit, rice, flowers, processed foods, and crafts.

day_to_day.name: Muramatsu Regular Open-Air Market
day_to_day.name_ja: 村松定期露店市場
day_to_day.description: Seasonal vegetables, fish, dried goods, and plants fill this market, a place of relaxation for local residents.

activities.name: Sakihana Onsen
activities.name_ja: 咲花温泉
activities.description: Hot-spring area beside the Agano River Line, with 54°C sulfur sodium chloride water and cherry trees planted about 50 years ago.

activities.name: Muramatsu Sakurando Hot Spring
activities.name_ja: 村松さくらんど温泉
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring with garden-view baths and an open-air bath; Sakura-no-Yu and Ogon-no-Yu switch genders monthly, plus rooms, a restaurant, and a produce shop.

activities.name: Gosen City Forest Park Campground
activities.name_ja: 五泉市森林公園キャンプ場
activities.description: A Gosen forest-park campsite among cedar plantings and native plants, with five grass tent sites, a 3.4 km trail and five-million-year-old strata.

activities.name: 42nd Sakihana Onsen Underwater Fireworks Festival
activities.name_ja: 第42回 咲花温泉水中花火大会
activities.description: About 200 underwater fireworks bloom in the Agano River at Sakihana Onsen; the show is postponed if the river rises or weather turns bad.

activities.name_ja: 咲花温泉
activities.description: Hot spring beside the Agano River Line in Gosen, named for flowers that once bloomed there, with cherry trees planted about 50 years ago.

food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Gosen, Niigata.

food.name: Yogashi no Furian
food.name_ja: 洋菓子の ふりあん
food.description: Sweets and bakery shop in Gosen.

food.name: Esprit
food.description: Sweets and bakery shop in Gosen.

sights.name: Sumoto Tulips (Gosen)
sights.name_ja: 五泉市巣本のチューリップ
sights.description: Tulip fields gathered in one place in Sumoto, Gosen, for a festival; sandy soil between two rivers suits many varieties, including Dutch imports.

sights.name: Gosen Hachiman Shrine
sights.description: Shrine on the former Gosen Castle site that displays about 4,500 wind chimes at its July festival.

sights.name: Ogon no Sato (Golden Ginkgo Village)
sights.description: Ginkgo-nut growing area in Gosen’s Hiruno district, where over 100 trees aged 200–600 years turn golden in mid to late November.

sights.name: Osawa Limestone Cave
sights.description: Limestone cave near Osawa Pass between Gosen and Tagami, cool even in summer, with bats in its completely dark interior.

sights.name: Gosen Nittofesu 2026
sights.description: Place to see in Gosen, Niigata.

sights.name: Muramatsu Park
sights.description: Park in Gosen built in 1906 as a Russo-Japanese War memorial, with about 3,000 cherry trees, playgrounds, and seasonal flowers and autumn maples.

sights.name: Laporte Gosen
sights.description: Multi-use complex in Gosen with learning and industry zones, a produce shop, a Gosen-ingredient cafeteria, and indoor and outdoor play areas.

sights.name: Muramatsu Carp Cuisine
sights.description: Carp cuisine is a specialty of Muramatsu in Gosen, including sweet-simmered carp, koi koku, and koi no arai.

sights.name: Senmi River Gorge
sights.description: A 6 km tributary gorge of the Hayade River, with river play downstream and stream sounds, birdsong, Tsubotaki Falls and Nagatoro upstream.

sights.name: Murakawa Chestnut Orchard
sights.description: Chestnut orchard in Gosen offering sweet potato digging and chestnut rice while chestnut picking is paused for large-scale replanting.

sights.name: Loyal Dog Tama Statue
sights.description: Statue in Muramatsu Park of Tama, a dog that twice rescued people from avalanches, in 1934 and 1936.

sights.name: Ogon no Sato Hall
sights.description: Free rest stop at the foot of Mt. Hakusan, before Takidani Jikoji Temple, serving handmade soba, udon and mugikiri.

sights.name: Takitani Jikoji Temple
sights.description: Soto Zen temple at the foot of Mount Hakusan, rebuilt after a 1755 fire, with six nationally registered tangible cultural properties.

sights.name: Awashima Park
sights.description: An 8.4-hectare park in Gosen with a fountain, sports facilities, and about 500 cherry trees illuminated at night during bloom season.

sights.name: Hayade River Dam
sights.description: Dam on the upper Hayade River with seasonal green and autumn views, near Koromo Rock, Meoto Falls, and Fudo Falls.

sights.name: Bessho Kokuzoson Annual Festival
sights.name_ja: 雪灯籠がお出迎え 別所虚空蔵尊例祭
sights.description: Annual February 12–13 festival at Bessho Kokuzoson, where local snow lanterns line the route and limited-time goshuin are available.

sights.name: Kitokusen Restaurant
sights.description: Restaurant in Gosen known for carp dishes, seasonal mountain foods, and coffee made with spring water; reservations are required from January to March.

sights.name: Sato Apple Orchard
sights.description: Apple-picking orchard growing leaf-on apples, sold by harvested weight at 500 yen per kilogram.

sights.name: Sugikawa Challenge Land
sights.name_ja: チャレンジランド杉川
sights.description: Youth outdoor camp beside the clear Sugikawa stream in Gosen, with tent sites, a group lodge, and a preserved farmhouse.

sights.name: Mount Okura and Mount Okura Trailhead
sights.name_en: Mount Okura and Mount Okura Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 大蔵山・大蔵山登山口
sights.description: An 864.2 m beginner mountain in Gosen, with natural beech forest on the trail and Niigata Plain views about two hours twenty minutes from the summit.

sights.name: Gosen City Tulips
sights.name_ja: 五泉市のチューリップ
sights.description: Tulip fields gathered in Sumoto, Gosen, for a festival on sandy soil between the Agano and Hayade rivers.

sights.name: Jikoji Temple Cedar Avenue
sights.description: Jikoji Temple's 500-meter approach is lined with 136 giant cedars and is a prefectural natural monument.

sights.name: Mount Hakusan (Hiruno Trailhead)
sights.description: A 1,012.4 m sacred peak on the Gosen–Kamo border, an intermediate 2.5-hour hike from Hiruno, with a hut and natural-monument salamanders near the summit.

sights.name: Muramatsu Park Deer Garden
sights.description: Yaku deer at Muramatsu Park are popular with children and can be fed directly; feed is sold at neighboring Furusato Kaikan.

sights.name: Clear Stream Village Kawase Park
sights.description: A park in Kawase, Gosen, using clear stream water and groundwater, with springs, parking and toilets across 12,500 square meters.

sights.name: Oyamada Higan Cherry Grove
sights.description: A cherry-blossom site since the Edo period, with over 250 Edohigan trees, the largest three metres around at eye level.

sights.name: Hayade River Gorge
sights.description: Gorge scenery near Hayade Dam, with viewpoints by the dam lake and dam park, from spring snowmelt through autumn foliage, and suited to drives.

sights.name: Meoto Falls
sights.description: A waterfall with an 11-meter drop and a viewing point near the plunge pool.

sights.name: Mount Takadate, Mount Bodaiji and Takadate Trailhead
sights.name_en: Mount Takadate, Mount Bodaiji and Takadate Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 高立山・菩提寺山・高立山登山口
sights.description: Beginner hiking area in western Gosen linking Mount Takadate (275.8 m) and Mount Bodaiji (248.4 m), with trails open from April to November.

sights.name: Gosen City Muramatsu Local History Museum and Folk Implements Museum
sights.name_en: Gosen City Muramatsu Local History Museum and Folk Implements Museum
sights.name_ja: 五泉市村松郷土資料館・民具資料館
sights.description: Local history museum on the former Muramatsu Castle site in Gosen, exhibiting Muramatsu domain and Hori family materials, with a folk implements museum in the park.

sights.name: Gosen Municipal Baseball Stadium
sights.description: Municipal baseball stadium in Gosen, completed in 1994, used for city and high school games, with a 2,200-seat stand and nearby katsura trees.

sights.name: Muramatsu Castle Town Map
sights.description: Map of the Edo-period Muramatsu castle town, drawn in 1751–1764 with detailed roads and plots, on display at Muramatsu Local History Museum.

sights.name: Gosen Sakura Aroma Workshop
sights.description: A 2018 town station beside Muramatsu Park in Gosen that makes and sells goods from local double-flowered cherry extract and has a cafe.

sights.name: Ohatsuki Ginkgo of Kamigoya
sights.name_ja: 上郷屋のオハツキイチョウ
sights.description: A large ohatsuki ginkgo over 500 years old at Suwa Shrine in Kamigoya, about 20 m tall, forms seeds on its leaf edges.

sights.name: Kirihata Milk Ginkgo
sights.description: A prefectural natural monument in Kirihata, Gosen: a male ginkgo 40 m tall whose trunk bears dozens of hanging growths.

sights.name: Muramatsu Castle Ruins Park
sights.description: Park on the former Muramatsu domain castle site, with spring plum and cherry blossoms, a local history museum, and preserved Kanbara Railway cars.

sights.name: Furusato Observation Deck
sights.description: Observation deck on Mount Atago in Muramatsu Park, with views of Gosen, Niitsu, Yasuda, and sometimes Niigata.

sights.name: Yazu Hachimangu Main Hall
sights.description: Main hall of Yazu Hachimangu, said to have been founded in 807 by Sakanoue no Tamuramaro, retaining early Edo-period architectural form.

sights.name: Suo Cedar at Haguro Shrine
sights.name_ja: 羽黒神社の周防杉(すおうすぎ)
sights.description: A sacred cedar said to be over 900 years old stands in Haguro Shrine in Nagahashi, 35 meters high with a 6.9-meter trunk.

sights.name: Emori Cedar of Maki
sights.description: A sacred cedar estimated at over 1,000 years old stands at Maki Hachimangu, 35 meters high with a 7.9-meter trunk.

sights.name: Illustrated Plan of Muramatsu Castle
sights.description: A 1911 memory drawing of late-Edo Muramatsu Castle by former samurai Yamada Iwakura, the only record of the castle interior, displayed at Muramatsu Local History Museum.

sights.name: Gorin Line-Carved Stupas
sights.description: Natural-stone pillars incised with five-ring stupa forms, raised mainly in the Kamakura and Nanbokucho periods as memorials for the dead.

sights.name: Kambara Kagura
sights.description: Folk performing art of Shimookambara, dedicated at Shinmei Shrine from late New Year’s Eve until early New Year’s morning.

stays.name_ja: 咲花温泉 望川閣
stays.description: Inn at Sakika Onsen in Satori, Gosen with riverside setting.

stays.name_ja: 咲花温泉 阿賀のめぐみ 望川閣

stays.description: Inn at Sakika Onsen in Satori, Gosen with free-flowing hot spring baths.

stays.name: Sakika Onsen Issui-so
stays.name_ja: 咲花温泉 一水荘
stays.description: Inn at Sakika Onsen in Satori, Gosen with open-air baths and private baths.

stays.name: Sakika Onsen Hotel Maru Matsu
stays.name_ja: 咲花温泉 ホテル丸松
stays.description: Hotel at Sakika Onsen in Satori, Gosen with free-flowing hot spring baths.

stays.name: Sakika Onsen Suigyoku no Yu Satori-kan
stays.name_en: Sakika Onsen Suigyoku no Yu Satori-kan
stays.name_ja: 咲花温泉 翠玉の湯 佐取館
stays.description: Inn at Sakika Onsen in Satori, Gosen with open-air baths and scenic views.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Marine Dream Nou
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「マリンドリーム能生」
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Nou, Itoigawa, selling locally landed red snow crab, with a fresh-fish center, restaurant, seaside park, marine museum, and campground.

day_to_day.name: Oyashirazu Pier Park Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「親不知ピアパーク」
day_to_day.description: Roadside station at Oyashirazu overlooking the Sea of Japan, with a 102-ton jade display, fresh seafood, and a bronze sea-turtle statue.
