sights.name: Sasagawa Nagare
sights.description: An 11 km coastline of sea-eroded rocks, reefs, and caves, a national scenic site and natural monument seen by sightseeing boat.

sights.name: Iyoboya Kaikan
sights.description: Museum displaying Murakami salmon culture and historic fishing methods, with underground windows onto the Tanegawa, a branch of the Miomote River.

sights.name: Murakami Castle Town Machiya Folding Screen Festival
sights.name_en: Murakami Castle Town Machiya Folding Screen Festival
sights.name_ja: 城下町村上 町屋の屏風まつり
sights.description: About 80 houses in Murakami’s old merchant quarter display heirloom folding screens for free and explain their history.

sights.name: Murakami Castle Town Machiya Doll Tour
sights.name_en: Murakami Castle Town Machiya Doll Tour
sights.name_ja: 城下町村上 町屋の人形さま巡り
sights.description: Townhouses and shops in Murakami’s old merchant quarter freely display heirloom dolls, and visitors can enter interiors usually closed to the public.

sights.name: Kikkawa (Thousand-Year Salmon)
sights.description: A company processing and selling Murakami salmon dishes in a 130-year-old townhouse, a registered cultural property, with about 1,000 salmon hanging inside.

sights.name: Iwafune Port Fresh Fish Center
sights.description: Fresh-fish center selling catch landed at Iwafune Port, homemade dried fish, and Murakami salmon products, with seafood dining on the second floor.

sights.name: Sasagawa Nagare Sightseeing Boat
sights.description: A 40-minute sightseeing boat along Sasagawa Nagare, an 11 km coast of wave-eroded rocks, reefs, and caves designated a national scenic site and natural monument.

sights.name: Murakami Festival
sights.description: Held since 1633, this Murakami festival features a parade of 19 carved, lacquered oshagiri floats and was designated an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property in 2018.

sights.name: Sennen-zake Izutsuya (Salmon Restaurant)
sights.description: Salmon restaurant in Murakami, in a national tangible cultural property where Matsuo Basho stayed two nights.

sights.name: Sasagawa Beach
sights.description: A swimming beach in central Sasagawa Nagare, a national scenic site and natural monument, with wave-carved rocks and a path to Itagai Beach.

sights.name: Echigo-Murakami Sannomaru-style Salted Salmon Workshop
sights.name_ja: 越後村上三ノ丸流鮭塩引き道場
sights.description: Workshop where participants learn to make shiobiki salted salmon, taught as distinct from aramaki, and can receive rank certificates.

sights.name: Anzen-koji (Kurobei-dori)
sights.description: A castle-town alley in Murakami lined with black fences, temples and restaurants, and an October venue for a festival of about 20,000 bamboo lanterns.

sights.name: Murakami Municipal Arakawa Golf Course
sights.name_ja: 村上市営あらかわゴルフ場
sights.description: An 18-hole municipal golf course on the Arakawa riverbed in Murakami, with a practice range and rounds suited to beginners.

sights.name: Sasagawa Nagare and Iwafune Natural Rock Oysters
sights.name_en: Sasagawa Nagare and Iwafune Natural Rock Oysters
sights.name_ja: 笹川流れ・岩船の天然岩ガキ
sights.description: Natural rock oysters from Sasagawa Nagare and Iwafune in Murakami, grown large by mineral-rich mountain water.

sights.name: Murakami Castle Ruins
sights.description: Castle ruins on 135-meter Mount Gagyu, a National Historic Site with earthworks and stone walls but no remaining buildings.

sights.name: Sake-soaked Salmon (Sake-bitashi)
sights.description: Thinly sliced salted salmon shade-dried about half a year in Murakami’s wind, eaten with sake or mirin poured over it.

sights.name: Senami Haguro Shrine
sights.description: Shrine in Murakami whose 1690 hall was designated a Niigata Prefecture tangible cultural property in 1969.

sights.name: Minami-Ohira Dam Lake Park
sights.description: Dam-lake park campsite with cooking facilities and stargazing at the Polar Star Kamihayashi observatory.

sights.name: Ishifune Shrine
sights.description: An ancient shrine listed first among the eight shrines of Iwafune District in the Engishiki, with a camellia grove designated a prefectural natural monument.

sights.name: Kuwagawa Beach
sights.description: Fine sandy beach in Kuwagawa, Murakami, with nearby rocks for fishing and views of the sunset over the sea off Awashima.

sights.name: Goishi Beach
sights.description: A beach whose black-and-white pebbles are said to resemble Go stones, with day-trip hot-spring bathing nearby at Yurihana Kaikan.

sights.name: Salt-Cured Salmon and Aramaki Salmon Direct Sale
sights.name_en: Salt-Cured Salmon and Aramaki Salmon Direct Sale
sights.name_ja: 塩引き鮭・新巻鮭 即売会
sights.description: Direct sale in Murakami of salt-cured and aramaki salmon made only from locally landed fish by fishermen’s wives; about 150–200 Sanpoku male salmon (3–6 kg).

sights.name: Jomon no Sato Asahi (Okumiomote History Exchange Hall)
sights.name_en: Jomon no Sato Asahi (Okumiomote History Exchange Hall)
sights.name_ja: 縄文の里・朝日 奥三面歴史交流館
sights.description: History exchange hall in Murakami about Jomon-period and village life in dam-submerged Okumiomote, with craft-making experiences.

sights.name: Iyahiko Shrine
sights.description: A shrine beside Senami Onsen's Funto Park enshrining Senami's dragon god, with an inner sanctuary 180 steps up overlooking the town and the Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Kikkawa Kamon-tei Tea Salon
sights.name_ja: 茶館きっかわ 嘉門亭で上質なティータイム
sights.description: Tea salon in Murakami, opened in May 2022, where guests taste Murakami tea from first to fourth infusions while viewing the courtyard.

sights.name: Itagai Beach
sights.description: Sandy and rocky swimming beach in Itagai, Murakami, where you can swim, fish from the rocks, and walk to Sasagawa Beach.

sights.name: Murakami City Local History Museum (Oshagiri Kaikan)
sights.name_en: Murakami City Local History Museum (Oshagiri Kaikan)
sights.name_ja: 村上市郷土資料館（おしゃぎり会館）
sights.description: Local history museum exhibiting Oshagiri festival floats from the Murakami Grand Festival, plus armor, helmets, and other historical materials.

sights.name: Iwafune Beach
sights.description: A sandy beach in Murakami with free parking, changing rooms and showers, near the Awashima ferry terminal and a fresh-seafood shop.

sights.name: Arakawa River
sights.description: A 73 km first-class river through Yamagata, Niigata, and Fukushima that ranked first nationally in a government water-quality survey for three years (2003-2005).

sights.name: Gold Park Narumi (Narumi Gold Mine)
sights.name_ja: ゴールドパーク鳴海（鳴海金山）
sights.description: Narumi Gold Mine ruins, said to have produced one-third of the nation's gold in the Keicho era, retain hand-dug tunnels and rough rock faces.

sights.name: Samukawa Beach
sights.description: A white-sand swimming beach in Murakami's Sanpoku district, with an emerald-colored sea unlike rocky shores.

sights.name: Morokamiji Park
sights.description: Hilltop park between Senami Onsen and Iwafune Port, with about 500 cherry trees and views of the Sea of Japan, Awashima, and Sado Island.

sights.name: Jōnen-ji Temple
sights.description: Temple in Murakami whose main hall, built in 1818 in earthen storehouse style, is a National Important Cultural Property.

sights.name: Kamihayashi Fresh Vegetable Market
sights.name_ja: とれたて野菜市かみはやし株式会社
sights.description: Direct-sales market inside Michi-no-Eki Kamihayashi in Murakami, selling local vegetables, rice, flowers, sasadango and tempe buns.

sights.name: Kashio Beach
sights.description: A 300-metre beach in Murakami facing an inlet, with relatively calm waves, clear water, changing rooms and a beach hut.

sights.name: Murakami Tea
sights.description: Murakami tea is said to be the northern limit of commercial tea production; shorter sunshine yields a mellow, low-tannin flavor, with new-tea picking from May.

sights.name: Wakabayashi Family Residence
sights.description: A thatched single-story magariya-style house of a middle-ranking samurai, with finely divided rooms typical of a samurai residence.

sights.name: Murakami Kibori Tsuishu
sights.description: Murakami craft of carved wood coated with layered lacquer, a name used for both vermilion and black pieces.

sights.name: Murakami Donburi Battle
sights.description: A Murakami dining campaign where restaurants serve original donburi made with local salmon, Murakami beef, Koshihikari rice, and salmon roe.

sights.name: Kannonji Temple
sights.description: Shingon Buddhist temple in Murakami enshrining Priest Bukkai, a self-mummified monk who died in 1903.

sights.name: Imagawa Beach (Kamano-mae to Kamiyama)
sights.name_ja: 今川海水浴場（釜ノ前～上山）
sights.description: Imagawa Beach has Kamano-mae north of the village and Kamiyama to the south, a white-sand shore with rocky areas and nearby shops.

sights.name: Kaneei Tea House
sights.description: A tea house in a renovated factory space of a Murakami tea shop founded in 1868, where you can be served tea or brew it yourself.

sights.name: Former Iwama Family Residence
sights.description: Thatched former samurai residence in Murakami, remodeled from a row house in 1858 and relocated and restored in 1995.

sights.name: Mount Takatsubo and Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 高坪山・高坪山登山口
sights.description: A 570.5 m beginner mountain in Murakami, with beech and cedar trails and views of Awashima, Sado Island, and the Iide range.

sights.name: Mount Nihonkoku (Omata-juku Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 日本国・小俣宿登山口
sights.description: Beginner trailhead for 555 m Mount Nihonkoku in Murakami, about 90 minutes to the summit, with a mountain hut for 10 people.

sights.name: Mountain Flavors School Cafeteria IRORI
sights.name_ja: 山のおいしさ学校食堂「IRORI」
sights.description: A closed-school cafeteria in Takane serving local Koshihikari, soba, iwana, and mountain vegetables at spring-to-autumn weekend and holiday lunches.

sights.name: Kōun-ji Temple
sights.description: Sōtō Zen temple in Murakami founded in 1394; after an 1886 fire, its 1702 bell tower remains as the temple gate.

sights.name: Shofuso (Senami Day-use Hot Spring)
sights.description: Day-use hot spring in Senami Onsen with free-flowing water cooled from a 90°C source, a free rest area, private rooms, and fitness equipment.

sights.name: Rokusai Market
sights.description: Street market in Murakami held six times a month on days ending in 2 or 7, with about 150 stalls selling seasonal produce, seafood, and daily goods since 1919.

sights.name: Shōjō-ji Temple
sights.description: Ancient temple in Iwafune, once called Kannō-ji, with a garden of plum, cherry, azalea, camellia, and wisteria.

sights.name: Omakuba Tea Gathering
sights.description: A casual May tea gathering at Omakuba, a former Murakami domain pleasure garden known as a white-sand and green-pine site.

sights.name: Kamibayashi Waterside School
sights.description: Waterside recreation plaza on the Arakawa’s north bank, with close-up views of medaka and ugui, campsite barbecues, and a cherry-lined riverside park.

sights.name: Omakuba Oike Park
sights.description: A roughly 3-hectare dune lake surrounded by red pine forest, a whooper swan site with over 1,000 birds, walking paths, and an observation deck.

sights.name: Suzuga Falls
sights.description: A 55 m high, 10 m wide waterfall on a 450 m beech-forest path, with a 38 m fall in rocky Suzuya Gorge.

sights.name: Fujimoto Shrine
sights.description: Zelkova gongen-style shrine in Murakami, completed in 1849, with basket carvings by Ariiso Shusai.

sights.name: Maizuru Park
sights.description: A park marking the wedding of the Crown Prince and Princess Masako, with the former Takaoka and Iwama houses and views toward Maizuru Castle ruins.

sights.name: Hakogata Hachimangu Sacred Grove
sights.description: Sacred grove of Hakogata Hachimangu, founded in 921 on a rocky summit about 60 meters above the Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Echigo Murakami Shiobiki Salmon Street
sights.name_ja: 越後村上鮭塩引き街道
sights.description: Traditionally salt-cured salmon hang under house eaves in Murakami’s castle town, drying in the cold wind.

sights.name: Fusai-ji Temple
sights.description: A roughly 500-year-old temple in Murakami with a tended garden, a waterfall, and spring wildflowers and cherry blossoms.

sights.name: Castle Town Murakami Spring Hundred Gardens Tour
sights.name_en: Castle Town Murakami Spring Hundred Gardens Tour
sights.name_ja: 城下町村上 春の庭百景巡り
sights.description: In May, townhouse, samurai-house and temple gardens in castle-town Murakami open free for viewing flowers, bonsai and wild plants.

sights.name: Traditional Iguri-ami Fishing
sights.name_ja: 伝統漁法「居繰網漁」（いぐりあみりょう）
sights.description: A traditional salmon-fishing method on the Miomote River in Murakami, using three boats to drive salmon into a net; now seen only there.

sights.name: Okumiomote Dam Lake
sights.description: The reservoir of Niigata Prefecture's only arch concrete dam, 116 m high with 125.5 million cubic metres of storage, in Bandai-Asahi National Park.

sights.name: Polar Star Kamihayashi Observatory
sights.description: A twin-dome astronomical observatory completed in 1994, with 35 cm and 40 cm telescopes for viewing the night sky.

sights.name: Murakami Salmon Cuisine
sights.description: Murakami restaurants serve more than 100 salmon dishes that use the whole fish, including salt-cured salmon, sake-soaked salmon, and harako.

sights.name: Mount Odaira (Minami-Odaira Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 大平山・南大平登山口
sights.description: Beginner route to a 561 m summit with primeval beech forest near the top; the trailhead is at Minami-Odaira Dam Lake Park.

sights.name: Kichijo Spring
sights.name_ja: 吉祥清水（きちじょうしみず）
sights.description: Spring water from Mount Kichijo that has long supplied Ogoto village and is used for the local sake Nihonkoku.

sights.name: Miomote Dam Lake
sights.description: Dam lake of 169 hectares at 200 metres elevation, at the entrance to the 52.1 km Asahi Super Line, with Futagojima Forest Park on the lake.

sights.name: Yamakumada Gorge
sights.description: A 2 km gorge that turns vivid red and yellow in autumn, viewed from the Yamakumada–Fuya prefectural road.

sights.name: Kareizan Spring
sights.name_ja: 鰈山清水（かれいざんしみず）
sights.description: A spring beside the farm road linking Ogoto and Takane, near a pass, where visitors can easily draw water.

sights.name: Dewa Kaido
sights.description: An 18-kilometer historic road through Murakami’s Sanpoku mountains, once traveled by Matsuo Basho, with post-town streetscapes and stone paving at Osawa Pass.

sights.name: Omakuba Forest Park
sights.description: A red-pine forest park between National Route 345 and the sea, with paths and gazebos, hosting an outdoor tea ceremony in the pines each late May.

sights.name: Former Takeoka Family Residence
sights.description: A thatched hip-roof house restored on its present site in 1996 and related to Crown Princess Masako’s Owada family.

sights.name: Uetsu Shina Cloth
sights.description: Niigata traditional craft goods such as handbags, brooches, and hats, handmade from shina cloth and thread woven by hand over a year.

sights.name: Asahi Supa Line Ensen no Genseirin
sights.description: Sightseeing spot in Murakami, Niigata.

sights.name: Aozora Farm Strawberry Garden
sights.name_ja: あおぞら農産いちご園
sights.description: Strawberry-picking garden in Murakami where visitors can pick Echigo-hime strawberries, with widely spaced beds for wheelchair access.

sights.name: Former Fujii Family Residence
sights.description: Former samurai residence in Murakami, dated by an 1850 ridge plaque and acquired by the Fujii family around 1900.

sights.name: Silk Flower Workshop
sights.description: Handmade silk-flower workshop in Murakami using Asahi-district cocoons for arrangements, corsages, and wedding bouquets.

sights.name: Hirabayashi Castle Ruins
sights.description: Ruins of a medieval castle built by the Irobe clan, with three baileys protected by dry moats and earthworks on a plateau overlooking the plain.

sights.name: Yanagigarei
sights.description: A light-flavored flatfish named for its willow-leaf shape; egg-bearing fish are dried overnight before the winter spawning season.

sights.name: Silk Spinning from Cocoons
sights.name_ja: 糸の細さにビックリ！ころんとかわいい繭玉から糸をつむごう
sights.description: Hand-spin raw silk from a cocoon of your chosen color, take it home the same day, and hear about silkworm ecology and sericulture history.

sights.name: Ubasugi at Omata Hakusan Shrine
sights.description: Estimated 1,200-year-old cedar at Omata Hakusan Shrine, 13.4 meters around, where newborns are made to cry in a prayer for their future.

sights.name: Kokuzo Green Park
sights.name_ja: 虚空蔵グリーンパーク
sights.description: A park with forest zones for viewing, walking, and learning, including a 5 km trail that takes about three hours.

sights.name: Dewa Kaido Walking Trail
sights.name_ja: 松尾芭蕉も歩いた出羽街道散策
sights.description: A historic road between Echigo and Dewa that Matsuo Basho walked, with surviving stone pavement, a Basho poem stele, and the former post town of Omata.

stays.name: Taikan-so Senami no Yu
stays.name_ja: 大観荘せなみの湯
stays.description: Inn at Murakamiichinosenami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Senami Grand Hotel Haginoya
stays.name_ja: 瀬波グランドホテル はぎのや
stays.description: Hotel at Murakamiichinosenami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Oedo Onsen Monogatari Premium Shio Bi-so
stays.name_en: Oedo Onsen Monogatari Premium Shio Bi-so
stays.name_ja: 大江戸温泉物語Premium 汐美荘
stays.description: Inn at Oedo Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Senami Hamanasu-so
stays.name_ja: 瀬波はまなす荘
stays.description: Inn at Togensenshiyono Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Senami Onsen Jiman no Notenburo Yumoto Ryusen
stays.name_en: Senami Onsen Jiman no Notenburo Yumoto Ryusen
stays.name_ja: 瀬波温泉 自慢の野天風呂 湯元 龍泉
stays.description: Inn at Senami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Senami Onsen Komorebi Inn Yunoka
stays.name_ja: 瀬波温泉 木もれびの宿 ゆのか
stays.description: Inn at Senami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Senami Kiyoshi Nami Onsen
stays.name_ja: 瀬波 清波温泉
stays.description: Inn at Kiyoshinami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Tsubaki Inn Yoshidaya
stays.name_ja: 椿の宿 吉田や
stays.description: Inn at Murakamiichinosenami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Senami Onsen Kaito no Yado Yamato-ya Ryokan
stays.name_en: Senami Onsen Kaito no Yado Yamato-ya Ryokan
stays.name_ja: 瀬波温泉 開湯の宿 大和屋旅館
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Senami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami with in-room dining.

stays.name: Relaxation Inn Seiunso and Annex Kakairo
stays.name_en: Relaxation Inn Seiunso and Annex Kakairo
stays.name_ja: くつろぎの宿 静雲荘 ・ 別邸 華海廊
stays.description: Inn at Murakamiichinosenami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami with open-air baths.

stays.name: Minshuku Kotobuki
stays.name_ja: 民宿 ことぶき
stays.description: Family-run minshuku at Murakamiichinosenami Onsen in Senamionsen, Murakami with local seafood dinners.

stays.name: Yudokoro Sobadokoro Iwafune
stays.name_ja: ゆ処・そば処 磐舟
stays.description: Sulfur-sodium-chloride hot spring bath in Senami Onsen, Murakami.

stays.name: Asahi Midori no Sato Honwakan
stays.name_ja: 朝日みどりの里 ほんわ館
stays.description: Two-story cottage in Sarusawa, Murakami, with self-catering and Japanese-style living and dining space.

stays.name: Iromusubi no Yado
stays.name_ja: いろむすびの宿
stays.description: Inn in Sasaki, Murakami.

day_to_day.name: Arai Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 「あらい」（国道18号）
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Myoko accessible from the expressway and Route 18, with produce shops, restaurants, lodging, and local rice, sake, kanzuri, and seafood.

day_to_day.name: Myoko Foothills Direct Sales Center (Tomato)
day_to_day.name_ja: 妙高山麓直売センター「とまと」
day_to_day.description: A direct-sales center at the foot of Mount Myoko selling seasonal local vegetables and foods, with a cafeteria and monthly events.

activities.name: Takinoyu Open-air Bath (Akakura Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 赤倉温泉野天風呂 滝の湯
activities.description: Open-air sulfate-bicarbonate bath at Akakura Onsen, built with about 3,000 rocks totaling 2,500 tons, with a summer mixed swimsuit pool.

activities.name: Akakura Onsen Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 赤倉温泉スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort at the foot of Mount Myoko with 17 courses from 720 to 1,500 meters, night skiing, and day baths at Akakura Onsen.

activities.name: Myoko Kogen Liner
activities.name_ja: 赤倉・池の平・杉野沢の各温泉地を結ぶバス。
activities.description: The Myoko Kogen Liner ran daily without transfers from Joetsu-Myoko Station to Akakura, Shin-Akakura, Ikenotaira and Suginozawa hot springs from 26 December 2020 to 14 March 2021.

activities.name: Akakura Kanko Resort Ski Area (New Year's Sunrise Sky Cable)
activities.name_en: Akakura Kanko Resort Ski Area (New Year's Sunrise Sky Cable)
activities.name_ja: 元旦 初日の出早朝スカイケーブル
activities.description: Myoko Kogen Sky Cable at Akakura Kanko Resort Ski Area runs from 6:30 a.m. on New Year's Day for the first sunrise, with drinks at the summit terrace.

activities.name: Fudo Falls (Seki Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 関温泉 不動滝
activities.description: A roughly 20-metre waterfall under Fudo Bridge in a gorge near Seki Onsen, with Otaki Fudo shrine beside the basin.

activities.name: Seki Onsen Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 関温泉スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort in Myoko's Seki Onsen area with four runs, powder skiing, a snowboard park, and baths, operating into mid-May.

activities.name: Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_ja: アライマウンテンリゾート（旧ロッテアライリゾート）
activities.description: A ski resort on Mount Omunashi in Myoko, with 24 courses, a 7 km longest run, and a hot spring from 1,750 meters underground.

activities.name: Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 妙高杉ノ原スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort in Myoko with a 1,124 m vertical drop and an 8.5 km run, plus a snow park and Mt. Fuji views on clear days.

activities.name: Ikenotaira Onsen Alpenblick Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 池の平温泉アルペンブリックスキー場
activities.description: Ski resort on the lower slopes of Mt. Myoko, with 16 runs, a 4 km course, and views of Lake Nojiri.

activities.name: Kaminomiya Onsen Kawara-tei
activities.name_ja: 神の宮温泉 かわら亭
activities.description: Hot-spring facility in Myoko with a sauna by advance reservation and a cold bath of metasilicic mineral water.

activities.name: Akakura Kanko Resort Ski Area
activities.name_ja: 赤倉観光リゾートスキー場
activities.description: Ski area in snowy Myoko Kogen, eight minutes from Myoko Kogen IC, with a 4.5 km downhill from 1,500 m plus sled and tube courses.

activities.name: Madarao Kogen Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 斑尾高原スキー場
activities.description: Snow resort on the Niigata-Nagano border with north-facing slopes, 31 runs for all levels, and night skiing.

activities.name: Kyukamura Myoko Runrun Ski Area
activities.name_ja: 休暇村妙高ルンルンスキー場
activities.description: Gentle beginner ski slope between the Kyukamura Myoko hotel buildings, with a 900 m run and sledding space.

activities.name: Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort Snowmobile Experience
activities.name_en: Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort Snowmobile Experience
activities.name_ja: 妙高杉ノ原スキー場 2025-2026 スノーモービル体験
activities.description: Snowmobile experiences at Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort include a one-group-a-day magic-hour private tour, a short ride, and a forest tour on 200cc machines.

activities.name: Traditional Japanese Craft Experience in Myoko
activities.name_en: Traditional Japanese Craft Experience in Myoko
activities.name_ja: 妙高で日本の伝統工芸体験
activities.description: A small craft session in Myoko where an embroidery artist teaches tsumami-zaiku and hand-painted yuzen, and finished pieces can be taken home.

activities.name: Hot Air Balloon Experience at Lotte Arai Resort
activities.name_en: Hot Air Balloon Experience at Lotte Arai Resort
activities.name_ja: 気球体験
activities.description: A limited-time, rope-tethered hot-air balloon ride at Lotte Arai Resort, with views of the resort and mountains from evening into night.

activities.name: MYOKO BASE CAMP
activities.description: Japan's first telework facility, near Imori Pond in Myoko-Togakushi Renzan National Park, designed with ZVC Japan.

activities.name: Snow Caliber Mini Trip at Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Snow Caliber Mini Trip at Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: Snow Caliber Mini Trip 雪上車遊覧ツアー
activities.description: A snow-vehicle tour into the forest at Myoko Suginohara Ski Resort, with winter scenery visible from the windows.

activities.name: Myoko Sake Brewery Tour (Kiminoi Brewery)
activities.name_ja: 妙高の酒蔵見学～君の井酒造～
activities.description: Kiminoi Brewery tour in Myoko, where three sake houses brew smooth, delicate sake by traditional methods using local water and rice.

activities.name: Snow Drive Tour (Arai Mountain Resort)
activities.name_ja: スノードライブツアー
activities.description: A seated snow ride at Arai Mountain Resort that you operate without ski or snowboard experience, lasting about 120 minutes.

activities.name: Snow Tubing Park (Arai Mountain Resort)
activities.name_ja: スノーチュービングパーク
activities.description: Visitors slide down dedicated snow-slope courses on tire-tube rings, with more course variations added this year.

activities.name: SpongeBob Kids Park / Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_en: SpongeBob Kids Park / Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_ja: スポンジ・ボブキッズパーク
activities.description: A SpongeBob-themed snow-play area for children, set up to support families’ first safe experiences on the slopes.

activities.name: Snow Rafting at Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_en: Snow Rafting at Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーラフティング
activities.description: A snow-rafting ride that speeds across the snow-play slopes at Arai Mountain Resort, with photo spots on the course.

activities.name: Snow Country Working Vehicle Experience
activities.name_ja: 雪国はたらく車体験
activities.description: Ride snow-grooming and snow-removal vehicles at Arai Snow Resort; open to ages 7 and over.

activities.name: Strider Park / Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_ja: ストライダーパーク
activities.description: Children glide freely on snow with Snow Striders, Strider bikes fitted with ski attachments, while training balance and core strength.

activities.name: Zip Tour at Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_en: Zip Tour at Arai Mountain Resort
activities.name_ja: ジップツアー
activities.description: A winter snow-zipline ride on a 1,501-meter cable from the 950-meter summit, dropping about 240 meters over snowy forest.

food.name: Akakura Kanko Hotel Cafe Terrace
food.name_ja: 赤倉観光ホテル カフェテラス

food.name: Cafe＆Restaurant Kayaba
food.description: Cafe and restaurant in front of the Alpenblick Shirakaba Capsule Pair Lift boarding area, with slope and cafe menus; open 8:30-16:30, closed Tue and Wed in summer, no holidays during ski season.

food.name: Myoko Coffee
food.description: House-roasted coffee and in-house baked sweets in the LIME RESORT lobby lounge, with library space and terrace seats; open 10:00-17:00.

food.name: HUNTER
food.description: Cafe and restaurant in Akakura Onsen serving coffee and meals, also usable as a bar; lunch 11:30-14:00, dinner 17:30-21:30, open in winter only.

food.name: Myoko Service Area Nobori Keishoku Food Court
food.name_en: Myoko Service Area Nobori Keishoku Food Court
food.name_ja: 妙高サービスエリア 上り 軽食・フードコート

food.name: Onakaippai Shokudo Myoko
food.name_ja: おなかいっぱい食堂みょうこう

food.name: Izakaya Nihontei Betten Tsugumi
food.description: Izakaya serving meals and fresh sashimi inside Alpenblick Spa; summer 11:00-23:00 (closed Tue and Wed), winter 15:00-23:30 (no regular closing day).

food.name: Sasagamine Greenhouse
food.name_ja: 笹ヶ峰グリーンハウス
food.description: Second-floor restaurant serving Niigata beef steak, including a jumbo steak of about three servings and set menus with soba; cash only, all seats non-smoking.

food.name: Omori Ramen Arai
food.name_ja: オーモリラーメン 新井店

food.name: Gohan Tokoro Shokudo Misa Arai Michi no Eki
food.name_en: Gohan Tokoro Shokudo Misa Arai Michi no Eki
food.name_ja: ごはん処食堂ミサ あらい道の駅店

food.name: Matsu Cha-ya Ramen-tei
food.name_ja: 松茶屋 らーめん亭

food.name: Ramen Sho Roadside Station Arai
food.name_ja: ラーメン翔 道の駅あらい店

food.name: Soba Dokoro Onyado Sekigawa
food.name_ja: そば処 御宿せきがわ
food.description: Soba shop in a renovated late-Edo farmhouse over 150 years old, serving seasonal tempura and 2:8 handmade soba; open 11:00-15:00 from mid-April to the end of November, closed Wednesdays.

food.name: Kirishita Soba Yabu
food.description: Serves Kirishita soba plus udon, rice bowls, Chinese noodles and some izakaya dishes from 650 yen; open 11:00-14:00 and 17:00-20:00, closed Tuesdays.

food.name: Shokudo Misa Arai Michi-no-Eki
food.name_ja: 食道ミサ あらい道の駅店
food.description: Serves garlic-and-onion miso ramen and set meals; open 11:00-20:00, closed January 1.

food.name: Myokosanroku Chokubai Center Tomato
food.name_ja: 妙高山麓直売センターとまと
food.description: Direct sales center selling Myoko foothill vegetables and sasazushi, with a cafeteria serving juwari soba, ramen and set meals; open 9:00-16:00 Jan-Mar and 9:00-17:00 Apr-Dec (9:00-12:00 on Dec 31), closed Jan 1-4.

food.name: Soba Restaurant Bashoen
food.description: Hand-made soba restaurant beside Imori Pond using Myoko soba flour; soft-serve ice cream is also served; open 8:00-17:00, closed in winter.

food.name: Arakin Ramen
food.description: Ramen restaurant open 9:00-23:00 with irregular closing days; prices from 300 yen, seating for up to 35.

food.name: APA Resort Joetsu Myoko Restaurant
food.name_ja: アパリゾート上越妙高 レストラン
food.description: Hotel restaurant offering Japanese-Western breakfast and dinner buffets, a lunch buffet, and a steak and French dinner course; lunch 11:30-14:00, dinner 17:30-20:30 by reservation, closed mid-November to mid-April.

food.name: Aqua Dining
food.name_ja: アクア ダイニング

food.name: Creative Japanese Restaurant Dan
food.name_ja: 創作和食レストラン 暖 -DAN-
food.description: Creative Japanese restaurant in Hotel Alpenblick; open 7:00-9:00 and 18:00-21:00, closed on hotel closure days.

food.name: Dining Place Waremokou
food.description: Japanese restaurant serving ramen, soba and galette in summer, and ramen, set meals and handmade curry in winter; lunch 11:00-14:00, dinner 17:00-20:00, irregular closing days; currently closed.

food.name: Shikisai-kan Myoko
food.description: Opened July 2020 at Michi-no-Eki Arai; its restaurant serves Myoko rice, vegetables and Sea of Japan seafood (10:00-20:00, irregular closures), and barbecue is available by reservation.

food.name: Tonjiru no Mise Tachibana
food.name_ja: とん汁の店 たちばな
food.description: Tonjiru specialty restaurant serving pork, onion and tofu tonjiru and tonjiru ramen; open 11:00-17:00, closed Mondays (Tuesdays if Monday is a holiday).

food.name: Himi Kitokito Sushi Arai Michi-no-Eki Store
food.name_en: Himi Kitokito Sushi Arai Michi-no-Eki Store
food.name_ja: 氷見 きときと寿し あらい道の駅店

food.name: Kitokito Sushi Arai Michi-no-Eki
food.name_ja: きときと寿司 あらい道の駅店
food.description: Serves hand-formed nigiri and conveyor-belt sushi made with fresh Sea of Japan seafood, plus Shichi-Go-San meals by reservation; open 11:00-21:00.

food.name: FARM GELATO Sekka
food.description: Gelato shop inside Michi-no-Eki Arai serving gelato made from local seasonal vegetables and fruits (from 400 yen); open 8:30-17:00, closed only on New Year's Day.

food.name: Crepe and Ice Cream Shop Jerato Okura
food.name_en: Crepe and Ice Cream Shop Jerato Okura
food.description: Crepe and ice cream shop in Akakura Onsen; items from 250 to 1,000 yen; open 9:00-22:00 (hours may vary), irregular holidays, open through winter.

sights.name: Naena Falls
sights.description: Naena Falls is a 55-meter waterfall on the Seki River at the Niigata-Nagano border, one of Japan's 100 waterfalls.

sights.name: Koyaike Pond
sights.description: Mountain pond just before the Mt. Hiuchi summit, with Hakusan kozakura in summer, autumn foliage, and the nearby Koyaike Hut for hikers.

sights.name: Imori Pond
sights.description: Imori Pond is a 2-meter-deep artificial pond facing Mount Myoko, where over 100,000 Asian skunk cabbages bloom in late April.

sights.name: Naenadaki-en Restaurant
sights.name_ja: お食事処 苗名滝苑
sights.description: Restaurant at the entrance to Naena Falls serving bamboo flowing somen chilled with Myoko spring water, plus salt-grilled iwana.

sights.name: Myoko Kogen Sky Cable
sights.name_ja: 妙高高原スカイケーブル
sights.description: A cable car on the Myoko Plateau with views toward the Shiga and Nozawa ranges, Mount Madarao and Lake Nojiri, plus a summit cafe and beech forest.

sights.name: Myoko Zip Tour
sights.name_ja: 全長約1,501mを飛ぶ空中の旅へ出発！ジップツアー
sights.description: A zip-line tour in Myoko that descends from about 950 m to 710 m in roughly three minutes, with views of the Hokushinetsu mountains and Takada Plain.

sights.name: Mount Hiuchi
sights.description: A 2,462-metre peak in Myoko, one of Japan's 100 Famous Mountains, with alpine plants and rock ptarmigan along the trails.

sights.name: Sasagamine Plateau
sights.description: A 1,300-meter plateau with trails for spring-to-autumn trekking and, in its pasture, Utana Spring, selected among Heisei's 100 famous waters.

sights.name: Sasagamine Direct Bus
sights.name_ja: 妙高高原駅と笹ヶ峰高原を結ぶ｢笹ヶ峰直行バス」。
sights.description: Direct bus linking Myoko-Kogen Station to Sasagamine Plateau, a 1,300-meter trailhead for Mount Hiuchi and Mount Myoko.

sights.name: Mount Myoko
sights.description: A 2,454 m mountain in Myoko City, one of Japan’s 100 Famous Mountains, with summit lava rocks and views of the Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Myoko Kogen Visitor Center
sights.name_ja: 妙高高原ビジターセンター
sights.description: Visitor center explaining Myoko Kogen wildlife, landforms and geology, with a cafe overlooking Imori Pond and Mount Myoko.

sights.name: Garden Pool & Night Pool
sights.name_ja: ガーデンプール＆ナイトプール
sights.description: A two-story garden pool with a waterfall about 4 m high, a 40 cm toddler pool, a heated jacuzzi, and a night pool on weekends and during Obon.

sights.name: Sotaki Falls
sights.description: An 80-metre waterfall beyond Tsubame Onsen, one of Japan's 100 Waterfalls, seen from Sotaki Observatory near the Kogane-no-Yu outdoor bath.

sights.name: Myoko Kogen Beer Tatra-kan
sights.name_ja: 妙高高原ビール タトラ館
sights.description: A 400-seat beer restaurant beside Hotel Alpen Blick, modeled on a European townscape, serving fresh Myoko Kogen Beer with buffet dishes.

sights.name: Kanzuri
sights.description: Traditional fermented seasoning from Myoko, made with chili, koji, yuzu, and sea salt over three years.

sights.name: Sekiyama Shrine
sights.description: Village shrine of Mount Myoko founded in 708, with an 1818 palace registered as a national cultural property in 2018.

sights.name: Heartland Myoko Golden Week Experience Fair
sights.name_en: Heartland Myoko Golden Week Experience Fair
sights.name_ja: ハートランド妙高「GWわくわく体験フェア」
sights.description: A Golden Week fair at Heartland Myoko with potato planting, soft-wax candle making, and ice-making experiences.

sights.name: Sasa Mino Sushi Making
sights.name_ja: 謙信公が残した食文化～くびき野伝統食・笹箕寿し～
sights.description: Make Myoko sasa mino sushi by folding bamboo leaves into a winnowing-basket shape and topping rice with egg, salmon, shiitake and miso-pickled daikon.

sights.name: Hokkoku Kaido Sekikawa Checkpoint Road History Museum
sights.name_en: Hokkoku Kaido Sekikawa Checkpoint Road History Museum
sights.name_ja: 北国街道関川関所「道の歴史館」
sights.description: Museum at the former Edo-period Sekikawa checkpoint that recreates the era with CG and life-size figures and explains road history.

sights.name: Myoko Summer Parent-Child Workation
sights.name_ja: 妙高 夏休み親子ワーケーション
sights.description: A summer parent-child workation in Myoko with a walk at Naena Falls, one of Japan's 100 Waterfalls, plus barbecue and fireworks.

sights.name: HOT STASH sauna point.
sights.description: Private-group sauna in Myoko with varied loyly, an underground natural-water cold bath, a free-flowing hot spring, and room for eight people.

sights.name: Myoko Ski Park
sights.description: Ski area in Myoko with quality snow and gentle slopes popular with families and beginners, including a 1.2 km forest course.

sights.name: Treetop Adventure
sights.name_ja: 木の上の大冒険ツリーアドベンチャー
sights.description: A rope-course attraction in a Myoko forest where visitors travel between trees, with three courses for children and adults.

sights.name: MYOKO IKENOTAIRA MTB PARK
sights.description: An MTB park at the Ikenotaira Onsen Alpenblick ski area, with a beginner-friendly 1.6 km flow trail, Lake Nojiri views and forest riding lines.

sights.name: Shimizugaike Pond
sights.description: A pond on Sasagamine Plateau in Myoko City, about 15 minutes on foot, with views of the adjacent ranch and surrounding mountains.

sights.name: Myoko Kogen Snowshoe Tour
sights.name_ja: 妙高高原スノーシューツアー
sights.description: A private snowshoe walk through deep-snow primeval forest in Myoko Kogen, guided by local nature guides and followed by a snow picnic.

sights.name: Heartland Myoko
sights.description: A Myoko facility where visitors can try farming, straw crafts, cooking, harvesting, and violin making with locals, and also use a coworking space.

sights.name: Myoko-Style Health Resort Program
sights.name_ja: 妙高型健康保養地プログラム
sights.description: An exercise program pairing climate-therapy walks on forest therapy roads in Myoko-Togakushi Renzan National Park with exercise in a natural hot-spring pool.

sights.name: Infinity Pool and Barrel Sauna
sights.name_ja: インフィニティプール・バレルサウナ
sights.description: Infinity pool and two barrel saunas in Myoko with views of Mount Myoko, also open as a night pool.

sights.name: Daily Changing Adventure
sights.name_ja: 日替わりアドベンチャー
sights.description: Winter activities in Myoko City that change each day, including snow-hut making, snowball fights, treasure hunts, and giant-snowman building.

sights.name: HIZUME Snow Adventure
sights.name_ja: スノーアドベンチャー「HIZUME」
sights.description: A snow-play area in Myoko with 15 kinds of items, including sleds and tubes, for children and adults.

sights.name: Snow Rafting
sights.description: Ride a rubber raft towed by a snowmobile across snowfields; open to ages 4 and over.

sights.name: Nature Trekking
sights.name_ja: ネイチャートレッキング
sights.description: Guided trekking on nature-rich Myoko Kogen in Myoko-Togakushi Renzan National Park, visiting seasonal spots at the foot of Mount Myoko.

sights.name: Private E-bike Adventure (Myoko Kogen)
sights.name_ja: オフロード＆絶景を楽しむ！プライベートE-bikeアドベンチャー
sights.description: A private tour riding E-MTBs or e-cross bikes over Myoko Kogen's hills and off-road trails, visiting viewpoints and food spots at your own pace.

sights.name: One-Day Telemark Skiing Plan on Untouched Powder (Beginners Welcome)
sights.name_en: One-Day Telemark Skiing Plan on Untouched Powder (Beginners Welcome)
sights.name_ja: 初心者歓迎！テレマークスキーで未踏の新雪を滑る1日プラン
sights.description: One-day telemark skiing experience in Myoko.

stays.description: Hotel in Inoyama, Myoko with parking.

stays.description: Inn at Kaminomiya Onsen in Jinguji, Myoko.

stays.description: Hotel in Yanagida-cho, Myoko, about five minutes by car from Joetsu-Myoko Station on the Hokuriku Shinkansen.

stays.description: Whole-building rental old folk house minshuku with an irori in Nishinotani, Myoko.

stays.name: Forest＆Stars Akakura Villa

stays.name: Hotel Mimozakan
stays.name_ja: ホテル ミモザ館
stays.description: Hotel in Tagiri, Myoko.

stays.name: Hotel Mumon
stays.name_ja: ホテル無門
stays.description: Hotel in Akakura, Myoko, with a free-flowing hot spring bath available 24 hours.

stays.name: Uguisu no Hatsune
stays.name_ja: うぐいすの初音

day_to_day.name: JA Echigo Chuetsu Wanja Land Festival 2025

day_to_day.name_ja: 長岡駅観光案内所

day_to_day.name_en: Teradomari Fish Market Street Year-End and New Year

activities.name: Kome Hyappyo Festival

activities.description: Colorful tulips fill the park, with photo spots such as a swing, door, and windmill, plus Niigata-grown varieties.

food.description: Reservation-only kappo serving seasonal dishes, local sake, A5 Sendai beef shabu-shabu and winter tiger pufferfish; open 11:30-13:30 and 17:00-21:30, closed Sundays.

food.description: Japanese restaurant in Nagaoka Grand Hotel serving local-style kaiseki with Japan Sea seafood and Nagaoka vegetables, plus sake from 15 Nagaoka breweries; open 11:00-14:00 and 17:00-21:00, closed Mondays and Wednesdays.

food.description: Kappo restaurant serving seasonal dishes, including a shokado brewing lunch reserved three days ahead; open 11:00-22:00, irregular closures, reservation required.

food.name: Kappo Shinkiya
food.description: Kappo restaurant in Settaya founded in 1916, serving shokado bento and Nagaoka local dishes made with local vegetables and traditional seasonings.

food.name: Kappo Hidehama
food.description: Kappo restaurant serving seafood, seasonal dishes and Niigata local sake, with omakase from 4,400 yen; open 11:30-14:00 and 17:00-22:00 (last order 21:30), closed Sundays.

food.name: Niigata Kaihōmaru Nagaoka Ekimae
food.name_ja: 新潟海宝丸 長岡駅前店
food.description: Serves same-day fish, including sashimi, and local, out-of-prefecture and limited sake; open 11:00-21:00 (last order 20:30), no closing days.

food.name: Seafood Izakaya Sakanaya Honten
food.description: Seafood izakaya serving Sea of Japan sashimi and prefectural local sake; open 17:00-23:00, closed Sundays.

food.name_ja: 寺泊中央水産 まるなか

food.description: Dango shop in an old house with a cafe serving sweets overlooking a Japanese garden; cafe open 10:00-17:00 (last order), closed Tuesdays.

food.name: Eguchi Dango Honten
food.description: Wagashi shop founded in 1902; its old-house sweet shop serves a Niigata regional gozen lunch, and a storehouse cafe serves roll cake.

food.name: Yasuda Yogurt Shop CoCoLo Nagaoka
