food.name: Naniwaya Seika Kabushiki Gaisha
food.description: Sweets and bakery shop in Nagaoka.

sights.name: Takaryu Shrine
sights.description: Near Yomogihira Onsen, Takaryu Shrine enshrines the water dragon god Takaokami, whose white-snake messenger receives offerings of raw eggs and sake.

sights.name: Echigo Yamakoshi Bullfighting Tournament
sights.name_ja: 越後山古志「牛の角突き」大会
sights.description: Traditional bullfighting tournament in Yamakoshi, Nagaoka, where bouts are drawn so the bulls are not injured.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.description: Park in Nagaoka, Niigata.

sights.name: Yukyuzan Park
sights.description: A Nagaoka park nicknamed Oyama, with about 2,500 cherry trees, a free small zoo, a Japanese garden, and Aoshiba Shrine.

sights.name: Yamakoshi Alpaca Farm
sights.description: Visitors can see alpacas raised at Aburao and Tannebara in Yamakoshi, first sent from Colorado after an earthquake.

sights.name: Nagaoka City Toki and Nature Learning Center (Toki Miite)
sights.name_en: Nagaoka City Toki and Nature Learning Center (Toki Miite)
sights.name_ja: 長岡市トキと自然の学習館 トキみ～て
sights.description: Visitors can watch crested ibises up close through large windows and learn about wild reintroduction and Nagaoka's breeding efforts.

sights.name: Yukiguni Botanical Garden
sights.description: A botanical garden of natural snow-country woodland vegetation, with about 850 plant species, spring wildflowers, and summer fireflies.

sights.name: Houtokusan Inari Taisha
sights.description: A shrine to Amaterasu Shiragiku Hotoku Okami, relocated here around 1820, drawing over 300,000 visitors a year from across Japan.

sights.name: Echigo-Kawaguchi Fish Weir and Otokoyama Fishery
sights.name_en: Echigo-Kawaguchi Fish Weir and Otokoyama Fishery
sights.name_ja: 越後川口やな場 男山漁場
sights.description: Fish weir on the clear Uono River, a Shinano tributary, known since 1868, where Otokoyama Fishery serves ayu and other river fish.

sights.name: Kinpu Shrine
sights.description: Kinpu Shrine in Nagaoka, called Zao-sama, stands in a Shinano River zelkova forest and still holds yabusame rites.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park Christmas Illumination
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park Christmas Illumination
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「Xmasイルミネーション」
sights.description: Christmas illumination at Echigo Hillside National Government Park, themed Snow Illumination Party, with an outdoor zelkova display and indoor photo spots.

sights.name: Nagaoka Kome no Jin (Rice Festival) 2025 at Ao-re Nagaoka
sights.name_en: Nagaoka Kome no Jin (Rice Festival) 2025 at Ao-re Nagaoka
sights.name_ja: ながおか米の陣 2025 in アオーレ長岡
sights.description: A new-rice festival at Ao-re Nagaoka with all-you-can-eat cooked rice, side-dish and sake booths, brand-rice tastings, and a contest award ceremony.

sights.name: Ponshukan (Nagaoka Specialty Products Hall)
sights.name_ja: 長岡銘品の館『ぽんしゅ館』
sights.description: Shop inside Nagaoka Station offering 500-yen tastings of Niigata sake, plus local miso, soy sauce, and souvenirs.

sights.name: Nitoko Mieru Hall
sights.description: Information center for the Ohkouzu Diversion Channel renovation, with AR and VR exhibits, a theater on the 2019 flood, and rooftop construction views.

sights.name: Yoshinogawa Sake Museum Jōgura
sights.name_ja: 吉乃川 酒ミュージアム『醸蔵（じょうぐら）』
sights.description: Sake museum in a renovated century-old nationally registered cultural-property warehouse on the Yoshinogawa grounds in Nagaoka, for learning about, tasting, and buying sake.

sights.name: Echigo Nagaoka Yuraiya Super Sento
sights.name_ja: スーパー銭湯越後長岡ゆらいや
sights.description: Super sento and sauna facility in Nagaoka.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Museum of Modern Art
sights.name_en: Niigata Prefectural Museum of Modern Art
sights.description: Modern art museum in greenery near central Nagaoka, presenting about four exhibitions of Japanese and world art each year.

sights.name: Yamakoshi Terraced Rice Fields and Ponds
sights.name_en: Yamakoshi Terraced Rice Fields and Ponds
sights.description: Mountain-slope rice terraces and ponds in Yamakoshi, where koi fry are released after planting; a cultural landscape and Japan Agricultural Heritage No. 1.

sights.name: Echigo Nagaoka Sake-no-Jin
sights.name_ja: 美味しい酒にアオーレ 越後長岡酒の陣
sights.description: Local sake event at Ao-re Nagaoka where Nagaoka breweries gather; visitors can meet brewers and pair sake with local ingredients.

sights.name: Autumn Nagaoka Craft Fair 2026 (Art Village)
sights.name_ja: 秋の長岡クラフトフェア2026 ～アートビレッジ～
sights.description: Craft fair in Nagaoka where 55 artisans from across Japan exhibit and sell works, with food booths also available.

sights.name: Nakayama Tunnel
sights.description: A tunnel residents dug by hand with pickaxes over 16 years; pickaxe marks remain, and it was named a JSCE civil engineering heritage site in 2006.

sights.name: Momiji-en Garden
sights.description: A Meiji-era Japanese garden in Nagaoka, planted with 150- to 200-year-old maples that are illuminated at night in autumn.

sights.name: AQUARE Nagaoka
sights.description: Health complex in Nagaoka with a heated pool, gym, sauna, outdoor bath, medical checkups, and lodging.

sights.name: Private Sauna ART
sights.description: Private sauna at Sumiyoshiya inn on the Teradomari coast, where changing, sauna, cold bath, and outdoor air bathing are all done privately.

sights.name: Tochio Fishing Park
sights.name_ja: 栃尾フィッシングパーク
sights.description: Natural fishing park on the Kariyata River where visitors can catch iwana, yamame and rainbow trout, with bait fishing and a barbecue area.

sights.name: Teradomari Central Beach
sights.description: A wide, shallow sandy swimming beach in Teradomari, near the fish-market street where visitors can shop.

sights.name: Umataka Jomon Museum (Flame Pottery Museum)
sights.name_ja: 馬高縄文館 火焔土器ミュージアム（馬高遺跡、三十稲場遺跡）
sights.description: Guidance facility for the Umataka and Sanju-inaba Sites, displaying the original flame pottery and a same-size replica visitors can touch.

sights.name: Naniwaya Seika
sights.description: Nagaoka confectioner that created Kaki no Tane in 1924; a 2024 visitor center and Kaki no Tane Shrine stand on the grounds.

sights.name: Yamakoshi Sightseeing Taxi Course
sights.name_ja: 日本の原風景「山古志」を満喫！
sights.description: Same-day taxi course of about three hours from Nagaoka Station, visiting Yamakoshi sites such as an alpaca farm and Nakayama Tunnel.

sights.name: Western-style Katsudon
sights.description: A Nagaoka pork-cutlet rice bowl in ketchup-based or demi-glace styles, originating at Komatsu Parlor, founded in 1931.

sights.name: Yamamoto Isoroku Memorial Museum
sights.description: A memorial museum tracing the life and character of Nagaoka-born Yamamoto Isoroku, with displays of his personal effects.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Museum of History
sights.description: History museum in Nagaoka centered on Jomon exhibits, covering Niigata's history and culture, including snow and daily life.

sights.name: Kase Farm
sights.description: A mountain dairy farm in Nagaoka that raises only Guernsey cows and produces Guernsey milk with local water.

sights.name: Nagaoka Machibaru (Food and Drink Walk)
sights.description: A ticket-based eating and drinking walk through downtown Nagaoka; each ticket includes one drink and one pincho.

sights.name: Nagaoka War Damage Museum
sights.description: Museum opened in July 2003 that preserves records of the Nagaoka air raid and shares them with later generations.

sights.name: 34th Nagaoka City Flower Fair 2026
sights.name_ja: 第34回長岡市花いっぱいフェア2026
sights.description: Flower fair at Nagaoka Citizens Disaster Prevention Park, where about 20,000 citizen-grown flowers are in bloom, with hands-on activities, shopping, and food trucks.

sights.name: Koshi no Murasaki (Historic Soy Sauce Shop)
sights.name_en: Koshi no Murasaki (Historic Soy Sauce Shop)
sights.name_ja: 越のむらさき（地元に愛される老舗の醤油屋）
sights.description: Historic soy sauce shop in Nagaoka whose Meiji-era building, brick chimney and guidepost Jizo won the city's first urban landscape award.

sights.name: 19th Echigo-Nagaoka Hina Monogatari
sights.name_ja: 第19回越後長岡ひなものがたり
sights.description: Hina dolls kept around Nagaoka are displayed mainly along Ote-dori, including hanging, historic and creative styles.

sights.name: Teradomari Aquarium
sights.description: Octagonal aquarium on the sea with views all around and a tank of 300 species and 10,000 coastal and tropical fish.

sights.name: All-Japan Log Fast-Cutting Championship
sights.name_ja: 全日本丸太早切選手権大会
sights.description: Pairs cut a large log with a two-person saw in general, women's, and elementary divisions at Mishima Gymnasium in Nagaoka.

sights.name: Settaya and Miyauchi Brewing Town Walk
sights.name_en: Settaya and Miyauchi Brewing Town Walk
sights.name_ja: 江戸時代から続く醸造の町「摂田屋・宮内」を歩こう！
sights.description: In Nagaoka’s Settaya district, miso, soy sauce, and sake are still brewed, and brewery visits are available by reservation.

sights.name: Hakusan-hime Shrine
sights.description: Shrine in Teradomari, Nagaoka, dedicated to Izanami and Kikurihime, with a storehouse of 52 designated boat ema.

sights.name: Echigo-Nagaoka Expert Sightseeing Taxi
sights.name_ja: 越後長岡名人・達人観光タクシー
sights.description: Three-hour chartered taxi tours of recommended Nagaoka courses, guided by local drivers and adjustable to requests.

sights.name: Nagaoka Nature, History and Eguchi Dango
sights.name_en: Nagaoka Nature, History and Eguchi Dango
sights.name_ja: 長岡の自然や歴史にふれ、人気の「江口だんご」でグルメを堪能！
sights.description: Taxi course from Nagaoka Station to a park, history museum or botanical garden, then Eguchi Dango or the Umataka Jomon Museum.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park: Parent-Child Beetle Care Workshop
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park: Parent-Child Beetle Care Workshop
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「親子で学ぼう！カブトムシ・ノコギリクワガタの飼い方講座」
sights.description: A parent-child workshop on rhinoceros beetle and saw stag beetle ecology and care, with a cage and adults to raise at home.

sights.name: Villa Voix
sights.description: A private Finnish-style sauna for Villa Voix guests, with a cold-water jacuzzi, outdoor terrace recliners for air bathing, and a VIP room for groups of ten or more.

sights.name: Christmas Rose Festa at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_en: Christmas Rose Festa at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「クリスマスローズフェスタ」
sights.description: About 200 pots of Christmas roses from Niigata breeders are displayed, with cultivation classes, lectures, auctions, and photo spots.

sights.name: Happodai Viewpoint
sights.description: A night-view spot on a summit about 600 meters high overlooking Nagaoka, with almost no lights to the east and a starry sky.

sights.name: 17th Flower Stamp Rally
sights.name_ja: 「第17回フラワースタンプラリー」
sights.description: A smartphone digital stamp rally visiting four Niigata flower sites and 16 sponsor facilities, with lottery prizes for 390 people.

sights.name: Ote-dori Winter Illumination 2025
sights.name_ja: 大手通ウィンターイルミネーション2025
sights.description: Annual lights decorate Ote-dori crossing and its pocket park, the bank-front crossing, Ao-re Nagaoka, and Central Street in the Christmas season.

sights.name: Kome Hyappyo Place Miraie Nagaoka
sights.name_ja: 米百俵プレイス ミライエ長岡
sights.description: A civic complex in Nagaoka on the former Kokkan School site, with a library, industry exchange space, and programs rooted in the Hundred Sacks of Rice spirit.

sights.name: Nakanoshima Suwa Shrine Lantern Pushing Ritual
sights.name_en: Nakanoshima Suwa Shrine Lantern Pushing Ritual
sights.name_ja: 中之島諏訪神社灯籠神事（灯籠押し合い）
sights.description: At Nakanoshima Suwa Shrine's autumn-festival eve, a rite over 100 years old, young men in matching happi coats push seven straw-linked, illuminated lanterns at a drum signal.

sights.name: Aore! German Fest 2026
sights.name_ja: アオーレ！ドイツフェスト2026
sights.description: Festival at Aore Nagaoka, held since 2013 with sister city Trier and friendship city Bamberg, offering German beer, sausages, imported wine, and stage music.

sights.name: Yosenji Temple (Teradomari)
sights.description: Jodo Shinshu Otani-ha temple in Teradomari that moved from Shinano in 1593, with century-old pines overlooking the Sea of Japan and Sado Island.

sights.name: Goto no Ichi Market
sights.description: A long-established market selling fresh fish, vegetables, fruit, clothing, and daily goods, where lively calls draw many shoppers.

sights.name: Yabusame at Kinpu Shrine
sights.description: Horseback archery at Kinpu Shrine’s festival, a rite remaining in Niigata Prefecture only here and on Sado.

sights.name: Aollumination2025-2026
sights.description: A light-and-music illumination at Ao-re Nagaoka runs special shows from 16:00 to 20:00, with a Christmas tree in Nakadoma until 25 December.

sights.name: City Hall Plaza Aore Nagaoka (Nagaoka City Hall)
sights.name_en: City Hall Plaza Aore Nagaoka (Nagaoka City Hall)
sights.name_ja: シティホールプラザ アオーレ長岡(長岡市役所)
sights.description: A Kengo Kuma-designed public complex three minutes on foot from JR Nagaoka Station, with a covered plaza, arena, city hall, and a free theater showing Nagaoka fireworks.

sights.name: Tochio Aburaage (Fried Tofu)
sights.name_ja: 栃尾の油揚げ（あぶらげ）
sights.description: Jumbo fried tofu from Tochio, 22 cm long with a springy bite, made at 15 shops in the area.

sights.name: Akiha Sanjakubō Daigongen (Akiha Shrine)
sights.name_ja: 秋葉三尺坊大権現（秋葉神社）
sights.description: Fire-prevention shrine in Akiha Park, said to have been transferred by Uesugi Kenshin in 1551, with tengu carvings by Ishikawa Unchō.

sights.name: Private Sauna ART
sights.description: Completely private sauna room where guests can pour water on the stones at their own pace.

sights.name: Nagaoka Municipal Science Museum
sights.description: A science museum in Saiwai Plaza with exhibits on Nagaoka's nature and history, cultural properties, and a restored Nagaoka Castle model.

sights.name: Suido Park
sights.description: Urban park in Nagaoka with a 1927 water tank and classical-modern waterworks buildings registered as national tangible cultural properties.

sights.name: Teradomari Port Park
sights.description: Park beside Teradomari Port with a lawn plaza and playground equipment, used by families as a lunch and rest spot.

sights.name: Nozumi Beach
sights.description: A swimming beach at the entrance of the Echigo Nanaura Seaside Line in Teradomari, Nagaoka.

sights.name: Ryokan no Sato Art Museum
sights.description: Art museum centered on calligraphy and poetry by Ryokan and Teishin-ni, with overlapping buildings representing the monk and his disciple.

sights.name: Eguchi Dango Main Store
sights.description: Sweets shop in a renovated folk house amid Nagaoka countryside, offering rice-cake sweets and reserved dango-making experiences.

sights.name: Rakusui Beach
sights.description: A municipal sandy beach in the Washima district of Nagaoka, with a free rest area, toilets, and a nearby auto campsite.

sights.name: Momiji-en (Hilltop Guest House)
sights.name_ja: もみじ園『丘の上の迎賓館』
sights.description: A roughly 4,000-square-meter garden of 150- to 200-year-old maples, mountain cherries and azaleas, with autumn night lighting and a cafe.

sights.name: Todonomori Spring
sights.name_ja: 杜々の森湧水（とどのもりゆうすい）
sights.description: A year-round soft-water spring in Nagaoka, named one of Japan's 100 Famous Waters in 1985.

sights.name: Kanayama Beach
sights.description: The original swimming beach in Teradomari, near the aquarium, with sandy and rocky shore for families.

sights.name: Kigoro Memorial Park
sights.name_ja: 木籠メモリアルパーク
sights.description: Memorial park where houses of Kigoro village, submerged by river-channel blockage, remain as traces of the Chuetsu Earthquake.

sights.name: Former Kina Saffron Liquor Brewery and Rice Storehouse
sights.name_en: Former Kina Saffron Liquor Brewery and Rice Storehouse
sights.name_ja: 旧機那サフラン酒製造本舗・米蔵
sights.description: A Meiji-era saffron-liquor brewery in Settaya, now a registered cultural property whose rice storehouse holds a fermentation museum and cafe.

sights.name: Mount Sumon Opening Ceremony (Otake)
sights.description: Annual mountain-opening event on Mount Sumon in Nagaoka, held on the fourth Sunday in May to start the climbing season.

sights.name: Kawai Tsugunosuke Memorial Museum
sights.description: Museum on the site of Kawai Tsugunosuke's birthplace, displaying about 30 related items and a garden visible from the windows.

sights.name: Kikumori Memorial Art Museum
sights.name_ja: 菊盛記念美術館 ※現在、休館中です。
sights.description: Art museum displaying a personal collection of modern sculptures by Auguste Rodin, Takamura Kotaro and other artists, plus 11 paintings.

sights.name: Echigo Hepatica Road Smartphone Stamp Rally 2026
sights.name_en: Echigo Hepatica Road Smartphone Stamp Rally 2026
sights.name_ja: えちご雪割草街道スマホでスタンプラリー2026
sights.description: A smartphone stamp rally linking four hepatica flower sites in Kashiwazaki and Nagaoka with nearby hot springs and dining facilities.

sights.name: Chosei Bridge (Shinano River)
sights.description: Completed in 1937, the 850-meter Chosei Bridge crosses the Shinano River in Nagaoka and hosts Niagara fireworks during the Nagaoka Festival.

sights.name: Settaya Brewing Town Stroll and Koryu Shrine
sights.name_en: Settaya Brewing Town Stroll and Koryu Shrine
sights.name_ja: 醸造のまち摂田屋散策とパワースポット高龍神社
sights.description: Same-day taxi course from Nagaoka Station through Settaya's breweries and Koryu Shrine, lasting about two and a half hours.

sights.name: Hiragata Shrine
sights.description: A shrine in central Nagaoka, revered as the citizens' guardian deity and called Chiken-sama, with a memorial tower for Nagaoka air-raid victims.

sights.name: Kaifutei Teradomari Sea of Japan Live-Fish Restaurant
sights.name_en: Kaifutei Teradomari Sea of Japan Live-Fish Restaurant
sights.name_ja: 海風亭 寺泊 日本海 いけすレストラン
sights.description: Live-fish restaurant in Teradomari with island-like tatami seating, serving a 12-item seafood bowl with rock-seaweed soup.

sights.name: Washima Tout le Monde
sights.name_ja: 和島トゥー・ル・モンド
sights.description: A restaurant and bakery in Washima's renovated 85-year-old wooden former Shimada Elementary School, serving food made with local ingredients.

sights.name: Hoozan Myohoji Temple
sights.name_ja: 日蓮宗本山村田 法王山 妙法寺
sights.description: Nichiren Buddhist head temple in Murata, Nagaoka, founded in 1307 amid cedar groves, with a centuries-old red gate and seasonal flowers.

sights.name: Chiakigahara Hometown Forest
sights.name_ja: 千秋が原ふるさとの森
sights.description: Green grounds in Nagaoka with flower and green plazas and cultural facilities, including a modern art museum.

sights.name: Nyozo Museum
sights.description: Museum in Nagaoka with materials on Nomoto Kyohachiro, donor of Goson Bunko, and on people connected with Nagaoka.

sights.name: Aoshiba Shrine
sights.description: Shrine on Yukyuzan in Nagaoka, landscaped in 1781 after Nikko Toshogu, whose approach is lined with a thousand cherry trees.

sights.name: Masugatayama Nature Park
sights.description: Nature park on Sengoku-period castle-ruin terrain, with an observation plaza overlooking Echigo Sanzan and the Sea of Japan, walking paths, and 25 tent sites.

sights.name: Italian (Friend)
sights.description: At Friend, Italian differs in seasoning and noodle thickness from Niigata City's Mikazuki, and a gyoza set is a typical combination.

sights.name: Kitado Shrine
sights.description: Shrine built in 1848 for Uemura Kakusaemon, who laid the foundations of Tochio textiles, its small hall filled with Uncho carvings of silk-making.

sights.name: Daishi Hokuetsu Museum: Nagaoka’s Journey
sights.name_ja: 第四北越ミュージアム ～長岡のあゆみ～
sights.description: Museum opened in 2023 for Daishi Hokuetsu Bank’s 150th anniversary, exhibiting bank history, Boshin War recovery, modern industry, and how money and banks work.

sights.name: Hōshō-ji Temple
sights.description: A temple in suburban Nagaoka preserving 32 of the Saigoku Thirty-three Kannon statues carved by Mokujiki in 1804.

sights.name: Niigata Ajinoren Honpo (Nanokamachi Store)
sights.name_ja: 新潟味のれん本舗 七日町直営店
sights.description: Rice-cracker shop, noted as relocated, selling Echigo senbei made from Niigata rice by traditional craftsmanship.

sights.name: Yamakoshi Reconstruction Exchange Center Orataru
sights.name_ja: やまこし復興交流館おらたる
sights.description: Exchange center in Yamakoshi sharing Chuetsu Earthquake experiences, resident testimonies and recovery stories, also a starting point for the area.

sights.name: BOOKMARKS CAFE
sights.description: Cafe in the west building of Miraie Nagaoka, beside Goson Library, serving bakery goods, side dishes, and coffee.

sights.name: Hasegawa Residence (Former Hasegawa Family House)
sights.name_ja: 長谷川邸（旧長谷川家住宅）
sights.description: Early-Edo village headman's farmhouse in Nagaoka, with a roughly 300-year-old thatched main house, surrounding moat, and large gate.

sights.name: Eiryōji Temple
sights.description: Family temple of the Makino clan, lords of Nagaoka, with graves of Kawai Tsugunosuke, Lord Makino Tadanori, and Mishima Okujirō.

sights.name: Ushi no Tsunotsuki Bullfighting (Ojiya and Yamakoshi)
sights.name_en: Ushi no Tsunotsuki Bullfighting (Ojiya and Yamakoshi)
sights.name_ja: 牛の角突き（小千谷・山古志）
sights.description: Traditional bullfighting with over 1,000 years of history, a national Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property, held in Ojiya and Yamakoshi and generally ended in a draw.

sights.name: Ju Kan Sono
sights.description: Sightseeing spot in Nagaoka, Niigata.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Sasa Dango Making)
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Sasa Dango Making)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「笹だんごづくり」
sights.description: Visitors make sasa dango at Echigo Hillside National Government Park using bamboo leaves and mugwort gathered in the park.

sights.name: Nagaoka Kojimaya Main Store
sights.description: Soba restaurant in Nagaoka serving hegi soba, Echigo buckwheat noodles bound with seaweed, and Niigata tare-katsu don.

sights.name: Saifukuji Temple
sights.description: Its bell, struck in 1868 to warn Nagaoka of attacking government forces, is called the Dawn Bell of the Restoration.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Bungee Trampoline and Spinning Boat)
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Bungee Trampoline and Spinning Boat)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「バンジートランポリン・くるくるボート」
sights.description: Play activities at Echigo Hillside National Government Park in Nagaoka, where visitors strap on a rubber belt and jump high into the air.

sights.name: Rose Cultivation Workshop at Echigo Hillside National Government Park (After Autumn Bloom to Overwintering)
sights.name_en: Rose Cultivation Workshop at Echigo Hillside National Government Park (After Autumn Bloom to Overwintering)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「ばら栽培講習会～秋ばらの開花後から越冬まで～」
sights.description: Beginner-focused lecture with demonstrations on upcoming rose care at Echigo Hillside National Government Park in Nagaoka.

sights.name: Yamamoto Memorial Park
sights.description: Park on the site of Yamamoto Isoroku's birthplace, with a restored house and a bronze bust.

sights.name: Mount Sumon Tochibori Trailhead
sights.description: Intermediate Tochibori trailhead for 1,432 m Sumondake, one of Japan’s 200 famous mountains, about two hours to the summit, with a hut.

sights.name: Mount Sumon (Irishio River Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 守門岳・入塩川登山口
sights.description: A 1,432 m peak in Echigo Sanzan-Tadami Quasi-National Park, listed among Japan's 200 Famous Mountains; the summit takes about 4 hours 30 minutes.

sights.name: Todoroki-no-Mori Spring Park
sights.description: A park beside Todoroki-no-Mori Spring, one of Japan's 100 Famous Waters, where soft water flows year-round, about 2,000 tons a day even in summer drought.

sights.name: Echigo Yukwariso Highway Day Bus Tour 2026
sights.name_en: Echigo Yukwariso Highway Day Bus Tour 2026
sights.name_ja: えちご雪割草街道 日帰りバスツアー2026
sights.description: A spring day bus tour of yukwariso flower sites from Nagaoka, with bloom-timed routes, local-specialty lunch, and local-product shopping.

sights.name: Nokogiriyama Hanadate Course Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 鋸山・花立コース登山口
sights.description: Hanadate course trailhead for Nokogiriyama, a jagged ridge of 765 metres that takes about four hours to climb, with no mountain hut.

sights.name: Osugi Park
sights.description: A park beside Rengeji Temple’s great cedar, a prefectural natural monument, with barbecue areas and playground equipment.

sights.name: Tochio Castle Ruins
sights.description: Castle ruins on 227-meter Mt. Kakujoyama where Uesugi Kenshin raised his banner as a youth, with four trekking courses and summit views of Tochio.

sights.name: Jūun-en Garden
sights.description: Garden of the Kusumi family, founders of Echigo Railway, created in 1717 with borrowed views of Mount Yahiko.

sights.name: Nagaoka Earthquake Archive Center Kioku Mirai
sights.name_en: Nagaoka Earthquake Archive Center Kioku Mirai
sights.name_ja: 長岡震災アーカイブセンター きおくみらい ※2026年1月31日閉館
sights.description: Nagaoka archive center sharing records and lessons of the Niigata Chuetsu Earthquake; the current site closes at the end of January 2026.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Wooden Plate Carving)
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Wooden Plate Carving)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「公園の木をノミで彫ってお皿を作ろう！」
sights.description: Visitors cut, split, and carve wood from trees on the park grounds to make a wooden plate; advance online registration is required.

sights.name: Nagaoka Domain Makino Family Historical Museum
sights.name_en: Nagaoka Domain Makino Family Historical Museum
sights.name_ja: 長岡藩主 牧野家史料館
sights.description: Museum of materials from the Makino lords, who ruled Nagaoka for about 250 years, including a restored model of Nagaoka Castle.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park Water Playground
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park Water Playground
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「水遊び広場」
sights.description: Summer-only water playground with 12 unique water toys, including water machine guns and human-powered water wheels, in 10–20 cm water.

sights.name: Gōmoto Beach
sights.description: A sandy and rocky swimming beach in Teradomari, where blocks calm offshore waves so families can swim.

sights.name: Kawaguchi Sports Park Cottage Village
sights.name_ja: 川口運動公園 コテージ村
sights.description: Natural-wood cottages in the center of Kawaguchi Sports Park, near picnic areas, tennis courts, and hot springs.

sights.name: Cherry Blossoms along the Fukushimae
sights.description: A row of cherry trees along the Fukushimae blooms overhanging the water.

sights.name: Nagaoka City Local History Museum
sights.description: On a hill in Yukyuzan Park, a castle-keep-style building introduces local figures and displays Nagaoka's history and snow-country folk materials.

sights.name: Najirate Sekihara (Fresh Produce Market)
sights.name_ja: とれたて旬鮮市なじら～て 関原店
sights.description: A direct-sales market in Sekihara, Nagaoka, offering seasonal local vegetables, farmer-made deli foods, pickles, and soft-serve ice cream, with harvest fields behind the shop.

sights.name: Sacred Well of Nichiren Shonin's Inkstone Water
sights.name_en: Sacred Well of Nichiren Shonin's Inkstone Water
sights.description: Sacred well on the Soshido grounds in Teradomari, preserved as the inkstone water Nichiren used when writing the Teradomari Gosho in 1271.

sights.name: City Hall Plaza Ao-re Nagaoka (Theater)
sights.name_ja: シティホールプラザ アオーレ長岡（シアター）
sights.description: Theater at City Hall Plaza Ao-re Nagaoka with a 240-inch screen showing live-action films of Nagaoka fireworks and local culture.

sights.name: Mikojiodori Folk Dance
sights.description: Mikojiodori is a Niigata-designated folk art from Taromaru, with a pair of dancing dolls performed at Shibumi Shrine's spring festival.

sights.name: Tochio 24th Special Market
sights.description: Special Tochio 24th market with free freshly pounded mochi, food trucks, workshops, a shooting gallery, and mini-games.

sights.name: Nagaoka Local Sake School
sights.description: A Nagaoka sake event with brewery tours, seasonal tastings, and talks with brewers, including courses at Asahi Shuzo and Ofuku Shuzo.

sights.name: Higashiyama Fureai Agricultural Park
sights.name_ja: 東山ふれあい農業公園
sights.description: Agricultural park in Nagaoka with views of the Shinano River, Echigo Plain, city and night scenery, beside a municipal ski area with a campground and sports ground.

sights.name: Nature Craft Diorama Workshop at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_en: Nature Craft Diorama Workshop at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「ネイチャークラフトを楽しもう～自然素材のジオラマづくり～」
sights.description: A workshop making an original diorama from wood, sand, nuts, and other natural materials combined with a favorite figurine.

sights.name: Nagaoka City Industrial Exhibition Room
sights.description: Industrial exhibition room where Nagaoka's history and industries are shown through multi-screen videos and displays of valuable materials.

sights.name: Western Army (New Government Army) Landing Site
sights.name_en: Western Army (New Government Army) Landing Site
sights.name_ja: 西軍(新政府軍)上陸の地
sights.description: Landing place in Nakajima, Nagaoka, where the Western Army came ashore after crossing the Shinano River; domain soldiers' graves and a memorial stand nearby.

sights.name: Akiba Park (Kenshin Ko Dozo Akiba Shrine Oku no In)
sights.description: Park and shrine in Nagaoka, Niigata.

sights.name: Tochio Temari
sights.description: Traditional Echigo hand-stitched temari from Tochio, with named silk-thread patterns and nuts inside that rattle when shaken.

sights.name: Koshi Four Seasons Village
sights.description: Recreation area in Yamakoshi with Amayachi Hall for rest, bathing and meetings, plus a campsite, sports ground and five log houses.

sights.name: Umamichi Forest Park
sights.description: Forest campground overlooking the Echigo mountains and Shinano River, with tree-style bungalows, birdwatching, and insect collecting.

sights.name: Nagaoka City Tochio Art Museum
sights.description: Art museum with permanent displays of works by locally connected artists and a Uesugi Kenshin mausoleum on the grounds.

sights.name: Aguratte Nagaoka Farm Station (Hometown Experience Agriculture Center)
sights.name_en: Aguratte Nagaoka Farm Station (Hometown Experience Agriculture Center)
sights.name_ja: 農の駅あぐらって長岡(ふるさと体験農業センター)
sights.description: A farm station where visitors can process and cook products such as miso, ham, sausage, and soba amid rich nature.

sights.name: Ushigakubi Observatory
sights.description: An observatory in Nagaoka, developed in 2021 at about 260 meters, overlooking the Uonuma townscape and Echigo Sanzan mountains.

sights.name: Fun Insect Clock Making at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_en: Fun Insect Clock Making at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園『おもしろ こん虫時計づくり』
sights.description: A class at Echigo Hillside National Government Park for making insect-shaped clocks; advance booking is recommended as same-day entry ends at capacity.

sights.name: Yoita History and Folklore Museum (Kanetsugu Ofune Museum)
sights.name_en: Yoita History and Folklore Museum (Kanetsugu Ofune Museum)
sights.name_ja: 与板歴史民俗資料館（兼続お船ミュージアム）
sights.description: A museum in Yoita displaying a replica of Naoe Kanetsugu's armor, local history, and the story of Japan's first beer brewer, Nakagawa Seibei.

sights.name: NEST Nagaoka
sights.description: NEST Nagaoka offers meditation pods and real-time communication with remote OriHime telepresence-robot pilots.

sights.name: Satoyama Segway Tour at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_en: Satoyama Segway Tour at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「里山セグウェイツアー」
sights.description: A guided Segway tour through the expansive satoyama of Echigo Hillside National Government Park in Nagaoka.

sights.name: Yukyuzan Baseball Stadium
sights.description: A baseball stadium in Yukyuzan Park with 98m foul lines, a 122m center field, and stands seating about 8,000.

sights.name: Nagaoka Castle Ruins (Ninomaru Site)
sights.name_ja: 長岡城址 二の丸跡
sights.description: Second-bailey site of Nagaoka Castle, marked by a stone monument; the keep-less castle used a turret called Osangai in its place.

sights.name: Shotoku-ji Garden
sights.description: A secluded pond-stroll garden of 4,108.5 square meters at Shotoku-ji, with hills, a pond, a waterfall, trees and stones.

sights.name: Nanbu Shrine
sights.description: Nagaoka shrine to sericulture deity Ama-no-Kagutsuchi, called Nekomata Gongen, with stone cat statues and a 1333 Nitta legend.

sights.name: Satoyama Walking at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_en: Satoyama Walking at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「里山ウォーキング」
sights.description: Park volunteer staff guide seasonal highlights along the nature trail on this casual walk.

sights.name: Former Kina Saffron Liquor Manufacturing Main Store
sights.name_en: Former Kina Saffron Liquor Manufacturing Main Store
sights.name_ja: 旧機那サフラン酒製造本舗「鏝絵蔵」「主屋」「離れ座敷」
sights.description: Former Settaya estate and storehouses of saffron-liquor maker Yoshizawa Jintaro, with colorful kote-e plaster reliefs and an onigiri café in a rice storehouse.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Nagaoka Winter Fes 2026 Linked Event)
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Nagaoka Winter Fes 2026 Linked Event)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「ながおかウィンターフェス2026連動イベント」
sights.description: Winter event at Echigo Hillside National Government Park linked to Nagaoka Winter Fes, with snow rafting, snow molkky, and snow-hike tours.

sights.name: Shoraikaku
sights.description: Residence completed by 1934 for Asahi Shuzo founder Hirasawa Konosuke, later relocated and designated a National Important Cultural Property in 2018.

sights.name: Let's Enjoy Trail Running! (Echigo Hillside National Government Park)
sights.name_en: Let's Enjoy Trail Running! (Echigo Hillside National Government Park)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「トレイルランニングを楽しもう！」
sights.description: A beginner-friendly trail running experience session on unpaved mountain and field trails.

sights.name: Tokushō-ji Temple and Ruins
sights.description: Sōtō Zen family temple of Yoita Castle lord Naoe Yamashiro-no-kami, linked to Ryōkan, with Middle Jōmon pit dwellings for four or five people.

sights.name: Teradomari Historic Sites Tour
sights.name_ja: 史跡めぐり「情緒豊かな寺泊の史跡」
sights.description: Volunteer guides lead a walk of Teradomari’s historic sites, a designated Kitamaebune port of call and shipowner settlement.

sights.name: Sakanoue Elementary School Tradition Hall
sights.name_ja: 阪之上小学校 伝統館
sights.description: A school tradition hall with five exhibits on the 100 sacks of rice, the Boshin War, Kokkan School, Sakanoue Elementary School, and the Nagaoka air raid.

sights.name: Paper Art Museum
sights.description: Museum in Oguni's papermaking district displaying Oguni washi, Japanese and world papers, and objects made of paper and light.

sights.name: Kakigawa River
sights.description: One hundred Somei-Yoshino cherry trees line the Kakigawa River in central Nagaoka, from Atrium Nagaoka to the Yanagihara branch office.

sights.name: Chomeido Ameho (Japanese Confectionery)
sights.description: A Nagaoka confectioner founded in 1912, known for ame monaka of mild starch syrup in toasted wafers.

sights.name: Teradomari Beach Sports Court
sights.name_ja: 寺泊ビーチスポーツコート
sights.description: Seasonal recreation courts beside Teradomari Central Beach for beach volleyball, beach tennis, and beach soccer, with some equipment available to borrow.

sights.name: Chaya Sumiyoshiya Beach House
sights.name_ja: 海の家「茶や すみよしや」 2024年7月12日～夏営業開始です！
sights.description: A summer-only beach house at Teradomari Central Beach in Nagaoka, a shallow family beach five minutes by car from the Sumiyoshiya inn.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Flower Picture Project)
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Flower Picture Project)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「花絵プロジェクト」
sights.description: Flower-picture project at Echigo Hillside National Government Park: on 22 April 2023, visitors arranged 40,000 Tainai tulips into pictures of Miffy, Dan, and Kororin.

sights.name: Nagaoka Country Club
sights.name_ja: 長岡カントリー倶楽部
sights.description: A 27-hole woodland golf course separated by pine forest, opened in 1966, with a practice range and about 10 minutes from Nagaoka IC.

sights.name: Weeping Cherry at Korinji Temple
sights.description: A single-petaled red weeping cherry at Korinji Temple, said to have been planted in 1576, about 20 meters tall and a Nagaoka City natural monument.

sights.name: Nozumi River Park
sights.description: A park on high ground in Nozumi overlooking the Sea of Japan, with 17 Somei-Yoshino cherry trees.

sights.name: Rengeji Great Cedar
sights.description: An upright cedar about 1,200 years old, 50 m tall and 9 m around at eye level, stands in the grounds of Rengeji’s Shichisha-gu shrine.

sights.name: Yamakoshi Walking Stamp Rally [HAKONIWA]TRIP
sights.name_ja: やまこし散策スタンプラリー[HAKONIWA]TRIP
sights.description: Stamp rally held in Yamakoshi in 2021, where participants collected four or more stamps and redeemed them at Orataru.

sights.name: Kuriyamazawa Weeping Cherry
sights.description: A weeping cherry about 120 years old and 15 meters tall stands in Kuriyamazawa, Nagaoka, where villagers hold a one-day blossom viewing.

sights.name: Kokuei Echigo Kyuryo Park (Shiitake Nameko no Hoda Ki Zukuri)
Teradomari Sea of Japan Sunset Forest Cherry Avenue
sights.name_en: Teradomari Sea of Japan Sunset Forest Cherry Avenue
sights.name_ja: 寺泊日本海夕日の森 桜並木
sights.description: Cherry-tree avenue at Teradomari’s Sea of Japan Sunset Forest, where visitors stroll under blossom arches within sound of distant waves.

sights.name: Epicenter Memorial Park
sights.name_ja: 震央メモリアルパーク
sights.description: Memorial park at the Chuetsu Earthquake epicenter, with paths, a pavilion, and a roughly 30-minute hiking loop maintained by locals.

sights.name: Oguchi Lotus Root
sights.description: A white lotus root from Nakanoshima, Nagaoka, that does not turn black when boiled and has a crisp texture.

sights.name: Eguchi Dango Settaya Store
sights.name_ja: 江口だんご 摂田屋店
sights.description: Sweets shop in an Edo-period house in Settaya, serving dango and brewery-fermented sweets with a Japanese-garden cafe.

sights.name: Imamiya Park
sights.description: Imamiya Park is surrounded by 100 Somei-Yoshino cherry trees and has a spiral slide, large play equipment, a lawn plaza, and walking paths.

sights.name: Komagata Jukichi Memorial Art Museum
sights.description: Art museum in Nagaoka exhibiting 160 Taisho- and Showa-period works, including Japanese paintings, Western-style paintings, and ceramics, from Komagata Jukichi's collection.

sights.name: Kawai Shrine
sights.description: Shrine in Nagaoka, one of the five Uonuma shrines in the Engishiki, worshipped as a deity of water and sex and also called Aorisama.

sights.name: Yururiya Coworking and Share Space
sights.name_ja: コワーキング＆シェアスペース ゆるり屋
sights.description: Detached-house coworking and share space within walking distance of Nagaoka Station, with a homey Japanese room, earthen-floor space, private booths, and meeting rooms.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Spring Birdwatching)
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Spring Birdwatching)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「春のバードウォッチング」
sights.description: Spring birdwatching is held at the satoyama field museum of Echigo Hillside National Government Park.

sights.name: Kome-gura 5th Anniversary Storehouse Mystery Rally
sights.name_ja: 米蔵リニューアル5周年「蔵めぐり謎解きラリー」
sights.description: A fifth-anniversary event touring six Settaya storehouses to solve mysteries, with a capsule lottery at the former Kina Saffron sake brewery rice warehouse.

sights.name: JOYFUL Soccer Experience at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_en: JOYFUL Soccer Experience at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「JOYFULサッカー体験会」
sights.description: A soccer experience welcoming first-time children, with no reservation required.

sights.name: Enjoy the Full Bounty of the Sea of Japan
sights.name_en: Enjoy the Full Bounty of the Sea of Japan
sights.name_ja: 日本海の恵をまるごと楽しむ
sights.description: Teradomari has four beaches along 16 km of coast, with seafood, swimming, marine sports, fishing, an aquarium, and hot springs.

sights.name: Enoki Pass Historic Battlefield Park
sights.description: Historic battlefield park at Enoki Pass, 13 km south of Nagaoka castle town, where Nagaoka domain troops fired on 10 May 1868.

sights.name: Fujibashi Historical Plaza (Fujibashi Site)
sights.name_ja: 藤橋歴史の広場（藤橋遺跡）
sights.description: Historical plaza at the late Jomon Fujibashi Site, where raised-floor buildings, pottery, and jade-working remains were found.

sights.name: Jōan-ji Temple (Akiha Park)
sights.description: Temple in Akiha Park founded by Uesugi Kenshin in 1547, preserving his calligraphy and a portrait of him with two retainers.

sights.name: Bust of Isoroku Yamamoto
sights.description: A 1.16-metre bust of Isoroku Yamamoto, erected in 1970, stands in a memorial park at his restored birthplace in Nagaoka.

sights.name: Insect Specimen Making at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_en: Insect Specimen Making at Echigo Hillside National Government Park
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園『昆虫標本づくり』
sights.description: A class at Echigo Hillside National Government Park to make specimens from dragonflies captured in the park and learn about insects.

sights.name: Echigo Nagaoka Sake Festival and Nagaoka Local Sake Workshop
sights.name_en: Echigo Nagaoka Sake Festival and Nagaoka Local Sake Workshop
sights.name_ja: 越後長岡酒の陣と長岡地酒塾
sights.description: A one-night tour in Nagaoka combining a sake festival with a local sake workshop, a choice of brewery courses, and a bottled souvenir.

sights.name: Kawaguchi Kizuna Hall
sights.description: Kawaguchi hall exhibiting bonds built during recovery from the Niigata Chuetsu Earthquake; the current site closes from 1 February 2026.

sights.name: Todo no Mori Seiya Kaji Collaboration Scrap-Material Aquarium
sights.name_en: Todo no Mori Seiya Kaji Collaboration Scrap-Material Aquarium
sights.name_ja: 杜々の森×加治聖哉コラボ企画「廃材水族館」
sights.description: Aquarium-themed scrap-material exhibition by artist Seiya Kaji, with rays as this year’s focus and one new work each month.

sights.name: Chokoji Temple
sights.description: Temple in Nagaoka with graves of many domain samurai, including Yamamoto Tatewaki, and of Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto.

sights.name: Yachi Pond Kakitsubata Colony
sights.name_ja: 谷内池「カキツバタ群生地」
sights.description: A natural kakitsubata iris colony at Yachi Pond in Nagaoka, blooming deep purple, pale purple, and white from mid-May to early June.

sights.name: Echigo Yukwariso Highway Day Bus Tour 2026
sights.name_en: Echigo Yukwariso Highway Day Bus Tour 2026
sights.name_ja: えちご雪割草街道 日帰りバスツアー2026
sights.description: Spring day bus tour from Nagaoka visiting hepatica fields on two 2026 courses, including a local lunch and specialty shopping.

sights.name: WILLOW HOUSE
sights.description: A restaurant themed on fermentation, inspired by the brewing town of Settaya, and on circulation, with a natural-yeast bakery and wood-fired oven.

sights.name: Tochio Gangi and Aburaage Town Stroll
sights.name_en: Tochio Gangi and Aburaage Town Stroll
sights.name_ja: 雁木と「あぶらげ」のまち栃尾散策
sights.description: A same-day taxi tour from Nagaoka Station with two courses visiting Tochio’s gangi streets, Mamesen, or Akiha Shrine.

sights.name: Teradomari Cultural Center Summer Craft Kids Fest
sights.name_en: Teradomari Cultural Center Summer Craft Kids Fest
sights.name_ja: 寺泊文化センター「夏休み工作キッズフェス」
sights.description: Annual summer craft workshops for elementary students, with 21 classes plus festival stalls and e-sports; advance booking required.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park Premium Camp Experience
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park Premium Camp Experience
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園「プレミアム・キャンプ体験会」
sights.description: An adult camp program at Echigo Hillside National Government Park teaching bushcraft, campfire cooking, and night walks under the stars.

sights.name: Koshiji Rogaining 2024 (Koshiroge)
sights.name_ja: 越路ロゲイニング2024「コシロゲ」
sights.description: An outdoor navigation event in Nagaoka’s Koshiji district where teams visit historic and tourist checkpoints within three hours; the 2024 event has ended.

sights.name: KOSHIJI Snow King in Momiji-en and Koshijihara
sights.name_en: KOSHIJI Snow King in Momiji-en and Koshijihara
sights.name_ja: KOSHIJI スノーキング INもみじ園・越路原
sights.description: A snowshoe walk through snowy rural hills at Momiji-en and Koshijihara, where animal tracks can be seen and snowshoes are rented free.

sights.name: Ito Doemon Monument
sights.description: Monument to Ito Doemon, the 62-year-old Nagaoka domain artillery captain who died fighting at the fall of Nagaoka Castle.

sights.name: Isoroku Yamamoto Birthplace (Restored)
sights.description: Restored birthplace of Isoroku Yamamoto in Nagaoka, rebuilt after the original home was destroyed in the war.

sights.name: Snow Camping at Kawaguchi Sports Park
sights.name_en: Snow Camping at Kawaguchi Sports Park
sights.name_ja: 川口運動公園「雪中キャンプ」
sights.description: Winter camping on an uncompacted snow field at Kawaguchi Sports Park in Nagaoka, with snowy scenery unlike summer camping.

sights.name: Nagaoka Monozukuri Festival
sights.name_ja: ながおかものづくりフェス
sights.description: A hands-on event in Nagaoka with hand-spinner assembly, metal craft, robot operation, crafts, and woodworking.

sights.name: Takashi Akiyama Poster Museum Nagaoka
sights.name_ja: 秋山孝ポスター美術館長岡（アート）
sights.description: A museum in the former Hokuetsu Bank building, a registered tangible cultural property from the Taisho era, showing works by Nagaoka-born artist Takashi Akiyama.

sights.name: Yoita Rakuzan-en Garden
sights.description: A Meiji-era villa and garden in Yoita, built in 1892 by merchant Miwa Juntaro, with tea houses, a Kannon statue, and seasonal hydrangeas.

sights.name: Hacchō-oki Historic Battlefield Park
sights.description: Battlefield park in Nagaoka marking Tsuginosuke’s surprise wetland crossing by over 690 soldiers that recaptured Nagaoka Castle, with a monument and washbasin.

sights.name: Fusaiji Temple
sights.description: A temple with memorials to young soldiers who died in the Hokuetsu Boshin War and the grave of Nagaoka's first lord, Makino Tadanari.

sights.name: Kawai Tsugunosuke Monument
sights.description: A monument to Kawai Tsugunosuke whose inscription was written by Mishima Chushu, moved to Yukyuzan Park in 1918.

sights.name: Aoshiba Shrine
sights.description: Shrine once located in Nagaoka Castle's main bailey, now on Mount Yukyu, still watching over the people of Echigo-Nagaoka.

sights.name: Rinkoan Temple
sights.description: Rinkoan displays 14 transoms and four lion-head carvings by Ishikawa Uncho, reportedly donated in 1864, plus fusuma paintings and an umbrella ceiling.

sights.name: Tachibana Park (Yoita Riverside Green Space)
sights.name_ja: 与板河川緑地たちばな公園
sights.description: Park along the old Kurokawa riverbed in Yoita, nicknamed Dinosaur Park, with a dinosaur slide and about 2,500 irises.

sights.name: Tsukanoyama Ushinokubi District
sights.name_ja: 長岡市塚野山牛ノ首地区
sights.description: District in Tsukanoyama, Nagaoka, where Genji and Heike fireflies can be seen across the area in season.

sights.name: Mount Sumon
sights.description: Mount Sumon in Nagaoka is visited year-round for its large snow cornice, beech forests, and autumn leaves, with Hokure and Irishiogawa as the main hiking courses.

sights.name: Kawaguchi Sports Park
sights.description: Sports park in Kawaguchi, Nagaoka, with a baseball field, tennis courts, gymnasium, auto campground, and picnic areas.

sights.name: Manbonzakura Cherry Tree Belt
sights.description: A cherry-blossom spot in Nakanoshima, with about 1,000 trees lining the Shinano River from Yoita Bridge to the Ohkouzu Diversion Channel.

sights.name: Yonex Country Club
sights.name_ja: ヨネックスカントリークラブ
sights.description: An 18-hole golf course (par 72, 6,986 yards) in Nagaoka with a clubhouse and a 250-yard driving range.

sights.name: Adult Backyard Tour (High School Students and Above)
sights.name_en: Adult Backyard Tour (High School Students and Above)
sights.name_ja: 高校生以上限定 ～大人のバックヤードツアー～
sights.description: Behind-the-scenes aquarium museum tour for high school students and older, covering operations, animal care, outreach, and environmental issues.

sights.name: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Make Echigon and Kororin)
sights.name_en: Echigo Hillside National Government Park (Make Echigon and Kororin)
sights.name_ja: 国営越後丘陵公園『「えちごん」と「ころりん」を作ろう！』
sights.description: Make the park's mascot characters from acorns and walnuts.

sights.name: Niko Niko Plaza (Yamakoshi Terraced Rice Fields and Ponds)
sights.name_en: Niko Niko Plaza (Yamakoshi Terraced Rice Fields and Ponds)
sights.name_ja: にこにこひろば（山古志の棚田・棚池）
sights.description: A viewing spot for Yamakoshi’s terraced rice fields and ponds, with benches, parking, and a weekend shop for souvenirs and light meals.

sights.name: Sasa Dango (Kawaguchi, Nagaoka)
sights.name_ja: 笹だんご［長岡市川口地域］
sights.description: Traditional sasa dango from Kawaguchi in Nagaoka, with chewy dough and coarse sweet-bean paste, sold at Michi-no-Eki Echigo-Kawaguchi Aguri no Sato.

sights.name: Araya Site
sights.description: A late Paleolithic site from about 13,000 years ago, known for Araya-type burins and designated a National Historic Site in 2004.

sights.name: Shokurakuen (Folk House Experiences)
sights.description: Folk house in Echigo-Kawaguchi offering concerts, hearth-cooked rice, coffee-roasting experiences, and yoga.

sights.name: Teishin-ni Hermitage and Poem Monument
sights.description: Rebuilt hermitage recalling the Enma Hall where nun Teishin lived, housing fire-surviving Enma statues, near her poem monument and a centuries-old zelkova.

sights.name: Spark Kawaguchi Indoor Gateball Court
sights.name_ja: 川口運動公園 屋内ゲートボール場「すぱーく川口」
sights.description: Indoor gateball court with two artificial-turf surfaces, usable in any weather.

sights.name: Oguni Forest Park (Winter Camp)
sights.name_ja: おぐに森林公園「冬キャンプ」
sights.description: Oguni Forest Park offers winter camping from 18 November 2024 through 31 March 2025; early spring allows morning forest walks without snowshoes.

sights.name: chahho.
sights.description: Drop-in community space in Nagaoka with a rotating kitchen, tea-goods shop, rental space, and small shelf vendors.

sights.name: Statue of Friendship
sights.description: A paired statue at Wakamiya Shrine of Takeshi Sadamatsu and fellow student Horiguchi Kumakazu holding hands, carved by Sadamatsu's brother Takeshi Kosaburo.

sights.name: Fermentation Lifestyle Course Wine Seminar
sights.name_ja: 発酵暮らし講座ワインセミナー
sights.description: Wine seminar in Nagaoka to deepen knowledge of fermented foods, with lecturer Sakai from Stasion.

sights.name: Parent-and-Child Exciting Fish Land Backyard Tour
sights.name_en: Parent-and-Child Exciting Fish Land Backyard Tour
sights.name_ja: 親子わくわく魚ランド ～バックヤードツアー～
sights.description: Aquarium backstage tour for elementary school children and parents, including freezer and tank visits plus a creature-feeding experience.

sights.name: Kawaguchi Sports Park Picnic Area
sights.name_ja: 川口運動公園 ピクニック広場
sights.description: A lawn for relaxed family time in nature, also a cherry-blossom viewing spot where sheets line the grass in spring.

sights.name: Mishima Local Museum
sights.description: Themed on wood, tools, and craftsmen, it lets visitors experience Mishima-area culture and industry through saws, a recreated blacksmith workshop, and folk tools.

sights.name: Otake Residence Memorial Museum
sights.description: Memorial museum displaying belongings of politician Kan'ichi Otake, known for flood-control work including the Ohkouzu Diversion.

sights.name: Echigo-Kawaguchi Raw Ham School
sights.description: A workshop where you salt about 11 kg of Niigata bone-in pork hind leg; staff then age your additive-free ham in snow-cooled air for at least a year.

sights.name: Settaya–Miyauchi Hospitality Trip
sights.name_ja: 摂田屋・宮内おもてなしとりっぷ
sights.description: Charter-bus tour linking Settaya, Miyauchi, Horaidaira, and Yamakoshi with place-specific local experiences.

sights.name: In Search of Ryokan Trail with Washima Volunteer Guides
sights.name_en: In Search of Ryokan Trail with Washima Volunteer Guides
sights.name_ja: 和島観光ボランティアガイドとめぐる「良寛たずね道」
sights.description: A volunteer-guided walk in Washima past sites linked to Ryokan, who spent about six years at the Kimura home in Shimazaki.

sights.name: Yukyuzan Shokonsha
sights.description: War memorial shrine in Yukyuzan Park, built in 1874, enshrining over 300 Hokuetsu Boshin War dead and 18 Seinan War dead.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Museum of History: Mini Stone Buddha Making Program
sights.name_en: Niigata Prefectural Museum of History: Mini Stone Buddha Making Program
sights.name_ja: 新潟県立歴史博物館体験プログラム『ミニ石仏作り』
sights.description: Experience program for making mini stone Buddhas, held at a changed venue with limited attendance while the usual weekend and holiday corner is paused.

sights.name: Maejima Shrine
sights.description: Shrine in Nagaoka with a monument marking where war against the new government army was decided after the Ojiya negotiations failed.

sights.name: Nikkosha Shrine
sights.description: Shrine in Nagaoka with a monument to Kito Kumajiro, a domain samurai who died guiding the recapture of Nagaoka Castle.

sights.name: Kawaguchi Sports Park Gymnasium
sights.name_ja: 川口運動公園 体育館
sights.description: Gymnasium at Kawaguchi Sports Park with one basketball court, one volleyball court, and three badminton courts.

sights.name: Kawaguchi Sports Park Tennis Courts
sights.name_ja: 川口運動公園 テニスコート
sights.description: Five hard tennis courts that drain quickly after rain, so they can be used despite sudden weather changes.

sights.name: Kawaguchi Sports Park Baseball Field
sights.name_ja: 川口運動公園 野球場
sights.description: A full-scale baseball field with 92-meter foul lines, a 120-meter center field, and night lighting, open for tournaments and training camps.

sights.name: Mori no Katarai (Kawaguchi Community Exchange Hall)
sights.name_en: Mori no Katarai (Kawaguchi Community Exchange Hall)
sights.name_ja: 川口地域交流体験館「杜のかたらい」
sights.description: Community exchange hall in Kawaguchi, Nagaoka, with a 250-seat hall, gallery, and craft rooms, plus views of the Echigo Sanzan mountains.

sights.name: One-Night Tour of Echigo-Nagaoka Breweries and Culture
sights.name_en: One-Night Tour of Echigo-Nagaoka Breweries and Culture
sights.name_ja: 日本酒好き必見！越後長岡の醸造蔵と文化を巡る1泊2日の旅
sights.description: A special tour of the Settaya and Miyauchi area focused on brewing and fermentation culture and historic registered buildings.

sights.name: Walking Brunch
sights.description: Guided morning town walk and fermentation-seasoned breakfast in Settaya and Miyauchi, a brewing town in Nagaoka since the Edo period.

sights.name: Kamimaejima Konpira Hall
sights.description: Hall in Nagaoka with 36 Mokujiki Buddha statues carved in 1804, worn down after children floated them in the river.

sights.name: Nishikura Site
sights.description: An Incipient Jomon site from about 10,000 years ago, noted for pottery decorated with fingernail impressions.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Museum of History: Let's Enjoy Asobi-e (Cancelled)
sights.name_en: Niigata Prefectural Museum of History: Let's Enjoy Asobi-e (Cancelled)
sights.name_ja: 新潟県立歴史博物館 体験コーナー「遊び絵を楽しもう！」※中止
sights.description: You play with puzzles and cards using Edo-period asobi-e pictures.

sights.name: SUNSET RIVER FIELD
sights.description: Winter snow-camping site directly in front of Echigo-Kawaguchi Onsen Resort in Nagaoka.

sights.name: Teradomari Aquarium Museum (Seahorse Search)
sights.name_ja: 寺泊水族博物館 水生生物探索会「タツノオトシゴを見つけよう」
sights.description: Elementary students and guardians collect and observe aquatic life in the sea beside Teradomari Aquarium Museum, with explanations.

sights.name: Electric Pottery Wheel Trial Experience
sights.name_ja: 美しい作品をつくりたい本格志向のあなたに！電動ろくろ体験お試しプラン
sights.description: Shape 1 kg of clay on an electric wheel in a nature-surrounded workshop into plates, bowls, cups, vases, or light holders.

sights.name: Autumn Walking in Washima and Teradomari
sights.name_en: Autumn Walking in Washima and Teradomari
sights.name_ja: 秋を楽しむウォーキング～わしま・てらどまりを歩こう～
sights.description: An autumn walking event from Roadside Station Ryokan no Sato Washima, with 3 km and 13.5 km courses around Washima and Teradomari.

sights.name: Yoita Riverside Green Park
sights.description: Riverside park in Yoita, Nagaoka, with about 400 cherry trees, playground equipment, and evening lantern lighting in April.

stays.name: Yomogihira Onsen Izumi-ya
stays.name_ja: よもぎひら温泉 和泉屋
stays.description: Inn at Yomogihira Onsen in Yomogitaira, Nagaoka with kaiseki dinners.

stays.name: Teradomari Kaigan Tsuwabuki Onsen Bimi Tankyu no Yado Sumiyoshi-ya
stays.name_en: Teradomari Kaigan Tsuwabuki Onsen Bimi Tankyu no Yado Sumiyoshi-ya
stays.name_ja: 寺泊海岸つわぶき温泉 美味探究の宿 住吉屋
stays.description: Inn at Kaigantsuwabuki Onsen in Teradomaridai, Nagaoka with local seafood dinners.

stays.name: JR-East Hotel Mets Nagaoka
stays.name_ja: JR東日本ホテルメッツ 長岡
stays.description: Hotel in Nagaoka, Niigata.

stays.name: Hotel New Otani Nagaoka
stays.name_ja: ホテルニューオータニ長岡
stays.description: Hotel in Dai, Nagaoka with breakfast available.

stays.name: Villa Voix Ao no Iori
stays.name_ja: VILLA VOIX（ヴィラ ヴォワ） 碧ノ庵－あおのいおり－
stays.description: Villa in Nagaoka, Niigata.

stays.name: Hotel Route Inn Nagaoka Inta
stays.name_ja: ホテルルートイン長岡インター
stays.description: Hotel in Sakaihigashi, Nagaoka with Wi-Fi.

stays.name: Hotel Hokke Kurabu Nigata Nagaoka
stays.name_ja: ホテル法華クラブ新潟長岡
stays.description: Hotel at Jinko Onsen in Jonai, Nagaoka.

stays.name: Tsutaya Ryokan
stays.name_ja: つたや旅館
stays.description: Ryokan inn in Watari, Nagaoka with family-friendly stays and business travelers.

stays.name: Nagaoka Grand Hotel (BBH Hotel Group)
stays.name_ja: 長岡グランドホテル（BBHホテルグループ）
stays.description: Hotel in Nagaoka, Niigata.

stays.name: Hotel Route Inn Nagaokaeki Mae
stays.name_ja: ホテルルートイン長岡駅前
stays.description: Hotel in Jonai, Nagaoka with breakfast available and a large communal bath.

stays.name: Hotel Global View Nagaoka
stays.name_ja: ホテルグローバルビュー長岡
stays.description: Hotel in Nagaoka, Niigata.

stays.name: Business Hotel Sun Palace
stays.name_ja: ビジネスホテル サンパレス
stays.description: Hotel in Jonai, Nagaoka with business travelers.

stays.name: Super Price Hotel Impact 2002
stays.name_ja: スーパープライスホテル インパクト２００２
stays.description: Hotel in Jonai-machi, Nagaoka, a two-minute walk from Nagaoka Station, with Wi-Fi and single rooms.

stays.name: Hotel New Green Plaza
stays.name_ja: ホテル ニューグリーンプラザ
stays.description: Hotel in Jonai-machi, Nagaoka, a one-minute walk from the station, with a large bath and sauna.

stays.name: Hotel Business Inn Nagaoka
stays.name_ja: ホテルビジネスイン長岡
stays.description: All-tatami hotel in Kitamachi, Nagaoka, one minute from Nagaoka IC, with a large view hot-spring bath.

stays.name: Nagaoka Kamaburo Onsen Ryokan
stays.name_ja: 長岡かまぶろ温泉旅館
stays.description: Ryokan in Tokamachi, Nagaoka, with a hot spring, traditional kamaburo sauna, and Japanese kaiseki.

stays.name: Teradomari Kinpachi no Yu
stays.name_ja: 寺泊きんぱちの湯
stays.description: Inn in Teradomari Matsusawa, Nagaoka, with seafood meals and a Sea of Japan deep ocean water bath.

stays.name: Kaifutei Teradomari Nihonkai
stays.name_ja: かにと活魚料理の宿 海風亭 寺泊 日本海
stays.description: Inn in Teradomari Kamiara, Nagaoka, with a large public bath facing Sado Island and seafood cuisine.

stays.name: Kappo Ryokan Tajin
stays.name_ja: 割烹旅館 田甚
stays.description: Ryokan in Teradomari, Nagaoka, near the sea and port, with seafood dishes.

stays.name: Villa Voix Ao no Iori
stays.name_ja: ＶＩＬＬＡ ＶＯＩＸ（ヴィラ ヴォワ）碧ノ庵‐あおのいおり‐
stays.description: Private villa in Teradomari, Nagaoka, for groups of up to 22 people.

stays.name: Teradomari Misaki Onsen Hotel Asuka
stays.name_ja: 寺泊岬温泉 ホテル飛鳥
stays.description: Hotel at Teradomari Misaki Onsen in Nozumi, Nagaoka.

stays.name: Teradomari Nozumi Kaigan Onsen Yasuragi no Yado Yuhana
stays.name_en: Teradomari Nozumi Kaigan Onsen Yasuragi no Yado Yuhana
stays.name_ja: 寺泊野積海岸温泉 やすらぎの宿 夕華（ゆうはな）
stays.description: Onsen ryokan in front of Nozumi Beach in Teradomari, Nagaoka.

stays.name: Teradomari Sunset House
stays.name_ja: 寺泊サンセットハウス
stays.description: Whole-building rental villa on a hill in Teradomari Kamiaramachi, Nagaoka, overlooking the Sea of Japan.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Niigata Furusato Village
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「新潟ふるさと村」
day_to_day.description: A roadside station with about 10,000 local products, regional dishes, sake tasting, crafts, seasonal flower fields, and a year-round artificial snow experience.

day_to_day.name: Toyosaka Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 「豊栄」（国道7号線）
day_to_day.description: Barrier-free roadside station serving Niigata rice onigiri and kitsune soba, with a shop selling Koshihikari and local produce beside a nature park.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Kamuri Niitsu
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 花夢里にいつ
day_to_day.description: A roadside station designated in 2002 that displays and sells about 2,000 varieties and 40,000 pots of potted flowers and flowering trees.

day_to_day.name: Fruit Doumu Yamada Orchard
day_to_day.name_ja: フルーツ童夢やまだ農園
day_to_day.description: Orchard offering peach and grape picking, including all-you-can-eat peaches, and also growing pears on 1.1 hectares for up to 100 visitors.

day_to_day.name: Yamanoshita Market
day_to_day.name_ja: 山ノ下市場
day_to_day.description: A market in Yamanoshita, Niigata, selling vegetables, fruit and household goods, with an Obon flower market on 12 August.

day_to_day.name: Kameda Regular Stall Market (3-and-9 Market)
day_to_day.name_ja: 亀田定期露店市場(三・九の市)
day_to_day.description: Stall market on the central market street in Kameda, open from 8 a.m. to noon on days ending in 3 or 9, continuing since 1694.

activities.name: Wara Art Festival
activities.name_ja: わらアートまつり
activities.description: An annual event in Nishikan Ward, Niigata City, showing five giant rice-straw artworks at Uwasekigata Park, with night lighting on weekends and holidays.

activities.name: Niitsu Onsen
activities.name_ja: 新津温泉
activities.description: A 1954 day-use hot spring in a residential neighborhood, known for petroleum-scented, slightly cloudy sodium-chloride bicarbonate water.

activities.name: New Soba Festival
activities.name_ja: 新そばまつり
activities.description: A reservation-only festival where visitors taste noodles made from locally produced new soba flour from Maki.

activities.name: Fukuju Onsen Jonnobikan
activities.name_ja: 福寿温泉 じょんのび館
activities.description: Day-use natural hot spring and sauna at the foot of Mount Kakuda, with indoor and open-air baths and four saunas.

activities.name: Akiha Onsen Hanamizu
activities.name_ja: 秋葉温泉 花水
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring at the foot of Mount Akiha, with a southern European atmosphere and Japanese- and Western-style baths.

activities.name: Iwamuro Onsen
activities.name_ja: 岩室温泉
activities.description: Historic hot-spring town in western Niigata City, dating to the Edo period and known as the birthplace of Echigo geisha.

activities.name: Kamon! Duck and Leek Festival
activities.name_ja: かもん！カモねぎまつり
activities.description: Annual December event in duck-hunting Katahigashi, Nishikan Ward, with wild-duck soup, local leeks, free mochi, and negiyaki.

activities.name: Dairo no Yu (Taho Hot Spring)
activities.name_ja: 多宝温泉 だいろの湯
activities.description: Day-use hot spring with three source springs, including a sulfur-scented 50-tatami garden open-air bath and rock and waterfall baths.

activities.name: Kosudo Onsen Hana-no-Yu Health Center
activities.name_ja: 小須戸温泉健康センター花の湯館
activities.description: Day-use hot spring at the foot of oil-seeping hills, with a smooth metasilicic-acid neutral spring and a second-floor cafe using local ingredients.

activities.name: Winter Sake Festival
activities.name_ja: 冬酒まつり
activities.description: Twenty-eight Niigata breweries gather at ANA Crowne Plaza Hotel Niigata for reserved-seat sake tastings and talks with brewers.

activities.name: Umibe no Mori Campground
activities.name_ja: 海辺の森キャンプ場
activities.description: Campground beside Shimami Beach offering 32 tent sites, four cooking buildings, showers, forest bathing, barbecues, and beach seine-net fishing.

activities.name: Niigata Ichiryu Sake Brewery, Echigo no Sato Kayama-tei
activities.name_en: Niigata Ichiryu Sake Brewery, Echigo no Sato Kayama-tei
activities.name_ja: 新潟一粒酒造 越後の里 嘉山亭
activities.description: Sake tasting room in the brewery's old main house, with Niigata snacks, original goods, and a three-sake comparison set.

activities.name: Kakudahama Campground
activities.name_ja: 角田浜キャンプ場
activities.description: Pine-forest campground near the sea with 70 tent sites, a cooking area, and hot showers; swimming, fishing, and clear-day sunsets toward Sado.

activities.name: Tanoura Onsen
activities.name_ja: 田ノ浦温泉
activities.description: Seaside hot spring in Mase, where open-air baths look toward Sado Island on clear days and sunsets over the Sea of Japan.

activities.name: Dairo no Yu (Taho Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 多宝温泉 だいろの湯
activities.description: Day-trip sulfur hot spring in Nishikan, Niigata, with three unfiltered free-flowing sources and open-air baths; currently closed for construction.

activities.name: Sauna and Natural Hot Spring Jonobi-kan
activities.name_en: Sauna and Natural Hot Spring Jonobi-kan
activities.name_ja: サウナと天然温泉じょんのび館
activities.description: Hot-spring facility in Niigata City with outdoor baths and a forest sauna whose cold plunge is Kakuda Mountain spring water.

activities.name: Imayo Tsukasa Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: 今代司酒造（株）
activities.description: Sake brewery founded in 1767 in an 1899 building about 15 minutes' walk from Niigata Station, offering guided tours and tastings.

activities.name: Akiha Onsen Kasui (Sauna)
activities.name_ja: 秋葉温泉 花水（サウナ）
activities.description: Sauna at Akiha Onsen Kasui in Niigata City, with a men's dry sauna around 90°C and a women's far-infrared sauna around 77°C.

activities.name: Niigata Furusato Village Golden Week Festival
activities.name_en: Niigata Furusato Village Golden Week Festival
activities.name_ja: 新潟ふるさと村 GWフェスティバル
activities.description: An annual Golden Week event with brewery sake markets, goods selected from about 10,000 items, festival stalls, stage attractions, workshops, and challenge shops.

activities.name: Iwamuro Onsen Town Walk
activities.name_ja: 岩室温泉まちあるき
activities.description: Local guides lead walks through Iwamuro Onsen back streets and lanes, with routes tailored to visitors' requests.

activities.name: Porcelarts Tableware Workshop
activities.name_ja: 好きな模様のオリジナル食器が完成！手ぶらでポーセラーツ体験
activities.description: A one-session porcelarts lesson to decorate two pieces, such as a cup and plate, later fired by the studio at 800°C.

activities.name: Shiokawa Sake Brewery (Koshi no Seki)
activities.name_ja: 塩川酒造（株）
activities.description: Sake brewery with a 1912 earthen storehouse, using sand-dune-filtered groundwater and offering reserved tours on Fridays from May to September.

activities.name: Iwamuro Onsen Fuyuzuma Fireflies
activities.name_ja: 岩室温泉冬妻ほたる
activities.description: Firefly viewing near Iwamuro Onsen, named for Fuyuzuma fireflies that grow in clear springs below Mount Taho.

activities.name: Kimono Strolling Experience
activities.name_ja: 着物散策体験
activities.description: Rent a kimono or yukata a two-minute walk from Niigata Station and stroll the streets of Furumachi.

activities.name: Sasaiwai Sake Brewery (Tour and Tasting)
activities.name_ja: 伝統の酒蔵見学＆県外に殆ど出ない笹祝酒造の唎酒体験
activities.description: Founded in 1899, this traditional wooden sake brewery uses only Niigata City rice and offers tours and tastings of sake rarely sold outside the prefecture.

activities.name: Cave d'Occi Winery and Wara Art Festival Gata Bus Tour
activities.name_en: Cave d'Occi Winery and Wara Art Festival Gata Bus Tour
activities.name_ja: カーブドッチワイナリーとわらアートまつり＜がたバスツアー＞
activities.description: Day bus tour from Bandai with a guided Cave d'Occi Winery visit and Western lunch, then large straw sculptures at the Wara Art Festival and shopping at Sorano Terrace.

activities.name: Original Pair Guinomi Pottery Experience
activities.name_ja: 日本酒に合うオリジナルペアぐい呑みを作れる陶芸体験
activities.description: Make original sake cups from scratch with an instructor who studied pottery in New York; they are reduction-fired and shipped home in one to two months.

activities.name: Gata Bus Tour: Edamame Harvesting and Akiha Onsen Hanamizu
activities.name_en: Gata Bus Tour: Edamame Harvesting and Akiha Onsen Hanamizu
activities.name_ja: ＜新潟市の魅力発見！がたバスツアー＞ 枝豆収穫体験と秋葉温泉 花水
activities.description: A day bus tour with edamame harvesting and tasting, lunch of local produce, a visit to Niigata Prefectural Botanical Garden, and bathing at Akiha Onsen.

activities.name: Ito Family Three-Person Mochi Pounding
activities.name_ja: 豪農伊藤家 三人餅搗き体験
activities.description: Visitors pound mochi in the three-person style long served at the wealthy Ito family’s New Year and celebrations, guided by a craftsperson.

activities.name: Hand-Building Pottery Experience
activities.name_ja: ぬくもりを感じる器をつくろう！手びねり陶芸体験
activities.description: Coil-build a teacup, rice bowl, or coffee cup in one to two hours with a New York-trained instructor; pieces are returned after reduction firing.

activities.name: Ajikata Granary Taiko
activities.name_ja: 味方穀倉太鼓
activities.description: Taiko group formed in 1990 by Ajikata youth to symbolize pride in village agriculture, performing vigorous drumming at various events.
