sights.name: Pier Bandai
sights.name_ja: みなとのマルシェ ピアBandai
sights.description: A fresh seafood and specialty market in central Niigata, with fish, produce, and souvenir shops plus sushi restaurants, near Bandai Bridge and Toki Messe.

sights.name: Niigata History Museum Minatopia
sights.description: History museum in Niigata, Niigata.

sights.name: Uwasekigata Park
sights.description: A park at the foot of Mount Kakuda centered on an 11-hectare lagoon, with seasonal flowers, a two-kilometer trail, playgrounds, and an autumn straw-art festival.

sights.name: Befco Bakauke Observation Deck
sights.description: Free observation room on Toki Messe’s 31st floor, with 360-degree views of Niigata, the Shinano River, and the Sea of Japan from 125 metres.

sights.name: Northern Culture Museum
sights.description: Former Ito family mansion museum with historic buildings, a pond-strolling garden, art collections, and a wisteria over 150 years old.

sights.name: Bandai Bridge
sights.name_ja: 国指定重要文化財「萬代橋」
sights.description: The 306.9-meter Bandai Bridge, a national Important Cultural Property completed in 1929, spans the Shinano River in Niigata.

sights.name: Former Saito Family Villa
sights.description: A modern Japanese-style guest house built in 1918 and designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty, with a strolling garden on sand dunes.

sights.name: Niigata City Aquarium Marinepia Nihonkai
sights.name_ja: 新潟市水族館 マリンピア日本海
sights.description: An aquarium with about 600 species and 20,000 aquatic creatures, a tunnel under the Japan Sea tank, and daily dolphin shows.

sights.name: Niigata Senbei Kingdom
sights.description: A rice-cracker theme park run by Kuriyama Beika, where you can tour the factory and bake senbei.

sights.name: Fukushima Lagoon
sights.description: A 260-hectare lagoon east of Niigata City, home to over 220 bird species and more than 470 plant species.

sights.name: Cave d'Occi Winery
sights.name_ja: カーブドッチワイナリー
sights.description: Coastal winery at Kakudahama producing wine solely from grapes grown on its sandy, well-drained land.

sights.name: Yumotoya
sights.description: A ryokan in Iwamuro Onsen, founded in 1880, with sulfur-bearing sodium-calcium chloride spring water at 52.2°C and 63 Mbps Wi-Fi.

sights.name: Nishikan Sightseeing Loop Bus
sights.name_ja: にしかん観光周遊ぐる～んバス
sights.description: A seasonal loop bus around Nishikan and Yahiko, visiting parks, wineries, a hot spring, sake breweries, and Yahiko Shrine.

sights.name: Poppo-yaki
sights.description: A chewy brown-sugar and flour sweet baked in long thin pieces, said to have originated in late-Meiji Shibata.

sights.name: Shinano River Yasuragi Embankment Green Space
sights.name_en: Shinano River Yasuragi Embankment Green Space
sights.name_ja: 信濃川やすらぎ堤緑地
sights.description: Riverside green space on a gently sloping embankment along the Shinano River in central Niigata, with about 1,000 cherry trees and spring tulips.

sights.name: Hakusan Park
sights.description: A Dutch-style strolling garden beside Hakusan Shrine, among Japan's first 25 public parks, with seasonal flowers, a night-lit aerial garden, and Meiji-era Enkikan.

sights.name: Iwamuro Health Promotion Center (Yugan no Yu Yorinare)
sights.name_en: Iwamuro Health Promotion Center (Yugan no Yu Yorinare)
sights.name_ja: 新潟市岩室健康増進センター「遊雁の湯よりなれ」
sights.description: Day-use Iwamuro Onsen facility with a large indoor bath and an open-air bath overlooking seasonal nature.

sights.name: Former Saito Family Villa (Autumn Leaves Light-up)
sights.name_en: Former Saito Family Villa (Autumn Leaves Light-up)
sights.name_ja: 旧齋藤家別邸 紅葉ライトアップ
sights.description: The Former Saito Family Villa extends opening hours for an autumn maple light-up in its pond garden of maples and old pines.

sights.name: Toki Messe Niigata Convention Center
sights.name_ja: 朱鷺メッセ 新潟コンベンションセンター
sights.description: Waterfront convention complex where the Shinano River meets the Sea of Japan, with exhibition space, 13 meeting rooms, a hotel, and a free observation deck.

sights.name: Minato Inari Shrine
sights.description: Shrine known for komainu turned while making a wish, and for tying hemp wish-strings to a fox statue’s feet.

sights.name: Echigo Nanaura Coast
sights.description: The Echigo Nanaura Seaside Line runs 5 km along this coast of oddly shaped rocks, with many historic sites and scenic spots nearby.

sights.name: Kakudahama Beach
sights.description: A sandy swimming beach at the foot of Mount Kakuda, marked by Kakuda Cape Lighthouse, with Sado views on clear days.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda (Lighthouse Trailhead)
sights.description: Lighthouse trailhead on Mount Kakuda with views of the Echigo Nanaura coast, Sado and Mount Yoneyama; about two hours to the summit.

sights.name: Aoyama Coast Beach
sights.description: A wide sandy swimming beach near the city, also known as a sunset-viewing spot.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda
sights.description: A 481.7 m mountain in the Sado-Yahiko-Yoneyama Quasi-National Park, with seven hiking courses and spring wildflower blooms.

sights.name: Sakata (Ramsar Wetland)
sights.name_ja: ラムサール条約登録湿地「佐潟」
sights.description: A Ramsar-registered dune lake in Niigata City where whooper swans winter, with up to about 7,000 birds in mid to late January.

sights.name: Niigata City Art Museum
sights.description: Municipal art museum opened in 1985 near Furumachi, in a building designed by Kunio Maekawa, with a collection of over 5,000 works.

sights.name: Hangan-bune Kakushi Cave
sights.description: Two caves where Minamoto no Yoshitsune is said to have hidden with his boat in 1187 while fleeing to Hiraizumi; a Niigata City cultural property.

sights.name: Gokurakuyu Meike
sights.description: Day-use bathing facility near Niigata Station with spacious baths, high-heat saunas, a men's automatic loyly, and a women's salt sauna.

sights.name: Hiyoriyama Beach
sights.description: Sandy swimming beach near an observation deck with views of summer sunsets over the Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda (Gokatoge Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 角田山・五ケ峠登山口
sights.description: Beginner trailhead on Mount Kakuda in Sado-Yahiko-Yoneyama Quasi-National Park; the gentlest family route (3.1 km) of seven, with a summit hut.

sights.name: Bodaijiyama Hiking Course
sights.name_ja: 菩提寺山ハイキングコース
sights.description: A family hiking trail on Bodaijiyama (248 m) that follows the 4 km Hotokeji-goe, a medieval route used for religious training and trade.

sights.name: Niigata City Niitsu Art Museum
sights.description: Art museum beside a botanical garden and an ancient burial mound, with a snowplow-inspired entrance and exhibitions of modern art, photography, and manga.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Botanical Garden
sights.description: Botanical garden with a 30 m-high, 42 m-wide tropical dome of 550 species and about 4,000 plants, plus eight yearly shows and an aquatic garden.

sights.name: Ikeda Orchard (Fruit Picking)
sights.description: Fruit-picking orchard offering Echigo-hime strawberries, grapes, pears and Le Lectier through the year, with wheelchair-accessible raised beds.

sights.name: Befco Bakauke Observation Room (First Sunrise Viewing)
sights.name_en: Befco Bakauke Observation Room (First Sunrise Viewing)
sights.name_ja: Befcoばかうけ展望室 「初日の出鑑賞」
sights.description: Befco Bakauke Observation Room sits about 125 m up on Toki Messe’s 31st floor, with 360-degree views, and opens at 6:00 on New Year’s Day.

sights.name: Italian (Mikazuki)
sights.description: Niigata dish of thick noodles with tomato sauce and white ginger, created in 1960 to be eaten with a fork.

sights.name: Niigata Science Museum
sights.description: Hands-on science museum with nature, daily-life, and Niigata exhibits, a moving Maiasaura theater, toki taxidermy, an 18-meter planetarium, and outdoor locomotives.

sights.name: Shichimen Daimyojin Conversion Cave
sights.name_ja: 七面大明神教化の岩穴
sights.description: Rock cave near Myokoji said to be where Nichiren converted a seven-headed serpent into Shichimen Daimyojin, later enshrined at Minobu as a guardian deity.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Sports Park
sights.description: Sports park beside Lake Toyanogata in Niigata City, about 2 km from JR Niigata Station, with about 500 cherry trees and lakeside paths.

sights.name: Setsuryosha Art Museum
sights.name_ja: 雪梁舎（せつりょうしゃ）美術館
sights.description: A traditional Japanese-style art museum in Yakibuna Park with tatami exhibition rooms, Meissen and Chagall galleries, and a garden with summer lotus flowers.

sights.name: View Fukushimagata
sights.name_ja: 水の公園・福島潟水の駅「ビュー福島潟」
sights.description: Nature and culture center for Fukushima Lagoon, with exhibits on the greater white-fronted goose and views of the lagoon and Echigo Plain from a 29-meter rooftop.

sights.name: Former Sasagawa Family Residence
sights.name_ja: 重要文化財 旧笹川家住宅（笹川邸）
sights.description: Former senior village headman's residence built in 1826, pairing formal offices with refined living rooms and a garden.

sights.name: Shirone Grape Garden
sights.name_ja: 白根グレープガーデン
sights.description: Year-round fruit-picking garden with low-pesticide cultivation, including Echigo-hime strawberry picking from January to June and gelato made from natural ingredients.

sights.name: Tanaka-ya Honten Minato Workshop
sights.name_ja: 田中屋本店みなと工房
sights.description: A workshop where visitors can watch Niigata specialty sasa-dango being made and try making them themselves.

sights.name: Sekiyu no Sato (Oil Village)
sights.description: A Japanese garden centered on the Nakano Residence Memorial Hall, former home of Nakano Kanichi, with 2,000 maples and seasonal concerts and bonsai displays.

sights.name: Nuttari Terrace Shopping Street
sights.description: Renovated row-house shopping street in Nuttari near the Shinano River mouth, home to about 30 cafes, workshops, and specialty shops.

sights.name: Northern Culture Museum Niigata Branch
sights.name_ja: 北方文化博物館新潟分館
sights.description: Former Meiji villa exhibiting Ryokan calligraphy and Aizu Yaichi’s works, with his poem monument in the garden.

sights.name: Akiha Park
sights.description: A nature-rich park on a gentle hill about 80 meters above sea level, with recreation areas, Akiha Lake, and about 200 cherry trees.

sights.name: Iwamuroya (Iwamuro Tourism Facility)
sights.name_ja: 新潟市岩室観光施設 いわむろや
sights.description: Information facility for Nishikan Ward, centered on Iwamuro Onsen, with exhibits, local products, a rest area, and a foot bath.

sights.name: Niigata City Agri-Park
sights.description: A campsite in Niigata City’s Minami Ward with five sites, a farm shop, restaurant, and reserved cow-milking plus goat and sheep feeding.

sights.name: Toyanogata Lagoon
sights.description: A lagoon bordering central Niigata, ringed by about 2,000 cherry trees, with lanterns lit near Benten Bridge during the bloom.

sights.name: Sekiya Beach
sights.description: Sandy swimming beach on the right bank of the Sekiya Diversion Channel, near the Marinepia Nihonkai aquarium and popular for walks and cycling.

sights.name: Toyanogata Park Shumoku Area
sights.name_ja: 鳥屋野潟公園鐘木地区
sights.description: Lakeside park by Toyanogata lagoon with about 700 cherry trees and a deck where whooper swans fly close overhead.

sights.name: Former Ozawa Family Residence (Niigata City Cultural Property)
sights.name_en: Former Ozawa Family Residence (Niigata City Cultural Property)
sights.name_ja: 新潟市文化財 旧小澤家住宅
sights.description: Shop and home of the Ozawa merchants, active in Niigata town from the late Edo period, preserving a typical townhouse and nearly intact Meiji-era estate buildings.

sights.name: MGC Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Ice Arena
sights.name_en: MGC Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Ice Arena
sights.name_ja: MGC三菱ガス化学アイスアリーナ
sights.description: Indoor ice arena in Niigata’s Chuo Ward with an international-standard rink and a sub rink for curling, skating, and hockey, plus free beginner lessons.

sights.name: Oil World Museum
sights.description: Storehouse-style museum on oil history and the Niitsu oilfield, with drilling tools and a two-thirds-scale Kazusa-bori derrick model.

sights.name: Furumachi Niigata Odori
sights.description: Stage performance by all Furumachi geisha of traditional Niigata dance and musical accompaniment, evoking the port town’s atmosphere and history.

sights.name: Shinano River Water Shuttle
sights.name_ja: 信濃川ウォーターシャトル
sights.description: River shuttle on the Shinano River between Minatopia, Toki Messe, and Niigata Furusato Village, passing under Bandai Bridge, also offered as charters.

sights.name: Manganji Hasagi Tree Avenue
sights.name_ja: 満願寺稲架木（はさぎ）並木
sights.description: An avenue of rice-drying hasagi trees in Manganji, transplanted by local farmers in 1943–1945 and kept for seed-rice drying.

sights.name: Mount Taho (Marukoyama Park Trailhead, Tenjinyama Route)
sights.name_en: Mount Taho (Marukoyama Park Trailhead, Tenjinyama Route)
sights.name_ja: 多宝山・丸小山公園登山口（天神山ルート）
sights.description: Intermediate trailhead at Marukoyama Park for 633.8 m Mount Taho via the Tenjinyama route, about two hours to the summit with no hut.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Mandai Shima Art Museum Kikakuten (Sakuramomoko Ten)
sights.description: Art museum exhibition in Niigata, Niigata.

sights.name: Mase Shimoyama Beach
sights.description: A shallow sandy swimming beach along the Echigo Nanaura Seaside Line in Mase, with gentle waves and sunset views.

sights.name: Echizenhama Beach
sights.description: A swimming beach with a rare, still-expanding sandy shore from which all of Sado Island can be seen.

sights.name: Niigata City Niitsu Railway Museum
sights.name_ja: 新潟市新津鉄道資料館
sights.description: A railway museum with first-floor permanent exhibits and outdoor displays of E4 and 200 series Shinkansen trains and steam locomotive C57 No. 180.

sights.name: Denka Big Swan Stadium
sights.name_ja: デンカビッグスワンスタジアム
sights.description: Athletics stadium in Niigata Prefecture Sports Park, nicknamed Big Swan, that hosted Japan's 2002 FIFA World Cup opening match and is a spring cherry-blossom viewing spot.

sights.name: Mase Tanoura Beach
sights.description: A sandy and rocky beach in Mase along the Echigo Nanaura Seaside Line, offering swimming, rocky-shore play, and views of Sado.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda (Inajima Trailhead)
sights.description: Beginner trailhead on Mount Kakuda in Sado-Yahiko-Yoneyama Quasi-National Park, about one hour to the 481.7 m summit.

sights.name: Echigo Nanaura Kannon
sights.description: An 8-metre bronze Kannon in Maze facing the Sea of Japan, revered for sea rescue, safety, and memorial prayers.

sights.name: Water Mirror of the Echigo Plain
sights.name_en: Water Mirror of the Echigo Plain
sights.description: Near Echigo-Akatsuka Station, flooded Echigo Plain paddies mirror the sky from late April to mid-May, with Echigo Line trains crossing the view.

sights.name: Furumachi Sauna KUMORI
sights.description: A loyly-focused sauna in Niigata’s Furumachi, built with Uonuma cedar and arched Yasuda-tile walls that spread heat evenly.

sights.name: Kanbara Shrine
sights.description: Shrine enshrining Shiinetsuhiko and Sugawara no Michizane; about 130 plum trees bloom in spring, and a summer festival has over 450 stalls.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Office 18th-Floor Observation Corridor (Year-End and New Year Opening)
sights.name_en: Niigata Prefectural Office 18th-Floor Observation Corridor (Year-End and New Year Opening)
sights.name_ja: 新潟県庁 18階展望回廊 年末年始開放
sights.description: Glass-enclosed indoor corridor about 67 meters up with views of the Sea of Japan and Mount Yahiko, open from 6 a.m. on 1 January for sunrise.

sights.name: Shimamihama Beach
sights.description: A sandy beach in Kita Ward, Niigata City, that is seldom crowded, near the nature-rich Umibe no Mori campsite.

sights.name: Niigata Prefecture Gokoku Shrine
sights.description: A solemn shrine in pine woods overlooking the Sea of Japan, with an approach path of about 100 meters beyond the torii.

sights.name: Hachingaki Persimmon (Original Tree)
sights.name_ja: 八珍柿（はっちんがき）原木
sights.description: The Kawasaki family's seedless seedling persimmon in Akiha was recognized in 1931 as the original Hiratanenashi tree.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda (Fukui Firefly Village Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 角田山・福井ほたるの里登山口
sights.description: Beginner trailhead on Mount Kakuda near Fukui Firefly Village and Heisei Fukuju Kannon, with a gentle 90-minute climb to the summit.

sights.name: Sorano Terrace
sights.description: A countryside terrace in Nishikan Ward with Mount Kakuda views, rice-planting and harvest experiences, and strawberry picking from March to May.

sights.name: Yamanoshita Funaemachi Beach
sights.name_ja: 山の下船江町浜海水浴場
sights.description: A family swimming beach with calm waves among breakwaters, where visitors can watch planes and ferries near Niigata West Port and Airport.

sights.name: Kuzutsuka Market and Matsuhama Market
sights.description: Two monthly markets in Niigata’s Kita Ward selling fresh seafood and produce; Kuzutsuka has run for over 250 years and Matsuhama for over 140.

sights.name: Niigata Sushi Zanmai 'Kiwami'
sights.description: A 1.5-serving nigiri set in Niigata City with local fish such as nodoguro and spear squid, plus sea urchin, fatty tuna and salmon roe.

sights.name: SPA & LOUNGE Nagata
sights.description: Spa and lounge in Niigata with an 88°C far-infrared dry sauna, a 14°C cold bath, changing artificial hot-spring baths, and a year-round outdoor bath.

sights.name: Natsui Hazagi (Rice-Drying Racks)
sights.description: About 600 hazagi rice-drying racks are preserved by the Natsui community on the Echigo Plain, where rice is still hung to dry in autumn.

sights.name: Aqua Park Niigata
sights.name_ja: 新潟市ふれあい健康センター アクアパークにいがた
sights.description: Year-round warm-water facility using surplus heat from the adjacent Nitta Cleaning Center, with a 60-meter flowing pool where float rings can be used.

sights.name: Toyanogata Park
sights.description: Toyanogata Park is a prefectural park on an urban lagoon about 2 km from Niigata Station, with about 2,000 cherry trees and views of Big Swan Stadium.

sights.name: Tenjinyama Castle Ruins
sights.description: Mountain castle ruins at 234 m between Ishize and Iwamuro Onsen, with seven dry moats, a main bailey, and Hyotan Pond.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda Urahama Trailhead
sights.description: Urahama Trailhead on Mount Kakuda, in Sado-Yahiko-Yoneyama Quasi-National Park, is a beginner 2.5 km route reaching the 481.7 m summit in about 90 minutes.

sights.name: Sasaiwai Sake Brewery
sights.description: A sake brewery in Nishikan Ward, Niigata City, making elegant, rich sake with a refreshing finish.

sights.name: Minoru Endo Memorial Hall and Jisshokan
sights.name_en: Minoru Endo Memorial Hall and Jisshokan
sights.name_ja: 遠藤実記念館・実唱館
sights.description: Music museum where composer Minoru Endo left records of his life, with exhibits, free listening, and a karaoke cafe.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Bandaijima Art Museum
sights.name_ja: 新潟県立万代島美術館
sights.description: An art museum inside Toki Messe overlooking the Sea of Japan, sharing about 6,000 works and staging five to six exhibitions a year.

sights.name: Niigata Tare Katsudon
sights.description: A rice bowl of freshly fried thin-battered tonkatsu dipped in soy-based sauce, which began at a canal-side Western food stall in early Showa-era Niigata City.

sights.name: Gokurakuyu Makio
sights.description: Sauna facility in Niigata’s Nishi Ward with dry and steam saunas, a cold-water bath, and a high-concentration artificial carbonated spring bath.

sights.name: Iwamuroya Bicycle Rental
sights.name_ja: いわむろやのレンタサイクル
sights.description: Bicycle rental offering electric-assist bikes, plus regular bicycles and children's bikes without electric assist.

sights.name: Japan Flowering Quince Exhibition
sights.description: A flowering quince exhibition showing about 100 varieties and 10,000 pots, with plant sales and cultivation lectures.

sights.name: Takarayama Brewery
sights.description: A sake brewery over 100 years old near Mount Yahiko, offering paid tours and tastings; its daiginjo won national gold awards in 1994 and 1997.

sights.name: Benten Stand
sights.description: A standing bar in central Niigata with a private sauna, where guests can use the sauna and then drink.

sights.name: Shirone Giant Kite and History Museum
sights.name_en: Shirone Giant Kite and History Museum
sights.name_ja: しろね大凧と歴史の館
sights.description: Museum showing real Shirone giant kites and rare kites from Japan and abroad, with kite-making and a 3D kite-battle theater.

sights.name: The Great Thief's House at Niigata Prefectural Bandaijima Art Museum
sights.name_en: The Great Thief's House at Niigata Prefectural Bandaijima Art Museum
sights.name_ja: 新潟県立万代島美術館 企画展「大どろぼうの家」
sights.description: Experiential exhibition touring eight rooms of a retired thief’s house, with stolen treasures, cherished collections, and a display of outer space.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda (Gorinishi Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 角田山・五りん石登山口
sights.description: Beginner trailhead on Mount Kakuda passing Kobo Spring and Gorin Falls through pine and cedar plantations, about 90 minutes to the summit.

sights.name: Ikutopia Shokka (Food and Flowers)
sights.description: Food-and-flower complex in Niigata City with a local produce market, restaurant, gardens, play areas, and a spring tulip display of about 30,000 bulbs.

sights.name: Kiwami and Niigata Japanese Cuisine
sights.description: The Kiwami Niigata sushi tasting paired with local dishes and seasonal grilled fish, highlighted by fish sauce made from nanban shrimp.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda Yunokoshi Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 角田山・湯之腰登山口
sights.description: Yunokoshi Trailhead on Mount Kakuda is a somewhat steep, varied 2.6 km beginner route to the 481.7 m summit, with a stream near the start and no toilet.

sights.name: Nishikan Evening Drinks with Taiguruma Lanterns
sights.name_en: Nishikan Evening Drinks with Taiguruma Lanterns
sights.name_ja: 鯛車とともに味わう西蒲の晩酌
sights.description: An evening event at Hotel Nikko Niigata with sake from historic breweries, local dishes, and traditional taiguruma sea-bream lanterns.

sights.name: Gokurakuyu Matsuzaki
sights.description: Sauna facility with a spacious far-infrared sauna, a men's cold bath about 90 cm deep, and a wide outdoor rest area.

sights.name: Ango Sakaguchi Literary Monument
sights.description: Literary monuments to writer Ango Sakaguchi near Niitsu Station and behind Niitsu Library, inscribed with his words and a passage from his novel.

sights.name: Nishikawa Fureai Park
sights.description: A 2.6-hectare park completed in 1991 that uses river scenery, with a lawn area, water plaza, community house, and artificial waterfall.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Toyanogata Park (Meike Area)
sights.name_ja: 鳥屋野潟公園女池地区
sights.description: Prefectural park by Toyanogata whose Meike area has an observatory view of cherry blossoms and Big Swan, with about 300 cherry trees.

sights.name: Shirone Tourist Mushroom Garden
sights.description: All-weather mushroom-picking garden growing shimeji, nameko, shiitake and maitake, with local shipping of freshly picked mushrooms.

sights.name: Tenjuen Garden
sights.description: A garden with a Chinese imperial-style section and a traditional Japanese pond-and-waterfall garden, where about 200 peonies bloom in early May.

sights.name: Echigo Beer
sights.description: Brewpub that in February 1995 produced Japan's first domestically made craft beer, focusing on distinctive rather than uniform flavors.

sights.name: Tsukigata Ruisan Pear
sights.description: The original Ruisan pear tree in Tsukigata is a national natural monument still standing in the Fukazawa family orchard.

sights.name: Fukushimagata Water Park
sights.name_ja: 水の公園・福島潟遊水館
sights.description: An indoor and outdoor water park with a 25-meter pool, slides, a sauna, and a wooden-boat rowing course.

sights.name: Niigata City Manga House
sights.description: A facility recreating the worlds of Niigata-related gag manga artists, with photo spots, life-size figures, daily drawing classes, and a reading room.

sights.name: Tanoura Coast
sights.description: A coast with a wide view of the sunset over the Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Niigata City Higashi General Sports Center
sights.name_en: Niigata City Higashi General Sports Center
sights.name_ja: 新潟市東総合スポーツセンター
sights.description: Sports center with a main arena and 200 m indoor running course, a sub-arena, training and climbing rooms, and 3,120 seats.

sights.name: Niigata City Manga and Anime Information Center
sights.name_en: Niigata City Manga and Anime Information Center
sights.name_ja: 新潟市マンガ・アニメ情報館
sights.description: A museum introducing Niigata-related manga artists and anime creators, with character play areas, a voice-acting experience, a mini theater, and special exhibitions.

sights.name: Satoyama Visitor Center
sights.name_ja: 里山ビジターセンター
sights.description: Visitor center for Niitsu Hills offering tourism information, local products, and rest space, also used for school science activities and geology trip departures.

sights.name: Authentic Hands-Free Barbecue
sights.name_ja: 本物の手ぶらでバーベキュー
sights.description: Niigata’s first hands-free barbecue at Umibe no Mori Campground includes food, fuel, a tent and site fees, with Weber-grill instruction.

sights.name: Uchinohama Beach
sights.description: A shallow sandy beach in Niigata’s Nishi Ward, sheltered by breakwaters, with gentle waves suited to families.

sights.name: HUB STATION KENTO
sights.description: A coworking and rental office linked directly to Niigata Station, with free desks, a lounge, and card-only entry.

sights.name: Minemura Brewery Miso Storehouse Tour
sights.name_ja: 味噌蔵見学 峰村醸造
sights.description: Miso storehouse tour where Minemura Brewery relocated and renovated two historic storehouses and serves miso-pickle tastings on warm rice.

sights.name: Marukoyama Park
sights.description: A park near Iwamuro Onsen, ringed by low hills, with 130 cherry trees, tennis courts, and a mountain path to the Yorinare day-use hot spring.

sights.name: Daiei-ji Temple
sights.description: A historic Sōtō Zen training temple with graves of Sawami Castle lords and a Bashō haiku monument in the grounds.

sights.name: Cherry Blossoms at Hakusan Park Sky Garden
sights.name_en: Cherry Blossoms at Hakusan Park Sky Garden
sights.name_ja: 白山公園・空中庭園の桜
sights.description: A park connected to Hakusan Shrine with six sky gardens, waterways, ponds and waterfalls, where about 200 cherry trees are lit at night.

sights.name: Fukushimagata Rapeseed Flowers
sights.description: From early April, rapeseed flowers cover about three hectares of Fukushimagata, a 260-hectare lagoon east of Niigata City.

sights.name: Junsai Pond Park
sights.description: A park of two ponds surrounded by red pine forest, named for the aquatic plant junsai that grows in the water.

sights.name: Pear Yokan
sights.description: Yokan made with fruit from the nationally designated natural monument Ruisan pear tree, over 190 years old.

sights.name: Farm Restaurant, Northern Culture Museum, Niigata Hitotsubu Brewery
sights.name_en: Farm Restaurant, Northern Culture Museum, Niigata Hitotsubu Brewery
sights.name_ja: ＜新潟市の魅力発見！がたバスツアー＞ 採れたてを味わう 農家レストランと北方文化博物館・新潟一粒酒造
sights.description: A day bus tour of the Northern Culture Museum, a sake tasting at Niigata Hitotsubu Brewery, and an Italian lunch at a farm restaurant.

sights.name: Riverside BBQ & Bonfire in Bandai Terrace Hajimari Hiroba
sights.name_en: Riverside BBQ & Bonfire in Bandai Terrace Hajimari Hiroba
sights.name_ja: リバーサイドBBQ＆焚火 in 万代テラス ハジマリヒロバ
sights.description: Visitors can enjoy riverside BBQ and bonfires, including roasting marshmallows, at Hajimari Hiroba on Bandai Terrace beside the Shinano River.

sights.name: Myōren-ji Temple Gate
sights.description: An 1826 two-story, three-bay gate of restrained design at Myōren-ji, a Nichiren temple in Higashijima founded in 1288.

sights.name: Tenjin-yama Muster Ground
sights.description: Colonies of purple katakuri flowers bloom in spring at the Tenjin-yama castle-site muster ground as the snow melts.

sights.name: Mamiya Orchard
sights.description: Fruit farm in the former Shirone area growing and selling about ten grape and pear varieties, including Le Lectier, on 10 hectares.

sights.name: Exclusive Three-Daiginjo Sake Tasting and Niigata Guide
sights.name_en: Exclusive Three-Daiginjo Sake Tasting and Niigata Guide
sights.name_ja: ここでしか呑めない大吟醸3酒呑み比べ＆新潟案内
sights.description: A Niigata sake specialty shop offering tastings of three select daiginjo, local guidance, restaurant reservations, and bring-in of shop sake when you book.

sights.name: Kitayama Pond Park
sights.description: A park with 130 Somei-Yoshino cherries around a large pond, three rare green-flowering Gyoiko trees, and crucian carp fishing.

sights.name: Right-to-Yahiko Guidepost
sights.description: A guidepost inscribed right to Yahiko stands at a three-way junction on the country road from Matsunoo at the edge of Fusebe toward Takenomachi.

sights.name: Ito Family Hagama Gozen
sights.name_ja: 大地主の食文化を味わう 羽釜御膳
sights.description: Staff guide you through the Ito family's buildings, garden and Meiji-era exhibits, and you can eat hagama-cooked Koshihikari rice.

sights.name: Farm Restaurant, Northern Culture Museum, DHC Sake Brewery
sights.name_en: Farm Restaurant, Northern Culture Museum, DHC Sake Brewery
sights.name_ja: 採れたてを味わう農家レストランと北方文化博物館・DHC酒造＜がたバスツアー＞
sights.description: A bus tour from Bandai City Bus Center visiting the Northern Culture Museum, DHC Sake Brewery for tastings, a farm-vegetable Italian lunch, and Pier Bandai.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Buried Cultural Properties Center
sights.name_en: Niigata Prefectural Buried Cultural Properties Center
sights.name_ja: 新潟県埋蔵文化財センター
sights.description: Cultural facility in Flower and Ruins Hometown Park, near the national historic Furutsu-Hachimanyama site and burial mounds.

sights.name: Niitsu Flower Land
sights.description: Producer-run flower shop in Akiha, Niigata City, selling seasonal flowers and holding more than 50 exhibitions and sales events each year.

sights.name: Kakubei-jishi Lion Dance
sights.description: Traditional Kakubei-jishi lion dance, once an Edo-period spring sight, still performed by its preservation society in June and September.

sights.name: Kakubee-jishi Village Promenade
sights.name_ja: 角兵衛獅子の里遊歩道
sights.description: A 2.2 km promenade on a former railway along the Nakanokuchi River, with old Tsukigata Station, railcars, and a Hibari Misora song monument.

sights.name: Kiwami & Niigata Local Sake Set
sights.description: A food set of selected seasonal local fish, tuna belly, sea urchin, salmon roe, and Niigata sake.

sights.name: Nakano Residence Memorial Museum
sights.description: Museum displaying art and oil-culture materials collected by the Nakano family, with the residence garden and a maple garden open to visitors.

sights.name: Nihon Boke Park (Flowering Quince)
sights.description: Park in Kosudo, Akiha, with about 230 varieties and 6,400 flowering quince plants; peak viewing is late April to early May.

sights.name: Kakubei Jizo
sights.description: Guardian Jizo of Kakubei-jishi performers beside the old Tsukigata Station, with two statues said to date from around the Azuchi-Momoyama period.

sights.name: Sugobori Cherry Blossom Avenue
sights.description: A 3.2 km avenue of 400 cherry trees along the Yokogoshi drainage canal, planted by Oeyama residents in 1989.

sights.name: Tonbodama Glass Bead Making
sights.name_ja: 選べる色は30種類！色とりどりのとんぼ玉を作ろう
sights.description: Make tonbodama by shaping melted glass rods into round beads, choosing from 30 colors and five designs in Nuttari.

sights.name: Cherry Blossom Promenade Park
sights.description: A riverside park on both banks of the Washinoki Odori River, with about 80 Somei-Yoshino cherries in spring and azaleas into early summer.

sights.name: Mount Kakuda Nature Museum
sights.description: Museum explaining the nature of Mount Kakuda, symbol of Maki in Nishikan Ward, using dioramas and photographs.

sights.name: Sunflower Field behind Agri Park
sights.name_ja: アグリパーク裏のひまわり畑
sights.description: A roughly 300-tsubo field of small sunflowers in Higashikasamaki, with Mount Yahiko and Mount Kakuda behind, blooming late July to early August 2026.

sights.name: Cherry Blossoms at the Former Niigata Customs House
sights.name_en: Cherry Blossoms at the Former Niigata Customs House
sights.description: About 30 cherry trees bloom around the Former Niigata Customs House, the only original treaty-port customs building still standing and a National Important Cultural Property.

sights.name: Fukushima Lagoon and Lake Hyoko Early-Morning Swan-Watching Eco Tour (Gata Bus Tour)
sights.name_en: Fukushima Lagoon and Lake Hyoko Early-Morning Swan-Watching Eco Tour (Gata Bus Tour)
sights.name_ja: 福島潟＆瓢湖 早朝の白鳥観賞エコツアー＜がたバスツアー＞
sights.description: A day bus tour of Hyoko and Fukushima Lagoon to watch swans, see and join a feeding session, and learn about their habitat with a ranger.

sights.name: Kameda General Gymnasium (Aspark Kameda)
sights.name_ja: 亀田総合体育館（アスパーク亀田）
sights.description: Sports complex in Niigata’s Konan Ward with arenas, an indoor heated pool and water slide, a running course, and lit outdoor tennis courts.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Museum of Environment and Human Interaction
sights.name_en: Niigata Prefectural Museum of Environment and Human Interaction
sights.name_ja: 新潟県立環境と人間のふれあい館
sights.description: Prefectural museum themed on water and people, showing river and sea life and the history of Niigata Minamata disease.

sights.name: Shigotoba Toudai Coworking Space
sights.name_ja: コワーキングスペースしごと場灯台
sights.description: A small coworking space in Nuttari Terrace shopping street, with an attic-like interior and windows overlooking temple greenery.

sights.name: Iwamuro Onsen Town Walk (Historic Sites)
sights.name_ja: 岩室温泉まちあるき（歴史・史跡を巡る）
sights.description: A guided walk through Iwamuro Onsen, a 300-year-old hot-spring town, visiting historic buildings, streetscapes, and local sites.

sights.name: Furutsu Hachimanyama Site
sights.name_ja: 国指定史跡 古津八幡山遺跡
sights.description: National historic site of a Yayoi-period highland moated settlement and a large circular burial mound, opened as a historic park in 2015.

sights.name: Katahigashi History and Folklore Museum
sights.description: Local history museum with displays on area pioneers and farm and folk tools recalling former Yoroi Lagoon and rice-growing life.

sights.name: Imojenne Sweet Potatoes
sights.name_ja: さつまいも「いもジェンヌ」
sights.description: Imojenne is a brand sweet potato grown on the sand dunes of Nishi and Nishikan wards in Niigata City and aged about one month after harvest to increase sweetness.

sights.name: Osugi Rose Garden
sights.description: A rose garden in Iwamuro named for Osugi of a local folk tale, with 660 varieties and 1,350 plants blooming from late May to late November.

sights.name: Osawa Forest Park
sights.description: Forest park in Akiha with a lawn, gazebo, and outdoor cooking area; toilets and cooking facilities close from December to mid-March.

sights.name: Kazuo Dan Literary Monument
sights.description: A haiku monument on the Agano River embankment, inscribed with a verse Kazuo Dan composed while visiting Ango Sakaguchi’s grave.

sights.name: Prickly Water Lily
sights.description: A rare Japanese water lily with purple-red flowers and leaves 1.5–2 metres across; Fukushima Lagoon is the northern limit of its wild range.

sights.name: Minami Ward Orchards, Niigata City
sights.description: Fruit orchards in Minami Ward where peach blossoms bloom from late April to early May near Ibarasone and Niida along the Nakanokuchi River.

sights.name: Niitsu-yaki Kiln (Hand-Building Experience)
sights.name_ja: 160年続く伝統の窯元で初めてでも作りやすい手びねりに挑戦
sights.description: At a 160-year-old Niitsu-yaki kiln, visitors hand-build pottery from one kilogram of Shigaraki clay and choose from over 20 glazes.

sights.name: Free-form Hand-building Pottery Course
sights.name_ja: 自由に成形できる手びねりコース！
sights.description: A hand-building pottery course where you can make two pieces, such as cups, tea bowls, or vases, choosing from seven glaze colors.

sights.name: Water Station View Fukushimagata (New Year Special Opening)
sights.name_en: Water Station View Fukushimagata (New Year Special Opening)
sights.name_ja: 水の駅 ビュー福島潟 正月特別開館
sights.description: Observation facility at Fukushimagata, a wintering ground for greater white-fronted geese, opening 6:30–12:30 on New Year’s Day for the first sunrise and geese.

sights.name: Fukui Fireflies
sights.description: Fresh spring water from many streams gathers in Fukui, at the southern foot of Mount Kakuta, where fireflies can be viewed from mid to late June.

sights.name: Kameda Plum Orchards
sights.description: Plum orchards in Niigata’s Kameda district, birthplace of Togoro Ume and Koshi no Ume, where pale pink blossoms fill the air with scent in March.

sights.name: Electric Kick Scooter Rental Tour in Niigata City Chuo Ward
sights.name_en: Electric Kick Scooter Rental Tour in Niigata City Chuo Ward
sights.name_ja: 新潟市中央区を電動キックボードレンタルプランでラクラク周遊！
sights.description: An electric kick scooter rental lets you tour Niigata City Chuo Ward, including the station, Bandai, and Furumachi areas, from a designated start point.

sights.name: Urara Kosudo Flower and Greenery Zone
sights.name_en: Urara Kosudo Flower and Greenery Zone
sights.name_ja: 花と緑のシンボルゾーンうららこすど
sights.description: A direct-sales outlet in Kosudo for vegetables and ornamental trees, with seasonal events, workshops, and hands-on farming plots.

sights.name: Yayoi no Oka Exhibition Hall (Furutsu-Hachimanyama National Historic Site)
sights.name_en: Yayoi no Oka Exhibition Hall (Furutsu-Hachimanyama National Historic Site)
sights.name_ja: 国史跡古津八幡山・弥生の丘展示館
sights.description: Exhibition hall where visitors learn history from the Paleolithic through the Heian period at the Furutsu-Hachimanyama ruins and try crafts such as magatama making.

sights.name: Agano River Riverside Park
sights.description: Riverside park overlooking the Agano River and the Echigo mountains, with baseball fields, tennis courts, and sports grounds.

sights.name: Yakibuna Historic Site
sights.description: Historic site of Yakibuna, one of Echigo's Seven Wonders, tied to a legend that Shinran revived a grilled crucian carp.

sights.name: Nakanokuchi Hall of Pioneers
sights.description: A hall honoring notable people from Nakanokuchi, including the 36th yokozuna Haguroyama, with exhibits and a 12-minute film about the district.

sights.name: Kishi no Daimoku
sights.description: Daimoku Nichiren wrote on a rock at Kakuda shore after winds drove him ashore en route to Sado; one of the Three Daimoku, kept at Myokoji Temple.

sights.name: Kawane Koen Guraundo
sights.description: Park ground in Niigata, Niigata.

sights.name: Seasonal Cuisine and Furumachi Geisha Dance at Kappo Hotaru (Gata Bus Tour)
sights.name_en: Seasonal Cuisine and Furumachi Geisha Dance at Kappo Hotaru (Gata Bus Tour)
sights.name_ja: 老舗割烹 蛍で愉しむ旬の味覚と古町芸妓の踊り＜がたバスツアー＞
sights.description: A bus tour with seasonal Japanese cuisine and Furumachi geisha dance at Kappo Hotaru, plus a November villa visit or a winter sake-brewery tour and tasting.

sights.name: Shirone Grape Garden and Shinano River Water Shuttle (Gata Bus Tour)
sights.name_en: Shirone Grape Garden and Shinano River Water Shuttle (Gata Bus Tour)
sights.name_ja: 白根グレープガーデンと信濃川ウォーターシャトル ＜がたバスツアー＞
sights.description: An afternoon bus tour of about four hours with seasonal fruit picking at Shirone Grape Garden and a 50-minute Shinano River Water Shuttle cruise.

sights.name: Aoyama Waterworks Park
sights.description: Park using water from the adjacent Aoyama purification plant for waterfalls and fountains, with peacocks, rabbits, an iris garden, and a small zoo.

sights.name: Kurosaki District General Gymnasium
sights.description: District gymnasium in Niigata’s Nishi Ward with tennis courts, volleyball, gateball, a martial arts hall, and a sumo ring.

sights.name: Niigata City Nishi General Sports Center
sights.name_en: Niigata City Nishi General Sports Center
sights.name_ja: 新潟市西総合スポーツセンター
sights.description: A sports facility that residents of the Sakaiwa and Nishi areas can easily use.

sights.name: Niigata City Minami Ward Orchards
sights.description: Pear blossoms are in full bloom in Minami Ward orchards from late April to early May, mainly near Osato along the Shinano River embankment.

sights.name: Le Lectier Pear
sights.description: A fragrant Western pear with a melting texture, first grown in Japan in former Shirone, now Niigata City.

sights.name: No-Reservation Town Walking Tour
sights.name_ja: 予約のいらないまち歩き
sights.description: On weekends and holidays, Niigata City Guides lead a two-hour walk of historic lanes in Furumachi and Nishiohata for 500 yen.

sights.name: Wooden Half-Seated Statue of Jizo Bosatsu (Kosodate Enmei Jizo)
sights.name_en: Wooden Half-Seated Statue of Jizo Bosatsu (Kosodate Enmei Jizo)
sights.name_ja: 木造地蔵菩薩半跏像（子育延命地蔵尊）
sights.description: This wooden Jizo at Morinji Temple, worshipped for child-rearing and longevity, is Niigata City's only Important Cultural Property sculpture.

sights.name: Shiratama Falls Kangomori (Winter Waterfall Austerity)
sights.description: In the coldest season, enthusiasts practice waterfall austerity at this Kanazu Hills fall, known since 1210–1221 and once a yamabushi training site.

sights.name: Soga-Hirasawa Memorial Hall
sights.description: Memorial hall in Ajikata, completed in 1991 to honor scholars Soga Ryojin and Hirasawa Ko and display their relics and documents.

sights.name: Dagashiya C57 (Showa Retro Experience)
sights.name_ja: 鉄道の町、新津で楽しむ昭和レトロタイムスリップ体験！昭和学校給食・綿あめづくり・駄菓子買い物・お土産付
sights.description: In railway town Niitsu, Dagashiya C57 offers Showa-era school lunches, cotton-candy making, and over 300 kinds of old-fashioned sweets.

sights.name: Oyamadai Park
sights.description: Park beside Oyamadai welfare town, with an observation deck overlooking the Sea of Japan, Sado, Yahiko, and the Iide range.

sights.name: Salmon Cuisine
sights.description: Full-course cuisine using salmon and roe from the Agano River at Yokogoshi, served at local caterers and restaurants.

sights.name: Niigata Kameda Distillery Tour
sights.name_ja: 新潟亀田蒸溜所 見学ツアー
sights.description: A monthly tour of a distillery making whisky entirely from Niigata ingredients, with equipment viewing and a tasting of four whiskies.

sights.name: Tabune no Sato (Kameda Clean Center Rest Facility)
sights.name_en: Tabune no Sato (Kameda Clean Center Rest Facility)
sights.name_ja: 亀田清掃センター附属休憩所 田舟の里
sights.description: Attached rest facility using waste heat from the Kameda Clean Center incinerator, with separate baths, a break room, and a multipurpose hall.

sights.name: Kiba Hachimangu Main Hall
sights.description: Main hall finished entirely in lacquer, preserving late-Edo methods used to study that period's architecture.

sights.name: Kurosaki District Baseball Field
sights.description: Baseball facility with two fields, one equipped for night games.

sights.name: Nuttari Beer (Craft Beer Tasting)
sights.name_ja: まちなかのマイクロブルワリー「沼垂ビール」で、クラフトビールを4種選んで飲み比べ
sights.description: Visitors compare four chosen craft beers at this microbrewery in a renovated old house in Nuttari, 15 minutes on foot from Niigata Station.

sights.name: Kadota Haza Avenue
sights.description: A 700-meter haza-tree avenue on the prefectural road linking National Routes 8 and 116, selected in 1994 for Japan's New 100 Street Tree Scenes.

sights.name: Washio Ukou Literary Monument
sights.description: Literary monument to Washio Ukou, Niigata’s only Naoki Prize winner, erected in 1995 with the opening of Yoshino-cho Taiheiki carved on the front.

sights.name: Ogawa Renchu (Kagura Troupe)
sights.description: Niida Kagura, said to have been brought home about 160 years ago by Shibuya Toemon after he learned arts among Naniwa performers, is performed at the June Niida Festival.

sights.name: Kizu Sanbaishi Kagura
sights.name_ja: 木津棧俵（サンバイシ）神楽
sights.description: An unusual dedicated kagura has a large mouth of two woven rice-straw bales, eggplant eyes, a pumpkin nose, kumabi-e hair, and gold-papered split-bamboo teeth.

sights.name: Great Zelkova of Kamo Shrine
sights.description: The great zelkova at Kamo Shrine, reportedly planted 600 years ago, is 11 m tall with a 10 m basal girth and was designated a prefectural natural monument in 1967.

sights.name: Takagi Farm (Strawberry Picking)
sights.description: Farm in Niigata City offering seasonal all-you-can-eat and pick-your-own Echigo-hime strawberries, plus fruit tomatoes and tomato products.

sights.name: Great Zelkova of Takamori
sights.description: A 1,200-year-old zelkova with a 12-metre root circumference, standing on a raised hill near a park and simple viewing platform.

sights.name: Satsukiyama Park
sights.description: Hillside park on the Niitsu hills with about 5,000 satsuki and azaleas, colorful from April to June along linked walking paths.

sights.name: Terao Central Park
sights.description: A park with a plaza, a stream, and a multi-purpose court, colored by 40,000 tulips in spring.

sights.name: Hanshin-age (Half-Chicken Karaage)
sights.description: Fried half-chicken in a thin curry-flavored batter, a style its originator linked to whole-bird cutting and to curry in Niigata school lunches around 1959.

sights.name: Fukushima Lagoon in Winter
sights.description: Winter lagoon where greater white-fronted geese, swans and other birds can be seen, with nature displays at View Fukushima Lagoon.

sights.name: NIIGATA Premium Dining
sights.name_ja: NIIGATA プレミアムダイニング
sights.description: A special dining event where young Niigata chefs serve a one-day premium meal in the grand hall of Northern Culture Museum, overlooking the garden.

sights.name: Former Saito Family Villa (Garden-View Matcha)
sights.name_ja: お庭を眺めながらお抹茶を！
sights.description: At this Taisho-era villa, enjoy tea and sweets indoors while viewing a strolling garden that changes with the seasons.

sights.name: Prefectural Office Forest
sights.description: A rest area of about 15,000 square meters on the prefectural office grounds, where many hepatica flowers bloom after yearly planting for their protection.

sights.name: Kita Ward Local History Museum
sights.description: Local history museum in Niigata’s Kita Ward with a permanent display of calligraphy by Toyosaka-born artist Tsurumaki Shoin and a toy collection.

sights.name: Agano Riverside Park
sights.description: A riverside park overlooking the Agano River and the Echigo mountain range, with seven baseball fields, five tennis courts, and two multi-purpose grounds.

sights.name: Niigata City Tennis Courts
sights.description: Tennis facility with 16 sand-filled artificial-turf courts and night lighting.

sights.name: Kobo Shimizu (Spring)
sights.name_ja: 弘法清水（こうぼうしみず）［新潟市］
sights.description: A spring in Takenomachi, Nishikan Ward, amid persimmon orchards near a city sports park, said to have appeared when Kobo Daishi drew his staff from the ground.

sights.name: Kiteboarding School
sights.name_ja: 風に乗って海上を疾走！カイトボーディングスクール
sights.description: A kiteboarding school at Ikarashi Beach in Niigata, where veteran instructors teaching since 1999 offer safe basic lessons.

sights.name: Niigata Winter Food Festival: Furumachi Ryotei Flavors
sights.name_en: Niigata Winter Food Festival: Furumachi Ryotei Flavors
sights.name_ja: にいがた冬食の陣「ふるまち料亭の味」
sights.description: A reservation dining plan to taste Niigata winter ingredients cooked in traditional style at Furumachi ryotei, including geisha dance and gourmet courses.

sights.name: Niigata Sightseeing Taxi
sights.name_ja: にいがた観光タクシー
sights.description: Sightseeing taxi plans in Niigata City, guided by certified tourism drivers, with recommended routes or custom courses and flexible start times.

sights.name: Hirasawa Spring
sights.description: A spring thought to have been used since the Jomon period, with traditions of Heike ties and visits by Matsuo Basho and Ryokan.

sights.name: Edamame (Chamame)
sights.description: Niigata edamame is harvested before full fill for flavor; light-brown-skinned chamame is sweet and aromatic when boiled.

sights.name: Handmade Natural Stone Bead Bracelet
sights.name_ja: 天然石ビーズで作る！手作りブレスレット
sights.description: Visitors choose from about 100 kinds of natural stone beads, with birthstone explanations provided, and thread them on elastic to make a bracelet.

sights.name: Iwamuro Yunosato Park
sights.description: Park in the middle of the Iwamuro Onsen area, where trees and flowers can be seen from early spring through autumn.

sights.name: Niigata Furumachi Geisha Hospitality (Private Plan)
sights.name_ja: 貸切プラン「新潟古町芸妓のおもてなし」
sights.description: Group charter to watch Niigata Furumachi geisha dances of a roughly 200-year tradition, with photos and parlor games, at a central Niigata venue.

sights.name: Private Tour to Watch the Sunset over the Sea
sights.name_en: Private Tour to Watch the Sunset over the Sea
sights.name_ja: 完全プライベートツアー！海に沈む夕日をみにいこう
sights.description: A private tour from Niigata City Chuo Ward to Sea of Japan sunset spots, guided by an experienced local driver who helps with photos.

sights.name: Niigata Restaurant Bus 2023
sights.description: A dining bus revived after four years, running summer routes past Niigata night views, Fukushima Lagoon, Tsukioka Onsen, and fireworks.

sights.name: Ikarashi Beach SUP School
sights.name_ja: 新感覚のマリンスポーツを体験！SUPスクール
sights.description: Stand-up paddle school at Ikarashi Beach, where association-certified instructors teach paddling and wave practice on larger boards.

sights.name: Marinepia Nihonkai Dolphin Showtime
sights.name_ja: マリンピア日本海 イルカのショータイム！
sights.description: Daily dolphin shows at this aquarium explain the animals’ bodies and athletic ability, with feeding talks for sea lions, seals and Humboldt penguins.

sights.name: Gururin Niigata Island Loop Course
sights.name_ja: 新潟中心部でサイクリングを楽しもう！「ぐるりん新潟島一周コース」
sights.description: A roughly 18 km cycling loop from Niigata Station around Niigata Island, along the Shinano River and the Sea of Japan coast.

sights.name: Ikutopia Shokuka Sparkling Tour
sights.name_ja: いくとぴあ食花キラキラツアー
sights.description: Tour of Ikutopia Shokuka featuring garden walks, a Niigata-produce restaurant and market, and an adjacent center with alpacas and capybaras.

sights.name: Nishishirone Kagura Dance
sights.description: Lion kagura begun by Nishishirone's Takahashi family after a late-Meiji Ise pilgrimage, performed yearly in late August at Shirone Shrine.

sights.name: Discover the Charm of Furumachi Hanamachi
sights.name_en: Discover the Charm of Furumachi Hanamachi
sights.description: Online event on central Niigata’s historic Furumachi hanamachi, with a lecture and an online tour of the Former Saito Family Villa.

sights.name: Gardens in Fall Colors: Elegant Niigata Day Trip
sights.name_en: Gardens in Fall Colors: Elegant Niigata Day Trip
sights.name_ja: 紅葉の庭園×日本文化“雅な新潟”満喫日帰り旅Gardens in Fall Colors – Japanese Culture”Exquisite Niigata” Grand Tour
sights.description: A one-day bus tour of wealthy farmers’ and merchants’ residences and gardens, with mochi-pounding, shinobue flute, and tea experiences.

sights.name: Shirone Giant Kite Town Guide
sights.name_ja: しろね大凧タウンガイド
sights.description: Guided visits to traditional machiya streets, centered on the Shirone Giant Kite Battle.

sights.name: Nuttari Port Town and Historic Temple and Shrine Tour
sights.name_en: Nuttari Port Town and Historic Temple and Shrine Tour
sights.name_ja: 湊町沼垂と由緒ある寺社めぐり
sights.description: Shoku no Jin’s town-walk visits old shrines and temples in the fermentation district along the Kurinoki River, with Niigata sushi for lunch.

sights.name: Historic Niigata Mansion Tour
sights.name_ja: 歴史ある新潟お屋敷めぐり
sights.description: Walking course visiting historic merchant houses and buildings in Niigata City by tourist loop bus, with a wappa-meshi lunch.

stays.description: Hotel in Chuokukawabata, Niigata with breakfast available.

stays.name_en: Hoho Inn Overlooking Echigo Plain and Yahiko Mountains
stays.name_ja: 越後平野と弥彦連山一望の宿 穂々 ― hoho ―
stays.description: Inn at Tenpurodeiwamuro Onsen in Nishikankuiwamuroonsen, Niigata with open-air baths.

stays.description: Hotel in Chuokutodaitori, Niigata; 3-minute walk from Nigata Station.

stays.name_en: Hotel Crown Hills Niigata No. 2 Higashinakadori

stays.description: Hotel in Benten, Chuo-ku, Niigata, about a 2-minute walk from Niigata Station, with Wi-Fi in all rooms.

stays.description: Hotel in Hanazono, Chuo-ku, Niigata, a one-minute walk from Niigata Station.

stays.description: Hotel in Hanazono, Chuo-ku, Niigata.

stays.name_ja: ジュラクステイ新潟
stays.description: Hotel in Hanazono, Chuo, Niigata, with breakfast, 26-square-meter deluxe twin rooms, and humidifying air purifiers in all rooms.

stays.name: Tennen Onsen Taho no Yu Dormy Inn Niigata
stays.name_en: Tennen Onsen Taho no Yu Dormy Inn Niigata
stays.name_ja: 天然温泉 多宝の湯 ドーミーイン新潟
stays.description: Hotel in Akashi, Chuo, Niigata, with separate natural hot spring baths and a men's high-temperature sauna.

stays.name_ja: 岩室温泉 ゆもとや
stays.description: Inn in Iwamuro Onsen, Nishikan Ward, Niigata.

stays.name_en: Iwamuro Onsen Koshi no Yado Takashimaya
stays.name_ja: 岩室温泉 高志の宿 高島屋

stays.description: Sulfur-scented hot-spring inn in Iwamuro Onsen, Nishikan Ward, Niigata, with a two-source bath and spring-source rooms.

stays.name: Niigata Iwamuro Onsen Fujiya
stays.name_ja: 新潟・岩室温泉 自家源泉の宿 富士屋

stays.name: Niigata Iwamuro Onsen Shaga no Sato Yumeya
stays.name_en: Niigata Iwamuro Onsen Shaga no Sato Yumeya
stays.name_ja: 新潟・岩室温泉 自家源泉の宿 著莪の里ゆめや

stays.name: Tanoura Onsen Kaikatei Kawai
stays.name_ja: 田ノ浦温泉 海華亭 かわい
stays.description: Onsen inn in Maze, Nishikan, Niigata, with a sea-view open-air bath and a 12-tatami Japanese-style room.

day_to_day.name_en: Chijimi no Sato Ojiya Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 「ちぢみの里おぢや 」（国道17号）
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Ojiya offering hegi soba, a day-trip hot spring, dining, a shop, and a movie room.

activities.name: Egami and the Ojiya Hina Festival
activities.name_en: Egami and the Ojiya Hina Festival
activities.name_ja: 絵紙と小千谷のひいな祭り
activities.description: During the Ojiya Hina Festival, ukiyo-e prints called egami and hina dolls are displayed in the shopping street, reviving a local custom designated in 2019.

activities.name: Takanoi Sake Brewery (Koshi no Hatsuume)
activities.name_ja: 高の井酒造（株）
activities.description: Sake brewery in Ojiya that stores sake in snow, using contract-grown local rice, with tours and tastings at Yukimizuan.

activities.name: Ojiya Chijimi Handloom Weaving Experience
activities.name_ja: トントンカラリトンカラリ♪はた織体験
activities.description: Make a woven coaster in Ojiya, home of Ojiya-chijimi, a hemp textile listed as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

sights.name: Ojiya Nishikigoi no Sato
sights.description: Exhibition facility in Ojiya, birthplace of nishikigoi, where about 200 koi of 15 varieties can be seen in a Japanese garden.

sights.name: Yamamotoyama Plateau
sights.description: A 336 m plateau with a gentle summit for hiking and drives, seasonal flower fields, and views of the Shinano River and Echigo Plain.

sights.name: Nishikigoi
sights.description: Ornamental carp originating in Ojiya and Nagaoka, exported worldwide and designated Niigata Prefecture’s ornamental fish in 2017.

sights.name: Jigenji Temple
sights.description: Temple preserving the room where Kawai Tsugunosuke held 1868 peace talks, plus battle pictures and relics; the hall was rebuilt after the 2004 earthquake.

sights.name: Yamamotoyama Rapeseed and Sunflower Fields
sights.description: Rapeseed and sunflower fields at Yamamotoyama Pocket Park, with hilltop views of the Echigo Sanzan and the Shinano River.

sights.name: Ojaru (Citizens' House and Ojiya Shinano River Hydroelectric Power Museum)
sights.name_en: Ojaru (Citizens' House and Ojiya Shinano River Hydroelectric Power Museum)
sights.name_ja: おぢゃ～る（市民の家・小千谷信濃川水力発電館）
sights.description: Ojiya facility with a lawn campsite, overnight lodging, a free hydroelectric museum, a dog run, and winter snow play.

sights.name: Ikegahara Hasagi (Rice-Drying Racks)
sights.description: Rice-drying racks at Ikegahara in Ojiya, a photo spot featured in TV commercials that changes with dawn, starry skies, and snow.

sights.name: Ojiya-chijimi and Echigo-jofu
sights.description: Traditional hemp textiles of the Echigo Uonuma region, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, with displays and weaving experiences at Ojiya Sunplaza.

sights.name: Ojiya Hegi Soba
sights.description: Ojiya hegi soba is served as bite-sized rolls on a hegi vessel, bound with funori seaweed.

sights.name: Ojiya Hotaru Illumination
sights.description: About 5,000 bottle lights at Yamamotoyama in Ojiya depict the Shinano River’s bends and the colors of nishikigoi.

sights.name: Ojiya Chijimi Snow Bleaching
sights.description: A step in making Ojiya Chijimi hemp cloth that bleaches the fabric on snow, done on clear days when the snow is frozen and clean.

sights.name: Oguriyama Mokujiki Kannon Hall
sights.description: Hall preserving 33 Kannon statues carved by the monk Mokujiki in 1803, opened on the 17th except from November to April.

sights.name: Ryotei Tochu
sights.description: A roughly 280-year-old ryotei in a nationally registered tangible cultural property, retaining the room where Kawai Tsugunosuke lunched after negotiations, and serving seasonal dishes.

sights.name: Ojiya City General Gymnasium and Civic Pool
sights.name_en: Ojiya City General Gymnasium and Civic Pool
sights.description: Gymnasium and civic pool in Ojiya with arenas, martial-arts and training rooms, children's spaces, and a 50-meter pool with a retractable roof.

sights.name: Baba Shimizu Spring
sights.description: A spring at the Tokimizu historic-site trailhead in Ojiya, selected as a Niigata famous water that visitors come to draw.

sights.name: Atagoyama Snow Camellia Grove
sights.name_ja: 愛宕山ユキツバキ群生地
sights.description: A one-hectare grove of snow camellias at Atagoyama, found only on the Japan Sea side from Toyama to Akita and protected under winter snow.

sights.name: Ushi no Tsunotsuki Bullfighting (Ojiya and Yamakoshi)
sights.name_en: Ushi no Tsunotsuki Bullfighting (Ojiya and Yamakoshi)
sights.name_ja: 牛の角突き（小千谷・山古志）
sights.description: Traditional bullfighting with over 1,000 years of history, a national Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property, held in Ojiya and Yamakoshi and generally ended in a draw.

sights.name: Nishiwaki Residence (Ojiya Wealthy Merchant's House)
sights.name_ja: 小千谷豪商の館 西脇邸
sights.description: Wealthy merchant's residence in Ojiya.

sights.name: Yamamotoyama First and Second Regulating Reservoirs
sights.name_en: Yamamotoyama First and Second Regulating Reservoirs
sights.name_ja: 山本山 第一調整池 第二調整池
sights.description: Regulating reservoirs at the JR Shinano River Power Station; water generates electricity sent to Kanto for the Yamanote Line, and the second reservoir has dam views and cherry blossoms.

sights.name: Hakusan Sports Park
sights.description: Sports park in Ojiya amid nature, with baseball, tennis, athletics, a 40-meter ski jump, cycling paths, and a barbecue area.

sights.name: Seated Wooden Statue of Aizen Myoo
sights.name_en: Seated Wooden Statue of Aizen Myoo
sights.description: Late Kamakura cypress principal image of Myokoji Temple, with a fierce three-eyed face, unveiled on the 26th of each month.

sights.name: Niigata Meijo Sake Brewery (Chojamori)
sights.description: Sake brewery in Ojiya producing Chojamori, a light, dry Niigata sake with a fine, elegant body and a clean finish.

sights.name: OJIYA SAUNA DEN
sights.description: A rural sauna in Ojiya with three barrel saunas and a cold bath of Baba Shimizu, a selected Niigata water, plus outdoor air bathing.

sights.name: Kooridon Pond
sights.description: A pond in Ojiya named for a legendary local governor, said never to dry and to keep nearby fields watered in drought.

sights.name: Tatenohara, Shiodono District
sights.description: Just before the Uono joins the Shinano, complex channels and the Echigo Sanzan mountains fill this viewpoint.

sights.name: Ojiya City General Industrial Hall Sun Plaza
sights.name_en: Ojiya City General Industrial Hall Sun Plaza
sights.name_ja: 小千谷市総合産業会館サンプラザ
sights.description: Multipurpose hall in Ojiya selling local specialties and textiles, with hegi soba restaurants and a weaving experience.

sights.name: Amida Hall of Uonuma Shrine
sights.description: A nationally designated Important Cultural Property, this thatched pyramidal Amida hall has very short eaves for heavy snow and is thought to date from 1558-1570.

sights.name: Mimamori Rock
sights.description: A boulder beside Ojiya Bullfighting Arena that split in the 2004 Chuetsu earthquake, hung with a 15-meter rope by local bullfighting members.

sights.name: Asahiyama Historic Battlefield
sights.description: Historic battlefield where Hokuetsu Boshin War fighting intensified after peace talks failed; French-style trenches and campsite remains survive near the summit.

sights.name: Day-Trip Nishikigoi Farm Visit
sights.description: A day visit to nishikigoi farms and outdoor ponds in Ojiya’s Echigo Nijumurago, the birthplace of colored carp.

sights.name: Mount Kanakura
sights.description: A sacred peak featured in Bakin's Hakkenden, with wildflowers and summit views of the Echigo Plain, rice terraces, and koi ponds.

sights.name: Akashido Hall
sights.description: A city-designated zelkova hall built in 1848 to enshrine Ojiya-chijimi founder Hori Jiro Masatoshi, open to the public only on September 12.

sights.name: Takumi-no-Za (Ojiya Textile Workshop)
sights.name_ja: 小千谷織物工房「匠之座」
sights.description: A second-floor shop in Ojiya's Sun Plaza selling Ojiya chijimi, Ojiya tsumugi, Katakai cotton, fabric bolts, clothing, and household goods.

sights.name: Sotonosawa Rice Terraces
sights.description: Rice terraces in Ojiya that receive sunlight all day and overlook the Uonuma hills toward the Mikuni Mountains.

sights.name: Mount Asahi
sights.description: A mountain overlooking Ojiya, known as a Boshin War battlefield, with French-style trenches, camp remains, and soldiers' graves near the summit.

sights.name: Ojiya Town Walk
sights.description: A town walk in Ojiya including Nishikigoi no Sato, the only nishikigoi viewing facility in Niigata Prefecture, Akashido, and hegi soba.

sights.name: Ojiya Country Club
sights.name_ja: 小千谷カントリークラブ
sights.description: 18-hole, par-72 golf course covering 115 hectares in the Ojiya hills, with views of the Echigo Sanzan mountains.

sights.name: Orinoza (Ojiya Textile Workshop)
sights.name_ja: 小千谷織物工房「織之座」
sights.description: Experiential textile gallery at Sun Plaza in Ojiya where visitors can see, touch, and make original textiles guided by traditional craft artisans.

sights.name: Junzaburo Nishiwaki Poetry Monument
sights.description: Poetry monument to Junzaburo Nishiwaki, born in Ojiya in 1894, whose collections influenced modern Japanese poetry.

sights.name: Shiodono Warabi Harvesting Experience
sights.name_ja: 塩殿でわらび収穫体験開催！
sights.description: An early-summer warabi-harvesting experience in Shiodono, Ojiya, on relatively flat restored farmland, where locals teach how to remove bitterness.

stays.name: Business Hotel Nyu Plaza
stays.name_ja: ビジネスホテルニュープラザ
stays.description: Hotel in Jonai, Ojiya with buffet meals and breakfast available.

stays.name: L-Stay Ojiya
stays.name_ja: L-Stay小千谷
stays.description: Lodging in Ojiya, Niigata.

day_to_day.name: Sado Select Market
day_to_day.name_ja: 佐渡特選市場
day_to_day.description: Shop selling almost entirely Sado products, including fresh vegetables, seasonal fruit, mushrooms, processed foods, crafts, and souvenirs.

day_to_day.name: Ogiya Souvenir Market
day_to_day.name_ja: おみやげ市場 小木家
day_to_day.description: Souvenir market connected to Sado Kisen Ogi Port Terminal, offering Sado seafood, sake, crafts and sweets, plus a restaurant serving squid kamameshi.

day_to_day.name: Umaimon-ya (Direct Sales Shop)
day_to_day.name_ja: うまいもんや（直売所）
day_to_day.description: Direct-sales shop on Sado selling local vegetables, prepared dishes, and processed foods, where producers and local staff explain cooking methods.

activities.name: Tub Boat Experience (Yajima Experience Exchange Center)
activities.name_en: Tub Boat Experience (Yajima Experience Exchange Center)
activities.name_ja: たらい舟体験（矢島体験交流館）
activities.description: Visitor tub-boat rides in Ogi, Sado, on boats developed from washtubs to gather seaweed and shellfish along a rocky coast.

activities.name: Shosenkaku (Hatano Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 畑野温泉 松泉閣
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring at Hatano Onsen in Sado, with a 41.8°C sodium-chloride bath and views of the Kuninaka Plain and Mount Kinpoku.

activities.name: Shiizaki Hot Spring
activities.name_ja: 椎崎温泉
activities.description: Hot spring on a hill by Lake Kamo on Sado, with views of the lake, the Osado mountains, and sunsets, linked to a crested-ibis legend.

activities.name: Niibokatakami Hot Spring
activities.name_ja: 新穂潟上温泉
activities.description: Day-use hot spring on Sado with an 800-year history, linked to a legend of a white heron healing its wounds in the water.

activities.name: Sado Taiko Experience Exchange Hall Tatakokan
activities.name_en: Sado Taiko Experience Exchange Hall Tatakokan
activities.name_ja: 佐渡太鼓体験交流館 たたこう館
activities.description: Taiko experience hall run by the Kodo Cultural Foundation beside Kodo Village, with a large drum handmade from a 600-year-old zelkova.

activities.name: Futatsugame Campground
activities.name_ja: 二ツ亀キャンプ場
activities.description: A campsite at Futatsugame Beach in Washizaki, Sado, overlooking Futatsugame and Onogame, two-star sites in the Michelin Green Guide Japon.

activities.name: ist-Sado
activities.name_ja: ist-Sado（旧：佐渡関岬オートキャンプ場）
activities.description: A campground on a rise 100 meters from the Seki coast, facing the Sea of Japan, above a trailhead to ancient-cedar forest.

activities.name: Kubota Campground
activities.name_ja: 窪田キャンプ場
activities.description: Campsite in a pine grove facing Mano Bay, with a calm shallow beach just across the road.

activities.name: Aikawa Hina Doll Festival (Sado)
activities.name_ja: 佐渡國相川ひなまつり
activities.description: A public viewing of hina dolls and related items kept in homes, shops, and hotels at about 30 venues in Aikawa, a town that prospered from gold mining.

activities.name: Suhama Campground
activities.name_ja: 素浜キャンプ場
activities.description: Open-pitch campsite on Suhama Beach's 4 km sandy shore, with roadside and hilltop areas, toilets, showers, and an adjacent bungalow village.

activities.name: Ryotsu Onsen (Ryotsu Hot Spring Area)
activities.name_ja: 両津温泉（両津温泉郷）
activities.description: A hot-spring area five minutes by bus from Ryotsu Port on Sado, with inns in five districts near Lake Kamo.

activities.name: Sado Island Galaxy Art Festival
activities.name_ja: さどの島 銀河芸術祭
activities.description: Artists share Sado’s appeal year-round except summer, with winter sea-and-snow tours and workshops on Noh and local cuisine.

activities.name: Hemmi Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: 逸見酒造
activities.description: Sake brewery founded in the Meiji era that makes Shinryo with on-site spring water and offers brewery tours and tastings.

activities.name: Kato Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: 加藤酒造店
activities.description: Sake brewery founded in 1915 on Sado, producing Kintsuru and junmai daiginjo Jogen no Tsuki, with free tastings.

activities.name: Obata Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: 尾畑酒造
activities.description: Sake brewery founded in 1892 that produces Mano Tsuru and offers brewery tours and tastings.

activities.name: Tsubakiya Pottery Gallery
activities.name_ja: 椿屋陶芸館
activities.description: Sado pottery shop centered on mumyoi ware made from red clay that cannot leave the island, displaying about 1,000 pieces from 16 kilns.

activities.name: Hokusetsu Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: 北雪酒造
activities.description: Sake brewery on Sado offering reserved tours and tastings of handmade daiginjo made from island-grown Yamada Nishiki rice.

activities.name: Sado Koban-Making Experience (with Kirarium Sado Admission)
activities.name_en: Sado Koban-Making Experience (with Kirarium Sado Admission)
activities.name_ja: 佐渡小判作り体験（佐渡金銀山ガイダンス施設「きらりうむ佐渡」入場券付）
activities.description: A Sado koban-making experience including admission to Kirarium Sado, a guidance facility with videos about the Sado gold and silver mines.

activities.name: Hamochi Onsen
activities.name_ja: 羽茂温泉
activities.description: Hot spring area in Hamochi, Sado, with one bathhouse, Kuaterume Sado, past a red torii, and a B&G gym and pool nearby.

activities.name: Sado Koji Homemade Miso Experience
activities.name_ja: 初めてでも安心♪佐渡麹で手前味噌体験
activities.description: Make homemade miso using koji from Tsukamoto Kojiya, a Sado maker over 100 years old, then visit the storehouse.

activities.name: Irisaki Campground
activities.name_ja: 入崎キャンプ場
activities.description: Campground beside fine-gravel, clear Irisaki Beach, with rocky areas for fishing and tide-pool play; sites have no trees.

activities.name: Sea Kayaking at Ogi Kotoura Caves
activities.name_en: Sea Kayaking at Ogi Kotoura Caves
activities.name_ja: 佐渡のきれいな海と最高のロケーションでシーカヤック体験（小木琴浦洞窟）
activities.description: Sea kayaking on the Ogi Peninsula for beginners and children, viewing naturally formed caves in a designated marine park.

activities.name: Sado Lake Kamo Onsen
activities.name_ja: 佐渡加茂湖温泉
activities.description: A hot-spring inn beside Lake Kamo on Sado, popular for skin-beautifying baths and Sea of Japan cuisine, near Ryotsu Port.

activities.name: Hangiri Black Night Cruise (Noctiluca Course)
activities.name_ja: はんぎりブラックナイトクルーズ 体験！海にきらめく「夜光虫」を探す旅（夜光虫コース）
activities.description: A limited-date night tarai-bune cruise from Shukunegi on Sado to search for glowing noctiluca.

activities.name: Sumiyoshi Hot Spring
activities.name_ja: 住吉温泉
activities.description: Coastal hot spring facing Ryotsu Bay near Ryotsu Port on Sado, long known as a healing bath for injured crested ibises.

activities.name: Hangiri Day Cruise B Course Shukunegi Tub Boat Experience
activities.name_en: Hangiri Day Cruise B Course Shukunegi Tub Boat Experience
activities.name_ja: はんぎりデイクルーズ Bコース（25分） 宿根木でたらい舟体験
activities.description: A 25-minute cruise in a handmade cedar-and-bamboo tub boat past rocky shores, with Shukunegi’s Edo-period-style streets behind you.

activities.name: Sado Sakiori Weaving Experience
activities.name_ja: 佐渡のお母さんたちと作ろう！佐渡で受け継がれる裂織体験
activities.description: Weave strips of old cloth on a standing loom in Sado to make a placemat, coaster or card case in one to two hours.

activities.name: Sado Night Enjoyment Tour (Local Dinner, Traditional Arts & Kitazawa Flotation Plant Illumination)
activities.name_en: Sado Night Enjoyment Tour (Local Dinner, Traditional Arts & Kitazawa Flotation Plant Illumination)
activities.name_ja: 佐渡満喫ナイトツアー「佐渡産食材の夕食＋伝統芸能＋北沢浮遊選鉱場ライトアップ見学」
activities.description: A package night tour on Sado with a local-ingredient dinner, traditional performing arts, hotel transfers, and night illumination viewing at the Kitazawa Flotation Plant.

activities.name: Sado Sea Firefly Observation
activities.name_ja: 波面に青く光る無数の星 幻想的な佐渡のウミホタル観察会体験
activities.description: Night viewing of sea fireflies on Sado, the only place in Niigata where these nocturnal sea-floor creatures glow blue on moonless nights.

activities.name: Night Sea Kayaking at Sawada
activities.name_ja: 佐和田の海でナイトシーカヤック体験
activities.description: Night kayaking on the gently lit shallow sea around Sawada Beach, starting near popular Ameya Pier and open to beginners and families.

activities.name: Sunset Kayak and SUP Experience at Lake Kamo
activities.name_en: Sunset Kayak and SUP Experience at Lake Kamo
activities.name_ja: 加茂湖でサンセットカヤック/SUP体験
activities.description: Sunset kayak and SUP trips leave Kamoko Boat House on Lake Kamo, Niigata’s largest natural lake, about five minutes from Ryotsu Port.

activities.name: Kodo Taiko Experience
activities.name_ja: 世界的な人気を誇る太鼓芸能集団 「鼓童」スタッフが教える！太鼓体験で楽しく健康＆リフレッシュ！
activities.description: Staff of Sado-based taiko group Kodo lead a drumming session where visitors strike a 120 cm drum, certified as health tourism.

activities.name: Mushizaki Trial Diving and Sea Kayaking Day Course
activities.name_en: Mushizaki Trial Diving and Sea Kayaking Day Course
activities.name_ja: 両津港から車で30分！虫崎で一日遊べる「体験ダイビング」＋「シーカヤック」コース
activities.description: A full-day trial diving and sea kayaking course at Mushizaki Beach, 30 minutes from Ryotsu Port, in groups of one or two parties.

activities.name: Mushizaki Trial Diving Half-Day Plan
activities.name_ja: 両津港から車で30分！虫崎で「体験ダイビング」半日プラン
activities.description: A half-day trial diving plan at Mushizaki Beach, 30 minutes by car from Ryotsu Port, with a short lesson so no permit is needed.

activities.name: Onidaiko Experience on Sado Island
activities.name_ja: 佐渡島で学ぶ 伝統芸能鬼太鼓
activities.description: Beginner hands-on session of Sado’s traditional Onidaiko, still kept in 120 villages, with a video, talk, practice and photos.

activities.name: Lake Kamo Kayak and SUP Experience
activities.name_en: Lake Kamo Kayak and SUP Experience
activities.name_ja: お子様でも安心！加茂湖でカヤック/SUP体験
activities.description: Kayak or SUP trips on Sado's Lake Kamo leave Kamoko Boat House; the lake is designated among Japan's 100 Views.

activities.name: Mizuhiki Craft Experience
activities.name_ja: 日本の伝統工芸「水引体験」～心を結ぶ佐渡の旅～お友達同士にもオススメです！
activities.description: Make mizuhiki cords in soft colors recalling Sado Gold Mine gold and silver and crested ibis feathers, with instructor guidance.

activities.name: Sawata Sea Kayak and SUP Experience
activities.name_en: Sawata Sea Kayak and SUP Experience
activities.name_ja: 佐和田の海でシーカヤック/SUP体験
activities.description: Kayaking and limited-period SUP start near Ameya Pier at Sawata Beach, where the sea is clear and shallow and waves are calm from early summer to autumn.

activities.name: Sado Led-Horse Walk Experience
activities.name_ja: 今年はうま年！佐渡で楽しむ引馬さんぽ体験
activities.description: Staff lead horses on a walking ride through Sado’s nature, so inexperienced riders can join.

activities.name: Sawada Sunset Kayak and SUP Experience
activities.name_en: Sawada Sunset Kayak and SUP Experience
activities.name_ja: 佐和田の海でサンセットカヤック/SUP体験
activities.description: Sunset kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding from Ameya Pier at Sawada Beach, where seas are calm from early summer to autumn.

activities.name: Hangiri Sunset and Night Experience (Bonfire Course)
activities.name_en: Hangiri Sunset and Night Experience (Bonfire Course)
activities.name_ja: かがり火を焚いた特別体験！はんぎり サンセット&ナイター体験（かがり火コース）
activities.description: An evening-to-night hangiri tub-boat cruise at Shukunegi, lit by bonfires and bamboo lanterns, with possible views of sea life and noctiluca.

activities.name: Sado Norimaki-Making Experience with Local Mothers
activities.name_en: Sado Norimaki-Making Experience with Local Mothers
activities.name_ja: 地元お母ちゃんと作る佐渡の『のり巻き作り』体験 ～海が見える高台のレストランの薬膳ランチ付き～
activities.description: Make norimaki with local mothers in Mushizaki, a small Sado port settlement of about 20 residents.

activities.name: Hangiri Day Cruise C Course Shukunegi Tub Boat Experience
activities.name_en: Hangiri Day Cruise C Course Shukunegi Tub Boat Experience
activities.name_ja: はんぎりデイクルーズCコース（35分） 宿根木でたらい舟体験
activities.description: A handmade cedar-and-bamboo tub-boat cruise past Shukunegi's Edo-style townscape and rocky shores, guided by a local boatman.

activities.name: Koiwai Ranch (Animal Encounter)
activities.name_ja: 親子にオススメ！森の中の小さな牧場 動物ふれあい体験
activities.description: Koiwai Ranch is a small ranch in the forest where visitors can feed horses and cows, hold free-range chickens, and take a slow horseback ride.

activities.name: Sado Mochi-Pounding Experience
activities.name_ja: “暮らす”を感じる旅 ～佐渡で楽しむもちつき体験～
activities.description: Winter-only mochi pounding with a pestle and mortar in a quiet Sado farmhouse garden, plus pork soup cooked over a wood fire.

food.name: Fruit Cafe Saito
food.name_ja: フルーツカフェさいとう
food.description: Cafe serving juices and frozen desserts made from Saito Farm fruit (strawberries, peaches, nectarines, apples, Okesa persimmons, and grapes), with strawberry picking available in spring.

food.name: Gakkogura Cafe
food.description: Cafe in a corner of Gakkogura, a sake brewery in the former Nishi-Mikawa Elementary School, serving dishes using koji, sake lees and local ingredients, with views of the sky and sea.

food.name: Gashima Cinema
food.description: House on Kyomachi street built in the Showa 10s as a Sado gold-mine director's company home; films screen daily on a monthly bill, an old carbon-arc projector is displayed, and it is also a tea stop.

food.name: Coffee House Rarugo
food.name_ja: コーヒーハウスらるご
food.description: Coffee house founded in 1973 serving cloth-drip blend coffee from Central and South American highland beans, Napolitan, Koshihikari curry and seasonal fruit parfaits.

food.name: mikawa
food.description: Coffee, baked sweets, and cake are available to eat in or take away, and sandwiches are offered for breakfast and lunch.

food.name: maSanicoffee
food.description: Cafe on the 1st floor of Minami Futo Building beside the Sado Kisen Ryotsu Port Terminal, serving selected coffee and meals using Sado ingredients.

food.name: Cafe de Cattleya
food.name_ja: カフェ・ド・カトレア
food.description: Cafe opened in 1958, with stained-glass lights, a flower on each table, and background music, serving about 30 coffees including blends, origin coffees, and Irish coffee, plus cakes such as apple pie, tea, and juice.

food.name: Gyoza and Coffee Oni Cafe
food.description: Cafe that inherited handmade gyoza after a long-running ramen shop closed, serving Sado-style oni-yaki called onikin and dishes made with Sado wild herbs.

food.name: Jinnobi Cafe & Restaurant
food.description: Cafe and restaurant serving food and alcohol, with an open view, where locals and travelers gather.

food.name: Kamoko Cafe Koasobi
food.description: Cafe in a renovated boat house about 70 years old beside Lake Kamo, serving pasta with local oysters and a salmon lunch.

food.name: SABOCOFFEE
food.description: Cafe in a renovated old house, opened 3 April 2022, serving house-roasted coffee and bread (takeout available) plus sweets such as homemade amazake pudding and coffee yokan; outdoor seating available.

food.name: Guest House Jinku Cafe
food.name_ja: ゲストハウスじんくカフェ
food.description: Cafe attached to a guesthouse a short walk from Ryotsu Port, serving handmade hot piroshki, coffee and lunch, with Wi-Fi.

food.name: Cafe Umbrella
food.description: Cafe serving drinks, spaghetti, curry, noodles, set meals, sandwiches, sweets and homemade hamburger steak on an iron plate, plus rice grown by the shop.

food.name: Garage cafe RENNSPORT
food.description: Cafe displaying classic Porsches and Lotuses, serving weekly-changing spaghetti and sweets plus organic-fruit juice and chai.

food.name: Coffee & Tea Tutu
food.description: Cafe in a corner of the Honda Cars Sado Sawata showroom serving counter-order hand-drip specialty coffee, smoothies and SHIMAFUMI natural-yeast pancakes, and selling that shop's bread; free Wi-Fi available.

food.name: Kitchen Yorokonde Hara Kuro
food.name_ja: キッチン よろこんで 原黒店

food.name: Chugoku Saikan Fantao
food.name_ja: 中国菜館 ファンタオ
