day_to_day.description: Orchard in Seiro that bred and registered the sweet Benizuiho grape, also growing other grape and pear varieties.

day_to_day.name: Maruhan Ito Orchard (Grape Picking)
day_to_day.name_ja: まるはん伊藤農園
day_to_day.description: A tourist grape orchard in Seiro that has grown grapes for ten generations with organic soil made mainly from straw and chicken manure.

day_to_day.name: Awaji Orchard (Grape Picking)
day_to_day.name_ja: 淡路農園
day_to_day.description: Grape-picking orchard offering about 15 varieties, grown mainly with organic fertilizer and low pesticides, with nationwide shipping available.

activities.name: Seiro Kannon-no-Yu Zabun
activities.name_ja: 聖籠観音の湯「ざぶ～ん」
activities.description: Day-use salty hot spring in Seiro, drawn from about 1,100 meters underground, with a covered outdoor bath and baths that swap by day.

food.name: Seimen-ya Shokudo Seiro
food.name_ja: 製麺屋食堂 聖籠店

food.name: Nigataya Osaka Tako Yaki
food.name_ja: にいがたや大阪たこ焼き

food.name: Nigata Higashiminato Kowan Center Shokudo
food.name_ja: 新潟東港港湾センター 食堂

food.name: Asian Restaurant Miruchirio
food.name_ja: アジアンレストラン ミルチリオ

food.name: Higashiminato Ramen Shop
food.name_ja: 東港ラーメンショップ

food.name: Seiro Jiba Bussan-kan Restaurant Corner
food.name_ja: 聖籠地場物産館 お食事コーナー

food.name: Shibauma Honpo
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Seiro, Niigata.

sights.name: Ajirohama Beach
sights.description: Family swimming beach in Seiro with a sandy, shallow shore, where visitors also fish from the coast or boats.

sights.name: Seiju-en Orchard (Grape Picking)
sights.description: Grape orchard in Seiro selling Kyoho, Shine Muscat and other varieties plus homegrown vegetables; reservations required.

sights.name: Benten-gata Scenic Park
sights.description: A year-round scenic park, once part of the Ninomiya family garden, with cherry blossoms, hydrangeas, lotuses and over 200 swans from late November.

sights.name: Sakagami Orchard (Grape Picking)
sights.description: Grape orchard in Seiro offering picking of over 20 varieties, grown with low-pesticide organic methods, for up to 100 people.

sights.name: Amano Cherry-Picking Orchard
sights.name_ja: 天野さくらんぼ狩り園
sights.description: Cherry-picking orchard in Seiro, the first in the prefecture to grow cherries in greenhouses, with all-you-can-eat picking of several varieties even in the rain.

sights.name: Ken's Grape Garden
sights.name_ja: ケンズグレープガーデン
sights.description: A free-admission grape garden where visitors cut grapes with provided scissors and buy them by variety after weighing, with tastings offered.

sights.name: Ninomiya Family Garden Seishoen and Rose Garden
sights.name_en: Ninomiya Family Garden Seishoen and Rose Garden
sights.name_ja: 国登録有形文化財 二宮家庭園「静勝園」とバラ園
sights.description: The Ninomiya family garden Seishoen in Seiro, whose buildings were nationally registered in 2006, adjoins swan-visited Benten-gata and opens with the rose garden from late May to mid-June.

sights.name: Tanaka Grape Orchard
sights.description: Eco-farmer-certified grape orchard in Seiro growing Benizuho and seedless Shine Muscat that can be eaten with the skin.

sights.name: Sea Fishing at Niigata East Port 2nd East Breakwater
sights.name_en: Sea Fishing at Niigata East Port 2nd East Breakwater
sights.name_ja: 防波堤で出来る海釣り～新潟東港第2東防波堤～
sights.description: A breakwater fishing spot at Niigata East Port, opened in June 2011 under safety management, where various fish draw families and advanced anglers.

stays.name: Hotel Zabun
stays.name_ja: ホテル ざぶ～ん
stays.description: Hotel in Suwayama, Seiro, with a salty natural hot spring and tatami Japanese-style rooms.

day_to_day.name: Michi-no-Eki Sekikawa (Katsura no Seki)
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 関川（桂の関）
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Sekikawa Village with a day-use hot spring, a local produce shop, and a foot bath beside the souvenir hall.

day_to_day.name: Michinoeki Sekikawa (Katsura no Seki Onsen Yumu)
day_to_day.name_en: Michinoeki Sekikawa (Katsura no Seki Onsen Yumu)
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅関川「桂の関温泉 ゆ～む」
day_to_day.description: Roadside-station day spa in Sekikawa Village with large baths, open-air baths, saunas, and a sodium-calcium sulfate spring at 74.5°C.

day_to_day.name: Sekikawa Tourist Information Center Nyaamu
day_to_day.name_ja: せきかわ観光情報センター にゃ～む
day_to_day.description: Tourist information center at Roadside Station Sekikawa, where anyone can play the piano and watch neko-chigura making.

activities.name: Echigo Sekikawa Hot Spring Area
activities.name_ja: えちごせきかわ温泉郷
activities.description: Hot-spring area of five springs along the Arakawa River in Sekikawa, traditionally dated to the Kamakura period and within Bandai-Asahi National Park.

activities.name: Kirara Onsen (Echigo Sekikawa Hot Springs)
activities.name_ja: 雲母温泉（えちごせきかわ温泉郷）
activities.description: Hot-spring area on the left bank of the Arakawa River, with views of the Iide and Asahi ranges and two inns near National Route 113.

activities.name: Takanosu Campground
activities.name_ja: 鷹の巣キャンプ場
activities.description: Forest campground beside the clear Arakawa River, ringed by hinoki, zelkova, and oak, with dogtooth violets covering the slopes in spring.

activities.name: Takanosu Hot Spring (Echigo Sekikawa Hot Springs)
activities.name_en: Takanosu Hot Spring (Echigo Sekikawa Hot Springs)
activities.name_ja: 鷹の巣温泉（えちごせきかわ温泉郷）
activities.description: Takanosu Hot Spring is one of five Echigo Sekikawa hot-spring areas in the Arakawa gorge within Bandai-Asahi National Park, with two villa inns across a suspension bridge.

activities.name: Takase Hot Spring (Echigo Sekikawa Hot Springs)
activities.name_en: Takase Hot Spring (Echigo Sekikawa Hot Springs)
activities.name_ja: 高瀬温泉（えちごせきかわ温泉郷）
activities.description: Takase Hot Spring is an Echigo Sekikawa hot-spring area with six inns accommodating 365 guests.

activities.name: Yuzawa Onsen (Echigo Sekikawa Hot Springs)
activities.name_ja: 湯沢温泉（えちごせきかわ温泉郷）
activities.description: Hot spring in Sekikawa Village, said to have been found in the Kamakura period when a wounded bear was seen bathing.

activities.name: Takanosu Campground
activities.name_ja: 鷹の巣キャンプ場
activities.description: A campsite beside the Arakawa River in hinoki, zelkova, and oak forest within Bandai-Asahi National Park, managed by Sekikawa Village.

food.name: Motokojiya Kominka Cafe
food.name_ja: 古民家カフェ 元麹屋

food.name: Sekigawa Mura Higashi Katsura-en Cafe
food.name_ja: 関川村 東桂苑 カフェ

food.name: Drive-in Toyofuji
food.name_ja: ドライブインとよふじ

food.name: Restaurant With
food.name_ja: レストラン ウィズ

food.name: Restaurant Meiku
food.name_ja: レストラン メイク

food.name: Nakamura-ya
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Sekikawa, Niigata.

sights.name: Arakawa Gorge Momiji Line and Takanosu Suspension Bridge
sights.name_en: Arakawa Gorge Momiji Line and Takanosu Suspension Bridge
sights.name_ja: 荒川峡もみじライン・鷹の巣吊り橋
sights.description: A roughly 20 km autumn-foliage route from Sekikawa Village to Oguni in Yamagata, with scenery to enjoy in every season.

sights.name: Kuni Shitei Juyo Bunkazai Watanabe Tei
sights.description: Sight in Sekikawa, Niigata.

sights.name: Neko Chigura (Straw Cat Baskets)
sights.description: Handmade straw cat baskets from Sekikawa Village, modeled on traditional childcare baskets, with making demonstrations at the Sekikawa tourist information center.

sights.name: Cosmos Park
sights.description: Cosmos Park in Sekikawa, where about 200,000 cosmos bloom on 2.5 hectares from late September to mid-October, with paths for walking beside the Arakawa River.

sights.name: Oishi Auto Camp Village
sights.name_ja: 大石オートキャンプ村
sights.description: Auto campground at the foot of the Iide Mountains with 50 powered auto sites, birdwatching, and a wetland plant garden.

sights.name: Old Yonezawa Highway: Echigo Three Passes (Takanosu, Enoki and Osato)
sights.name_en: Old Yonezawa Highway: Echigo Three Passes (Takanosu, Enoki and Osato)
sights.name_ja: 旧米沢街道 越後三峠（鷹の巣峠・榎峠・大里峠）
sights.description: Historic passes linking Shibata and Yonezawa in Yamagata; Sekikawa’s three passes are among Japan’s 100 Historic Roads, with autumn foliage in late October and early November.

sights.name: Arakawa-kyo Grape Orchard
sights.description: Grape orchard in Sekikawa Village near Takase and Takanosu hot springs, selling more than ten varieties by weight.

sights.name: Sato Family Residence
sights.description: Thatched 1765 house of a former village headman, in mallet style on the old Yonezawa road; not open to the public.

sights.name: Tokeien Historic Residence
sights.description: Built in 1905 and set back from the street, this Watanabe family branch residence offers mountain views from its tatami rooms.

sights.name: Tōkeien Cafe
sights.description: Cafe inside village-designated Tōkeien, a 1905 mansion by Michi-no-Eki Sekikawa, offering soba and other dishes on weekends.

sights.name: Oishi Dam Lakeside Prefectural Recreation Area
sights.name_en: Oishi Dam Lakeside Prefectural Recreation Area
sights.name_ja: 大石ダム湖畔県民休養地
sights.description: A prefectural recreation park downstream of Oishi Dam with go-karts, mini trains, a small zoo, and autumn foliage.

sights.name: Okura Shrine
sights.description: Shrine in Sekikawa founded before 806, dedicated to Izumo deities and keeping a biwa from the Osato Pass legend as a sacred treasure.

sights.name: Yuzawa Kannon Park
sights.description: Hilltop park near Yuzawa Onsen with 33 life-size Kannon statues, historic monuments, and spring katakuri flowers.

sights.name: Maruyama Ohashi and Maruyama Park
sights.name_ja: 丸山大橋 丸山公園
sights.description: A reinforced-concrete fixed arch bridge linking Onodachi Park to Maruyama Park, with sunset views over flooded rice fields and a cherry-blossom park.

sights.name: Takase Cherry Blossom Avenue
sights.name_ja: 高瀬の桜並木 （見頃：例年4月初旬）
sights.description: About 90 cherry trees line some 600 meters from Yakushido at Takase Onsen and are lit by lanterns at night in early April.

sights.name: Taki Shrine Spring
sights.name_ja: 滝神社の清水（たきじんじゃのしみず）
sights.description: A cold spring at the shrine approach in central Kajikadani, surrounded by cedar forest and long enjoyed by locals and travelers.

sights.name: Mount Koto (Nakatsuka Trailhead)
sights.description: Nakatsuka trailhead for 966-meter Mount Koto in Sekikawa, where a rabbit-shaped snow pattern appears on the west face in spring.

sights.name: Sekikawa Fureai Dome
sights.name_ja: せきかわふれあいど～む
sights.description: Indoor multi-purpose dome at Roadside Station Sekikawa for sports and events, displaying the 82.8-metre, two-tonne Daishitamon snake float.

sights.name: Mount Tsuesashi (Oishi Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: ※23年東俣林道通行禁止 杖差岳（大石登山口）
sights.description: Oishi route to 1,636-meter Mount Tsuesashi, one of Japan's 200 famous mountains, with spring anemones and summer daylilies; both trails are closed after 2022 heavy rain.

sights.name: Tōkeien Office
sights.description: Office space with dedicated Wi-Fi on the second floor of village-designated Tōkeien, open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.

sights.name: Hozaka Mountain (Hozaka Trailhead)
sights.description: A 438 m beginner mountain in Sekikawa with one of Iwafune District's three first-order triangulation points and clear-day views to Sado.

sights.name: Furusato Sekikawa Gozen (Local Set Meal)
sights.name_ja: ふるさと関川 御膳
sights.description: Local Sekikawa set meals are served twice a year at Meiji-era Tokeien, overlooking the garden, by advance reservation.

sights.name: Tate-eboshi (Oishi Trailhead)
sights.description: A 680 m beginner mountain in Sekikawa, said to be where Oishi women danced for rain, with views of the Iide range.

sights.name: Sekikawa History and Road Museum
sights.name_ja: せきかわ歴史とみちの館
sights.description: A museum in Sekikawa Village exhibiting village history, the old Yonezawa Kaido, and local nature, where armor can be tried on for free.

sights.name: Arakawa River
sights.description: The Arakawa River ranked first in national Class-A river water-quality inspections (2004–2006, 2008) and is a Niigata famous water.

stays.name: Kome to Shukyo to Robata no Yado Takahashi-ya Kanzan-so
stays.name_en: Kome to Shukyo to Robata no Yado Takahashi-ya Kanzan-so
stays.name_ja: 米と酒興と炉端の宿 高橋屋観山荘
stays.description: Inn in Sekikawa, Niigata.

stays.name: Hikari Usagi no Yado Arakawa-so
stays.name_ja: 光兎の宿 あらかわ荘
stays.description: Inn at Tanoshimubishokuto Onsen in Takase, Sekikawa.

stays.name: Takase Onsen Hana Michiru Yado New Manriki
stays.name_en: Takase Onsen Hana Michiru Yado New Manriki
stays.name_ja: 高瀬温泉 花みちる宿 ニュー萬力
stays.description: Inn at Takase Onsen in Yuzawa, Sekikawa with pet-friendly rooms.

stays.name: Nukumori Inn Ebisuya Ryokan
stays.name_ja: 鯉が見られる天然温泉 ぬくもりの宿 ゑびすや旅館
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Mirarerutennen Onsen in Yuzawa, Sekikawa.

stays.name: Chotto Ii Yado Takahashi-ya Kanzan-so
stays.name_ja: ちょっといい宿 高橋屋観山荘
stays.description: Inn in Sekikawa, Niigata.

stays.name: Unmo Onsen Takadai no Yado Hisashi-so
stays.name_en: Unmo Onsen Takadai no Yado Hisashi-so
stays.name_ja: 雲母温泉 高台の宿 寿荘
stays.description: Inn at Unmo Onsen in Uenoseki, Sekikawa.

stays.name: Takanosu Onsen Takanosukan
stays.name_ja: 美食と自家源泉を愉しむ静寂の宿 秘湯・鷹ノ巣温泉 鷹の巣館
stays.description: Inn at Takanosu Onsen in Yuzawa, Sekikawa.

stays.name: Shiki no Sato Yoshihisa-ya
stays.name_ja: 四季の郷 喜久屋
stays.description: Inn in Yuzawa, Sekikawa with free-flowing hot spring baths and open-air baths.

day_to_day.name: Advan Farm Shibata (Strawberry Picking)
day_to_day.name_ja: アドバンファームしばた
day_to_day.description: Tourist farm near Tsukioka Onsen offering strawberry picking in elevated greenhouses, with pay-by-weight or 30-minute all-you-can-eat options.

day_to_day.name: Kurashima Apple Orchard
day_to_day.name_ja: 倉島農園
day_to_day.description: An apple orchard popular with families, where visitors can spend time amid the sweet scent of apples; mid-October is recommended.

day_to_day.name: Wakuwaku Farm Shibata Store
day_to_day.name_ja: わくわくファーム 新発田店
day_to_day.description: Produce shop in Shibata selling locally grown vegetables, fruit, rice, flowers, and regional foods such as Shibata fu and Koshihikari.

activities.name: Tsukioka Onsen
activities.name_ja: 月岡温泉
activities.description: Sulfur hot-spring town in Shibata, opened in 1915, with emerald-green water, foot baths, and shops for local sake and sweets.

activities.name: Tsukioka Onsen Direct Bus
activities.name_ja: 月岡温泉直行バス
activities.description: Direct bus from JR Niigata Station and JR Shibata Station to Tsukioka Onsen for visitors arriving by train.

activities.name: Ayame no Yu (Shibata Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 新発田温泉「あやめの湯」
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring on a hill in Shibata, where the main bath overlooks the Ninoji mountain range and uses undiluted, unheated source water.

activities.name: Hyakka no Sato (Shiroyama Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 百花の里「城山温泉」
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring overlooking Shiroyama, site of a Sengoku battle between Shibata Shigeie and Uesugi Kagekatsu, with open-air baths and a sauna.

activities.name: Kikusui Sake Culture Institute
activities.name_ja: 菊水酒造（株）
activities.description: Open to the public, this Shibata institute shows a small traditional brewery and part of 30,000 sake-related cultural materials.

activities.name: Kenryu Gorge Campground
activities.name_ja: 剣龍峡キャンプ場
activities.description: Campsite in Kenryu Gorge at the north end of Gozu Prefectural Natural Park, among rocky streams, cedars and broadleaf trees at 630 m.

activities.name: Shinsoyu Onsen Shiun-no-Sato
activities.name_ja: 深層湯温泉「紫雲の郷」
activities.description: Day-use hot spring in Shiunji Memorial Park, Shibata, with a custom outdoor bath carved from a huge stone.

activities.name: Omon Sake Brewery / Gokaibishi Experience Resort
activities.name_en: Omon Sake Brewery / Gokaibishi Experience Resort
activities.name_ja: 王紋酒造（株）
activities.description: This 1790s sake brewery produces Omon and wine-like Karen, and its 2022 resort offers tastings and projection mapping.

activities.name: Niigata Prefectural Shiunji Memorial Park Auto Campground
activities.name_en: Niigata Prefectural Shiunji Memorial Park Auto Campground
activities.name_ja: 新潟県立紫雲寺記念公園オートキャンプ場
activities.description: Auto campground inside Niigata Prefectural Shiunji Memorial Park beside Fujitsuka Beach, with powered sites, flush toilets, and a sanitary building.

activities.name: Nioji Shrine Campground
activities.name_ja: 二王子神社キャンプ場
activities.description: A campground on the grounds of Nioji Shrine, a nationally registered tangible cultural property, and the trailhead for Mount Nioji.

activities.name: Kingyo Daiwa Clay Bell Painting Experience
activities.name_en: Kingyo Daiwa Clay Bell Painting Experience
activities.name_ja: 金魚台輪土鈴絵付け体験
activities.description: Paint a one-of-a-kind Kingyo Daiwa clay bell, a traditional Shibata folk-toy charm, at Yasubei Chaya in front of Shibata Castle from April to November.

activities.name: Beginner SUP Experience (60 Minutes)
activities.name_ja: のんびり気ままに水上散歩！初心者歓迎のSUP体験60分
activities.description: A 60-minute beginner SUP session on the sea at Fujitsuka Beach, taught by a water-rescue qualified instructor, with one Cafe Paradiso drink for Asoview bookings.

sights.name: Bijin no Izumi Public Bath
sights.description: Day-trip public bath in central Tsukioka Onsen offering emerald-green sulfur water said to leave the skin moist.

sights.name: Shibata Castle and Shibata Castle Ruins Park
sights.name_en: Shibata Castle and Shibata Castle Ruins Park
sights.name_ja: 新発田城・新発田城址公園
sights.description: Shibata Castle retains its original main gate and corner turret as Important Cultural Properties, plus a restored three-story turret chosen among Japan’s 100 Famous Castles.

sights.name: Higashi-Akatani Continuous Tunnel Sheds
sights.description: A former Akatani copper-mine freight railway in Shibata, now a road of continuous concrete tunnel sheds on Prefectural Route 335, closed from about December to early spring.

sights.name: Shimizuen Garden
sights.description: Daimyo-style stroll garden in Shibata, said to date from the Kanbun era, with three tea rooms and a former rice storehouse showing domain materials.

sights.name: Fujitsukahama Beach
sights.description: A shallow white-sand swimming beach lined with pines in Shiunji Memorial Park, Shibata, where visitors swim and play beach sports in summer.

sights.name: Niigata Jizake Premium Sake Kura
sights.name_ja: 新潟地酒 premium SAKE 蔵
sights.description: A specialty standing bar for tasting local sake, with three cups for 500 yen, irori seating, and snacks you can eat while walking.

sights.name: Sugaya Fudoson
sights.description: Fudo temple known as one of Japan's three Fudo sites, said to answer prayers for family safety and eye ailments.

sights.name: Tsukioka Carillon Park
sights.description: A 12.4-hectare recreation park a 10-minute walk from Tsukioka Onsen, with a carillon tower, gardens, and a day-trip hot spring.

sights.name: Ichijima Residence
sights.description: Early Meiji mansion of the Ichijima family, landowners since the early Edo period, with a pond strolling garden and warped-glass windows.

sights.name: Suwa Shrine
sights.description: Shibata’s guardian shrine, whose New Year visit draws about 30,000 people seeking blessings for health, study, matchmaking, and safe birth.

sights.name: Ijimino Park
sights.description: A Shibata park whose iris garden holds 300 varieties and 600,000 plants, with a fishing pond, trails, camping, and sports grounds.

sights.name: Tsukiakari no Niwa (Moonlight Garden)
sights.description: A garden at Tsukioka Onsen lined with 50 colorful lanterns, with a waterside area where lights reflect on the water.

sights.name: Fukiya Koji Memorial Museum
sights.description: Museum in Shibata on lyrical painter Koji Fukiya, his Taisho Romantic works, and the lyrics of the song Bride Doll.

sights.name: Otomo Inari Inner Sanctuary
sights.description: This historic Inari shrine enshrines a divided spirit of Kyoto's Fushimi Inari and was founded in the Kamakura period as the guardian deity of Otomo Tosenji Temple.

sights.name: Ichishima Residence Hina Doll Special Exhibition
sights.name_en: Ichishima Residence Hina Doll Special Exhibition
sights.name_ja: 市島邸 ひな人形特別展示
sights.description: Displays hina dolls from the Edo and Meiji periods that have been passed down in the Ichishima family.

sights.name: Biidoro Handmade Glass Workshop
sights.name_ja: 手造りガラス工房びいどろ
sights.description: Handmade glass workshop in Tsukioka selling tableware, miniatures, and accessories, with experiences in blowing, bead-making, grinding, and painting.

sights.name: Ashigaru Nagaya (Foot-Soldier Row Houses)
sights.description: Late-Edo Shibata Domain foot-soldier row house: eight simple wooden thatched units where lower-ranking samurai lived, surviving from the domain period.

sights.name: Sword Tradition Hall and Akitsugu Amata Memorial Hall
sights.name_en: Sword Tradition Hall and Akitsugu Amata Memorial Hall
sights.name_ja: 刀剣伝承館・天田昭次記念館
sights.description: An exhibition hall in a Japanese garden at Tsukioka Carillon Park displays swords by Living National Treasure Akitsugu Amata and the Amata family.

sights.name: Takidani Forest Park
sights.description: Forest park in southern Shibata beside the Kajikawa River, with tent sites, cottages, fishing and stream play about one hour from Niigata.

sights.name: Niigata Prefectural Shiunji Memorial Park
sights.description: Prefectural health park in Shibata with a beach, birdwatching, hot-spring baths, and 140,000 tulips in spring.

sights.name: Susanoo Shrine
sights.description: An unusual shrine honoring Susanoo and Kushinadahime in separate halls, with two torii, known locally as Tenno Shrine and hosting the Tenno Festival on July 4–5.

sights.name: Arakawa Kenryukyo Gorge and Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 荒川剣龍峡・荒川剣龍峡登山口
sights.description: A sandstone gorge in Gozu Prefectural Natural Park, with rounded rocks, a clear stream, and a two-hour hike to 634 m.

sights.name: Omineyama Tochidaira Cherry Forest
sights.name_ja: 大峰山 橡平サクラ樹林
sights.description: Cherry forest on Mount Omine in Shibata, a national natural monument since 1934, with about 1,000 trees of over 40 varieties.

sights.name: Kajikawa Flood Control Memorial Park and Embankment Cherry Blossoms
sights.name_en: Kajikawa Flood Control Memorial Park and Embankment Cherry Blossoms
sights.name_ja: 加治川治水記念公園・加治川堤の桜
sights.description: About 2,000 cherry trees line the Kajikawa embankment at this flood-control memorial park, forming a blossom tunnel in full bloom.

sights.name: Shibata Echigo-hime Strawberry Sweets Tour
sights.name_ja: しばたの越後姫 いちご一会めぐり
sights.description: Stamp-rally event in Shibata offering sweets made with local Echigo-hime strawberries; collecting seals from different shops enters a prize draw.

sights.name: Teramachi Tamari Rest Stop
sights.description: A tourist rest stop in Shibata where visitors can chat with locals, see Shibata children's daiwa displays, and buy sweets, tea, and local produce.

sights.name: Tohoku Folk Crafts Museum
sights.description: Museum in Shibata displaying over 10,000 antiques and folk implements from the Hidano family, wealthy farmers and sake brewers, including tansu, Six Ancient Kilns pottery, and hina decorations.

sights.name: Omineyama Cherry Blossom Park
sights.description: Near a national natural-monument cherry grove on Mount Omine, this 5.2-hectare park has about 300 trees of 109 varieties, paths, and signs for year-round viewing.

sights.name: Bronze Statue of Horibe Yasubei Taketsune
sights.name_en: Bronze Statue of Horibe Yasubei Taketsune
sights.description: Bronze statue of Horibe Yasubei, one of the 47 Ako ronin from Shibata, stands before Shibata Castle's main gate facing Edo.

sights.name: Niigata Jimono Premium Selection Uma
sights.name_ja: 新潟地物 premium SELECTION 旨
sights.description: A Shibata souvenir shop of Niigata umami foods, with original dried fish, seafood, miso, dashi and pickles, plus free hot rice for tastings.

sights.name: Gensen no Mori (Hot Spring Grove)
sights.description: At the birthplace of Tsukioka Onsen, you can use a hand bath, pour water on a statue and drink a rare sulfur spring.

sights.name: Former Prefectural Governor's Residence Memorial Hall
sights.name_en: Former Prefectural Governor's Residence Memorial Hall
sights.description: Memorial hall in Shibata of a prefectural governor's residence built in 1909, relocated and restored, showing the official and private quarters plus governors' memorabilia; reservation required.

sights.name: Uchinokura Dam Lake
sights.description: Hollow-gravity concrete dam lake with views of Mount Ninoji, a lakeside park noted for autumn leaves, and fishing for crucian carp, yamame and char.

sights.name: Ijimino Tea House
sights.description: A sukiya-style tea house and villa of the Shibata domain, restored to its 1814 appearance with structural reinforcement.

sights.name: Mt. Hiruba (Hiruba Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 蒜場山・蒜場山登山口
sights.description: A 1,363 m advanced hike in Shibata, with summit views of the Iide range and, on clear days, Mts. Chokai, Gassan and Bandai and the Asahi range.

sights.name: Nakamine Golf Club
sights.description: An 18-hole golf course on flat terrain with water hazards and white-sand bunkers, covering 134 hectares.

sights.name: Ichishima Residence
sights.description: Early-Meiji mansion of the Ichishima family, landowners since the early Edo period, with a large pond stroll garden and distorted-glass windows.

sights.name: Noblewood Golf Club
sights.name_ja: ノーブルウッドゴルフクラブ
sights.description: An 18-hole, par-72 golf course of 7,087 yards with a practice range, opened in 2002 on 102 hectares.

sights.name: Daitenjo Park
sights.description: Park in Shibata with a nearby firefly biotope, where many fireflies can be seen in early summer.

sights.name: Kajikawa Flood-Control Dam
sights.description: Dam-lake park where Kitamata Peak of the Iide range is visible, with a waterfall stream, campsite, and barbecue area; peak season is mid-October to early November.

sights.name: Mt. Omine (Terasawa Forest Road Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 大峰山・寺沢林道登山口
sights.description: Beginner trail up 399 m Mt. Omine in Shibata, through the nationally designated Tochidaira cherry woods of more than 40 varieties.

sights.name: Mount Yakimine (Takidani Trailhead)
sights.description: A 1,086 m mountain in Shibata whose summit looks out over the Iide range and Uchinokura Lake, about three hours from the Takidani trailhead.

sights.name: 404 Not Found
sights.description: No details are available for this listing.

sights.name: Kingyo Daiwa (Goldfish Lantern Float)
sights.description: A miniature of Shibata's summer-festival goldfish floats: a small pull-cart with a goldfish lantern, once lit with candles and pulled by children at dusk near Obon.

sights.name: Gokaji Kagura
sights.description: Traditional sacred dance in Shibata, said to have begun from Nagano Matsumoto Kagura to banish demons and entertain farmers after Shiunji Lagoon was reclaimed.

sights.name: Forest Country Club
sights.name_ja: フォレストカントリー倶楽部
sights.description: A 36-hole, par-144 golf course on gentle wooded hills about 20 km east of Niigata City, covering 165 hectares.

sights.name: Rengyo Kaido (Forsythia Road)
sights.description: A forsythia-lined road in Shibata’s Shiunji district, where more than 30,000 yellow shrubs bloom from late March to late April, often beside cherry trees.

sights.name: Tagai (Firefly Viewing)
sights.description: Genji fireflies can be seen from mid-June to mid-July near Ninoji Shrine and Imose Falls in Tagai, Shibata, where a firefly event is held in late June.

sights.name: Echigo-hime Strawberries (Shibata)
sights.name_ja: 越後姫（いちご）〔新発田市〕
sights.description: Echigo-hime strawberries from Shibata's Shiunji district are known for their color, luster, aroma, and sweetness.

sights.name: Mt. Ninoji Tagai Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 二王子岳・田貝登山口
sights.description: Tagai trailhead for 1,420 m Mt. Ninoji in Shibata; the summit hike takes about four hours, with views of the Iide range, Echigo Plain and Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Five-Senses Handmade Omusubi and Taste Class at KIKUSUI Kura Garden
sights.name_en: Five-Senses Handmade Omusubi and Taste Class at KIKUSUI Kura Garden
sights.name_ja: 五感で学ぶ 手作り“おむすび”と味覚体験授業
sights.description: A taste workshop at KIKUSUI Kura Garden where guests learn the five basic tastes, compare new and old rice, and make an original omusubi.

sights.name: Mount Manaitagura (Manaitagura Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 俎倉山・俎倉山登山口
sights.description: An 856 m mountain in Shibata with summit views of Mount Hiruba, Mount Yakimine, old-growth cedar forest, and the Kajikawa flood-control dam.

sights.name: Shiun Golf Club
sights.description: A 125-hectare golf club with a British-style Kajikawa Course and a strategic American-style Iide Course, divided by red pine forest.

sights.name: Ninox Snow Park
sights.name_ja: ニノックススノーパーク
sights.description: Ski area on Mount Ninoji in Shibata with two courses, a kids park, and night skiing on Fridays and Saturdays.

sights.name: Chotoku-ji Temple
sights.description: Family temple of the Nakayama house, birth home of Ako ronin Horibe Yasubei, with a pine he is said to have planted and a hall of the forty-seven retainers.

sights.name: Parent-Child Ski Camp 2024 at Ninox Snow Park
sights.name_en: Parent-Child Ski Camp 2024 at Ninox Snow Park
sights.description: Beginner ski camp for one elementary-school child and one guardian at Ninox Snow Park, with lunch and separate morning then joint afternoon lessons.

sights.name: Junior Ski Class 2024 at Ninox Snow Park
sights.name_en: Junior Ski Class 2024 at Ninox Snow Park
sights.description: Sunday 90-minute ski lessons at Ninox Snow Park for Niigata City elementary students, with rental discounts and free lift rides during the course.

sights.name: 2024 Team Kaetsu Ski Lesson Tour at Ninox (Day Trip)
sights.name_en: 2024 Team Kaetsu Ski Lesson Tour at Ninox (Day Trip)
sights.name_ja: 第2回 2024スキーツアーレッスン付きチーム下越 in ニノックス(日帰り)
sights.description: A day-trip parent-and-child ski lesson at Ninox in Shibata, with lessons, lift tickets, and lunch for one elementary student and one guardian.

sights.name: Senior Ski Camp 2024 at Ninox Snow Park
sights.name_en: Senior Ski Camp 2024 at Ninox Snow Park
sights.name_ja: シニアスキーキャンプ2024
sights.description: Three-session ski lesson camp at Ninox Snow Park for people aged 55 and over, with beginners welcome.

sights.name: First 2024 Team Kaetsu Ski Tour with Lessons at Ninox (Day Trip)
sights.name_en: First 2024 Team Kaetsu Ski Tour with Lessons at Ninox (Day Trip)
sights.name_ja: 第1回 2024スキーツアーレッスン付きチーム下越 in ニノックス(日帰り)
sights.description: Day-trip ski tour with lessons, lifts, and lunch for one elementary student and one guardian; beginners welcome.

sights.name: Guided Journey through Shibata
sights.name_ja: 観光ガイドと巡る 新発田の旅
sights.description: Guides present the charms of castle-town Shibata with a spirit of hospitality and arrange local sightseeing.

sights.name: Gardens in Fall Colors: Elegant Niigata Day Trip
sights.name_en: Gardens in Fall Colors: Elegant Niigata Day Trip
sights.name_ja: 紅葉の庭園×日本文化“雅な新潟”満喫日帰り旅Gardens in Fall Colors – Japanese Culture”Exquisite Niigata” Grand Tour
sights.description: A one-day bus tour of wealthy farmers’ and merchants’ residences and gardens, with mochi-pounding, shinobue flute, and tea experiences.

stays.name_en: Shiratori no Yado Kappo Ryokan Masugataso

stays.description: Lodging in Tsukioka Onsen, Shibata, with guest rooms and a public bath from its own hot spring source.

stays.name_ja: 月岡温泉 ホテルひさご荘
stays.description: Hotel in Tsukioka Onsen, Shibata, with an open-air sulfur hot-spring bath.

stays.name_ja: ハミングの宿－華灯－
stays.description: Lodging in Tsukioka Onsen, Shibata, with a 12.5-tatami Japanese-style room for a sofa bed.

stays.name_ja: 月岡温泉 湯あそび宿 曙

stays.name_ja: 月岡温泉 湯宿あかまつ
stays.description: Hot spring inn in Tsukioka, Shibata, with a Japanese-Western room, two beds, and an eight-tatami room.

day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「たがみ」
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Tagami offering seasonal vegetables, fruit, and local-ingredient meals, selected as a priority roadside station.

activities.name: Yudakami Onsen
activities.name_ja: 湯田上温泉
activities.description: Quiet countryside hot-spring area in Tagami with a drinkable sodium-chloride spring, seasonal local cuisine, and a nearby garden of about 30,000 hydrangeas.

activities.name: Gomado Yuttarikan (Day-Use Hot Spring)
activities.name_ja: 日帰り温泉 ごまどう湯っ多里館
activities.description: Day-use hot spring in Yudakami Onsen with large, open-air, and medicinal baths on a hill with good views; one daily ticket allows unlimited entry.

activities.name: Bamboo Shoot Festival
activities.name_ja: たけのこまつり
activities.description: Festival in Tagami selling morning-dug bamboo shoots and offering digging sessions and bamboo-shoot rice.

activities.name: Tagami General Park YOU Yu Land Campground
activities.description: Campground in Tagami, Niigata.

activities.name: 47th Mount Gomado Yudagami Onsen Hydrangea Festival
activities.name_en: 47th Mount Gomado Yudagami Onsen Hydrangea Festival
activities.name_ja: 第47回護摩堂山湯田上温泉あじさいまつり
activities.description: Early-summer hydrangea festival at the summit of Mount Gomado in Tagami, reached by a roughly 40-minute hike with views across the Echigo Plain.

activities.name: Shigeno Tansu Shop (Factory Tour and Craft Experience)
activities.name_en: Shigeno Tansu Shop (Factory Tour and Craft Experience)
activities.name_ja: 茂野タンス店 工場見学・小物づくり体験
activities.description: In Tagami, visitors try traditional Kamo paulownia-chest techniques used to make durable kiri tansu.

activities.name: 15th Yudakami Onsen Hot Spring Festival
activities.name_ja: 第15回 湯田上温泉 温泉まつり
activities.description: The 15th Yudakami Onsen festival offers morning yoga, zazen, tea gatherings, mountain hikes, and town walks, praying for visitors' health.

activities.name: Yudakami Onsen Sweets Project
activities.name_ja: 湯田上温泉SWEETSプロジェクト
activities.description: Seasonal sweets project at Yudakami Onsen inns in Tagami, where original desserts use local produce such as peaches and Le Lectier pears.

activities.name: Zazen Experience for Spiritual Healing
activities.name_ja: 心の癒し座禅体験
activities.description: A one-hour zazen program for spiritual healing at Tōryū-ji, a Sōtō Zen temple beside Yudakami Onsen in Tagami.

sights.name: Tagami Bamboo Boo 2026
sights.description: Bamboo-light art event in Tagami Town's bamboo groves, with viewing areas, a cafe, workshops, and a light parade on 10 September 2026.

sights.name: Chinjuso Villa
sights.description: Detached residence of Tagami’s wealthy Tamaki family, built from 1914 over three and a half years with fine timber and temple-style architecture, plus a dry landscape garden.

sights.name: Mount Gomado (Gomado Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 護摩堂山・護摩堂山登山口
sights.description: A beginner-level 274 m mountain where about 30,000 hydrangeas bloom; the summit is about 45 minutes up a gentle path.

sights.name: Gomadoyama Hydrangea Garden
sights.description: Hydrangea garden at the summit of 274-meter Mount Gomado in Tagami, where about 30,000 plants bloom from mid-June to early July.

sights.name: Tagami General Park YOU Yu Land
sights.description: Park in Tagami, Niigata.

sights.name: Tsunagigaya of Ryogenji Temple
sights.description: A kaya tree said to be over 700 years old, linked to a legend of Shinran, whose leaves reverse front and back each year.

sights.name: Tsubakijuso Lunch (Echigo Wealthy Farmer's Residence)
sights.name_ja: 越後豪農の館 椿寿荘ランチ
sights.description: Lunch at Tsubakijuso in Tagami, a nail-free temple-style villa of Yoshino cedar and Aizu cypress beside a dry landscape garden.

sights.name: Bamboo Shoot Full-Course Meal
sights.description: Yudakami Onsen inn chefs in Tagami serve a full course of fresh local bamboo shoots, including simmered, fried, and sashimi dishes.

sights.name: Gomado Castle Ruins
sights.description: Castle ruins where the main bailey, storehouse residence, archery ground, and dry moats remain clearly shaped, with hydrangeas from mid-June to mid-July.

sights.name: Ume Processed Products (Pickled Plums, Plum Wine and Ume Daifuku)
sights.name_en: Ume Processed Products (Pickled Plums, Plum Wine and Ume Daifuku)
sights.name_ja: 梅加工品・梅干し・梅酒・梅大福
sights.description: Tagami ranks second in Niigata for ume output; locals process Koshi no Ume into pickled plums, plum wine, and ume daifuku.

stays.name_ja: ホテル小柳
stays.description: Hotel at Yudaue Onsen in Tagamiotsu, Tagami with open-air baths and scenic views.

stays.name: Echigo Inn Wakatake
stays.name_ja: 越後乃お宿 わか竹
stays.description: Inn at Yudaue Onsen in Tagamiotsu, Tagami.

stays.name_ja: 湯田上温泉 なつかしの宿 末廣館
stays.description: Inn at Yudaue Onsen in Tagamiotsu, Tagami with open-air baths.

stays.name: Yudagami Onsen Ryokan Hatsune
stays.name_ja: 和食とイタリアンの融合が楽しめる料理宿 湯田上温泉 旅館初音
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Yudaue Onsen in Tagamihinoe, Tagami with breakfast available.

day_to_day.name: Kangas Blueberry Farm (Blueberry Picking)
day_to_day.name_ja: カンガス ブルーベリーファーム ブルーベリー狩り
day_to_day.description: A pesticide-free tourist farm in Tainai with about 5,500 blueberry bushes of 24 varieties, where visitors can pick and eat the fruit.

activities.name: Shio no Yu Hot Spring
activities.name_ja: 塩の湯温泉
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring in Tainai serving sodium-chloride salt water from about 1,800 meters underground without added water, heating, or chlorine.

activities.name: Tainai City Free Campground Natsui Riverside Park
activities.name_en: Tainai City Free Campground Natsui Riverside Park
activities.name_ja: 胎内市無料キャンプ場 夏井河川公園
activities.description: A waterside park on the Tainai River floodplain with a lawn and space to pitch tents and tarps.

activities.name: Shintarugabashi Onsen (Kurhaus Tainai)
activities.name_ja: 新樽ケ橋温泉「クアハウスたいない」
activities.description: Day-trip hot spring beside a roadside station in Tainai, with eight baths, a 25-metre pool, a 30-metre waterslide, and a training room.

activities.name: Tainai Claystone Doctor's House and Pottery Experience Hall
activities.name_en: Tainai Claystone Doctor's House and Pottery Experience Hall
activities.name_ja: 胎内クレーストーン博士の館・胎内陶芸体験館
activities.description: A museum of minerals collected in Tainai, Japan, and mines worldwide, with pottery and stonework experiences.

activities.name: Tainai City Hina Doll Festival
activities.name_ja: 胎内市のひなまつり
activities.description: Hina doll festival in Tainai displaying dolls donated by residents at Nakajo Grand Hotel and Royal Tainai Park Hotel.

activities.name: Kurokawa Nensui Festival
activities.name_ja: 黒川燃水祭
activities.description: An annual festival in Kurokawa, based on a Nihon Shoki account, in which petroleum is skimmed with a plant and offered to Omi Shrine in Shiga.

activities.name: Tainai City Campground Matsubara Stables
activities.name_ja: 胎内市キャンプ場 牧場の一角にある松原ステーブルス
activities.description: Campsite in Tainai where guests may camp, picnic, or walk as they like, with open fires and pets allowed.

activities.name: Tainai Resort
activities.name_ja: 胎内リゾート
activities.description: Resort in Tainai centered on the Western-style Royal Tainai Park Hotel, set among mountains vividly colored in autumn.

activities.name: Tainai City Free Campground Sekizawa Forest Park
activities.name_en: Tainai City Free Campground Sekizawa Forest Park
activities.name_ja: 胎内市無料キャンプ場 関沢森林公園
activities.description: Free campsite in Sekizawa Forest Park, Tainai, at the Kushigata Mountains trailhead, with a gazebo, tables, chairs, and toilets.

activities.name: Tainai Onsen
activities.name_ja: 胎内温泉
activities.description: Hot-spring area along the Tainai River where you can bathe in silky water with mountain views or use a pool and training facilities.

activities.name: Tainai Cherry Blossom Festival
activities.name_ja: たいない桜まつり
activities.description: Cherry-blossom festival in Tainai, begun in 2016, held on 12 April 2026 at B&G Sports Park with local food stalls and hands-on activities.

activities.name: Tainai City Campground Nagaike Relaxation Forest Park
activities.name_en: Tainai City Campground Nagaike Relaxation Forest Park
activities.name_ja: 胎内市キャンプ場 長池憩いの森公園
activities.description: Forest and flower-field zones around Nagaike pond, intended for learning, play and rest, and for selling seasonal flowers and local vegetables.

activities.name: Tainai Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 胎内スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort in Tainai City with 13 courses, seven lifts, night skiing, and a children's park viewed from the lodge.

activities.name: Tainai Insect House (Butterfly Feeding Experience)
activities.name_ja: 胎内昆虫の家 チョウのエサやり体験
activities.description: Visitors watch butterflies drink nectar up close and can see swallowtails lay eggs on mandarin trees in the garden.

activities.name: Momozakihama Cultural Repository
activities.name_ja: 桃崎浜文化収蔵庫
activities.description: Cultural repository in Momozakihama storing and displaying many ship votive plaques and models dedicated to Arakawa Shrine.

activities.name: Tarugabashi Amusement Park (Animal Encounter)
activities.name_ja: 樽ケ橋遊園 動物ふれあい体験
activities.description: An amusement park in Tainai with over 23 species and 100 animals, offering guinea pig and alpaca encounters on weekends and holidays.

activities.name: Satoyama Aerial Walk (Paragliding Experience)
activities.name_ja: ​里山を空中散歩！パラグライダー体験
activities.description: Instructors guide paragliding at Tainai Ski Resort, where you run down the slope and float about 5-20 meters.

activities.name: Tree Climbing Experience at Tarugabashi Amusement Park
activities.name_en: Tree Climbing Experience at Tarugabashi Amusement Park
activities.name_ja: 樽ケ橋遊園でツリーイング体験
activities.description: Outdoor activity in which visitors climb trees wearing ropes and harnesses that support the body.

activities.name: Snow Ride Park Popland (Tainai Ski Resort)
activities.name_en: Snow Ride Park Popland (Tainai Ski Resort)
activities.name_ja: Snow Ride Park ポプランド
activities.description: A snowmobile pulls a banana boat across the snow at Tainai Ski Resort, for riders aged three and up.

food.name: India Nepalese ISHA
food.name_ja: インド・ネパール料理 ISHA
food.description: Chinese or Asian restaurant in Tainai.

food.name: Nakajo Grand Hotel Restaurant Baron
food.name_ja: 中条グランドホテル レストラン バロン

food.name: Daito-en
food.description: Yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant in Tainai, Niigata.

food.name: Kokorozashi Matsu Shokudo
food.description: Jingisukan (lamb BBQ) restaurant in Tainai, Niigata.

food.name: Western Dining Bistro Base
food.name_ja: 洋食ダイニング ビストロベース

food.name: Niboshi Ramen Nibonyan
food.name_ja: 煮干しらーめん にぼにゃん

food.name: Seimenya Shokudo Tainai ten
food.name_ja: 製麺屋食堂 胎内店

food.name: Nihonkai Country Club Restaurant
food.name_ja: 日本海カントリークラブレストラン

food.name: Royal Tainai Park Hotel
food.name_ja: ロイヤル胎内パークホテル

food.name: Nouka Restaurant Hikari Shokudo
food.name_ja: 農家レストラン ひかり食堂

food.name: Umi Ten Sushi Makoto Chujo
food.name_ja: 海転すし誠 中条店

food.name: Otsu Manju
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Tainai, Niigata.

food.name: Bakery LORO
food.description: Sweets and bakery shop in Tainai.

sights.name: Tainai City Tulip Festival 2026
sights.name_ja: 胎内市チューリップフェステイバル2026
sights.description: Spring tulip festival in Tainai, with 900 varieties on two hectares beside a two-hectare rapeseed-flower maze.

sights.name: Tour de Tainai 2026
sights.description: A cycling event from sea to mountains in Tainai, including a special visit to Okutainai Dam, normally not open for tours.

sights.name: Oppo-ji Temple
sights.description: Shingon temple founded in 736 by imperial order of Emperor Shomu; its 1620 three-story pagoda is a National Important Cultural Property.

sights.name: Tarugabashi Amusement Park
sights.description: A small zoo and amusement park in Tainai where visitors can see and touch 23 kinds of animals, including alpacas, plus ride go-karts and a merry-go-round.

sights.name: Muramatsuhama Beach
sights.description: A sandy, shallow swimming beach in Tainai with free parking, toilets, showers and changing rooms, and wind turbines visible nearby.

sights.name: Tainai Boat Park
sights.description: Boat park in Tainai, temporarily closed as of 26 July 2026 after heavy rain damage.

sights.name: Tainai Fishing Park
sights.name_ja: 胎内フィッシングパーク
sights.description: A fishing park in Tainai with charcoal-grill service and free Saturday admission for visitors through junior high school.

sights.name: Nagaike Ikoi-no-Mori Park
sights.description: Park around Nagaike pond with forest and tulip and rapeseed fields, spring blossoms, early-summer lotus, and a camping kitchen.

sights.name: Okuyamano-sho History Plaza and History Museum
sights.name_en: Okuyamano-sho History Plaza and History Museum
sights.name_ja: 奥山荘歴史の広場・奥山荘歴史館
sights.description: Plaza and museum with the restored Egami residence and finds from ten national historic Okuyamano-sho sites, due to open 4 April 2026.

sights.name: Okutainai
sights.description: Mountain area in Tainai City where the road to Okutainai Hutte is closed following heavy-rain damage.

sights.name: Okutainai Dam Tour
sights.name_ja: 奥胎内ダム見学ツアー
sights.description: A seasonal tour of Okutainai Dam, including areas not normally open to the public, fresh-green scenery, and dam curry at Royal Tainai Park Hotel.

sights.name: Singleton Memorial Park
sights.name_ja: シンクルトン記念公園
sights.description: Park in Tainai preserving an oil pot and shaft well said to have supplied Emperor Tenji in 668, named for British doctor Singleton.

sights.name: Tainai Highland Beer Garden
sights.description: Tainai local-beer brewery, begun in former Kurokawa Village, that ended production at the end of June 2025; stock still sold.

sights.name: Echigo Tainai Kannon Statue
sights.description: A 7.3-metre bronze Kannon statue at Tarugabashi in Tainai, built in 1970 for 1967 Uetsu flood victims and called Wave-Riding Kannon.

sights.name: Tainai City Illumination
sights.name_ja: 胎内市イルミネーション
sights.description: Summer illuminations light the Tarugabashi Tourism Exchange Center and its lawn plaza in Tainai.

sights.name: Oideyo! Honmachi Marche
sights.name_ja: おいでよ！本町マルシェ～中学生が本町通り商店街の活性化に挑戦！～
sights.description: A market in Honmachi, Tainai, bringing together shopping-street and city shops for food, goods, workshops, games, and city-introduction booths.

sights.name: Okuyamano-sho Castle Sites and Egami Residence Ruins
sights.name_en: Okuyamano-sho Castle Sites and Egami Residence Ruins
sights.name_ja: 奥山荘城館遺跡・江上館跡
sights.description: Ruins said to be the Nakajo clan Egami residence in medieval Okuyamano-sho, explained with excavated artifacts and photos at the history museum.

sights.name: Tainai Flower Park
sights.description: Flower park in Tainai with giant petal-pattern and circular beds of about 80,000 flowers of some 50 kinds from spring to autumn, plus a rock garden.

sights.name: Kinoto Manju
sights.description: Sake-manju shop in Tainai founded in 1804 before Oppoji Temple, still handmade with homemade sweet bean paste.

sights.name: Kurokawa Oil Park (Kurokawa no Kusozu)
sights.name_ja: 黒川石油公園（黒川のくそうず）
sights.description: Historic crude-oil seep site in Kurokawa with pit remains, an 1873 well, and Singleton Memorial Hall; a prefectural natural monument.

sights.name: Hamanasu Hill (Observation Deck)
sights.description: Observation deck on the Japan Sea Sunset Line, known for sunsets, with views of rugosa roses, Sado, Awashima, and wind turbines.

sights.name: Matsuo Basho Haiku Monument
sights.description: Haiku monument at Oppo-ji in Tainai marking Matsuo Basho's 1 July 1689 visit, with a verse on northern mountain cherry blossoms.

sights.name: Honmachi Beer Garden 2026
sights.description: Beer garden event on Honmachi-dori in Tainai, turning the shopping street into a pedestrian zone for local food and drinks.

sights.name: Tainai City Art Museum
sights.description: Tainai City Art Museum displays local artworks from ancient to modern times, including excavated burial goods and nationally designated important cultural properties.

sights.name: Oku-Tainai Hut
sights.description: A mountain hut in Oku-Tainai, closed this season after a suspected bear-related fatality, with the access road shut by heavy-rain collapse.

sights.name: Kushigata Mountain Range Opening Traverse 2026
sights.name_ja: KUSHIGATA2026-櫛形山脈山開き縦走登山-
sights.description: Guided mountain-opening traverse of the Kushigata range in Tainai, about seven hours, with pork soup for the first 200 after descent.

sights.name: Tainai Insect House
sights.description: Insect house in Tainai displaying about 10,000 specimens, where visitors can touch beetles and feed swallowtail butterflies in the butterfly garden.

sights.name: Tainai Insect House Insect Catching Champion Contest
sights.name_en: Tainai Insect House Insect Catching Champion Contest
sights.name_ja: 胎内昆虫の家「虫とりチャンピオン大会」
sights.description: Timed game at Tainai Insect House to collect as many insect types or groups as possible; the winning pair receives a prize.

sights.name: Shiratori (Signature Sweet)
sights.description: Shiratori, Baigetsudo’s confection in Tainai, wraps moist egg-yolk filling in melt-in-the-mouth foam snow and has been made for 80 years.

sights.name: Kushigata Mountain Range (Sekizawa Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 櫛形山脈・関沢登山口
sights.description: Sekizawa trailhead for the Kushigata range in Tainai, a beginner hike of about 75 minutes to the 568-meter summit through beech forest.

sights.name: Kotohira Shrine
sights.description: Branch of Sanuki’s Kotohira Shrine at Muramatsu-hama, whose main hall was completed in 1835 after villagers repaid famine relief.

sights.name: Tainai Nature Astronomical Museum
sights.description: Nature and astronomy facility in Tainai with a 60-centimeter telescope for daytime solar viewing and nighttime stargazing, including a late-August star festival.

sights.name: Kumano Wakamiya Shrine Sanctuary
sights.description: A wooden one-bay nagare-zukuri sanctuary of Kumano Wakamiya Shrine, moved to the present site in 1690, with Genroku-style painting and carving.

sights.name: Jimoto Mizubasho
sights.name_ja: 地本ミズバショウ（水芭蕉）
sights.description: Jimoto in Tainai City has about 20,000 Asian skunk cabbage plants, a prefectural natural monument since 1963, which bloom early from mid-March due to spring water.

sights.name: Taruga Bridge
sights.description: Scenic bridge area in Tainai with spring cherry blossoms and autumn mountain foliage, near a family amusement park and a local history museum.

sights.name: Hangaku Firefly Village
sights.description: A firefly spot in Tainai with 30 weeping cherry trees, about 5,000 hydrangeas along a 1 km road, and a Hangaku Gozen birth monument.

sights.name: Tanomogi-yama (Tainai Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 頼母木山・胎内登山口
sights.description: One of the Iide peaks, 1,730 m high, climbed by advanced hikers in about 5 hours 20 minutes, with a year-round emergency hut (capacity 40).

sights.name: Miyuki-an Soba Restaurant
sights.description: Soba restaurant in Tainai serving stone-milled local buckwheat noodles made with Tainai River spring water and mountain-foraged vegetables.

sights.name: Tainai Gorge
sights.description: A 20 km gorge on the Tainai River, which rises in the Iide range, with viewpoints along the river basin.

sights.name: Tainai Sanpachi Market
sights.description: Street market near Kumano Wakamiya Shrine in Tainai, held about 6:00–15:00 and said to date from the Genroku period (1688–1703).

sights.name: Akagawa Kasumitei Park
sights.description: A park in Tainai with walking courses along a wide riverbed, Tainai River sunset views, spring cherry blossoms, and autumn foliage.

sights.name: Jonoyama Kofun
sights.description: A fourth-century oval burial mound in Tainai, about 39 meters across and 5 meters high, where a boat-shaped coffin and grave goods were excavated.

sights.name: Mount Oishi (Tainai Trailhead)
sights.description: A 1,562 m advanced peak in the Iide range; its Tainai trail is closed from 1 June to 30 November 2026.

sights.name: Tainai-daira
sights.description: Green hillside in Tainai with walking paths, nature watching, and cedars planted by the Emperor and Empress in 1972.

sights.name: Kairi (Niigata and Shonai Food and Scenery Train)
sights.name_en: Kairi (Niigata and Shonai Food and Scenery Train)
sights.name_ja: 海里-新潟・庄内の食と景観を楽しむ列車
sights.description: A train themed on Niigata and Shonai food and Japan Sea views, serving meals in a dining car on packaged tours.

sights.name: Tainai City Industrial Culture Hall
sights.description: A multi-purpose hall in Tainai for concerts, film screenings, lectures and exhibitions, also used for local cultural activities.

sights.name: Model Japanese Ships and Ship Votive Tablets Dedicated to Arakawa Shrine
sights.name_en: Model Japanese Ships and Ship Votive Tablets Dedicated to Arakawa Shrine
sights.name_ja: 荒川神社奉納模型和船・船絵馬
sights.description: Two accurate Kitamaebune model ships and 86 ship votive tablets dedicated to Arakawa Shrine, a National Important Tangible Folk Cultural Property in Tainai.

sights.name: Monnai-dake (Tainai Trailhead)
sights.description: One of the Iide peaks, 1,887 m high, climbed by advanced hikers in about 7 hours 25 minutes, with Monnai Hut (capacity 50).

sights.name: Iide Mountains Tainai Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 飯豊連峰登山・胎内登山口
sights.description: Tainai trailhead for climbing the Iide Mountains; the Ashinomatsu ridge trail is closed from 1 June to 30 November 2026, and the road to Okutainai Hutte is blocked.

sights.name: Prespo Tainai (Tainai City General Gymnasium)
sights.name_ja: ぷれすぽ胎内（胎内市総合体育館）
sights.description: A gymnasium in Tainai for individual or group fitness, with volleyball, basketball, martial arts, and a training room with running and exercise machines.

sights.name: Okura Shrine
sights.description: A shrine in Tainai enshrining Emperor Jimmu, with its hall atop about 150 steps and a worship site facing Kashihara Jingu.

sights.name: Kotaka Shrine Precinct, Muramatsu Beach
sights.name_ja: 小鷹宮境内地 村松浜
sights.description: National historic site cited as a boundary of the Okuyama manor; a Yudono-san monument on a small hill is said to be that marker stone.

sights.name: Town Walk with Tainai City Volunteer Guides
sights.name_en: Town Walk with Tainai City Volunteer Guides
sights.name_ja: 街をめぐる（胎内市観光ボランティアガイド）
sights.description: Walk through former post town Nakajo, tracing its old character along nearby lanes, waterways, and historic buildings.

sights.name: Kushigata Mountain Range (Mount Kushigata)
sights.description: A 568 m beginner range with nature and historic sites; the traverse from Sekizawa trailhead to Shiratori Park takes about six hours.

sights.name: Kita Park
sights.description: A park in central Nakajo, Tainai, surrounded by trees, with playground equipment, a shelter, and toilets.

sights.name: Mount Tosaka (Haguro Trailhead)
sights.description: A 439 m beginner mountain at the north end of the Kushigata range, popular for historical hiking and seasonal panoramas, about two hours to the summit.

sights.name: Hakucho Park
sights.description: Hilltop park in Tainai with roller slides and other play equipment, 30 Somei-Yoshino cherry trees, azaleas, and an observation plaza.

sights.name: Torisaka Castle Ruins
sights.description: Castle ruins on the summit of 298-meter Shiratori Mountain in Tainai, once held by the Jo and Nakajo clans and now a hiking course.

sights.name: Tainai Wave Stone Cluster
sights.description: Folded chert and mudstone layers form wave-patterned rocks in Natsui, Tainai; one stone measures 8 m wide, 5 m high and 10 m deep.

sights.name: Tainai Gold Yakisoba 55% Noodle Increase Campaign
sights.name_en: Tainai Gold Yakisoba 55% Noodle Increase Campaign
sights.name_ja: 胎内ゴールドヤキソバ 55％麺増量キャンペーン
sights.description: Local Tainai yakisoba made with rice-flour noodles, with a limited campaign serving 55 percent more noodles through 31 August.

sights.name: Tainai Kogen Wine
sights.description: Wine from Tainai Kogen Winery, opened in 2007, using grapes grown on steep slopes of Mount Takatsubo overlooking the Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Chocolat Tainai (Rice-Flour Sweets)
sights.description: Rice-flour sweets developed by a pastry chef with 11 years of experience and made and sold at Royal Tainai Park Hotel.

sights.name: Tainai City General Ground
sights.name_ja: 胎内市総合グラウンド
sights.description: Class 3 certified athletics stadium with a 400-metre, eight-lane track, seating for 5,300, lighting, and about 150 spring cherry trees.

sights.name: Oppō-ji Three-storied Pagoda and Benten Hall
sights.name_en: Oppō-ji Three-storied Pagoda and Benten Hall
sights.name_ja: 乙宝寺三重塔・弁天堂
sights.description: A National Important Cultural Property three-storied pagoda at Oppō-ji, completed in 1620 in pure Japanese style, with an early Edo Benten Hall on a pond island.

sights.name: Starry Sky Yoga at Tainai City Nature Astronomical Museum
sights.name_en: Starry Sky Yoga at Tainai City Nature Astronomical Museum
sights.name_ja: 胎内市自然天文館 「星空のヨガ」
sights.description: Yoga under the stars at Tainai City Nature Astronomical Museum, with viewing of Jupiter, Saturn, nebulae and clusters through rooftop and 60cm telescopes, plus an optional photography class.

sights.name: Tainai City General Ground Athletics Stadium
sights.name_en: Tainai City General Ground Athletics Stadium
sights.name_ja: 胎内市総合グラウンド陸上競技場
sights.description: Athletics stadium at Tainai City’s multi-purpose general ground, which also has a gym, tennis courts, a pool, and spring cherry blossoms.

sights.name: Beginner Enjoy Plan (Rental Kart)
sights.name_ja: 初心者向けエンジョイプラン（手ぶらで体験可）
sights.description: Rental-kart session at Speed Park Niigata in Tainai; no permit is required, gear is free, and about 10 minutes covers 4–8 laps.

sights.name: Aizu Yaichi Poem Monument (Shuso Dojin)
sights.name_ja: 秋草道人（会津八一歌碑）
sights.description: A poem monument to Aizu Yaichi is in Taisoji Temple grounds in Tainai; he stayed in former Nakajo from 1945 to 1946 and left many works.

sights.name: Mount Torisaka
sights.description: A 438.8 m beginner-friendly mountain in Tainai, with summit views of the Kanbara Plain, Sado, Awashima, and the Iide range.

sights.name: Muramatsuhama Beach SUP
sights.description: Stand-up paddleboarding at Muramatsuhama Beach, with boards, paddles and life jackets provided, plus showers, toilets and limited sunset sessions.

sights.name: Photo Walk at Oppo-ji Temple
sights.name_ja: フォトウォークin乙宝寺
sights.description: A smartphone photo walk at Oppo-ji Temple, following LINE clues to find spots, take photos, and earn a perk.

sights.name: Shishinokura Forest Autumn Foliage Walking Tour
sights.name_en: Shishinokura Forest Autumn Foliage Walking Tour
sights.name_ja: 紅葉に染まる「ししのくら森」散策ツアー
sights.description: Walking tour of Shishinokura Forest in Tainai to see two giant beech trees with trunks about seven metres around.

sights.name: Tainai River Riverside Thousand Cherry Trees
sights.name_en: Tainai River Riverside Thousand Cherry Trees
sights.description: Somei-Yoshino cherry trees bloom on both banks of the Natsui riverbed in the upper Tainai River, sourced in the Iide range.

sights.name: Tainai Insect House
sights.description: Insect house in Tainai presenting worldwide specimens and ecology displays, where visitors can sometimes handle beetles and feed swallowtails in a butterfly garden.

sights.name: Autumn Temple Walk in Otsu
sights.name_ja: 乙 秋のお寺さんぽ
sights.description: A guided autumn walk at Oppoji Temple in Tainai, nearly 1,300 years old and home to a relic of the Buddha’s left eye.

sights.name: Kounosu Park
sights.description: Park in Tainai with a lawn and playground, two night-lit artificial-turf courts, parking for 15 cars, and autumn ginkgo trees.

sights.name: Tainai Rice-Flour Karinto Manju
sights.name_ja: 胎内米粉かりんとうまんじゅう
sights.description: A shop-only sweet of Tainai rice flour, with strained red-bean paste wrapped in a crisp crust.

sights.name: Kurokawa Local Culture Learning Hall (Powdered-Food Culture Experience Hall)
sights.name_en: Kurokawa Local Culture Learning Hall (Powdered-Food Culture Experience Hall)
sights.name_ja: 黒川郷土文化伝習館（黒川粉食文化体験館）
sights.description: Learning hall in Kurokawa, Tainai, scheduled to open on 1 April 2026, with local history exhibits and powdered-food, archery, and fire-making experiences.

sights.name: Tainai Kogen Wine and Shopping Street Pairing
sights.name_en: Tainai Kogen Wine and Shopping Street Pairing
sights.name_ja: 胎内高原ワイン×商店街ペアリング
sights.description: A gastronomy dining event pairing Tainai Kogen wine with ingredients from Honmachi-dori shopping street, held at Café Kyoten in Tainai.

sights.name: Oga Lotus (2,000-Year Lotus)
sights.description: Division of the Oga lotus, raised from a 2,000-year-old seed, blooms here each morning from July to August.

sights.name: B&G Marine Center Boathouse
sights.description: Boathouse in Tainai with yachts, canoes, cutters, and rowboats, plus a mini lodging facility and meeting room.

sights.name: Haguro Eleven-Faced Kannon Course
sights.name_ja: 羽黒十一面観音コース
sights.description: Guides lead a walk from Tainai City Hall to Haguro Eleven-Faced Kannon, with about 300 stone steps, sacred water, prayers, and lunch.

sights.name: Tainai River Dam
sights.description: A gravity concrete dam on the Tainai River, completed in 1977 for flood control, with a lakeside viewpoint and a day-hike trail in Bandai-Asahi National Park.

sights.name: Tainai Kogen Beer Brewery Tour
sights.name_ja: 胎内高原ビールを味わおう！ビール製造見学ツアー
sights.description: A guided brewery tour at Tainai Kogen Beer, made for over 25 years with methods learned from a German meister, includes one complimentary beer.

sights.name: Walking Meiji Niigata as Seen by Isabella Bird 2023
sights.name_en: Walking Meiji Niigata as Seen by Isabella Bird 2023
sights.name_ja: イザベラ・バードが見た 明治の新潟を歩く2023
sights.description: Walking tour from JR Nakajo Station of the old post town’s canals, storehouse lanes, Isabella Bird’s route and Dr. Palm sites, with a meal at Nantoya.

sights.name: Oppo-ji Temple
sights.description: Sacred temple visited by Basho, whose three-story pagoda is a national Important Cultural Property, with white lotus in the temple pond.

sights.name: Honcho Photo Walk
sights.name_ja: 小路を巡ろう！ホンチョウフォトウォーク
sights.description: A free smartphone photo walk of the alleys along Honcho-dori in Tainai, a former Edo-period post town.

sights.name: Oppō-ji Treasure Hall
sights.description: Historic treasure hall at Oppō-ji Temple in Tainai, housing hundreds of temple objects including an illustrated origin scroll and gilt-bronze ornaments.

sights.name: Shibahashi-an Aizu Yaichi Poem Monument
sights.name_ja: 柴橋庵 會津八一歌碑
sights.description: Poem monument at Shibahashi-an in Tainai, erected in 2014 with a verse from Aizu Yaichi's Yamabato poems mourning his adopted daughter.

sights.name: Speed Park Niigata Pro Plan (Faster Rental Karts)
sights.name_en: Speed Park Niigata Pro Plan (Faster Rental Karts)
sights.name_ja: より速いカートで経験者も満足！プロプラン（手ぶらで体験可）
sights.description: Faster expert rental karts at JAF-certified Speed Park Niigata, for riders who clear the Enjoy Plan time, with lap times shown during runs.

sights.name: Tainai City Smartphone Stamp Rally
sights.name_ja: 胎内市スマホDEスタンプラリー
sights.description: A stamp rally around tourist facilities and shops in Tainai City, joined by scanning on-site 2D codes with a smartphone and no app registration.

sights.name: Satoyama Cooking Class: Pick Mountain Vegetables and Make Soba (Ichibee Special)
sights.name_en: Satoyama Cooking Class: Pick Mountain Vegetables and Make Soba (Ichibee Special)
sights.name_ja: 里山お料理教室「山菜を採り、そばを打つ。」 そば処いちべえ特別企画
sights.description: In Sakai, Tainai, pick spring mountain vegetables, then make soba at Ichibee and take both home.

sights.name: Hassho Shrine Palace
sights.description: Shrine palace built in 1620 on a small hill south of the Dainichi Hall at Oppoji Temple in Tainai, said to date from 807.

sights.name: Idatenyama Ruins
sights.name_ja: 韋駄天山遺跡 （国指定史跡）
sights.description: A medieval hilltop cemetery in Tainai, a National Historic Site, where 1954 excavations uncovered many bone urns and stone pagodas.

sights.name: Makomo New Year Decoration Making
sights.name_ja: マコモの正月飾りづくり
sights.description: Hands-on workshop in Tainai making original New Year decorations from Tsuzumioka village makomo leaves, using local fruits and flowers.

sights.name: Play at Oppoji Temple
sights.description: Nature event at Oppoji Temple offering wood-chip making with a crusher, tree mazes, and other play-and-learn activities by local volunteers.

sights.name: School Trips to Tainai City
sights.name_ja: 胎内市への修学旅行等について
sights.description: Tainai City offers exhibition and cultural facilities suited to school trips, along with many experience programs.

sights.name: Great Snowfield Kanjiki Walk
sights.name_ja: 冬の里山をお散歩！大雪原かんじき雪中行軍
sights.description: A winter program walking Tainai's deep snowfields on kanjiki or snowshoes, with family snow play, meeting at Royal Tainai Park Hotel.

sights.name: Onagatani Satoyama Picnic
sights.description: A satoyama walk in Onagatani with rice-flour dorayaki making and a tea-whisking experience.

sights.name: Tainai Plateau Beer
sights.description: Craft beer from Tainai brewed by a German brewmaster; production ended in June 2025, with remaining stock still sold.

sights.name: Beam Rifle Challenge
sights.name_ja: ​あなたもスナイパー！？ ビームライフルに挑戦
sights.description: In Tainai, rent a rifle and aim at a 10-meter target in beam rifle, a modern sport in the National Sports Festival.

sights.name: History Tour (Tainai City Tourism Volunteer Guide)
sights.name_en: History Tour (Tainai City Tourism Volunteer Guide)
sights.name_ja: 歴史をめぐる（胎内市観光ボランティアガイド）
sights.description: Volunteer guides introduce legends of Oppo-ji, an ancient Echigo temple appearing in the Konjaku Monogatari and Oku no Hosomichi.

sights.name: Oppo-ji Temple and the Historic Oto Course
sights.name_en: Oppo-ji Temple and the Historic Oto Course
sights.name_ja: 北陸の名刹「乙宝寺」と歴史ある乙コース
sights.description: Stroll through Oto village, the guide’s hometown, encountering Oppo-ji history and the area’s own culture and customs.

sights.name: Torisaka Castle Ruins Observation Tower
sights.description: Observation tower on the summit of Mt. Shiratori, with views of the Kambara Plain, Sado, and Awashima.

sights.name: Speed Park Niigata
sights.description: A driving facility with a large kart course for racing karts, rental karts, motorcycles, and cars, with rentals and events.

sights.name: Tainai Ham
sights.description: Smoked ham made from salted, aged Niigata pork, slowly smoked with cherry wood using only natural seasonings.

sights.name: Satoyama Kaido Bicycle Rental
sights.name_ja: 田園風景を堪能！里山街道レンタサイクル
sights.description: Bicycle rental for riding through the quiet satoyama landscapes of mountainous Tainai.

stays.name: Chujo Grand Hotel
stays.name_ja: 中条グランドホテル
stays.description: Hotel in Higashimoto, Tainai with business travelers.

stays.name: Ryokan Moto Sakana-ya
stays.name_ja: 旅館元肴屋
stays.description: Ryokan inn in Hon, Tainai with breakfast available.

stays.name: Royal Tainai Park Hotel
stays.name_ja: ロイヤル胎内パークホテル
stays.description: Hotel in Tainai, Niigata.

day_to_day.name: Cross Ten Tokamachi Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「クロステン十日町」（国道117号）
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Tokamachi with a souvenir hall displaying 12,088 handmade hanging hina dolls recognized by Guinness World Records.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Segae no Sato Senda
day_to_day.name_en: Roadside Station Segae no Sato Senda
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「瀬替えの郷せんだ」（国道252号）
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Senda, Tokamachi, selling local vegetables and Senda-grown Uonuma Koshihikari, with a snow storage room visitable by advance arrangement.

day_to_day.name: Matsudai Furusato Kaikan Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「まつだいふるさと会館」（国道253号）
day_to_day.description: Roadside station beside Hokuhoku Line Matsudai Station, with a souvenir shop, restaurant, tourist information, and a FamilyMart.

activities.name: 78th Tokamachi Snow Festival
activities.name_ja: 第78回十日町雪まつり｜新潟・豪雪地で楽しむ冬の祭典
activities.description: A three-day winter festival in Tokamachi with citizen-made snow sculptures, snow activities, and warm local food.

activities.name: Matsunoyama Onsen
activities.name_ja: 日本三大薬湯・松之山温泉の観光ガイド│温泉街の歩き方
activities.description: Historic hot spring in snowy Tokamachi, traditionally listed with Arima and Kusatsu among Japan's three medicinal hot springs.

activities.name: Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale 2027
activities.name_ja: 大地の芸術祭 越後妻有アートトリエンナーレ 2027
activities.description: The Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale, held once every three years, takes place in 2027 and includes tours, food, and lodging.

activities.name: Matsudai Shibatoge Onsen Unkai
activities.name_ja: まつだい芝峠温泉 雲海
activities.description: Day-use hot spring in Tokamachi whose outdoor bath overlooks the Uonuma mountains, including Hakkaisan, Makihata and Naeba; the water is a strong sodium chloride spring.

activities.name: Senju Hot Spring Sennen-no-Yu
activities.name_ja: 千手温泉 千年の湯
activities.description: A free-flowing natural hot spring with a cypress bath, a Shinano River stone bath, outdoor baths of different sizes and temperatures, and a free foot bath.

activities.name: Backcountry Bike Experience Tour, Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground
activities.name_en: Backcountry Bike Experience Tour, Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground
activities.name_ja: ▲越後妻有 大厳寺高原キャンプ場
activities.description: A campsite at about 700 meters on Mount Tensui, with cottages, tents, and activities such as SUP on Fudo Pond.

activities.name: Akashi no Yu (Echigo-Tsumari Exchange Hall)
activities.name_ja: 越後妻有交流館「明石の湯」
activities.description: Day-use hot spring in Tokamachi, about a ten-minute walk from Tokamachi Station, in the same building as the MonET art museum.

activities.name: Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale Official Tour
activities.name_ja: 越後妻有 大地の芸術祭オフィシャルツアー
activities.description: Day bus tour from Echigo-Yuzawa Station of the Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale, with official guides and a seasonal vegetable lunch.

activities.name: Echigo-Tsumari Seidayama Campground
activities.name_ja: 越後妻有 清田山キャンプ場
activities.description: Quiet mountain campsite in Tokamachi overlooking Mt. Myoko, Mt. Yoneyama, Mt. Kurohime and the Uonuma range, with tent sites, auto sites and cottages.

activities.name: Taka-no-Yu (Matsunoyama Onsen Center)
activities.name_ja: 松之山温泉センター 鷹の湯
activities.description: A day-use hot spring in central Matsunoyama Onsen, a saline sodium-calcium chloride spring said to be one of Japan's three medicinal baths.

activities.name: Kiyotsukyo Hot Spring Village
activities.name_ja: 清津峡温泉郷
activities.description: Hot-spring village at the foot of Kiyotsukyo Gorge, with two inns, a foot bath, a restaurant, and a souvenir shop.

activities.name: Home of the Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale
activities.name_en: Home of the Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale
activities.name_ja: 大地の芸術祭の里
activities.description: The Echigo-Tsumari region of Tokamachi and Tsunan stages the art triennale every three years; the 2015 edition drew about 510,000 visitors.

activities.name: Kiyotsu River Fish Festival
activities.name_ja: 清津川さかなまつり
activities.description: A fish festival beside the Kiyotsu River with rainbow-trout fishing, a children's catching contest, and sales of grilled sweetfish, yamame, and char.

activities.name: Matsunoi Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: （株）松乃井酒造場
activities.description: Sake brewery in snow-country Tokamachi where junmai sake ages in a cave fed by spring water from a red-pine forest.

activities.name: Echigo-Tsumari Matsunoyama Onsen Snow Park
activities.name_ja: ▲越後妻有 松之山温泉スノーパーク（松之山温泉スキー場）
activities.description: Snow park about five minutes by car from Matsunoyama Onsen, offering skiing, snowboarding, airboarding, snowbiking, and on-slope camping.

activities.name: Mion Nakasato (Miyanakajima Hot Spring)
activities.name_ja: 宮中島温泉 ミオンなかさと
activities.description: Hot spring facility with silky brown water, a large indoor bath, and an open-air bath where the Shinano River can be heard.

activities.name: Haramachi Hot Spring Yukura Tsumari
activities.name_ja: 原町温泉 ゆくら妻有
activities.description: A hot spring with source water drawn directly into the baths and an outdoor bath overlooking the clear Kiyotsu River.

activities.name: Snow Play and Kamakura Experience
activities.name_ja: 雪遊び・かまくら体験
activities.description: At Mion Nakasato in Tokamachi, enter snow kamakura huts to grill rice cakes and eat mandarins, with candle lighting at night.

activities.name: Sasadango Making Experience (Easy Course)
activities.name_ja: 新潟の伝統食を作ろう！笹団子作り体験・お手軽コース
activities.description: Make three or four sasadango, steamed mugwort dumplings wrapped in bamboo leaves, with local mothers in about one hour, then taste them fresh.

activities.name: Nakasato Kiyotsu Ski Area
activities.name_ja: なかさと清津スキー場
activities.description: Ski area in Tokamachi whose operations are currently suspended.

activities.name: Shichirin Pottery
activities.name_ja: 七輪陶芸
activities.description: Hand-build sake cups and small plates, add color or stamped designs, and fire them the same day in a charcoal brazier.

activities.name: Setguro Castle Ruins Campground
activities.name_ja: 節黒城跡キャンプ場
activities.description: Campsite midway up the Setguro Castle ruins, with three log-style bungalows, three architect-designed cottages, a kitchen, and flush toilets, near trail artworks from Nakago Green Park.

activities.name: Matsunoyama Onsen and Snowshoe Rice-Terrace Walk
activities.name_en: Matsunoyama Onsen and Snowshoe Rice-Terrace Walk
activities.name_ja: 雪国で“心とけあう”大人旅│松之山温泉とかんじき棚田さんぽで味わう、冬の里山時間
activities.description: Winter package in Tokamachi pairing a stay at Matsunoyama Onsen, a snowshoe walk on rice terraces, and a satoyama gastronomy lunch at MURA PUB.

activities.name: Atema Gelande, Joetsu Kokusai Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Atema Gelande, Joetsu Kokusai Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 上越国際スキー場 あてまゲレンデ
activities.description: North-slope ski area of Joetsu Kokusai Ski Resort in Tokamachi, with powder snow, snowboarding, and lifts linking other zones.

activities.name: Airboard at Matsunoyama Onsen Ski Area
activities.name_en: Airboard at Matsunoyama Onsen Ski Area
activities.name_ja: エアボード
activities.description: Lie face-down on an inflatable board and slide the slope at Matsunoyama Onsen Ski Area, with beginner lessons offered.

activities.name: Karamushi Stole Plant-Dyeing Experience
activities.name_ja: からむしの布と葉を使用！ストール草木染め体験（1枚）
activities.description: In Tokamachi, tie-dye a stole of cotton and karamushi thread with dried karamushi leaves and take it home the same day.

activities.name: Matsudai Family Ski Area
activities.name_ja: 松代ファミリースキー場
activities.description: Ski area in Tokamachi, the city's only night-skiing venue, with beginner slopes, powder snow and a terrain park.

activities.name: Yuzen Dyeing Experience at Suizan
activities.name_ja: 友禅染めを気軽に体験
activities.description: Kimono maker in Tokamachi offering Tsujigahana process tours and hand-painted yuzen dyeing on postcards or tapestries.

activities.name: Wild Bird Kokeshi Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 野鳥こけし作り体験
activities.description: Make a wild-bird kokeshi, such as a white-eye, ruddy kingfisher, or blue-and-white flycatcher, with a teacher's guidance; Zoom classes are also offered.

activities.name: Tokamachi Fortune Doll (Chinkoro) Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 十日町のフォーチュンドール ” ちんころ” 作り体験
activities.description: Make Tokamachi's traditional rice-flour fortune dolls, called chinkoro, often shaped as puppies or the year's zodiac animal.

activities.name: Matsunoyama Onsen Taiko no Shio Ritoriito (Hannichi)
activities.description: Onsen activity in Tokamachi, Niigata.

activities.name: Matsunoyama Onsen Ancient Salt-Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 松之山温泉 太古の塩づくり体験
activities.description: Make salt from Matsunoyama Onsen’s 12-million-year-old fossil seawater, using locally thinned timber.

activities.name: Canoe and Kayak Experience (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground)
activities.name_en: Canoe and Kayak Experience (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground)
activities.name_ja: カヌー・カヤック体験（▲越後妻有大厳寺高原キャンプ場）
activities.description: Instructor-led canoe and kayak experience at Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground, with basic lessons then free paddling at your own pace.

activities.name: Campfire (Seidayama Campground)
activities.name_ja: キャンプファイヤー（清田山キャンプ場）
activities.description: Arranged campfires at Kiyotayama Campground for groups and school events, with an optional meteor that ignites the firewood.

activities.name: Snow Bike at Matsunoyama Onsen Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Snow Bike at Matsunoyama Onsen Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーバイク
activities.description: A beginner snow-bike school at Matsunoyama Onsen Ski Resort covers riding, stopping, lifts, and slope use on stable, bicycle-handled vehicles.

activities.name: Aoyagi Dyeing Workshop (Factory Tour and Yuzen Experience)
activities.name_en: Aoyagi Dyeing Workshop (Factory Tour and Yuzen Experience)
activities.name_ja: 工場見学・友禅体験（染色工房青柳）
activities.description: Tokamachi dyeing workshop Aoyagi offers factory tours and yuzen experiences; its kimono are made in Japan with dyeing, tie-dye, hand-painting, foil and embroidery.

activities.name: Kissaikan Building 2 (Hand-Painted Yuzen and Hand-Weaving Experience)
activities.name_en: Kissaikan Building 2 (Hand-Painted Yuzen and Hand-Weaving Experience)
activities.name_ja: 「手描き友禅・手織り体験」吉彩館２号館
activities.description: A dyeing and weaving workshop in Tokamachi for trying traditional kimono techniques, attached to a gallery of about 2,000 paper-clay dolls.

activities.name: Soba-making Experience, Atema Soba Shop, Belnatio Forum Center
activities.name_en: Soba-making Experience, Atema Soba Shop, Belnatio Forum Center
activities.name_ja: 「そば打ち体験」そば処あてま（ベルナティオ フォーラムセンター内）
activities.description: Soba-making experience for local hegi soba using only funori seaweed and buckwheat flour, eaten afterward or taken home.

activities.name: Chinkoro Making Experience (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
activities.name_en: Chinkoro Making Experience (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
activities.name_ja: ちんころづくり体験（あてま森と水辺の教室ポポラ）
activities.description: Make a chinkoro lucky charm, traditionally a puppy, zodiac animal, or animal of your choice, sold at Tokamachi's January Sekki Market.

activities.name: Bijinbayashi Snowshoe and Hearth Experience
activities.name_ja: 美人林スノーシューと囲炉裏体験
activities.description: A guided snowshoe walk in Bijinbayashi seeking weather-dependent snow crystals, then an irori experience with amazake at Kyororo.

activities.name: Gondola Tour at Atema Highland Resort Bernatio
activities.name_en: Gondola Tour at Atema Highland Resort Bernatio
activities.name_ja: ゴンドラツアー
activities.description: At Forest Fairy snow land in Tokamachi, ride a large sled behind a snowmobile for about 20 minutes through the winter landscape.

activities.name: Snow Removal Vehicle Experience
activities.name_ja: 除雪車体験
activities.description: See wheel dozers and rotary snowplows at work, and ride in the passenger seat of a snow removal vehicle.

activities.name: Putter Golf Course (Toma Highland Resort BELNATIO Forum Center)
activities.name_en: Putter Golf Course (Toma Highland Resort BELNATIO Forum Center)
activities.name_ja: パターゴルフコース（当間高原リゾートベルナティオ フォーラムセンター）
