activities.description: An 18-hole putter-golf course on natural turf, the same grass as the BELNATIO golf course, surrounded by seasonal flowers.

activities.name: Snow Play and Honyarado Experience
activities.name_ja: 雪遊び・ホンヤラドウ体験
activities.description: Guided Tokamachi experience of the local Honyarado snow-house custom, with mochi and marshmallow roasting and use of museum snow tools.

activities.name: Popora Kamakura Experience (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom)
activities.name_en: Popora Kamakura Experience (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom)
activities.name_ja: ポポラかまくら体験（あてま森と水辺の教室ポポラ）
activities.description: A limited-time winter kamakura experience at Atema Plateau Resort, where visitors eat rice cakes and roast marshmallows inside a snow hut.

activities.name: Sasadango Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 新潟の伝統食 「笹団子」作り体験
activities.description: An experience program in Tokamachi for making sasadango, bamboo-wrapped mugwort dumplings with sweet bean paste, taught by local experts.

activities.name: Snow Rafting at Atema Highland Resort Belnatio
activities.name_en: Snow Rafting at Atema Highland Resort Belnatio
activities.name_ja: スノーラフティング
activities.description: A five-minute ride in a snowmobile-towed boat on the snow at Forest Fairy, the hotel-linked snow land at Atema Highland Resort Belnatio.

activities.name: Traditional Zori and Cloth Zori Making Experience
activities.name_en: Traditional Zori and Cloth Zori Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 伝統わら細工 ぞうり/布ぞうり作り体験
activities.description: Make traditional rice-straw zori or colorful cloth zori with a local straw-craft master in Tokamachi.

activities.name: Canoe & Stand-Up Paddle Surfing Experience (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Kogen Campground)
activities.name_en: Canoe & Stand-Up Paddle Surfing Experience (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Kogen Campground)
activities.name_ja: カヌー＆スタンドアップパドルサーフィン体験（▲越後妻有大厳寺高原キャンプ場）
activities.description: You can try both canoeing and stand-up paddleboarding with an instructor, including land and water lessons and free time on the water.

activities.name: Backcountry Bike Experience Tour (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Kogen Campground)
activities.name_en: Backcountry Bike Experience Tour (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Kogen Campground)
activities.name_ja: バックカントリーバイク体験ツアー（▲越後妻有大厳寺高原キャンプ場）
activities.description: Hike 2.3 km through beech forest to the summit, then bicycle 3.5 km downhill; the tour is suspended after typhoon road damage in October 2019.

activities.name: Canoe Experience 70-Minute Plan
activities.name_ja: 初心者・お子様大歓迎！カヌー体験70分プラン
activities.description: A 70-minute canoe experience at Daigon-ji Plateau in Tokamachi, with a short lesson; children may ride with a parent.

activities.name: Snow Tubing (Atema Kogen Resort Bernatio)
activities.name_ja: チュービング
activities.description: Riders slide down an approximately 180-metre snow course on tubes at Atema Kogen Resort Bernatio, returning by wire lift.

activities.name: SUP Experience School 70-Minute Plan
activities.name_ja: 丁寧なレクチャー付きで安心！SUP体験スクール70分プラン
activities.description: A 70-minute SUP lesson at Daigonji Plateau Campground, with life-jacket fitting, a lecture, and about 50 minutes paddling on a gentle current.

activities.name: Herbarium Making Experience
activities.name_ja: お洒落な空間で楽しむ！ハーバリウム作り体験
activities.description: A herbarium-making experience in a building designed by architect Tadao Ando, where you arrange your own piece and take it home the same day.

activities.name: Stand-up Paddleboarding Experience (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground)
activities.name_en: Stand-up Paddleboarding Experience (Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground)
activities.name_ja: スタンドアップパドルサーフィン
activities.description: Instructor-led stand-up paddleboarding at Echigo-Tsumari Daigonji Plateau Campground, with land and water lessons before free time on the water.

activities.name: Kanjiki (Traditional Snowshoe) Experience
activities.name_ja: かんじき体験
activities.description: Wear traditional kanjiki snowshoes in Tokamachi to walk fresh snow boots cannot reach, with a local guide through winter hills.

activities.name: Woodworking Experience
activities.name_ja: 木工体験
activities.description: In Matsunoyama, visitors cut wood with a saw, join pieces with nails, and decorate works with acorns and nuts.

activities.name: Tokamachi Kouta Experience
activities.name_ja: 十日町小唄体験
activities.description: Families and groups can watch and try the singing and dancing of the Tokamachi Kouta folk song.

activities.name: Jirobata Hearth Experience
activities.name_ja: 地炉端体験
activities.description: Warm yourself by a recreated old-farmhouse irori while hearing local stories and tasting daikon stew, anbo, kushi mochi and amazake.

food.name: Tsumari no Gelato Shop Pione
food.name_ja: 妻有のジェラートショップ ピオーネ

food.name: Dining Room Cosmos
food.name_ja: ダイニングルーム コスモス

food.name: Karl Bengs Old Folk House Cafe Shibui
food.name_en: Karl Bengs Old Folk House Cafe Shibui
food.name_ja: カールベンクス古民家カフェ 澁い

food.name: Yoshoku & Wine Iru Katora Grill
food.name_ja: 洋食&ワイン イル カトラ グリル

food.name: Genkai
food.description: Yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant in Tokamachi, Niigata.

food.name: Steak Dining Iris
food.name_ja: ステーキダイニング アイリス

food.name: Echigo Tokamachi Kojima-ya Main Store
food.name_ja: 越後十日町 小嶋屋 本店

food.name: Soba no Sato Abuzaka
food.name_ja: そばの郷 アブザカ

food.name: Soba & Dainingu Nishi no
food.name_ja: そば＆だいにんぐ にし乃

food.name: Ramen Urekko
food.name_ja: らーめん うれっ子

food.name: Ramen Higuma Tookamachi ten
food.name_ja: らーめん ヒグマ 十日町店

food.name: Ramen Kobo Daishotei
food.name_ja: らーめん工房 大将亭

food.name: Echigo Matsudai Satoyama Shokudo
food.name_ja: 越後まつだい里山食堂

food.name: Kojima-ya Seika
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Tokamachi, Niigata.

food.name: Baumlinge
food.description: Sweets and bakery shop in Tokamachi.

sights.name: Kiyotsu Gorge (Tunnel of Light)
sights.description: A V-shaped gorge of columnar-jointed cliffs on the Kiyotsu River, a national scenic site and natural monument, with the 2018 Tunnel of Light installation.

sights.name: Hoshitoge Rice Terraces
sights.name_ja: 越後松代棚田群 星峠の棚田
sights.description: About 200 hillside rice paddies in Tokamachi become water mirrors in spring and autumn and were certified a Connecting Rice Terrace Heritage site in 2022.

sights.name: Bijinbayashi Beech Forest
sights.description: A hillside of roughly 100-year-old beech trees in Matsunoyama that regrew after the area was cleared for charcoal at the end of the Taisho era.

sights.name: Atema Highlands Cosmos
sights.name_ja: あてま高原のコスモス
sights.description: Cosmos bloom across the Hanadaira field on the Atema Highlands Resort Bernatio grounds, in season from late September to mid-October.

sights.name: Sekki Market (Chinkoro Market)
sights.description: Outdoor winter market in Tokamachi selling handmade rice-flour zodiac figures called chinkoro, which often sell out by morning.

sights.name: Muko-nage and Sumi-nuri (Groom Throwing and Face Painting)
sights.name_en: Muko-nage and Sumi-nuri (Groom Throwing and Face Painting)
sights.description: A 15 January rite at Matsunoyama Onsen where new grooms are thrown onto a snowy slope and couples paint each other's faces with ash.

sights.name: Tokamachi Jomon Tours
sights.description: Guided Jomon tours in Tokamachi visit the Sasayama Ruins, where Japan's only National Treasure flame-style pottery was found, plus the museum and a one-night restaurant.

sights.name: Nouland Kurosawa Chestnut and Hardy Kiwi Orchard
sights.name_en: Nouland Kurosawa Chestnut and Hardy Kiwi Orchard
sights.name_ja: 株式会社のうランド 黒沢観光栗・さるなし園
sights.description: Tourist orchard in Tokamachi where visitors pick ten kinds of chestnuts and sarunashi from about 1,200 vines.

sights.name: Tashiro Nanatsugama (Seven Pools)
sights.description: Seven waterfall pools on the Kamagawa in Tashiro, Tokamachi, designated a national scenic site and natural monument for their unusual layered rock banks.

sights.name: National Treasure Flame-Style Pottery
sights.description: Flame-style pottery from about 5,000 years ago, excavated at the Sasayama Site in Tokamachi, designated a National Treasure in 1999 and shown at Tokamachi City Museum.

sights.name: Echigo-Matsunoyama Satoyama Science Museum Kyororo
sights.name_ja: 十日町市立里山科学館 越後松之山「森の学校」キョロロ
sights.description: Small science museum in snowy Matsunoyama countryside, offering biodiversity exhibits and hands-on programs beside an 80-hectare forest and pond area.

sights.name: Hotel Kamosu Mori
sights.description: Hotel with seasonal forest views through glass-walled dining, local course dinners, Japanese breakfasts, Niigata drinks, and a 12.6°C cold mineral spring.

sights.name: Echigo-Tsumari Satoyama Museum of Contemporary Art MonET
sights.name_en: Echigo-Tsumari Satoyama Museum of Contemporary Art MonET
sights.name_ja: 越後妻有里山現代美術館 MonET（モネ）
sights.description: Contemporary art museum and Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale base, with a shop selling festival goods, artist works, and local products.

sights.name: House of Light
sights.description: James Turrell’s stay-in light artwork in Tokamachi, with a movable roof that opens a tatami room to the sky and a light-filled bath.

sights.name: Seto Gorge
sights.description: A quiet gorge along the emerald-green Kiyotsu River in Tokamachi, with views from Kiyotsu Gorge Bridge and summer fireflies on a tributary.

sights.name: Matsudai Nohbutai (Snow Country Agrarian Culture Center)
sights.name_en: Matsudai Nohbutai (Snow Country Agrarian Culture Center)
sights.name_ja: まつだい雪国農耕文化村センター「農舞台」
sights.description: Field museum of snow-country farming culture and art in Matsudai, with a gallery and restaurant in a building designed by MVRDV.

sights.name: 38th Nakasato Snowfield Carnival
sights.name_ja: 第38回雪原カーニバルなかさと
sights.description: A participatory winter carnival in Tokamachi with snow candles, fireworks, and daytime snow tubing at Kiyotsugawa Fresh Park.

sights.name: Echigo-Matsudai Satoyama Restaurant
sights.name_ja: 越後まつだい里山食堂
sights.description: Restaurant inside the Nobutai art base in Matsudai, serving local Echigo-Tsumari dishes in Jean-Luc Vilmouth's blue Café Reflet, overlooking rice terraces.

sights.name: Jirobata Thousand-Year Market
sights.name_ja: 千年の市 じろばた
sights.description: Direct-sales shop in Tokamachi run by local mothers, offering seasonal produce, rice-flour sweets, and a restaurant serving local rice and soba inari.

sights.name: Nasutebyu Yunoyama
sights.description: Day-use hot spring in Matsunoyama with a mineral-rich outdoor bath overlooking the mountains, plus indoor baths and a sauna.

sights.name: Popola, Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom
sights.name_en: Popola, Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom
sights.name_ja: あてま森と水辺の教室ポポラ
sights.description: Nature classroom at Atema Plateau Resort in Tokamachi, offering satoyama programs such as crafts, snowshoeing, and Alps Adventure.

sights.name: Matsuo Shrine
sights.name_ja: 国指定重要文化財「松苧神社」
sights.description: Wooden thatched-roof shrine in Tokamachi, built in 1497 and designated a National Important Cultural Property as Niigata Prefecture's oldest building.

sights.name: Nanatsugama Park
sights.description: A park adjacent to Tashiro no Nanatsugama, a national scenic site and natural monument, inaccessible in winter until June.

sights.name: Ubusuna House
sights.description: An Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale work: a 1924 thatched farmhouse restored with ceramics, serving local meals in artists' pottery.

sights.name: Echigo Matsudai Winter Campaign
sights.description: Winter festival in Matsudai, Tokamachi, featuring a snow race to retake Matsudai Castle, yosakoi performances, and fireworks.

sights.name: Tokamachi City Museum (TOPPAKU)
sights.description: Tokamachi City Museum exhibits National Treasure flame-type and crown-type Jomon pottery from the Sasayama Site, plus local textiles and the Shinano River.

sights.name: Tokamachi Industrial Culture Center Ikote
sights.name_ja: 十日町産業文化発信館 いこて
sights.description: A wooden two-storey Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale work by Takaharu and Yui Tezuka, serving Tokamachi seasonal dishes in a recreated gangi space.

sights.name: Komatsubara Wetland
sights.description: Komatsubara Wetland is a high moor on a lava plateau on Mt. Naeba's north slope, with countless ponds at about 1,350-1,600 m.

sights.name: Jinguji Temple Kannon Hall and Gate
sights.name_en: Jinguji Temple Kannon Hall and Gate
sights.description: Soto Zen temple in Tokamachi, said to date from the Heian period, whose gate, Kannon hall, and three Buddha statues are prefectural cultural properties.

sights.name: Omoji Oike Nature Observation Plaza
sights.name_ja: 重地大池自然観察広場
sights.description: Camping plaza in Tokamachi with a cottage for up to 15, beside Omoji Oike, a city-designated natural monument with a floating island.

sights.name: Yama no Ie Cafe & Dormitory
sights.description: A renovated private house in Matsudai combining a cafe for workshops and music events with a dormitory and residence, in the Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale area.

sights.name: Cherry Blossoms at Chojagahara Park
sights.description: A quiet park beside Senju Shrine in Tokamachi, with about 100 Somei-Yoshino cherry trees in bloom from mid-April to early May.

sights.name: Gamo Rice Terraces (Echigo-Matsudai)
sights.name_ja: 越後松代棚田群 蒲生の棚田
sights.description: Rice terraces in Gamo, Tokamachi, part of the Echigo-Matsudai group, certified a national rice-terrace heritage site in February 2022.

sights.name: Gimei Rice Terraces
sights.description: Terraced rice fields in Tokamachi, known as the cherry-blossom terraces, where mountain cherries reflect in the water and can be seen from Route 253.

sights.name: The Last Class
sights.description: Art Triennale work by Christian Boltanski and Jean Kalman in former Higashikawa Elementary School, using heartbeat-like sounds and flashing lights to evoke human absence.

sights.name: Suwa Shrine
sights.description: A hilltop shrine overlooking the town that also enshrines a textile-workers' deity and houses an unusual octagonal mikoshi used at August's Tokamachi Omatsuri.

sights.name: Yumoridokoro Jiro (Experience Facility)
sights.description: A roughly 100-year-old folk house relocated to the far end of Matsunoyama Onsen, used as an exchange and event space with a foot bath.

sights.name: Satoyama Expert Taxi
sights.description: A shared taxi, no longer sold as of August 2022, that toured rice terraces and beech woods between Matsudai Station and Matsunoyama Onsen.

sights.name: Shikisai-kan Vege Park
sights.description: Local-food complex in Tokamachi with a produce shop, a bakery using 100% local rice flour, and a food-education kitchen.

sights.name: Keichi Rice Terraces
sights.description: Rice terraces in Higashishimogumi, northeastern Tokamachi, with a 2017 deck for views of the paddies and surrounding mountains.

sights.name: Satoyama E-Bike
sights.name_ja: 電動スポーツサイクル「里山E-バイク」
sights.description: Power-assisted electric sports bikes for touring Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale works across Tokamachi, with a range of about 70 kilometres.

sights.name: Otogi no Kuni Art Museum
sights.description: Gallery of about 1,000 paper-clay dolls with motifs from The Tale of Genji and Hyakunin Isshu; inquire by phone or email before visiting.

sights.name: Nunagawa Campus
sights.description: Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale facility in a school closed in 2014, renewed in 2024 as a children’s museum of whole-body sensory art.

sights.name: Kiyotsukyo Gorge Water Retreat (Day Trip)
sights.name_ja: 清津峡渓谷・水のリトリート│日帰りリトリート
sights.description: Guided day retreat at an old folk house in Koide village near Kiyotsukyo Gorge, with only greeting and lunch times fixed.

sights.name: Iwase Firefly Village
sights.description: A place where natural firefly habitat remains, and Genji and Heike fireflies can be viewed.

sights.name: Shirakura Kasumi Cherry
sights.description: This mountain cherry in Shirakura, a Tokamachi City natural monument about 3.6 meters around, typically blooms in late April.

sights.name: Omune-yama Art Museum
sights.description: Museum in the former Murayama family home in Matsunoyama, featuring city-designated architecture, family antiques, and the room where writer Sakaguchi Ango stayed.

sights.name: Regular Birdwatching Session
sights.description: A monthly bird survey around Kyororo in Matsunoyama, co-hosted with a local wild-bird group that has monitored the area for over 60 years.

sights.name: Ichigo House (Strawberry Picking)
sights.description: A strawberry-picking greenhouse in Tokamachi growing Echigo-hime, a variety found only in Niigata, heated with waste heat from nearby Senju Onsen.

sights.name: Popora Wood Education Plaza (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom)
sights.name_en: Popora Wood Education Plaza (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom)
sights.name_ja: ポポラ木育ひろば（あてま森と水辺の教室ポポラ）
sights.description: A wood-education play space at Popora with wooden toys, where children stack blocks, push carts and roll balls.

sights.name: Kizakura Hill Park
sights.description: A Tokamachi park on surplus soil from Shinano River works, planted with pale-yellow cherries and Somei-Yoshino for spring blossom viewing.

sights.name: Yanagimizu Spring
sights.description: Spring in front of Omuneyama Art Museum, once brewing water for the Murayama family and used again since 2018 for Koshi no Tsuyu sake.

sights.name: Kiyotsugawa Fresh Park
sights.name_ja: 清津川フレッシュパーク
sights.description: A waterside park beside the Kiyotsu River with a lawn, a boulder river-play zone, and disc golf, with trees lit at night outside the snow season.

sights.name: Rice Paddy Biotope Mission
sights.name_ja: 田っぽビオトープ大作戦
sights.description: Visitors can experience restoring abandoned terraced paddies in Tokamachi, from planting to harvest, then eat a local bento and bran-pot rice.

sights.name: Rice Terrace Snowshoe Walk and Snow Tea Time
sights.name_en: Rice Terrace Snowshoe Walk and Snow Tea Time
sights.name_ja: 棚田かんじきウォーク＆雪上ティータイム
sights.description: Guided snowshoe walk on snow-covered rice terraces in Tokamachi, followed by tea with local kuromoji tea and sweets.

sights.name: Everyone's House
sights.description: A house in Mizusawa, Tokamachi, built by local residents, with a living room and large kitchen for day use or overnight stays.

sights.name: Hydrangea Park
sights.description: About 7,000 hydrangeas are planted on a 2.5-hectare slope, with peak viewing from early to mid-July.

sights.name: Fresh Feast Cooking with Tokamachi Moms
sights.name_en: Fresh Feast Cooking with Tokamachi Moms
sights.name_ja: 十日町のか～ちゃんしょと作る採れたてごっつぉ
sights.description: Cook with local mothers in Tokamachi using freshly harvested seasonal ingredients in the region’s preserved mountain-food tradition.

sights.name: Cherry Blossoms at Oida-no-Sato Park
sights.description: Park next to Jinguji Temple in Tokamachi, with ponds holding carp, crayfish and turtles, plus irises, lotuses and cherry blossoms.

sights.name: Matsudai Castle Ruins Park Campground
sights.name_ja: 松代城跡公園キャンプ場
sights.description: Campsite in Matsudai Castle Ruins Park, south of Matsudai Station, with three bungalows, about ten tent sites, and a cookhouse for barbecues, birdwatching, and stargazing.

sights.name: Tokamachi History Tour (Jomon and Culture)
sights.name_ja: 十日町の歴史を知る旅 ー縄文×文化編ー
sights.description: Tokamachi tour visiting a kimono factory, the city museum, and Sasayama Site, where National Treasure flame-shaped pottery was excavated, plus a Jomon dinner.

sights.name: Tsutsujihara Park
sights.description: Park in Tokamachi where about 3,000 azalea plants bloom across roughly three hectares from late May to early June, kept by local volunteers.

sights.name: Sato Chari Electric-Assist Bicycles
sights.name_ja: 電動アシスト自転車「里チャリ」
sights.description: City-bike-style electric-assist bicycles for art and food tours in Tokamachi, Kawanishi and Nakazato.

sights.name: Nakasato Kiyotsu Guides
sights.description: A paid guide service by local veteran guides inside the Kiyotsu Gorge tunnel, sharing local stories while viewing the scenery.

sights.name: JR Shinano River Power Station Miyanaka Intake Dam (Takanosu Dam)
sights.name_en: JR Shinano River Power Station Miyanaka Intake Dam (Takanosu Dam)
sights.name_ja: JR信濃川発電所宮中取水ダム（鷹ノ巣ダム）
sights.description: Intake dam on the Shinano River with a fishway observation room open free every year from 20 April to 20 November.

sights.name: Tokamachi Kimono GOTTAKU
sights.description: Limited-period tour of Tokamachi kimono factories for weaving, dyeing, processing, and maintenance, usually closed to the public.

sights.name: Nijuroku Park Beech Forest
sights.description: A rare lowland natural beech forest of about five hectares, with a walking path past 33 Kannon stone Buddhas.

sights.name: Niigata Matsunoyama Mountain Vegetable Garden
sights.name_ja: にいがた松之山山菜園
sights.description: A mountain-vegetable garden of about 5 hectares where visitors pick seasonal plants such as bracken, kogomi, udo, and autumn mushrooms.

sights.name: Matsudai Local History Museum
sights.description: A museum in a late-Edo zelkova house near Matsudai Station, supported by a 10-metre main pillar and displaying snow-country folk tools.

sights.name: Tojibuta Hot-Spring Pork Making
sights.description: Cook vacuum-packed Tsumari Pork for about two hours in a 63–68°C hot-spring kettle to make take-home Tojibuta roast pork.

sights.name: Stars and Forest Poem Art Museum
sights.name_en: Stars and Forest Poem Art Museum
sights.description: A small art museum surrounded by beech forest, with a 21-sculpture promenade and four special exhibitions a year.

sights.name: Matsudai Shiroyama Art Walk (Matsudai Nobutai Field Museum)
sights.name_en: Matsudai Shiroyama Art Walk (Matsudai Nobutai Field Museum)
sights.name_ja: 松代城山アート散策（まつだい「農舞台」フィールドミュージアム）
sights.description: Artworks of the Matsudai Nobutai Field Museum are scattered between Nobutai and hilltop Matsudai Castle for walks through satoyama nature.

sights.name: Matsudai Hokuhoku Street
sights.description: A former post-town stretch of road in Matsudai, named for the Hokuhoku Line and lined with old houses designed by Karl Bengs.

sights.name: Satoyama Wildlife Exploration
sights.description: Staff-led Kyororo event walking beech woods, grasslands, and ponds to collect and observe satoyama creatures.

sights.name: Setsugen Gakusha (Winter Snow Camp)
sights.name_ja: 雪原学舎※冬季間のみ営業
sights.description: A closed elementary school in Tokamachi operates only in winter as a snow camp and glamping site, with classroom stays and camping on the snowy grounds.

sights.name: Australia House
sights.name_ja: オーストラリア・ハウス
sights.description: A 2012 house in Tokamachi marking earthquake recovery and Echigo-Tsumari–Australia ties, where guests can stay among artist-made spaces and outdoor art when residencies are not running.

sights.name: Matsunoyama Shimofukawa Rice Terrace Art
sights.description: Rice terrace art in the mountains of Matsunoyama Shimofukawa, Tokamachi, handmade with local residents and given a new design each year.

sights.name: Tokamachi Tanada Trekking
sights.name_ja: 十日町棚田トレッキング（1泊2日
sights.description: Overnight trekking through Tokamachi’s historic rice terraces and the old Uesugi military road, with farm visits, seasonal activities, and local meals.

sights.name: Nakago Green Park
sights.name_ja: ナカゴグリーンパーク
sights.description: Park in Tokamachi with a 1.3-hectare lawn, a par-72 putting course and a nine-hole, par-29 family golf course.

sights.name: Tsumari Snowshoe Tour
sights.name_ja: 妻有スノーシューツアー
sights.description: Snowshoe walking tour through quiet snowy forests in Echigo-Tsumari, open to beginners, with a hot-spring bath afterward.

sights.name: Hachi & Seizo Tajima Museum of Picture Books and Tree Fruit
sights.name_en: Hachi & Seizo Tajima Museum of Picture Books and Tree Fruit
sights.name_ja: 鉢＆田島征三 絵本と木の実の美術館
sights.description: A closed elementary school in the mountain village of Hachi, turned by villagers and author Seizo Tajima into an experiential picture-book museum.

sights.name: Alps Adventure
sights.name_ja: アルプスアドベンチャー
sights.description: A forest aerial athletic course using PRISM design know-how, emphasizing safety for children, adults, and older visitors.

sights.name: Spring Wild Vegetable Picking Adventure (with Lunch)
sights.name_en: Spring Wild Vegetable Picking Adventure (with Lunch)
sights.name_ja: 春の息吹を感じる 山菜採りアドベンチャー（ランチ付き）
sights.description: A spring adventure foraging for wild mountain vegetables with a local guide in snowy Tokamachi.

sights.name: Kokorobijin Hiking
sights.description: A gentle guided hike through seasonally changing Bijinbayashi and bird-rich Suyama Forest on easy, well-kept paths.

sights.name: Gimyo Rice Terraces (Echigo-Matsudai Rice Terrace Group)
sights.name_en: Gimyo Rice Terraces (Echigo-Matsudai Rice Terrace Group)
sights.name_ja: 越後松代棚田群 儀明の棚田
sights.description: Terraced paddies in Gimyo, Tokamachi, where mountain cherry blossoms reflect in the water; certified a rice-terrace heritage site in 2022.

sights.name: Hosenji 2,000-Year Lotus
sights.description: Ancient lotus transplanted to Hosenji Temple in Tokamachi from plants Dr. Ichiro Oga grew from 2,000-year-old seeds, usually blooming in mid-July.

sights.name: Shirokawa Dam Park
sights.description: Park around a storage dam in Murono, Tokamachi, with a plaza, gazebo, and a path to Shiro-no-Ike and Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale works.

sights.name: Noguchi Skunk Cabbage Park
sights.description: Noguchi Skunk Cabbage Park has skunk cabbage that blooms together after the snow melts, from mid-April to early May.

sights.name: Atemayama Beech Forest
sights.description: Beech forest in Tokamachi named among Niigata’s 100 Beech Forests, with seasonal scenery and nature programs at the Popora classroom.

sights.name: Mount Toma
sights.description: A 1,028 m peak in Tokamachi with a beginner trail of about 5 km through beech forest from the Bernatio side.

sights.name: Tsumari Airboard Tour
sights.name_ja: 妻有エアーボードツアー
sights.description: Guide-led snow activity in Tokamachi where you lie prone on an inflated rubber board and slide down the slope.

sights.name: Matsuo Spring in Nakate
sights.description: Oldest spring in Nakate, the highest settlement in Tokamachi’s Yoshida district, said not to have dried up for over 300 years.

sights.name: Firefly Evening
sights.description: A 10-15 minute round-trip walk at Atemayama Plateau Forest in Tokamachi to observe Genji and Heike fireflies away from artificial light.

sights.name: Snowland Forest Fairy (Belnatio)
sights.name_ja: スノーランドフォレストフェアリー（ベルナティオ）
sights.description: Winter snow-play area at the Bernatio highland resort in Tokamachi, with fairy tubing, troll-mobile rides and a free kids' park.

sights.name: Shinano River Rafting Tour (Astral Orange)
sights.name_ja: 信濃川ラフティングツアー（アストラル・オレンジ）
sights.description: Rafting tours on the Shinano River with rapids, river swimming and jumps from the boat, plus natural hot-spring bathing.

sights.name: Forest Hall Crafts (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
sights.name_en: Forest Hall Crafts (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
sights.name_ja: 森のホール工作 （あてま森と水辺の教室ポポラ）
sights.description: Craft workshop at Popora in Tokamachi offering year-round handmade projects, including wooden cameras and cars, without reservation.

sights.name: Anbo Making (Local Cuisine)
sights.description: Local women teach visitors to make anbo—steamed rice-flour skins wrapped around nozawana or sweet bean paste—and eat them freshly made.

sights.name: Tsumari Snowshoe Tour (Night Course)
sights.name_ja: 妻有スノーシューツアー（Nightコース）
sights.description: Night snowshoe tour in Tokamachi, walking snowy fields, with moonlit views on full-moon nights.

sights.name: Summer Night Tour
sights.description: A night walk in Atema Forest with a flashlight and night scope to look for wildlife.

sights.name: Ubusuna no Ie
sights.description: Exclusive stay in a 100-year-old thatched farmhouse in Tokamachi, also an Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale work serving local food.

sights.name: Popora Quest
sights.description: A nature experience where you explore the fields, solve puzzles, and complete missions as a forest hero.

sights.name: Snow Forest Snowshoe Tour (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
sights.name_en: Snow Forest Snowshoe Tour (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
sights.name_ja: 雪の森スノーシューツアー（あてま森と水辺の教室ポポラ）
sights.description: Guided snowshoe walk through the snow-covered Atema Plateau forest, looking for tracks and nests and sometimes seeing rabbits or serows.

sights.name: Snow Country Explorers (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
sights.name_en: Snow Country Explorers (Atema Forest and Waterside Classroom Popora)
sights.name_ja: ゆきぐにたんけんたい（あてま 森と水辺の教室 ポポラ）
sights.description: Preschool snowshoe exploration in Tokamachi, with snowman-making and snowball play in moist, easy-to-pack snow.

sights.name: Shinano River Rafting (Mion Nakasato)
sights.name_ja: 信濃川ラフティング（ミオンなかさと）
sights.description: Beginner-friendly rafting on about 6 km of the Shinano River in the river-terrace area, based at Mion Nakasato.

sights.name: Old Matsunoyama Kaido (Uesugi Military Road)
sights.name_ja: 古道 松之山街道（上杉軍道 ）
sights.description: Historic mountain road once used by Uesugi Kenshin’s army; a section was designated one of Japan’s 100 Historic Roads in 1996.

sights.name: Airboard Slope Experience at Mion Nakasato
sights.name_en: Airboard Slope Experience at Mion Nakasato
sights.name_ja: 疾走感を満喫！迫力満点のエアボードでゲレンデ滑走
sights.description: Airboard slope riding at Mion Nakasato in Tokamachi, easier than skiing or snowboarding, with instruction and a hot-spring bath afterward.

sights.name: Wooden Chopstick Making (One Pair)
sights.name_ja: 使うほどに愛着がわく！自分だけの木製箸作り（1膳）
sights.description: Make one pair of wooden chopsticks from thinned timber at a Tadao Ando-designed facility in Tokamachi, and take them home the same day.

sights.name: Muko-nage Experience Spot & 24-Hour Hot Spring Eggs
sights.name_en: Muko-nage Experience Spot & 24-Hour Hot Spring Eggs
sights.name_ja: 婿投げ体験ご利益スポット＆24時間湯で玉子
sights.description: A face panel at Yakushi-do lets you pose as a thrown groom, and a nearby facility serves 100-yen eggs boiled 24 hours in Matsunoyama spring water.

sights.name: Tokamachi Rice Terrace Trekking Historical Village Course
sights.name_en: Tokamachi Rice Terrace Trekking Historical Village Course
sights.name_ja: 十日町棚田トレッキング 集落を巡る歴史コース
sights.description: Guided historical trek through Tokamachi’s rice-terrace satoyama along Matsunoyama Road, an old route walked by Uesugi Kenshin.

sights.name: Gosetsu WARS (Snow Recreation)
sights.description: A team-building snow recreation in Tokamachi and Uonuma, centered on a snowball survival game with strategy, building, and battle phases.

sights.name: Art and Satoyama Monitor Tour in Tokamachi
sights.name_en: Art and Satoyama Monitor Tour in Tokamachi
sights.description: A one-night, two-day monitor tour in Tokamachi, a stage of the Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale with over 200 permanent works.

stays.name: Kamosu Mori
stays.name_ja: 醸す森【kamosu mori】
stays.description: Inn in Matsunoyamakurokura, Tokamachi with a quiet countryside setting.

stays.name: Hina no Yadochi Tose
stays.name_ja: ひなの宿ちとせ
stays.description: Inn in Matsunoyamayumoto, Tokamachi with a quiet countryside setting.

stays.name: Atema Kogen Resort Belnatio
stays.name_ja: あてま高原リゾート ベルナティオ
stays.description: Resort hotel in Shukawa, Tokamachi with a quiet countryside setting.

stays.name: Sake no Yado Tamakiya
stays.name_ja: 酒の宿玉城屋
stays.description: Sake inn in Tokamachi, Niigata.

stays.name: Echigo Matsunoyama Onsen Ryoun-kaku
stays.name_ja: 越後松之山温泉 凌雲閣
stays.description: Inn at Echigomatsunoyama Onsen in Matsunoyamatensuietsu, Tokamachi.

stays.name: Yuki no Ya Furusawa Tei
stays.name_ja: 雪の家 古澤邸
stays.description: Residence in Tokamachi, Niigata.

stays.name: Hotel Shimizu
stays.name_ja: ホテルしみず
stays.description: Hotel in Hon, Tokamachi with breakfast available.

stays.name: Hayama-so
stays.name_ja: ハヤマ荘
stays.description: Lodge in Tokamachi, Niigata.

stays.name: Oku Echigo Hatago Ichiban-kan
stays.name_ja: 奥越後旅籠 壱番館
stays.description: Inn in Hachikakabuto, Tokamachi with business travelers and groups; 10-minute drive from Businessgasshukukangei!Tokamachi Station.

stays.name: Korasshai Chujo Inn
stays.name_ja: お宿こらっしゃい中条
stays.description: Inn in Chujokabuto, Tokamachi with one group per day and room-only plans.

stays.name: Kamataki no Noka Minshuku Mandai
stays.name_ja: 釜炊きの農家民宿 萬代
stays.description: Minshuku in Tokamachi, Niigata.

stays.name: Yuki no-ya
stays.name_ja: 雪の家
stays.description: Inn in Anyojiotsu, Tokamachi with one group per day.

stays.name: Kiyotsukyo Onsen Irori to Hotaru no Yado Setoguchi
stays.name_en: Kiyotsukyo Onsen Irori to Hotaru no Yado Setoguchi
stays.name_ja: 清津峡温泉 いろりとほたるの宿せとぐち
stays.description: Onsen inn with a hot spring bath in Nishitajiri, Tokamachi.

stays.name: Matsudai Shibatoge Onsen Unkai
stays.name_ja: まつだい芝峠温泉 雲海
stays.description: Onsen lodging with an open-air bath in Yomogihira, Tokamachi.

stays.name: Matsudai Tanada Hausu
stays.name_ja: 松代棚田ハウス
stays.description: House in Matsudai, Tokamachi.

stays.name: Kiyotsukyo Yumoto Onsen Kiyotsukan
stays.name_ja: 清津峡湯元温泉 清津館
stays.description: Hot spring inn in Koide, Tokamachi, with private open-air baths along a mountain stream.

stays.name: Matsunoyama Onsen Izumiya
stays.name_ja: 松之山温泉 和泉屋
stays.description: Small wooden ryokan in Matsunoyama Yumoto, Tokamachi, with five rooms and five free private baths.

stays.name: Yakuto Kaoru Yado Shirakawaya
stays.name_ja: 薬湯香ル宿 白川屋
stays.description: Inn in Matsunoyama Yumoto, Tokamachi.

stays.name: Matsunoyama Onsen Ponshu Hotel Suimu
stays.name_ja: 松之山温泉 Ponshu Hotel 睡夢
stays.description: Hotel in Matsunoyama Yumoto, Tokamachi, with a hot spring bath and Uonuma cedar sauna.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station SORAIRO Kugami
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 SORAIRO 国上
day_to_day.description: A roadside station that serves as a base for trekking and cycling, with barbecue, day-camp, and hot-spring facilities.

day_to_day.name: Kosugi Orchard (Pear Picking)
day_to_day.name_ja: 小杉農園
day_to_day.description: Pear orchard on fertile land along the Nakanokuchi River in Tsubame, where visitors can pick pears and eat them on site.

day_to_day.name: Migakiya Ichibankan (Metal Polishing Hall)
day_to_day.name_ja: 燕市磨き屋一番館
day_to_day.description: Metal polishing facility in Tsubame.

activities.name: Temari no Yu
activities.name_ja: てまりの湯
activities.description: Temari no Yu is a day-use hot spring at the foot of Mount Kugami in Tsubame, with a simple sulfur cold mineral spring beside Michi-no-Eki Kugami.

activities.name: Bunsui Oiran Procession (Tsubame Cherry Blossom Festival)
activities.name_en: Bunsui Oiran Procession (Tsubame Cherry Blossom Festival)
activities.name_ja: つばめ桜まつり 分水おいらん道中
activities.description: Three oiran performers and about 60 attendants parade along about 1,500 cherry trees planted in gratitude for the Ohkouzu Diversion.

activities.name: Hammered Copperware Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 鎚起銅器製作体験
activities.description: In Tsubame, shape copper by repeated hammering and annealing into a tumbler, sake cup, or spouted server.

activities.name: Tin Sake Cup Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 錫ぐい呑み製作体験
activities.description: At Tsubame City Industrial History Museum, shape a circular tin plate into a sake cup with a wooden mallet and molds.

activities.name: Hammered Copperware Small Plate and Cup-Saucer Making
activities.name_en: Hammered Copperware Small Plate and Cup-Saucer Making
activities.name_ja: 鎚起銅器の小皿/カップソーサーづくり体験
activities.description: Craftsmen guide beginners as they hammer a round copper plate into a small dish at Tsubame City Industrial History Museum.

activities.name: Beer Cup or Spoon Polishing Experience
activities.name_en: Beer Cup or Spoon Polishing Experience
activities.name_ja: ビアカップ or スプーンの磨き体験
activities.description: Polish your own beer cup with a Tsubame craftsman at Migakiya Ichibankan; children can polish spoons.

activities.name: Knife Resharpening Experience (Currently Suspended)
activities.name_ja: 包丁研ぎ直し体験（休止中）
activities.description: Try basic knife resharpening at Tojiro Open Factory in Tsubame, using knives provided by the shop for about 45 minutes.

activities.name: Metal Engraving Experience
activities.name_ja: 彫金製作体験
activities.description: In Tsubame, engrave bamboo-grass, plum, or dragonfly motifs on a copper pen case or tumbler with a chisel and hammer.

activities.name: Tin Small Plate Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 錫(すず)の小皿作り体験
activities.description: Shape a small tin plate, round, square, hexagonal, or octagonal, with wooden or metal hammers at Tsubame City Industrial Materials Museum.

activities.name: Tsuchime Hammering Experience
activities.name_ja: 鎚目（つちめ）入れ体験
activities.description: Add hammer marks to a pure copper cup at Tsubame City Industrial History Museum, one step in Tsubame hammered copperware making.

activities.name: Small Vessel Making (Hammer-Mark Experience)
activities.name_ja: 「小さな器づくり」鎚目（つちめ）入れを体験
activities.description: Hammer marks into a prepared vessel shape and attach a handle to make a small vessel, with staff guiding each step.

activities.name: Welding Art Experience
activities.name_ja: 溶接技術を使ったアート体験
activities.description: At WAAS FACTORY in Tsubame, visitors sketch on a 10 cm stainless-steel plate and melt the design with welding, without sparks.

activities.name: Handmade Soap Experience with Rice Oil and Rice Bran
activities.name_en: Handmade Soap Experience with Rice Oil and Rice Bran
activities.name_ja: 米油、米ぬかを配合した手作り石けん体験
activities.description: Make a skin-friendly soap with rice oil and rice bran at Aromatica Lab in Tsubame, choosing colors and scents; a souvenir soap is included.

activities.name: Tin Sake Cup Hammer-Marking Experience
activities.name_ja: 錫(すず)ぐい呑み 鎚目(つちめ)入れ体験
activities.description: Hammer a textured pattern into a spun tin sake cup or shot glass at Tsubame City Industrial Materials Museum and take it home.

activities.name: Hammered Copperware Cylindrical Vase Making
activities.name_ja: 鎚起銅器の筒花入れ製作体験
activities.description: At Tsubame Industrial History Museum, beginners make a sturdy hammered-copper vase whose copper helps keep flower water clean.
