sights.name: Sengando Suspension Bridge
sights.description: A 124-meter red suspension bridge on Mount Kugami linking Asahiyama Observatory and Gogoan, about 35 meters above Sengando Valley, chosen among Niigata’s 50 bridges in 1993.

sights.name: Kuni Uedera (Kokujoji)
sights.description: Temple in Tsubame, Niigata.

sights.name: Tsubame Back-Fat Ramen
sights.name_ja: 燕のソウルフード「燕背脂ラーメン」
sights.description: Local ramen of extra-thick noodles in a mellow, fairly strong seafood-soy broth, covered with enough pork back fat to keep the soup hot.

sights.name: Mount Kugami
sights.description: A 313-meter mountain in Tsubame whose summit overlooks the Bunsui district and Ohkouzu Diversion Channel, with a beech forest designated a prefectural natural monument.

sights.name: Tsubame City Traffic Park
sights.description: A park in Tsubame with traffic signals and railroad crossings for learning road rules, large play equipment, and a 650-meter go-kart course with an overpass.

sights.name: Gogo-an
sights.description: Hermitage of Kokuji Temple where Ryokan lived for about 20 years from 1793, meditating, reading classics, and writing poetry.

sights.name: Tsubame City Industrial History Museum
sights.description: Museum tracing Tsubame's 400-year metalworking history, with artisan works, kiseru pipes, spoons, and hands-on metalcraft workshops.

sights.name: Omagari Riverside Park
sights.description: Riverside park on the Nakanokuchi River’s left bank in Tsubame, where pheasants, harriers, and rare plants gather, with an Eco Clock and barbecue facilities.

sights.name: Shinano River Ohkouzu Museum
sights.description: Museum marking a century of Shinano River works, with exhibits on the river and Ohkouzu Diversion and river views from a fourth-floor observatory.

sights.name: Ohkouzu Diversion Cherry Blossom Avenue
sights.description: Someiyoshino cherry trees planted to honor the Ohkouzu Diversion project bloom along the river embankment in Tsubame.

sights.name: Yoshida Fureai Plaza
sights.description: Multipurpose park in Tsubame with a dog run, playground, go-karts, barbecue area, and spring cherry blossoms.

sights.name: Echigo Tsubame Tenjin-ko
sights.description: Tsubame's Tenjin-ko on February 25 honors Sugawara no Michizane with colorful sweets offered for children's growth and studies.

sights.name: Gyokusendo
sights.description: A Tsubame workshop where visitors can watch hammered-copperware making; Tamagawa Nobuo is a Living National Treasure, and the buildings are nationally registered cultural properties.

sights.name: Titanium Spoon and Fork Oxidation Coloring
sights.name_en: Titanium Spoon and Fork Oxidation Coloring
sights.name_ja: チタン製各種スプーンやフォーク酸化発色
sights.description: Visitors choose from 24 oxidation colors to make a titanium dessert spoon, fork, yogurt spoon, or coffee spoon at Tsubame City Industrial History Museum.

sights.name: Saito Strawberry Farm
sights.description: Strawberry farm in Tsubame growing fleshy, high-sugar Echigo-hime and selling jam, gelato, and sherbet made from them.

sights.name: Kamameshi Popularized by Local Company Presidents
sights.name_en: Kamameshi Popularized by Local Company Presidents
sights.name_ja: 地元の社長たちが広めた「釜めし」
sights.description: In Showa-era Tsubame, pricey kamameshi eaten by company presidents was later popularized by restaurateurs for ordinary diners.

sights.name: Otogo Shrine Hermitage
sights.name_ja: 乙子神社草庵（おとごじんじゃそうあん）
sights.description: Rebuilt hermitage at Otogo Shrine in Tsubame, where the monk Ryokan lived for about ten years from 1816.

sights.name: Kugami Health Forest Park
sights.description: A park surrounded by greenery at the foot of Mount Kugami, across from Shuten-doji Shrine, with a carp-feeding stream, play equipment, and a trail to Mount Kugami.

sights.name: Sharing Happiness Candle Making
sights.name_ja: 幸せのおすそ分けキャンドル作り
sights.description: Remake wedding-venue candles into an original candle at Tsubame Candle in Tsubame City, with weekday sessions from 500 yen.

sights.name: Great White Wisteria of Hachioji
sights.description: A white wisteria about 300 years old stands in the grounds of Anryoji Temple in Tsubame, a prefectural natural monument since 1958.

sights.name: Tsubame City Chozenkan Museum
sights.description: Museum of the former Chozenkan private academy, with rooms on its history and teaching plus a Yonozu meteorite model and works by Yokoyama Misao.

sights.name: Tsubame City Bunsui Ryokan Historical Museum
sights.name_en: Tsubame City Bunsui Ryokan Historical Museum
sights.description: A museum presenting Zen monk Ryokan's calligraphy and related materials from his Gogo-an and Otogo Shrine hut periods.

sights.name: Mount Kugami (Kokujō-ji Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 国上山・国上寺脇登山口
sights.description: A 313-metre mountain in Tsubame linked to the monk Ryokan, with beginner trails and summit views of the Sea of Japan, Sado, and the Echigo Plain.

sights.name: Tsubame City Bunsui Visitor Service Center
sights.name_en: Tsubame City Bunsui Visitor Service Center
sights.name_ja: 燕市分水ビジターサービスセンター
sights.description: Visitor center and base for climbing Mt. Kugami, with exhibits of Ryokan’s calligraphy and seasonal photos, plus a free rest area and café.

sights.name: Tojiro Knife Gallery and Open Factory
sights.name_en: Tojiro Knife Gallery and Open Factory
sights.name_ja: 藤次郎ナイフギャラリー/オープンファクトリー
sights.description: Tojiro’s knife gallery and open factory in Tsubame, where visitors can tour production, join workshops, and buy kitchen knives.

sights.name: Tsubame–Yahiko Sightseeing Taxi Tour (Ryokan Course)
sights.name_ja: 燕・弥彦を観光タクシーでめぐる旅[良寛巡りコース]
sights.description: A day taxi tour of Tsubame and Yahiko visiting sites linked to Ryokan, a late-Edo Zen monk, poet, and calligrapher.

sights.name: Yonozu Meteorite Fall Site Monument
sights.name_ja: 米納津隕石落下地記念碑
sights.description: Monument marking the 1837 fall of the Yonozu meteorite, a 31.65 kg specimen ranked third by weight among single meteorites in Japan.

sights.name: Yugure Hill
sights.description: A hill on the east bank of the Ohkouzu Diversion Channel where the monk Ryokan is said to have stopped on his alms rounds and composed a poem.

sights.name: Tsubame Ichibi (Street Markets)
sights.description: Periodic open-air markets in Tsubame, Yoshida, and Bunsui, held on fixed calendar days and selling vegetables, fish, and prepared foods.

sights.name: One-of-a-Kind Brass Ruler Making
sights.name_ja: 世界にひとつの真ちゅう製定規作り
sights.description: In Tsubame, press scales into a brass ruler and stamp letters under a mold craftsman’s guidance to make a one-of-a-kind piece.

sights.name: Brass Accessory and Teaspoon Making
sights.name_ja: 「真鍮アクセサリー」「ティースプーン」づくり
sights.description: Make a brass accessory or teaspoon at Factory Front in Tsubame, a session on the city's hammered-copperware and cutlery crafts.

sights.name: Sutra Copying and Buddha Drawing Sessions
sights.name_en: Sutra Copying and Buddha Drawing Sessions
sights.description: Sutra-copying and Buddha-drawing sessions at Kokujō-ji Temple in Tsubame, where visitors write the Heart Sutra.

sights.name: Tsubame and Yahiko Sightseeing Taxi (Highlights Course)
sights.name_en: Tsubame and Yahiko Sightseeing Taxi (Highlights Course)
sights.name_ja: 燕・弥彦を観光タクシーでめぐる旅[いいとこ巡りコース]
sights.description: A one-day taxi course around Tsubame, Yahiko Village, and Teradomari for day-trippers and guests near Tsubame-Sanjo, Yahiko Onsen, or Iwamuro Onsen.

sights.name: Mt. Kugami Ryokan Historic Sites Volunteer Guide
sights.name_en: Mt. Kugami Ryokan Historic Sites Volunteer Guide
sights.name_ja: 国上山良寛史跡ボランティアガイド
sights.description: Volunteer guides lead visitors around Ryokan sites on Mt. Kugami, including Kokujo-ji, Gogo-an, and Shuten-doji's mirror well.

sights.name: Tsubame City Bunsui Ryokan Museum
sights.description: Museum about Zen monk Ryokan, showing calligraphy from his hermitage years and spring and autumn exhibits of Kera and Abe family works.

stays.name: APA Hotel Niigata Tsubame Sanjo Ekimae
stays.name_en: APA Hotel Niigata Tsubame Sanjo Ekimae
stays.name_ja: アパホテル〈新潟 燕三条駅前〉
stays.description: Hotel in Tsubame, Niigata.

stays.name: Hotel Tsubame Hills Yoshida Ekimae Kyu Hotel Minato
stays.name_en: Hotel Tsubame Hills Yoshida Ekimae Kyu Hotel Minato
stays.name_ja: ホテル燕ヒルズ 吉田駅前（ＢＢＨグループ） 旧ホテルミナト
stays.description: Hotel in Yoshidahinode, Tsubame with breakfast available and business travelers; 3-minute walk from Saitekichoshokumuryojryoshida Station.

stays.name: Tsubame Sanjo Washington Hotel
stays.name_ja: 燕三条ワシントンホテル
stays.description: Hotel in Idokan, Tsubame with breakfast available and parking.

stays.name: Toyoko INN Tsubame Sanjo Ekimae
stays.name_ja: 東横ＩＮＮ燕三条駅前
stays.description: Inn in Idokan, Tsubame with breakfast available.

day_to_day.name: Tsunan Tourism Products Hall
day_to_day.name_ja: 津南観光物産館
day_to_day.description: Products hall in Tsunan stocking local sake, rice, woodcraft and sweet under-snow carrot juice, with a tonkatsu shop using Tsumari pork.

activities.name: Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale 2027
activities.name_ja: 大地の芸術祭 越後妻有アートトリエンナーレ 2027
activities.description: The Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale, held once every three years, takes place in 2027 and includes tours, food, and lodging.

activities.name: MUJI Tsunan Campground
activities.name_ja: 無印良品津南キャンプ場
activities.description: A MUJI-managed campground next to 903-meter Mount Yamabushi, surrounded by beech, mizunara oak, and birch, with grass sites, three cottages, a bait-fishing pond, and a dog run.

activities.name: New Greenpia Tsunan Campground
activities.name_ja: ニュー・グリーンピア津南 キャンプ場
activities.description: A highland campground in Tsunan with cottages, bungalows, lawn tent sites, a hot spring, and more than 16 outdoor activities.

activities.name: Naeba Sake Brewery (Naebasan)
activities.name_ja: 苗場酒造 株式会社
activities.description: A sake brewery in Tsunan operating for over 100 years, offering paid tastings and brewery tours.

activities.name: Najomon (Tsunan Agriculture and Jomon Experience Hall)
activities.name_en: Najomon (Tsunan Agriculture and Jomon Experience Hall)
activities.name_ja: 津南町 農と縄文の体験実習館「なじょもん」
activities.description: Experience hall in Tsunan for Jomon crafts and seasonal farming, with exhibits, reconstructed pit dwellings, and beech-forest walks.

food.name: Coffee and Gallery Mori Cafe
food.name_ja: コーヒーアンドギャラリー モリ カフェ

food.name: no-ya Chokuei Tsunan Eki Shokudo Eki Naka
food.name_en: no-ya Chokuei Tsunan Eki Shokudo Eki Naka
food.name_ja: 農家直営 津南駅食堂 えきナカ

food.name: Ito House Fukuhara
food.name_ja: イートハウスふくはら

food.name: Akiyama Sato Ketsu Higashi Onsen Katakuri no Yado
food.name_en: Akiyama Sato Ketsu Higashi Onsen Katakuri no Yado
food.name_ja: 秋山郷結東温泉 かたくりの宿

food.name: Kamigo Clove-za Restaurant
food.name_ja: 上郷クローブ座レストラン

food.name: Bread To Kurashi To Yanagiya
food.name_ja: パンと暮らしとヤナギヤ

food.name: Uonuma Bimi Honpo
food.description: Western sweets shop in Tsunan, Niigata.

sights.name: Tsunan Lantern Night Sky Light Show
sights.name_en: Tsunan Lantern Night Sky Light Show
sights.name_ja: 津南ランタンと夜空を彩る光の共演
sights.description: Winter lantern-launch experience in snowy Tsunan Town, where wish lanterns rise into the night sky, with fireworks on selected dates.

sights.name: Ryugakubo Pond
sights.description: A 1.2-hectare spring pond renewed once daily by about 43,000 tons of flow, designated one of Japan's 100 Famous Waters in 1985.

sights.name: Tsunan Sunflower Plaza 2026
sights.description: A 4-hectare field in Tsunan with about 500,000 sunflowers, staggered bloom sections, a viewing platform, and a sunflower maze.

sights.name: Akiyamago
sights.description: Villages along the upper Nakatsu River gorge spanning Niigata and Nagano, retaining older ways amid steep mountains and deep snow.

sights.name: Mount Naeba (Koakazawa and Oakazawa Trailheads)
sights.name_ja: 苗場山・小赤沢登山口
sights.description: A 2,145 m peak reached in about 3 hours 30 minutes from Koakazawa Trailhead or 6 hours 10 minutes from Oakazawa Trailhead, with no mountain hut.

sights.name: Dankyu Cherry Blossoms
sights.description: More than 200 individually owned cherry trees line the river terraces in Tsunan, with views of distant mountains still holding snow.

sights.name: Kurhaus Tsunan
sights.description: Swimwear hot-spring facility in Tsunan with a heated pool, ten bath types, a gym, and climbing, plus an indoor bath added in 2012.

sights.name: Mitama Fudo Temple
sights.description: Temple in Mitama, Tsunan, enshrining Fudo Myoo and credited with benefits for eye ailments, where spring water forms waterfalls along the stone steps.

sights.name: Machinaka Open Space Dandan
sights.name_ja: まちなかオープンスペースだんだん
sights.description: A community exchange space in Tsunan, created with residents to revitalize the shopping street, which won the 2023 Good Design Award and Wood Design Award.

sights.name: 13th Niigata Prefecture Doburoku Fair
sights.name_ja: 第13回 新潟県どぶろく博覧会
sights.description: A one-day gathering in Tsunan where visitors taste Niigata doburoku, talk with producers, and enjoy meals paired with the drink.

sights.name: Snow Walk 2027: Views Shaped by the Land and People
sights.name_en: Snow Walk 2027: Views Shaped by the Land and People
sights.name_ja: 雪散歩2027 ～大地と人が築いた眺め～
sights.description: Snowshoe walk in Tsunan Town to river-terrace viewpoints, meeting at Tsunan Station or the town office.

sights.name: Tsunan Snow-Buried Carrot Digging Contest
sights.name_ja: 津南の雪下にんじん掘り競争
sights.description: A timed contest in Tsunan Town to dig up as many snow-buried carrots as possible, a local specialty sweetened by storage under snow.

sights.name: Tsunan Mitama Park
sights.description: A park in Okubo, Mitama, overlooking Ishiotoshi columnar jointing cliffs across the Nakatsu River in Naeba Sanroku Geopark.

sights.name: Tsunan Brewery (Kiri no To)
sights.description: Sake brewery in Tsunan Town making Kiri no To from Gohyakumangoku rice and ultra-soft Naeba snowmelt water.

sights.name: Mikura Bridge
sights.description: A wooden-deck suspension bridge over the clear Nakatsu River in Tsunan, with views of rock walls, forest, and autumn foliage.

sights.name: Echigo Sorin Shrine Candle Night 2026 (Dream of the Short Night, 2nd Edition)
sights.name_en: Echigo Sorin Shrine Candle Night 2026 (Dream of the Short Night, 2nd Edition)
sights.name_ja: 越後双輪神社 candle night2026〜短夜の夢 2nd Edition〜
sights.description: An outdoor candle night at Echigo Sorin Shrine in Tsunan on the short summer-solstice night, with food trucks.

sights.name: Riverside Tsunan
sights.description: Station complex at JR Tsunan Station with a shop, light cafeteria, rest area, and hot-spring baths overlooking the trains.

sights.name: Mikura Katakuri Colony
sights.description: A long-hidden katakuri colony in Mikura, Akiyamago, with trekking paths, giant horse-chestnut trees, and a bloom delayed by late snowmelt.

sights.name: Tsunan Town Archaeological Center (Umorea)
sights.name_ja: 津南町埋蔵文化財センター“うもれあ”
sights.description: Archaeological center in a former school in Tsunan, showing a reconstructed Okinohara pit dwelling, flame-shaped pottery, and finds from about 30,000 years of local history.

sights.name: River Observatory
sights.description: A viewpoint at about 450 meters overlooks the meandering Shinano River, with the Nakatsu River and river terraces beyond, from a deck jutting over the cliff.

sights.name: Tsunan Town Forest Therapy Base
sights.name_ja: 津南町森林セラピー基地
sights.description: Forest therapy base in Tsunan with 300 hectares of beech forest that withstands heavy snow, between Mountain Park Tsunan and a MUJI campsite.

sights.name: Nakago Cherry Blossoms
sights.description: Cherry blossoms in higher-elevation Nakago, seen with remaining snow and reflected on a lake except in low-snow years.

sights.name: Jabuchi Falls
sights.description: A waterfall in remote Akiyamago straddling the border with Sakae Village in Nagano, seen from an observation deck among autumn foliage.

sights.name: Sky Lookout
sights.description: A lookout about 700 meters above sea level in Tsunan, overlooking Shinano River terraces and, on clear days, Mount Naeba and the Echigo range.

sights.name: Akeyama (Akiyamago Oakazawa Elementary School)
sights.name_ja: アケヤマ －秋山郷立大赤沢小学校－
sights.description: Former elementary school in Akiyamago, reopened in 2024 as a project to explore and share the region’s mountain living skills.

sights.name: Shimofunato Honmura Housing Complex
sights.description: Genji firefly habitat in the Shimofunato Honmura settlement of Tsunan, active from mid-June to early July.

sights.name: Yamagen Woodcraft
sights.description: Woodcraft workshop in Akiyamago making one-of-a-kind solid natural-wood pieces, including custom orders, since 1921.

sights.name: Mikura Giant Horse Chestnut
sights.description: A giant horse chestnut in Mikura, Tsunan, 25 meters tall with an 8.5-meter trunk and an estimated age of 500–800 years, listed among Japan’s 100 forest giants.

stays.name: Echigo Tanaka Onsen Shina no-so
stays.name_ja: 越後田中温泉しなの荘
stays.description: Inn at Echigotanaka Onsen in Kamisatouedaotsu, Tsunan with riverside setting.

stays.name: Hana Tohotaru Yu Nosato Yukiguni
stays.name_ja: 花とほたる 湯のさと 雪国
stays.description: Inn in Dai, Tsunan with riverside setting.

stays.name: Men-ya Ryokan
stays.name_ja: 綿屋旅館
stays.description: Ryokan inn in Gesenwatariinu, Tsunan with business travelers.

stays.name: Jika Gensen 100% no Yado Shinano-so
stays.name_ja: 自家源泉100％の宿 しなの荘
stays.description: Lodge in Tsunan, Niigata.

stays.name: New Green Pia Tsunan
stays.name_ja: ニュー・グリーンピア 津南
stays.description: Inn at Baikinguto Onsen in Akinaru, Tsunan with buffet meals.

stays.name: Sakamaki Onsen Kawatsu-ya
stays.name_ja: 逆巻温泉 川津屋
stays.description: Inn at Sakamaki Onsen in Ketsuhigashiushi, Tsunan with free-flowing hot spring baths.

stays.name: Akiyamago Ketto Onsen Katakuri no Yado
stays.name_en: Akiyamago Ketto Onsen Katakuri no Yado
stays.name_ja: 秋山郷結東温泉かたくりの宿
stays.description: Hot spring inn in Ketto, Tsunan, renovated from a former school.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Yunotani
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 「ゆのたに」
day_to_day.description: A roadside station near Uonuma IC with a specialty shop selling Uonuma Koshihikari rice and local products, plus a restaurant and tourist information.

day_to_day.name: Roadside Station Irihirose
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅 「いりひろせ」
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Uonuma offering seasonal mountain vegetables, handmade soba, Uonuma Koshihikari products, and a rice-cracker baking experience.

day_to_day.name: JA Uonuma Produce Direct Sales Store (Uonuma Hyakusaikan)
day_to_day.name_en: JA Uonuma Produce Direct Sales Store (Uonuma Hyakusaikan)
day_to_day.name_ja: JA魚沼農産物直売所 うおぬま百菜花ん
day_to_day.description: Direct-sales shop in Uonuma offering local vegetables, mountain greens, flowers, and Uonuma Koshihikari rice, including through snowy winters.

day_to_day.name: Mary's Farm (Blueberry Picking)
day_to_day.name_ja: ブルーベリー狩り（魚沼市・マリーズファーム）
day_to_day.description: Fruit farm in Uonuma growing blueberries and raspberries, with all-you-can-eat picking from 30 varieties and 1,000 bushes on sheet-covered ground.

activities.name: Uonuma Shibazakura Festival
activities.name_ja: 魚沼芝桜まつり
activities.description: About 200,000 moss phlox usually peak in mid-May at Flower, Greenery and Snow Village Park, overlooking Uonuma city and the Echigo Sanzan.

activities.name: Oyu Onsen
activities.name_ja: 大湯温泉
activities.description: A 1,300-year-old hot spring in Uonuma, with purple katakuri colonies in spring and ski areas nearby in winter.

activities.name: Tochiomata Onsen
activities.name_ja: 栃尾又温泉
activities.description: Hot-spring area in Uonuma called the child-blessing waters, a simple radium spring said to boost metabolism and aid calm, pain relief, and sleep.

activities.name: Komami View Bath (Aoshima Onsen)
activities.name_ja: 青島温泉 見晴らしの湯こまみ
activities.description: Day-use hot spring in Uonuma with a view through the steam and two spring types, beside Koide Park and the winter Koide Ski Area.

activities.name: Ginzandaira Campground
activities.name_ja: 銀山平キャンプ場
activities.description: Campground below Mt. Arasawa with riverside play, Lake Okutadami fishing, a hike to year-round snow, and a day-use hot spring.

activities.name: Juwa Onsen
activities.name_ja: 寿和温泉
activities.description: A quiet mountain hot spring in Uonuma, renewed in 2023 into a compact barrier-free facility with an indoor bath and sauna.

activities.name: Yakushi Onsen Yu-Park Yakushi
activities.name_ja: 薬師温泉 ゆ～パーク薬師
activities.description: Day-use hot spring with weakly alkaline Yunotani Yakushi Onsen baths at 37.4°C, handmade soba from slope-grown local flour, and a corner with over 2,000 comics.

activities.name: Oritate Onsen
activities.name_ja: 折立温泉
activities.description: Hot spring at the gateway to the Okutadami Silver Line, known for homestyle hospitality and abundant hot water.

activities.name: Okutadami Lake Sightseeing Boat Children's Captain Experience
activities.name_en: Okutadami Lake Sightseeing Boat Children's Captain Experience
activities.name_ja: 奥只見湖遊覧船こども船長体験
activities.description: On the Okutadami Lake sightseeing boat, elementary-school children and younger learn steering in the wheelhouse and receive a children's maritime certificate.

activities.name: Ginzandaira Onsen
activities.name_ja: 銀山平温泉
activities.description: Hot-spring area in Uonuma among peaks such as Mt. Echigo-Komagatake, with spring skiing, fishing on Lake Okutadami, hiking, camping, and morning waterfall clouds at Shiori Pass.

activities.name: Suhara Ski Area
activities.name_ja: 須原スキー場
activities.description: Ski area in Uonuma with ten courses, a 1.5 km run, night skiing and summit views of the Echigo Sanzan.

activities.name: Okutadami Maruyama Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 奥只見丸山スキー場
activities.description: A ski resort with mountain and Okutadami Dam Lake views from a 1,242 m summit and a 4 km downhill run.

activities.name: Koide Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 小出スキー場
activities.description: Family-oriented ski area in Uonuma with views of the Echigo Sanzan, seven courses, night skiing, and an adjacent hot spring.

activities.name: Hajimete no Yuki Asobi Experience in Uonuma | Yuki Iku Monita Tour
activities.description: Experience tour in Uonuma, Niigata.

activities.name: Yakushi Ski Area
activities.name_ja: 薬師スキー場
activities.description: North-facing ski area in Uonuma popular with families, with beginner-to-advanced slopes and views along the Uono and Aburuma rivers.

activities.name: Banana Boat at Yakushi Ski Area
activities.name_en: Banana Boat at Yakushi Ski Area
activities.name_ja: バナナボート
activities.description: Snowmobile-towed banana boat for up to six people at Yakushi Ski Area, held on Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays.

activities.name: Uonuma Snowshoe Experience
activities.name_ja: 豪雪地『魚沼』で体感！静寂の世界を行くスノーシュー体験
activities.description: A snowshoe walk through the quiet, snow-covered landscape of Uonuma, a heavy-snowfall area in Niigata.

activities.name: Snow-Viewing Walk, Teatime and Snow Tent Sauna Experience
activities.name_en: Snow-Viewing Walk, Teatime and Snow Tent Sauna Experience
activities.name_ja: 雪見散歩・ティータイム＆雪中テントサウナ体験
activities.description: Snowshoe through fresh powder at Asakusa Sanso in Uonuma, then have hot sandwiches by a fire and a tent sauna with snow dives.

activities.name: Lake Okutadami SUP Experience
activities.name_ja: 奥只見湖SUP体験
activities.description: Stand-up paddleboarding on Lake Okutadami at Ginzan-daira, where clear snowmelt from 2,000-meter mountains flows into the lake.

food.name: Hiro Shokuhinten
food.description: Cafe stand at Michi-no-Eki Yunotani serving rice-flour chiffon cake, onigiri-shaped rice crepes, and snow-room-coffee soft serve; open about 9:30-16:00, closed Mondays.

food.name: Chugoku Ryori Houkon
food.description: Chinese restaurant serving Cantonese and Fujian dishes, including ramen, fried rice, yakisoba, shark fin, Peking duck, abalone and Shanghai crab, with lunch set meals; closed Mondays.

food.name: Izakaya Hibiki
food.description: Izakaya serving fresh seafood and seasonal dishes; open 17:00-23:00, closed Sundays.

food.name: Tonkatsu Restaurant Tonki
food.name_ja: とんかつレストラントンキー

food.name: Yakiniku Hajime no Ippo
food.name_ja: 焼肉 はじめの一歩
food.description: Yakiniku restaurant serving all-you-can-eat yakiniku and namamotsu, with all-you-can-drink plans; open 11:30-14:30 and 17:00-22:00, closed Tuesdays except holidays.

food.name: Azumaya Main Store Kokudo
food.name_ja: あづまや 本店（国道店）

food.name: Kagami-ga-ike Lake Restaurant
food.name_ja: 湖上レストラン 鏡ヶ池

food.name: Komugiya
food.description: Ramen shop serving a pork-based soup simmered for 10 hours, mainly miso, plus salt and back-fat niboshi soy sauce; open 10:30-14:00 and 17:00-19:30, closed Tuesdays.

food.name: Ramen Gekijo Ore Style
food.description: Ramen shop using a double soup of chicken stock and seafood; open 7:00-14:00 and 17:00-20:00, closed Mondays and during winter.

food.name: Fukinoto Restaurant
food.name_ja: お食事処 ふきのとう
food.description: Soba restaurant attached to Yu-Park Yakushi day-trip hot spring, serving home-grown 100% buckwheat soba (zaru, tororo, oroshi); weekdays 11:00-14:00, weekends and holidays 11:00-19:30, closed Wednesdays.

food.name: Shokudo Ogawara
food.description: Chinese restaurant serving ramen, noodle dishes and fried rice; open 11:00-14:00 and 17:00-20:00, closed Tuesdays and the third Monday.

food.name: Namasoba Komatsuya
food.description: Soba and udon shop serving a soba-and-udon set, with Hokkaido buckwheat stone-milled a little coarsely in the shop and slightly thick soba, open 11:00-14:00 and 17:00-18:30 and closed Wednesdays.

food.name: Tochio Mata Onsen Jizai-kan
food.name_ja: 栃尾又温泉 自在館

food.name: ORANGE Kitchen
food.description: Kitchen car from Irihirose serving dondon-yaki (Kansai-style okonomiyaki) with a choice of toppings; it travels to events in Niigata Prefecture and the menu changes with events.

food.name: Ichibaya
food.description: Onigiri shop next to Koide Fish Market serving rice balls, seafood soup, pork soup, fried Kogane mochi and Tochio aburaage; 15 eat-in seats, usually open 10:00-15:00, closed irregularly.

food.name: Shunshokuya Koshu
food.description: Kappo restaurant serving seasonal dishes, with kaiseki courses by reservation; open 17:00-23:00, closed Mondays.

food.name: Miyuki no Sato
food.description: Restaurant serving local cuisine with Uonuma products, including Koshihikari rice and kenchin-jiru, plus noodles; open 11:00-14:00 (varies by season and day), closed irregularly.

food.name: Marukichi Shokudo
food.description: Diner in the Oritate Onsen area serving home-grown Koshihikari rice; open 17:00-23:00 (last order 22:30), closed Wednesdays.

food.name: Cafeteria Matsuzakaya
food.description: Traditional cafeteria at Oyu Onsen serving rice bowls and ramen; open 11:00-20:00, closed Thursdays.

food.name: Bento Shop Omomo
food.name_ja: 和洋酒・惣菜・弁当専門 おおもも
food.description: Shop for liquor, prepared foods and bento with 15-20 seats, offering homemade boxed meals and local dishes; open 7:00-19:00 (side dishes 11:00-19:00), closed Tuesdays except holidays.

food.name: Ginzan Chaya
food.description: Serves seasonal vegetables, mountain vegetables, mushrooms and prefecture-produced fresh fish with alcohol; open 11:30-13:30 and 17:00-22:30, closed Sundays and public holidays.

food.name: Umenoya
food.description: Restaurant serving meals for banquets, celebrations, memorial services and reunions, plus boxed meals; open 11:00-22:00 by reservation, irregular closures, 150 seats and private rooms.

food.name: Nihon Ryori Inaho
food.description: Japanese restaurant serving kaiseki, sushi and soba made with 100% buckwheat flour; open 11:00-13:30 and 17:00-21:00, closed every Monday.

food.name: Horinouchi Yanaba
food.description: Ayu, iwana and yamame restaurant operating since the Edo period; salt-grilled yamame, salt-grilled iwana and ayu set meals are served, open 9:00-16:00.

sights.name: Uehara Cosmos Garden
sights.description: A highland cosmos garden in Uonuma where flowers cover the plateau, overlooking Doko Highland fields and distant Mount Gongendo and the Echigo Sanzan.

sights.name: Shiori Pass
sights.description: A pass along National Route 352 in Uonuma, where early-morning mist from Oku-Tadami and Ginzan-daira flows over the ridgeline as waterfall clouds.

sights.name: Okutadami Lake
sights.description: Man-made lake in Uonuma, also called Ginzan Lake, with about 600 million tonnes of storage behind the 157-metre Okutadami Dam and sightseeing cruises.

sights.name: Saifuku-ji Temple (Founder's Hall)
sights.description: Soto Zen temple in Uonuma founded in 1534; its founder's hall holds Ishikawa Uncho carvings designated as prefectural cultural properties.

sights.name: Okutadami Lake Sightseeing Cruise
sights.description: Sightseeing cruises on Okutadami Lake, a reservoir storing over 600 million tons, including the 300-passenger paddle steamer Fantasia.

sights.name: Shiori Pass Trailhead (Mount Echigo-Komagatake)
sights.name_ja: 越後駒ヶ岳・枝折峠登山口
sights.description: Trailhead for Mount Echigo-Komagatake, a 2,002.7 m peak among Japan's 100 Famous Mountains, with popular flower fields near the summit.

sights.name: Takigumo Market in Ginzan-daira
sights.description: A market in Ginzan-daira with four to six food trucks and craft workshops, beside Hakugin no Yu, which offers morning baths on market days.

sights.name: Rokujurigoe Pass
sights.description: A mountain pass on National Route 252 linking Niigata and Fukushima, where drivers see spring greenery, mountain cherries, autumn foliage, and the parallel JR Tadami Line.

sights.name: Ginzan-daira
sights.description: Highland area popular for climbing Mount Echigo-Komagatake and fishing at Okutadami Lake, with spring skiing, autumn foliage, beech walks, and hot springs.

sights.name: Eirinji Temple
sights.description: Eirinji Temple is a Soto Zen temple founded over 500 years ago that holds over 100 Ishikawa Uncho carvings and served Matsudaira lords.

sights.name: Echigo Yukikura-kan (Snow Sake Storehouse)
sights.description: Sake storehouse in Uonuma that stores sake using snow, with free guided tours and tastings.

sights.name: Meguro Residence
sights.description: Nationally designated Important Cultural Property built in 1797 as a wealthy farmer's house and village official residence, retaining storehouses and an Edo-period garden.

sights.name: Uono River
sights.description: River in Uonuma with views of the Echigo Sanzan mountains, summer sweetfish fishing, and autumn salmon runs.

sights.name: Mount Arasawa (Ginzandaira Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 荒沢岳・銀山平登山口
sights.description: A 1,969 m peak and one of Japan's 200 famous mountains, with chain and ladder sections suited to experienced climbers.

sights.name: Koide Park
sights.description: Hillside park in Uonuma covering 10 hectares, with seasonal flowers, paths to the summit, views of Echigo Sanzan, and a dog run opened in 2026.

sights.name: Uonuma Jozo
sights.description: Fermentation factory in Uonuma producing rice koji and amazake, with reservation tours and an on-site cafe.

sights.name: Enpuku-ji Temple
sights.description: Ancient temple in Uonuma founded in the Nara period, preserving early Kamakura Buddhist statues and a Kyoto-style garden from 1704.

sights.name: Snow Cherry Blossoms at Fukuyama Pass
sights.name_en: Snow Cherry Blossoms at Fukuyama Pass
sights.description: About 100 cherry trees, including Somei-Yoshino and Oyama-zakura, bloom on remaining snow at Fukuyama Pass in Uonuma.

sights.name: Aburuma River Valley
sights.name_ja: 破間川渓谷（あぶるまがわけいこく）
sights.description: A hidden autumn-foliage valley near the Uonuma–Fukushima border, with primeval beech forest, maples, and wheelchair-accessible boardwalks by the Asakusayama Foothills Eco-Museum.

sights.name: Fukuyama Pass Hometown Plaza
sights.name_ja: 福山峠のふるさと広場
sights.description: Outdoor experience site at Fukuyama Pass for camping, charcoal making, soba making, and fishing, next to a snow-storage cellar.

sights.name: Hibiki-no-Mori Park (Okutadami Recreation Urban Park)
sights.name_ja: 奥只見レクリエーション都市公園 響きの森公園
sights.description: A 28.7-hectare park in Uonuma with the concept of a snow-country music forest, including a snow colosseum, culture hall, and visitor center.

sights.name: Sato House
sights.description: A sturdy farmhouse in Uonuma, built in 1738, typical of snow-country houses.

sights.name: Gongendo Mountain (Nagamatsu Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 権現堂山・長松登山口
sights.description: A 998-meter beginner hike in Uonuma, about 3 hours 10 minutes to the summit, with June rhododendrons and azaleas and autumn foliage.

sights.name: Aburumagawa Dam Snow Flow
sights.description: In spring, meltwater raises Aburumagawa Dam faster than the snow melts, so snow masses float on the surface like drift ice.

sights.name: Uono River Cherry Blossom Embankment
sights.description: About 230 cherry trees line roughly 2 km along the Uono River, a Niigata health walking route with views of the Echigo Sanzan.

sights.name: Hiragatake (Takanosu Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 平ヶ岳・鷹ノ巣登山口
sights.description: Trailhead for 2,140 m Hiragatake in the Yunotani district of Uonuma; an advanced July–November hike of about 6.5 hours to summit wetlands and egg-shaped stones.

sights.name: Mount Asakusa (Mujinazawa Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 浅草岳・ムジナ沢登山口
sights.description: A 1,586 m peak in Echigo Sanzan-Tadami Quasi-National Park and one of Japan's 300 famous mountains, where rare himesayuri lilies bloom near the summit around July.

sights.name: Togakushi Shrine
sights.description: Togakushi Shrine is a quiet shrine among dense cedars, said to date from 1583 and revered by farmers as a harvest deity.

sights.name: Machi-no-Eki Uonuma (Local Specialties Shop)
sights.description: Uonuma community shop opened in May 2024, selling local specialties and serving rice-flour chiffon cake and strawberry milk at Nou Cafe Lily.

sights.name: Miya Shuji Memorial Museum
sights.description: Memorial museum in Uonuma for tanka poet Miya Shuji, displaying his belongings and about 300 materials related to his teacher Kitahara Hakushu.

sights.name: Echigo Herb Garden Irihirose
sights.name_ja: 越後ハーブ香園入広瀬
sights.description: Campsite in Uonuma with auto sites, herb, lavender, rose and rock gardens, a grass soccer field, tennis courts and barbecue space.

sights.name: Uonuma City Natural Science Museum (House of Stars)
sights.name_en: Uonuma City Natural Science Museum (House of Stars)
sights.name_ja: 魚沼市自然科学館 星の家
sights.description: A natural science museum at 555 meters elevation with a 400mm reflecting telescope dome, hosting stargazing sessions from May to October.

sights.name: Mount Sumon
sights.description: A 1,538-meter peak in Uonuma within Echigo Sanzan-Tadami Quasi-National Park, counted among Japan’s 200 Famous Mountains.

sights.name: Aoshima Education Shrine
sights.description: Shrine to Sugawara no Michizane in Aoshima, built in 1993 for children's growth and academic success, with a large zelkova associated with Nitta Yoshisada.

sights.name: Hirose Yana (Fish Trap)
sights.description: A seasonal fish trap on the clear Aburuma River, a fish-rich tributary of the Uono River, where visitors can eat sweetfish dishes.

sights.name: Zazenso Colony
sights.description: Zazenso colony in Uonuma, an aroid named for resembling meditating Daruma, with thousands of plants and mizubasho also visible.

sights.name: Hayatsu Gallery
sights.description: Gallery in Uonuma of artist Hayatsu, who paints rarely seen snow-country folk houses, with about 20 oil and ink works always displayed.

sights.name: Oda Bracken Village (Mountain Vegetable Picking)
sights.description: Visitors pick mountain vegetables in snowy Uonuma, including on flat ground for adults and children, and guides explain how to eat them.

sights.name: Okutadami Electric Power Museum
sights.description: A museum for learning about Okutadami Dam, power generation, nature, and energy, with LED displays, Otori Dam trick art, and an AR dam app.

sights.name: Yunotani Handmade Village
sights.description: Local-products shop and restaurant in Uonuma selling wild-vegetable foods, rice mochi, tofu, and sweets.

sights.name: Sari River
sights.description: Clear stream in Uonuma flowing into the Uono River, visited by anglers for char and cherry salmon.

sights.name: Koide Park Katakuri Colony
sights.name_ja: 小出公園カタクリ群生地
sights.description: Katakuri grow in colonies on Koide Park’s slope and near the third lift, with cherry blossoms and views of Echigo Sanzan and Uonuma.

sights.name: Autumn Cosmos Walk
sights.name_ja: 秋のコスモスウォーク
sights.description: Autumn day-trip walk to a cosmos garden, with new Koshihikari onigiri, a sweets stop, and a bath at Kamiyu Onsen.

sights.name: Oze Pass (Transit Ticket)
sights.name_ja: 尾瀬パス～トランジットチケット～
sights.description: Combined ticket from Uonuma that prepays the lake cruise and shared bus to Oze, a wetland designated a special natural monument and quasi-national park.

sights.name: Nunobiki Falls
sights.description: A 30-meter waterfall reached in 30 minutes on foot from the Ohara trailhead of Mount Sumon.

sights.name: Negoya Flowers, Greenery and Snow Village
sights.name_en: Negoya Flowers, Greenery and Snow Village
sights.name_ja: 奥只見レクリエーション都市公園 根小屋（ねごや）花と緑と雪の里
sights.description: Park area in Uonuma where 10,000 moss phlox bloom in spring and fireflies live by an entrance stream, with a free mid-June viewing event.

sights.name: Oze National Park
sights.description: Designated in 2007, it includes Ozegahara, a 1,400 m high moor about 6 km by 3 km with skunk cabbage, daylilies, and other alpine plants.

sights.name: Uonuma City Historical Museum
sights.description: History museum in Uonuma with a permanent display of about 550 artifacts covering local history from the Paleolithic to the present.

sights.name: Oritate Shaka Hall Wart Spring
sights.name_ja: 折立釈迦堂の疣水（しゃかどうのいぼみず）
sights.description: Clear spring at a Shaka hall overlooking Route 352 and Mt. Echigo-Komagatake, linked to a legend of curing warts; currently not flowing.

sights.name: Nakaarasawa Perennial Snow
sights.description: Perennial snow at Nakaarasawa appears about 40 minutes from the trailhead; Honjo Falls may be visible in late August as the snow melts.

sights.name: Fixed-Fare Sightseeing Taxi: Niigata–Uonuma Tour (from Urasa Station)
sights.name_en: Fixed-Fare Sightseeing Taxi: Niigata–Uonuma Tour (from Urasa Station)
sights.name_ja: 定額観光タクシー 新潟･魚沼観光めぐり（浦佐駅発）
sights.description: Reserved fixed-fare taxi from Urasa Station visiting temples that display works by Ishikawa Uncho on two- or three-hour courses.

sights.name: Natural Maple Sap Collection Snowshoe Tour
sights.name_en: Natural Maple Sap Collection Snowshoe Tour
sights.name_ja: 春の息吹のおすそわけ 天然のメイプルサップ採取スノーシューツアー
sights.description: Snowshoe at Echigo Herb Garden to collect sap from wild itaya maples and taste it as herb tea.

sights.name: Mount Onigamen
sights.description: A 1,465 m peak for advanced hikers, about 4 hours 30 minutes from the Rokujurigoe trailhead between June and November, with no mountain hut.

sights.name: Autumn Gourmet Onigiri Walk
sights.name_ja: 秋のごちそうおにぎりウォーク
sights.description: A walk to Echigo Herb Garden Irihirose for views and onigiri, with herb tea, a Juwa Onsen bath, and a Tadami Line ride.

sights.name: Sanjo Falls
sights.description: A 73-meter waterfall on the Niigata-Fukushima border along the Tadami River, selected among Japan's 100 waterfalls, with a viewing platform.

sights.name: Echigo Herb Kōen Irihirose Aroma Bath Bomb Making (1 Piece)
sights.name_en: Echigo Herb Kōen Irihirose Aroma Bath Bomb Making (1 Piece)
sights.name_ja: お好きな香りでリフレッシュ！入浴剤作り（1個）
sights.description: Make one original aroma bath bomb with your choice of essential oil in about 30 minutes and take it home the same day.

sights.name: Echigo Herb Garden Irihirose (Original Soap Making)
sights.name_en: Echigo Herb Garden Irihirose (Original Soap Making)
sights.name_ja: 好きな香りと色を自分でチョイス！オリジナル石けん作り
sights.description: Make a gentle handmade soap by choosing a scent from various essential oils, for hands and face, and take it home the same day.

sights.name: Hiraname Falls
sights.description: Water flows over a single granite slab about 500 meters long, viewed from the hiking trail, and it is paired with Sanjo Falls on the Oze route.

stays.name: Oze Jujo
stays.name_ja: 10 stories hotel Oze 尾瀬十帖
stays.description: Hotel in Uonuma, Niigata.

stays.name: Gensen Yu no Yado Kairi
stays.name_ja: 源泉湯の宿 かいり
stays.description: Inn at Echigooyu Onsen in Oyuonsen, Uonuma.

stays.name: Tomo Ie Hotel
stays.name_ja: 友家ホテル
stays.description: Hotel at Uonumashidaiyu Onsen in Oyuonsen, Uonuma.

stays.name: Koide Hotel Okabe
stays.name_ja: 小出ホテルオカベ
stays.description: Hotel in Yokka, Uonuma with breakfast available and Wi-Fi.

stays.name: Shiki no Sato Kusurishi Onsen Yamabiko-so
stays.name_en: Shiki no Sato Kusurishi Onsen Yamabiko-so
stays.name_ja: 四季の郷 薬師温泉 やまびこ荘
stays.description: Inn at Kusurishi Onsen in Nanokaichi, Uonuma; 7-minute drive from Uonuma IC.

stays.name: Echigo Okutadami Sato Kami Yu Onsen Kurabu
stays.name_en: Echigo Okutadami Sato Kami Yu Onsen Kurabu
stays.name_ja: 越後・奥只見郷 神湯温泉倶楽部
stays.description: Inn at Kamiyu Onsen in Kiyomoto, Uonuma.

stays.name: Jihe
stays.name_ja: 治兵衛
stays.description: Inn in Suhara, Uonuma with local cuisine.

stays.name: Minshuku Konishiya
stays.name_ja: 民宿 小西屋
stays.description: Minshuku in Uonuma, Niigata.

stays.name: Yunotani Onsenkyo Hotel Yunotani-so
stays.name_ja: 湯の谷温泉郷 ホテルゆのたに荘
stays.description: Inn at Yunotani Onsen in Shimoritate, Uonuma with ski access.

stays.name: Oritate Onsen Hotel Sakaeya
stays.name_ja: 折立温泉 ホテルさかえや
stays.description: Hotel at Oritate Onsen in Shimoritate, Uonuma.

stays.name: Oritate Onsen Ryokan Choja
stays.name_ja: 折立温泉 旅館長者
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Oritate Onsen in Shimoritate, Uonuma with free-flowing hot spring baths.

stays.name: Oritate Onsen Yamakiya Ryokan
stays.name_ja: 折立温泉 やまきや旅館
stays.description: Ryokan inn at Oritate Onsen in Shimoritate, Uonuma.

stays.name: Pension Duke
stays.name_ja: ペンション デューク
stays.description: Pension with a hot spring bath in Oyu Onsen, Uonuma.

stays.name: Echigo Oyu Onsen Hotel Yumoto
stays.name_ja: 越後大湯温泉 ホテル湯元【伊東園ホテルズ】
stays.description: Hot spring hotel with a large rock bath, open-air bath, and all-you-can-drink buffet in Kamioritate, Uonuma.

stays.name: Kozanso
stays.name_ja: 湖山荘
stays.description: Hot spring inn in Shimooritate, Uonuma, with Japanese-Western rooms.

stays.name: Okutadami Sanso
stays.name_ja: 奥只見山荘
stays.description: Mountain inn in Shimooritate, Uonuma, with a natural hot-spring open-air bath.

stays.name: Dennosuke Koya
stays.name_ja: 伝之助小屋
stays.description: Inn with a natural hot spring bath in Utsuno, Uonuma.

stays.name: Nature College Midori no Gakuen
stays.name_ja: ネイチャーカレッジ緑の学園
stays.description: Mountain inn in Yunotani, Uonuma, with a 10-tatami Japanese room, air conditioning, and TV.

day_to_day.name: Bunsuidō Confectionery (Panda-yaki)
day_to_day.name_ja: 分水堂菓子舗 パンダ焼き
day_to_day.description: Yahiko confectioner selling panda-shaped rice-flour cakes filled with local edamame paste, a 2010 national snack award winner.

day_to_day.name: Yahiko Tourism Volunteer Guide
day_to_day.name_ja: 彌彦観光ぼらんてぃあガイド
day_to_day.description: Volunteer guides lead individuals and small groups of about 15 around Yahiko Shrine grounds, explaining power spots with local stories.

activities.name: Yahiko Chrysanthemum Festival
activities.name_ja: 弥彦菊まつり
activities.description: Autumn chrysanthemum exhibition at Yahiko Shrine, with judged blooms and a themed flower bed of 30,000 small chrysanthemums.

activities.name: Sakura no Yu (Yahiko Sakurai-go Onsen)
activities.name_ja: やひこ桜井郷温泉 さくらの湯
activities.description: Day-visit hot spring at the foot of Mount Yahiko, with a free-flowing outdoor bath and a bedrock bath.

activities.name: Yahiko Onsen
activities.name_ja: 弥彦湯神社温泉（弥彦温泉郷）
activities.description: Alkaline simple hot-spring village in the temple town of Yahiko Shrine, known for skin-beautifying waters and seasonal views.

activities.name: Yahiko Sake Brewery (Yahiko Kiwami)
activities.name_ja: 弥彦酒造（株）
activities.description: Sake brewery in Yahiko Village, founded in 1838, that hand-brews small winter batches using only Mount Yahiko underground water.

activities.name: Yahiko Onsen Firefly Viewing
activities.name_ja: 弥彦温泉 ホタル観賞
activities.description: Fireflies around Yahiko Onsen are viewed mainly in residential areas, with no special tourist setup; visitors should mind neighbors and traffic.

food.name: Yahiko Omiyage Tokoro Nishizawa Shoten
food.name_ja: 弥彦おみやげ処 西澤商店

food.name: Yahiko Brewing Taproom
food.name_ja: 弥彦ブリューイング タップルーム

food.name: Kappo Restaurant Yoshida-ya
food.name_ja: 割烹お食事 吉田屋

food.name: Bunsuidou Sweets Shop
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Yahiko, Niigata.

food.name: Narisawa Shoten
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Yahiko, Niigata.

food.name: Kameya
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Yahiko, Niigata.

food.name: Mikasa-ya
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Yahiko, Niigata.

food.name: Nakamura-ya
food.description: Japanese sweets shop in Yahiko, Niigata.

sights.name: Yahiko Shrine
sights.name_ja: 越後一宮 彌彦神社
sights.description: Niigata’s representative shrine, long revered as Echigo Ichinomiya, known for a rare two-bow, four-clap rite and matchmaking blessings.

sights.name: Yahiko Park
sights.description: Natural park beside JR Yahiko Station, developed as Yahiko Shrine’s outer garden, with waterfalls, a Taisho-era tunnel, and the vermilion Kangetsu Bridge.

sights.name: Mount Yahiko
sights.description: A 634-meter mountain in Yahiko with hiking trails and a ropeway, offering views of the Echigo Plain, the Sea of Japan, and Sado Island.

sights.name: Yahiko Park Momiji Valley Light-up
sights.name_ja: 弥彦公園もみじ谷ライトアップ
sights.description: Illumination of Yahiko Park's Momiji Valley, the vermilion Kangetsu Bridge, and a ginkgo over 300 years old and 20 metres high, from early to mid-November.

sights.name: Mount Yahiko Skyline
sights.description: A roughly 16.8 km drive toward Mount Yahiko's summit, with a 100 m revolving Panorama Tower overlooking the Echigo Plain, Sea of Japan, and Sado Island.

sights.name: Mount Yahiko Ropeway
sights.description: Ropeway to the 634 m summit of Mount Yahiko in about five minutes, with views of the Echigo Plain and the Sea of Japan.

sights.name: Mt. Yahiko (Yahiko Shrine Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 弥彦山・彌彦神社登山口
sights.description: Sacred mountain of Echigo Ichinomiya worshipped since the Manyo period; a beginner trail from Yahiko Shrine reaches the 634 m summit in about 90 minutes.

sights.name: Yahiko Summit Park
sights.description: Summit park at Yahiko's ninth station, with a roughly 100-metre rotating Panorama Tower overlooking the Sea of Japan and Sado.

sights.name: Mount Yahiko Opening Ceremony
sights.description: Public climb of Mount Yahiko starts after a purification rite at Yahiko Shrine; watch for remaining snow.

sights.name: Great Torii (Yahiko)
sights.description: A 30.16-metre ryobu torii built in 1982 to mark the Joetsu Shinkansen opening, modeled on Yahiko Shrine's first torii.

sights.name: Yahiko Shrine Onikkusai (Morning Offering Ceremony)
sights.name_ja: 越後一宮 彌彦神社「御日供祭（おにっくさい）」
sights.description: A daily 7 a.m. rite at Yahiko Shrine offering rice, sake, and salt; visitors may attend and receive offered rice.

sights.name: Yahiko Shrine Summit Sanctuary
sights.description: Summit sanctuary of Yahiko Shrine enshrining Ame-no-Kagoyama-no-Mikoto and his consort, with 360-degree views of Sado, the Echigo Plain, and the Noto Peninsula.

sights.name: Tohashira Shrine Hall (Yahiko Shrine)
sights.name_ja: 彌彦神社境内末社十柱神社社殿
sights.description: Subsidiary shrine hall at Yahiko Shrine, donated in 1694 by Nagaoka lord Makino Tadatsune, with late Momoyama-period styling.

sights.name: Yahiko YY Park
sights.description: Mixed clothed sauna in Yahiko with automatic löyly every 30 minutes, a cold-water slide pool, outdoor bathing at the foot of Mt. Yahiko, and glamping.

sights.name: Mount Yahiko Observation Building
sights.description: Observation restaurant at the ninth station of Mount Yahiko, overlooking the Echigo Plain, the Sea of Japan, and Sado.

sights.name: Manyo Path
sights.description: A path from Yahiko Shrine to the Yahiko Ropeway foothill station, displaying over 60 Manyoshu plants native to Mount Yahiko with their poems.

sights.name: Former Takeishi Family Residence
sights.description: About 300-year-old thatched hip-roofed farmhouse showing a typical mid-Edo farmer's home; the main house is a village-designated cultural property.

sights.name: Gyokuto (Rabbit-shaped Confection)
sights.description: Traditional rabbit-shaped powdered sweet from Yahiko, also offered at Yahiko Shrine, with a light texture and faint sweetness.

sights.name: Yahiko Octopus Zelkova
sights.description: At Sumiyoshi Shrine in Yahiko, a zelkova over 1,000 years old, 30 meters tall and 8 meters around, is named for its octopus-like branches.

sights.name: Great Ginkgo of Yahiko
sights.description: A roughly 300-year-old ginkgo near Omotenashi Square in Yahiko Onsen turns gold in autumn and has been illuminated at night since 2023.

sights.name: Yahiko Shrine Treasure Hall
sights.description: Treasure hall on the Yahiko Shrine grounds, displaying modern art by local artists and shrine treasures, including the 2.2 m Shida Odachi.

sights.name: Basho Haiku Monument
sights.description: Haiku monument in the grounds of Hoko-in inscribed with Basho's poem about the rough sea stretching toward Sado.

sights.name: Baba Cedar of Yahiko
sights.description: A cedar in Yahiko said to be 1,000 years old, 40 meters tall and over 10 meters around, linked to a legend of a reformed demon hag.

sights.name: Yu Shrine (Ishi Yakushi)
sights.description: A subsidiary shrine outside Yahiko Shrine's grounds, on Gotenyama's mid-slope, enshrining hot-spring and medicine deities linked to healing and prosperity.

sights.name: Kurotaki Castle Ruins
sights.description: Medieval fortress of the Echigo Uesugi clan on the Hokuriku road, important in the Otate Rebellion that aided Uesugi Kagekatsu's victory.

sights.name: Yahiko Shrine Sacred Grove
sights.description: Visitors can walk the Man'yo Path through Yahiko Shrine's sacred grove, where about 60 plants named in the Man'yoshu grow among old cedars and zelkova.

sights.name: Mt. Yahiko Night View and Starry Sky Cruise
sights.name_en: Mt. Yahiko Night View and Starry Sky Cruise
sights.name_ja: 弥彦山 夜景＆星空クルーズ
sights.description: A night ropeway to the 634 m summit of Mt. Yahiko for Echigo Plain night views, Sea of Japan fishing fires, and stars.

sights.name: Sakaya Yayoi Tasting Room
sights.name_ja: 酒屋やよい テイスティングルーム
sights.description: A tasting room in a 200-year-old folk house restored by German architect Karl Bengs, serving Niigata sake from 400 yen with views of Yahiko Shrine.

sights.name: Yahiko Shrine Cherry Garden
sights.description: Cherry blossom garden at Yahiko Shrine where over 50 varieties, from Somei Yoshino to May double blossoms, flower in succession for about a month.

sights.name: Mt. Yahiko (Hachimaizawa Trailhead, Chubu-Hokuriku Nature Trail)
sights.name_en: Mt. Yahiko (Hachimaizawa Trailhead, Chubu-Hokuriku Nature Trail)
sights.name_ja: 弥彦山・八枚沢登山口・中部北陸自然歩道
sights.description: Beginner trail on sacred Mt. Yahiko from Hachimaizawa passes flower colonies to the deity’s mausoleum, about 90 minutes to the 634 m summit.

sights.name: Kikyo Castle Ruins
sights.description: Ruins of Kikyo Castle, said to have been built in 1055 by Yoshikawa Munekata under Minamoto no Yorimitsu and never rebuilt after 1597.

sights.name: Yahiko Summit Museum
sights.description: Museum displaying insects and plants that live on Mount Yahiko.

sights.name: Yahagi Twin Pines
sights.description: Twin pines in Yahagi, about 700 years old, 10 meters tall and 6 meters around, where Yoshitsune and Benkei are said to have rested in 1187.

sights.name: Mikopyon-go Autonomous Bus Experience Event
sights.name_ja: 自動運転バス「ミコぴょん号」まるわかり特別体験会
sights.description: Free, reservation-only session at Yahiko Village Office where elementary and junior high students learn bus autonomy, obstacle detection, and try simple operation.

stays.name: Yahiko Onsen Shiki no Yado Minoya
stays.name_en: Yahiko Onsen Shiki no Yado Minoya
stays.name_ja: 弥彦温泉 四季の宿 みのや
stays.description: Inn at Yahiko Onsen in Yahiko with open-air baths and scenic views.

stays.name_ja: 旅館 冥加屋ハウス
stays.description: Ryokan inn in Yahiko with Wi-Fi; 1-minute drive from Yahiko Station.

stays.name_ja: 弥彦温泉 割烹の宿 櫻家
stays.description: Inn at Yahiko Onsen in Yahiko; 1-minute walk from Nigataken2Kuraijusho!>>Yahiko Station.

stays.name_ja: 弥彦温泉 お宿 だいろく
stays.description: Inn at Yahiko Onsen in Yahiko.

stays.name_ja: 弥彦館 冥加屋
stays.description: Inn at Shinise Onsen in Yahiko with pet-friendly rooms.

stays.description: Inn at Yahiko Onsen in Yahiko.

stays.name_ja: やひこＹＹＰａｒｋ
stays.description: Inn in Yahiko with a sauna.

stays.name: Wanko To Tomaru Inn Joshuen
stays.name_ja: わんこと泊まる宿 上州苑
stays.description: Inn in Yahiko, Niigata.

day_to_day.name: Mitsumata Roadside Station
day_to_day.name_ja: 道の駅「みつまた」
day_to_day.description: Roadside station in Yuzawa modeled on the prefecture-designated Ikeda family residence, with local produce, souvenirs, outdoor goods, a restaurant, a café, and a foot bath.

activities.name: Yuzawa Kogen Panorama Park (Yuzawa Kogen Ski Resort)
activities.name_en: Yuzawa Kogen Panorama Park (Yuzawa Kogen Ski Resort)
activities.name_ja: 湯沢高原パノラマパーク（湯沢高原スキー場）
activities.description: Highland park at about 1,000 m in Yuzawa, reached by a 1,300 m ropeway, with mountain views, a foot bath, and gardens.

activities.name: Akayu Onsen Yamaguchi-kan
activities.name_ja: 赤湯温泉 山口館
activities.description: Remote hot-spring inn at the fifth station southeast of Mt. Naeba (2,145 m), reached by a two-and-a-half-hour hike, with three spring baths.

activities.name: Daigenta Lake
activities.name_ja: 大源太湖
activities.description: Vast lake formed by Japan's first arch dam on the Daigenta River, ringed by mountains and seasonal scenery.

activities.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Onsen
activities.name_ja: 越後湯沢温泉
activities.description: Hot spring area in Yuzawa, setting of Yasunari Kawabata's Snow Country, with six public baths and ski resorts within walking distance of the station.

activities.name: 2026 Yuzawa Nakazato Autumn Festival
activities.name_ja: ２０２６ 湯沢中里秋祭り
activities.description: Autumn festival in Yuzawa with local food and product sales, new Koshihikari rice tastings, a children's stamp rally, and pony feeding.

activities.name: Naeba Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 苗場スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort in Yuzawa with 24 courses, two snow parks and three gondolas on about 134 hectares, including a World Cup slope.

activities.name: Yuzawa Kogen Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 湯沢高原スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort in Yuzawa with a 166-person ropeway, family slopes, and a 5 km downhill from the summit.

activities.name: GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: GALA湯沢スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort beside Yuzawa Station, open through Golden Week, with beginner-to-advanced runs and an on-site hot spring.

activities.name: 11th Iiji Mountain Climbing Festival
activities.name_ja: 第11回 飯士登山祭
activities.description: Cleanup hike on 1,111 m Mount Iiji from the mid-slope of Iwappara Ski Resort in Yuzawa; the fiscal 2026 event is cancelled.

activities.name: Iwappara Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 岩原スキー場
activities.description: Ski resort in Yuzawa, about 1.5 hours from Tokyo by shinkansen, with 20 courses and views of the Tanigawa range.

activities.name: Kagura Ski Resort (Kagura and Mitsumata Areas)
activities.name_en: Kagura Ski Resort (Kagura and Mitsumata Areas)
activities.name_ja: かぐらスキー場（かぐら・みつまたエリア）
activities.description: The Kagura and Mitsumata areas of Kagura Ski Resort offer views from 1,845 m, steep powder slopes, and a 121-person ropeway.

activities.name: Daigenta Canyon Campground
activities.name_ja: 大源太キャニオンキャンプ場
activities.description: Campsite among mountains and Daigenta Lake in Yuzawa, with summer kayaking, stream cooling, and craft activities.

activities.name: Shirataki Sake Brewery
activities.name_ja: 白瀧酒造株式会社
activities.description: Sake brewery in Yuzawa known for Jozen Mizunogotoshi, offering showroom tastings and reserved tours from November through March.

activities.name: Yumoto Communal Bath (Yama no Yu)
activities.name_ja: 湯元共同浴場 「山の湯」
activities.description: The oldest communal bath in Echigo-Yuzawa, near the inn where Yasunari Kawabata wrote Snow Country and is said to have bathed.

activities.name: Kagura Ski Resort (Tashiro Area)
activities.name_ja: かぐらスキー場（田代エリア）
activities.description: Ski area in Yuzawa’s Tashiro highlands with Nordic-style views, gentle slopes, and a longest run of 2,100 metres.

activities.name: Shimo-Yuzawa Communal Bathhouse Komako no Yu
activities.name_en: Shimo-Yuzawa Communal Bathhouse Komako no Yu
activities.name_ja: 下湯沢共同浴場 「駒子の湯」
activities.description: Communal bathhouse named after Komako from the novel Snow Country, with a tub for about 15 people, a display corner, and a small rest room.

activities.name: Akihayama Snowshoe Experience
activities.name_ja: 秋葉山スノーシュー体験
activities.description: A guided snowshoe tour a 10-minute walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station, through snowy forest in search of animal tracks.

activities.name: Tsuchitaru Public Bath (Iwa-no-Yu)
activities.name_ja: 土樽共同浴場 「岩の湯」
activities.description: Public bath in Tsuchitaru, Yuzawa, with a stone tub for about 15 people, near Yuzawa Fishing Park and ski areas.

activities.name: Snow Tubing, Sledding and Kids' Slope at Yuzawa Kogen Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Snow Tubing, Sledding and Kids' Slope at Yuzawa Kogen Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーチュービング、そり遊び、キッズゲレンデ
activities.description: Yuki Asobi Park at the foot of Yuzawa Kogen Ski Resort offers snow tubing, sledding, a gentle kids' slope, and a snow escalator.

activities.name: Kandatsu Snow Resort
activities.name_ja: 神立スノーリゾート
activities.description: Ski and snowboard resort in Yuzawa with a 3,500-meter run, park, powder and mogul areas, a day-use hot spring, and night skiing.

activities.name: Egami Onsen Bathhouse
activities.name_ja: 江神温泉浴場
activities.description: Hot spring bathhouse in Yuzawa whose tubs are continuously filled with unheated source water and are gentle on the skin.

activities.name: Yuzawa Park Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: 湯沢パークスキー場
activities.description: Hotel-linked ski resort in Yuzawa with beginner, intermediate, and advanced runs, a kids’ snow-play area, and a free shuttle from Echigo-Yuzawa Station.

activities.name: Mitsumata Communal Bath (Kaido no Yu)
activities.name_ja: 三俣共同浴場 「街道の湯」
activities.description: A communal bath surrounded by nature, with a rock open-air bath for about 10 people and a stone indoor bath for about 20.

activities.name: Futai Public Bath (Shukuba-no-Yu)
activities.name_ja: 二居共同浴場 「宿場の湯」
activities.description: Public bath beside a ski area in Yuzawa, with a sauna, a spacious rest area, and a permanent exhibition of children's pictures.

activities.name: Daigenta Experience Workshop
activities.name_ja: 体験工房「大源太」
activities.description: A workshop where visitors can try making soba noodles and sasa dango with guidance from experienced instructors.

activities.name: Yuzawa Nakazato Snow Resort
activities.name_ja: 湯沢中里スノーリゾート
activities.description: Ski resort in front of JR Echigo-Nakazato Station with 17 courses, a kids park, sledding, snow tubing, skiing and snowboarding.

activities.name: Naeba Plateau Auto Campground
activities.name_ja: 苗場高原オートキャンプ場
activities.description: An auto campground at about 900 meters, surrounded by nature near a hotel, also offering glamping.

activities.name: Daigenta Snowshoe and Soba-Making Experience
activities.name_ja: 大源太スノーシューとそば打ち体験
activities.description: A winter activity in the Daigenta area of Yuzawa: snowshoe a quiet snowy forest, then make soba and taste it with freshly fried tempura.

activities.name: Nakazato Snow Wood Ski Area
activities.name_ja: 中里スノーウッドスキー場
activities.description: Forest-surrounded ski area next to Yuzawa Nakazato, five minutes from Echigo-Nakazato Station, with gentle slopes.

activities.name: Moon Bike Tour at GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Moon Bike Tour at GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: ムーンバイクツアー
activities.description: An electric snowmobile, the Moon Bike, carries one rider aged 16 or older through quiet snowy forest at GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort.

activities.name: Asahigama Pottery Workshop
activities.name_ja: 陶芸工房「旭窯」
activities.description: A pottery workshop in Yuzawa where children, beginners, and hobbyists shape clay on a wheel and fire it in a kiln.

activities.name: Snow Cart Tour (GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort)
activities.name_en: Snow Cart Tour (GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort)
activities.name_ja: スノーカートツアー
activities.description: Riders glide down the ski slopes in single-seat electric snow carts, open to ages 12 and up.

activities.name: Snowscoot at Kandatsu Snow Resort
activities.name_ja: スノースクート
activities.description: A bicycle-like snowscoot activity at Kandatsu Snow Resort, easier to balance with handlebars than skiing or snowboarding, with rentals available.

activities.name: Snow Rafting at Naeba Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Snow Rafting at Naeba Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーラフティング
activities.description: At Naeba Ski Resort, a snowmobile pulls a large boat across the snowfield for riders aged three and older.

activities.name: Snowmobile Sled Tour at GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Snowmobile Sled Tour at GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーモービルそりツアー
activities.description: A snowmobile pulls a six-person sled through the snow at GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort for families and young children.

activities.name: Snow Tubing and Sledding at Naeba Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Snow Tubing and Sledding at Naeba Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーチュービング、そり遊び
activities.description: Snow tubing on float-like tubes and sled play in a family snow area at Naeba Ski Resort.

activities.name: Snow Tubing, Balance Bikes, Sledding and Kids' Slope at Yuzawa Nakazato Snow Resort
activities.name_en: Snow Tubing, Balance Bikes, Sledding and Kids' Slope at Yuzawa Nakazato Snow Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーチュービング、ストライダー、そり遊び、キッズゲレンデ
activities.description: Smile Kids Park at Yuzawa Nakazato Snow Resort includes sledding and snow tubing in the entry fee, with a tunneled snow escalator and a separate sled area.

activities.name: Snowmobile Experience at Naeba Ski Resort
activities.name_en: Snowmobile Experience at Naeba Ski Resort
activities.name_ja: スノーモービル
activities.description: Family snowmobile rides at Naeba Ski Resort include a 10-minute course for high-school age and older and guided tours.

activities.name: Daigenta Lake Stand-Up Paddle Experience (Half-Day Course)
activities.name_en: Daigenta Lake Stand-Up Paddle Experience (Half-Day Course)
activities.name_ja: 大源太湖 SUP（スタンドアップパドル）体験（半日コース）
activities.description: A half-day stand-up paddle experience on Daigenta Lake in Yuzawa, with morning or afternoon sessions for elementary-school age and older.

activities.name: Daigenta Lake Kayaking (Half-day Tour)
activities.name_ja: 大源太湖 カヤック体験（半日ツアー）
activities.description: Half-day single-person kayaking on a calm, current-free lake, with child-size boats and participation from elementary first grade.

food.name: Bakudan Onigiri-ya Echigoyuzawa Eki
food.name_ja: 爆弾おにぎり家 越後湯沢驛店

food.name: La Rokanda Deru Pittore
food.name_ja: ラ・ロカンダ・デル・ピットーレ

food.name: Muran Gozzo Cafe
food.name_ja: ムラン ゴッツォ カフェ

food.name: Sake Dokoro Goro
food.description: Dinner-only sake place serving food and local sake; weekdays 17:30-24:00 (L.O. 23:30), weekends 17:00-24:00 (L.O. 23:30), closed Thursdays.

food.name: Karaoke Sunakku Dandan
food.description: Karaoke snack a 5-minute walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station west exit; open 19:00-2:00, closed Mondays.

food.name: Yakigyu
food.description: Uses domestic beef and serves rice and alcohol; dinner 17:00-21:00 (last order 20:30), or 16:30-21:00 in winter, closed Wednesday and Thursday (Wednesday in winter).

food.name: Sumibi Yakitori Ikeya
food.description: Charcoal yakitori restaurant serving sake; summer 18:00-23:00, winter hours planned 17:00-23:00, closed Monday and Thursday.

food.name: Echigo Ishin Yuzawa Main Store
food.name_ja: 越後維新 湯沢本店

food.name: Echigo Tokamachi Kojima-ya Echigoyuzawa
food.name_ja: 越後十日町小嶋屋 越後湯沢店

food.name: Echigo Tsukemen Ishin Yuzawa Gangidori Shop
food.name_en: Echigo Tsukemen Ishin Yuzawa Gangidori Shop
food.name_ja: 越後つけ麺維新 湯沢がんぎどおり店

food.name: Yuzawa Iori
food.description: Standing soba counter in Yuzawa, Niigata.

food.name: Restaurant Yasuyoshi
food.description: Echigo-Yuzawa Onsen dining place serving Uonuma Shiozawa Koshihikari rice, Shiozawa maitake, mountain vegetables and ayu from the Uono River; open 11:00-14:00 and 17:00-21:00, closed Mondays.

food.name: Shokuya Asakusa
food.description: Kamameshi restaurant using 100% Uonuma Koshihikari rice with seasonal Yuzawa ingredients; open 11:30-14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30-23:00 (L.O. 22:00), closed Thursdays with seasonal irregular closures.

food.name: Yuzawa Kamakura Sohonten
food.description: Local-cuisine restaurant a 3-minute walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station west exit, serving local sake; open 11:30-14:00 and 17:00-22:00, closed irregularly.

food.name: Kaisen Doraku Totoya Yuzawa
food.name_ja: 海鮮道楽 ととや 湯沢店

food.name: Kappo Shidashi Kawamura
food.name_ja: 割烹・仕出し かわむら
food.description: Serves meals, banquets and catering, mainly sashimi and Japanese cuisine using tuna from Tsukiji and other Niigata seafood; hours 11:30-14:00 and 17:00-21:00, irregular closing days.

sights.name: Ponshukan Echigo-Yuzawa Station Store
sights.name_ja: ぽんしゅ館 越後湯沢驛店
sights.description: Niigata specialty food shop selling local sake, wine, rice and sweets, with brewery tastings, rice balls and a sake bath.

sights.name: Naeba Dragondola
sights.description: Gondola of 5,481 meters linking Naeba and Tashiro in about 25 minutes, operating for spring greenery, autumn leaves, and winter slope access.

sights.name: Naeba Dragondola & Tashiro Ropeway (Autumn Foliage Season)
sights.name_en: Naeba Dragondola & Tashiro Ropeway (Autumn Foliage Season)
sights.name_ja: 苗場ドラゴンドラ＆田代ロープウェー 紅葉営業
sights.description: During autumn foliage season, the Naeba Dragondola travels 5.5 km with a 425 m elevation change, and the Tashiro Ropeway offers views from 230 m.

sights.name: Takizawa Park (Fudo Falls)
sights.description: Two-tier Fudo Falls beyond Takizawa Park has a 20-meter upper fall that splits into male and female falls and cannot be reached in winter.

sights.name: Kewatasawa Railway Bridge
sights.description: A stone railway bridge near secluded Tsuchitaru Station, 217.4 meters long and more than 10 meters high.

sights.name: Kannakkuri Foot Bath
sights.name_ja: 足湯 かんなっくり
sights.description: Foot bath about a seven-minute walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station, renovated and reopened in 2020 so visitors can rest at leisure.

sights.name: Yuzawa Town History and Folklore Museum (Yukiguni-kan)
sights.name_en: Yuzawa Town History and Folklore Museum (Yukiguni-kan)
sights.name_ja: 湯沢町歴史民俗資料館「雪国館」
sights.description: A museum introducing snow-country life and history in Yuzawa, and the world of Kawabata Yasunari's novel Snow Country.

sights.name: Mount Mikuni (Mikuni Tunnel Yuzawa Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 三国山・三国トンネル湯沢側登山口
sights.description: A 1,636 m mountain on the Joetsu border known for alpine flowers, with a beginner trail of about 1 hour 30 minutes from Mikuni Tunnel.

sights.name: Mount Tairappyo (Tairappyo Trailhead)
sights.description: One of Japan's 100 Famous Flower Mountains, this 1,983 m peak at the western end of the Tanigawa range has alpine flower fields near the summit.

sights.name: Yuzawa Fishing Park
sights.name_ja: 湯沢フィッシングパーク
sights.description: A no-gear stream-fishing spot for char, yamame and rainbow trout, with on-site charcoal grilling, hand catching and barbecue.

sights.name: Private Taxi Charter to Kiyotsukyo Gorge Tunnel
sights.name_en: Private Taxi Charter to Kiyotsukyo Gorge Tunnel
sights.name_ja: 清津峡渓谷トンネルへは楽々貸切りタクシーで
sights.description: A private taxi charter in Yuzawa with local drivers experienced on snowy roads and customizable sightseeing courses.

sights.name: Snow Country Monument
sights.description: A monument in a Yuzawa park is engraved with Yasunari Kawabata's handwriting of the opening line of his novel Snow Country.

sights.name: Mount Naeba (Haraigawa and Motohashi Trailheads)
sights.description: From the 2,145 m summit, a high moor of hundreds of ponds spreads out, with clear-day views toward Mount Fuji, the Northern Alps, and Sado Island.

sights.name: Yuzawa Central Park and Sports Facilities
sights.name_en: Yuzawa Central Park and Sports Facilities
sights.name_ja: 湯沢中央公園＆スポーツ施設
sights.description: A park with an athletics field, baseball ground, tennis courts and leisure pool, plus spring cherry blossoms and autumn ginkgo.

sights.name: Yamadorihara Park
sights.description: A nature park with a wildflower garden, birch and azalea forest, a stone path recreating the old Mikuni Road, and a stream fishing area.

sights.name: Ipponsugi Snow Park
sights.description: Snow park in Yuzawa that uses a snow escalator instead of lifts, with separate ski and sled areas on a gentle slope of about 60 metres.

sights.name: Daigenta Canyon Forty-Eight Falls
sights.name_ja: 大源太キャニオン 四十八滝
sights.description: A waterfall formed by clear water from Lake Daigenta, viewed from an observation deck looking down on the stream, and recommended in spring and autumn.

sights.name: Yukiguni Agri Park Yuzawa Strawberry Village
sights.name_en: Yukiguni Agri Park Yuzawa Strawberry Village
sights.name_ja: 雪国アグリパーク 湯沢いちご村
sights.description: Strawberry-picking greenhouse in Yuzawa where visitors can pick Echigo-hime strawberries grown through heavy snow, even on snowy or rainy days.

sights.name: Ikeda Family Waki-Honjin (Mikuni Kaido)
sights.name_ja: 三国街道脇本陣跡 池田家
sights.description: This prefectural cultural property is the only surviving Edo-period waki-honjin at Mitsumata-juku, with rooms where high-ranking guests stayed.

sights.name: GALA YUZAWA MOUNTAIN FIELD
sights.description: Activity area in Yuzawa with a panorama coaster, a giant electric seesaw, mountain-cart courses, and Obon night events including gondolas and fireworks.

sights.name: NASPA Ski Garden
sights.description: Skier-only ski area in Yuzawa with eight courses, a longest run of nearly 2,200 metres, and a direct link to NASPA New Otani.

sights.name: Asagai Skunk Cabbage Colony
sights.description: About 20,000 white skunk cabbage plants grow across 1,260 square meters near Naeba Ski Resort, visible from the Naeba Independence Boardwalk from late April to mid-May.

sights.name: Aurora Leisure Pool
sights.name_ja: レジャープール「オーロラ」
sights.description: Leisure pool in Yuzawa with one indoor and one outdoor flowing pool, plus water slides for families.

sights.name: Naeba Boardwalk Camp
sights.name_ja: 苗場ボードウォークキャンプ
sights.description: Volunteer program maintaining the Naeba Boardwalk, Japan's second wooden path, built by hand since 2002 to allow wheelchair nature walks.

sights.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Snowshoe Tour (Night Course)
sights.name_ja: 越後湯沢スノーシューツアーNightコース
sights.description: Night snowshoe walk from Echigo-Yuzawa Station’s west exit across moonlit snowfields, with starts from 6 to 8 p.m.

sights.name: NASPA CAMP GARDEN
sights.description: Campground at NASPA New Otani in Yuzawa with glamping sites, free tent sites, an RV park, and use of the hotel hot-spring baths.

sights.name: Tashiro Ropeway
sights.description: A 2,175-metre ropeway in Yuzawa with 230 metres of ground clearance, reaching a summit station overlooking Lake Tashiro and Mount Naeba.

sights.name: Yuzawa Kogen Summer Fair
sights.name_ja: 湯沢高原サマーフェア
sights.description: Summer fair at Yuzawa Kogen with a mystery treasure hunt, gem hunting, water play, seasonal food, and longer ropeway hours on 13–15 August.

sights.name: 2025 Yuzawa Kogen Summer Fair
sights.description: Summer fair at Yuzawa Kogen during summer vacation, with a new free-research workshop, water play, gem hunting, and extended ropeway hours on 13–16 August.

sights.name: Yuzawa Nakazato Katakuri-no-Sato (Dogtooth Violet Garden)
sights.name_ja: 湯沢中里 カタクリの里
sights.description: Dogtooth-violet colony in Yuzawa Nakazato, improved over several years, with a roughly 500-metre viewing path.

sights.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Snowshoe Tour
sights.name_ja: 越後湯沢スノーシューツアー
sights.description: Snowshoe hike from Echigo-Yuzawa Station’s west exit, where families walk through a snow-covered forest.

sights.name: Mount Mantaro (Asamadaira Bridge Trailhead)
sights.name_ja: 万太郎山・浅間平橋登山口
sights.description: A Tanigawa-range peak on the Niigata–Gunma border, with an advanced trail of about 5 hours 30 minutes from Asamadaira Bridge to the summit.

sights.name: Yomogi Pass
sights.description: Historic hiking pass on the Niigata–Gunma border at 1,540 m, with a mountain hut, bamboo-grass meadows, and summer daylilies.

sights.name: Hoshizora Terrace
sights.description: On clear spring nights, ride a gondola from the hotel to the summit to view stars above still forests and mountains.

sights.name: Gold Echigo-Yuzawa Country Club
sights.name_ja: ゴールド越後湯沢カントリークラブ
sights.description: An 18-hole golf course among trees in Yuzawa, generally flat, with well-maintained bentgrass greens.

sights.name: Forest Adventure Yuzawa-Nakazato
sights.name_ja: フォレストアドベンチャー・湯沢中里
sights.description: A forest outdoor park in Yuzawa where visitors move from tree to tree through the air using natural standing trees; reservations are required.

sights.name: Snow Activity Experience (Round-trip Bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station)
sights.name_en: Snow Activity Experience (Round-trip Bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station)
sights.name_ja: 越後湯沢駅から往復バスで行くスノーアクティビティ体験！
sights.description: A snow-activity outing by round-trip bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station to Matsunoyama Onsen Ski Area, open from age one.

sights.name: Niō Statues at Zuishōan Temple
sights.description: Two Niō statues by Ishikawa Unchō are enshrined in the tower gate of Zuishōan, a Sōtō Zen temple in the Yuzawa Tsuchitaru area.

sights.name: Mountain Bamboo Shoot and Wild Vegetable Week 2026
sights.name_en: Mountain Bamboo Shoot and Wild Vegetable Week 2026
sights.name_ja: 山たけのこ山菜ウィーク2026
sights.description: A lodging-only plan with a tour to pick slender nemagaritake bamboo shoots on the mountain facing Naeba Prince Hotel.

sights.name: NASPA ASOBI GARDEN
sights.description: Activity area at NASPA in Yuzawa with buggy rides, a heated pool, VR, a haunted house, and a laser maze.

sights.name: Yuzawa Nakazato Firefly Village
sights.name_ja: 湯沢中里 ホタルの里
sights.description: Firefly habitat in Yuzawa with a roughly 2 km boardwalk, where Genji and Heike fireflies fly from late June to early August.

sights.name: Mount Daigenta and Daigenta Canyon Trailhead
sights.name_en: Mount Daigenta and Daigenta Canyon Trailhead
sights.name_ja: 大源太山・大源太キャニオン登山口
sights.description: Trailhead for 1,598 m Mount Daigenta, a four-hour mid-level hike with Tanigawa and Uonuma range views from the summit.

sights.name: Snow Rafting at NASPA Ski Garden
sights.name_en: Snow Rafting at NASPA Ski Garden
sights.description: A snowmobile-towed raft spins across the snow at NASPA Ski Garden in Yuzawa, an activity suited to families and groups.

sights.name: Snow Night Buggy Tour at NASPA Ski Garden
sights.name_en: Snow Night Buggy Tour at NASPA Ski Garden
sights.name_ja: スノーナイトバギーツアー
sights.description: At NASPA Ski Garden, a driver pilots a six-seat mega buggy on a nighttime snow cruise for guests aged three and older.

sights.name: OKKY Power Museum (Okukiyotsu Power Station)
sights.name_ja: 電力ミュージアムOKKY（奥清津発電所）
sights.description: A hands-on museum at a real power station in Yuzawa, with generating equipment, a green plaza, and the Water Path exhibit.

sights.name: Snowmobile Driving Experience at NASPA Ski Garden
sights.name_en: Snowmobile Driving Experience at NASPA Ski Garden
sights.name_ja: スノーモービル運転体験
sights.description: Parents drive compact snowmobiles on a speed-limited course at Naeba Ski Resort; children aged 3 to 9 can join after a safety briefing.

sights.name: Yuzawa Nakazato Katakuri Village
sights.name_ja: 湯沢中里カタクリの里
sights.description: Katakuri colony in Yuzawa Nakazato, viewed along a roughly 500-meter path, peaking from late April to early May at snowmelt.

sights.name: Great Cedar of Suwa Shrine
sights.description: A 400-year-old Yuzawa Town natural monument, the cedar under which Snow Country's Komako is said to have cooled off.

sights.name: Mannenbashi Promenade
sights.description: A newly developed walking path on the right bank of the Uono River, for strolls while listening to the flowing water.

sights.name: Yuzawa Snowmobile Land
sights.name_ja: スノーモビルランド湯沢
sights.description: Snowmobile park in Yuzawa for mini-circuit rides, short tours, and fresh-snow runs, with instruction from basic controls.

stays.name: Naeba Prince Hotel
stays.name_ja: 苗場プリンスホテル
stays.description: Hotel in Mikuni, Yuzawa with ski access.

stays.name: NASPA New Otani
stays.name_ja: NASPAニューオータニ
stays.description: Hotel in Yuzawa, Niigata.

stays.name: Yuzawa Grand Hotel
stays.name_ja: 湯沢グランドホテル
stays.description: Hotel at Echigoyuzawa Onsen in Yuzawa.

stays.name: Matsu Izumi-kaku Kagetsu
stays.name_ja: 松泉閣花月
stays.description: Inn in Yuzawa with kaiseki dinners.

stays.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Onsen Ichibo Senri Oyuyado Nakaya
stays.name_en: Echigo-Yuzawa Onsen Ichibo Senri Oyuyado Nakaya
stays.name_ja: 越後湯沢温泉 一望千里 御湯宿 中屋
stays.description: Inn at Echigoyuzawa Onsen in Yuzawa with free-flowing hot spring baths and open-air baths.

stays.name: Meno Onsen Oku Yuzawa Kai Kakari Onsen
stays.name_en: Meno Onsen Oku Yuzawa Kai Kakari Onsen
